name: 8-Claws Scorpion
desc: Once per turn, you can flip this card into face-down Defense Position. When this card attacks an opponent's face-down Defense Position monster, this card's ATK becomes 2400 during damage calculation only.

name: A-Team: Trap Disposal Unit
desc: This effect can be used during either player's turn. When your opponent activates a Trap Card, Tribute this face-up card to negate the activation of the Trap Card and destroy it.
rulings: The effect of "A-Team: Trap Disposal Unit" is a Quick Effect that can be activated during either player's turn. (It does not target. Tributing "A-Team: Trap Disposal Unit" is a cost to activate this effect.)
The effect of "A-Team: Trap Disposal Unit" can be activated during the Damage Step.
This effect must be chained to the activation of an opponent's Trap Card. (It cannot be chained to the activation of the effect of a Trap Card.)

name: Abaki
desc: When this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard by battle, both players take 500 damage.

name: Advanced Crystal Beast Amber Mammoth
desc: If "Advanced Dark" is not in a Field Zone, send this monster to the GY. Once per turn, when your opponent activates a card or effect that targets your "Advanced Crystal Beast" card(s) or "Advanced Dark" (Quick Effect): You can negate the activation. Once per turn, when your "Advanced Crystal Beast" monster is targeted for an attack: You can negate that attack. If this face-up card is destroyed in a Monster Zone, you can place it face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell, instead of sending it to the GY.

name: Advanced Crystal Beast Amethyst Cat
desc: If "Advanced Dark" is not in a Field Zone, send this monster to the GY. Your "Advanced Crystal Beast" monsters can attack directly, but when they do so using this effect, the battle damage inflicted to your opponent is halved. If this face-up card is destroyed in a Monster Zone, you can place it face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell, instead of sending it to the GY.

name: Advanced Crystal Beast Cobalt Eagle
desc: If "Advanced Dark" is not in a Field Zone, send this monster to the GY. You can send this card from your hand or field to the GY; add 1 "Advanced Dark" from your Deck to your hand. Once per turn: You can target 1 "Advanced Crystal Beast" card you control; return it to the hand or place it on top of the Deck. If this face-up card is destroyed in a Monster Zone, you can place it face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell, instead of sending it to the GY.

name: Advanced Crystal Beast Emerald Tortoise
desc: If "Advanced Dark" is not in a Field Zone, send this monster to the GY. Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can target 1 face-up monster on the field; change its battle position. If this face-up card is destroyed in a Monster Zone, you can place it face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell, instead of sending it to the GY.

name: Advanced Crystal Beast Ruby Carbuncle
desc: If "Advanced Dark" is not in a Field Zone, send this monster to the GY. If this face-up card is destroyed in a Monster Zone, you can place it face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell, instead of sending it to the GY. While this card is treated as a Continuous Spell: You can Special Summon this card, then you can Special Summon as many "Advanced Crystal Beast" Monster Cards as possible from your Spell & Trap Zones. You can only use this effect of "Advanced Crystal Beast Ruby Carbuncle" once per turn.

name: Advanced Crystal Beast Sapphire Pegasus
desc: If "Advanced Dark" is not in a Field Zone, send this monster to the GY. If this card is Summoned: You can place 1 of your "Advanced Crystal Beast" monsters that is banished, or in your hand, Deck, or GY, face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell. If this face-up card is destroyed in a Monster Zone, you can place it face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell, instead of sending it to the GY.

name: Advanced Crystal Beast Topaz Tiger
desc: If "Advanced Dark" is not in a Field Zone, send this monster to the GY. All "Advanced Crystal Beast" monsters you control gain 400 ATK/DEF, also monsters your opponent controls lose 400 ATK/DEF. If this face-up card is destroyed in a Monster Zone, you can place it face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell, instead of sending it to the GY.

name: Agido
desc: When this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard as a result of battle, roll a six-sided die. You can Special Summon 1 Fairy-Type monster from your Graveyard whose Level is equal to the number rolled. (If the result is 6, you can Special Summon a Level 6 or higher monster.)
rulings: This card's effect does not target.

name: Airknight Parshath
desc: If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage. If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Draw 1 card.
rulings: If you draw a Fairy-Type monster during the Damage Step (such as by "Airknight Parshath"), you can activate the effect of "Tethys, Goddess of Light".

"Tragoedia"'s effect activates at the same time that "Airknight Parshath"'s effect activate. "Tragoedia"'s effect would be activated in chain to "Airknight Parshath", so you would Special Summon "Tragoedia" and then resolve "Airknight Parshath"'s effect.
The effect of "Gemini Soldier" activates after Damage Calculation - that is, it activates when battle damage is inflicted to the player's Life Points.

Example: "Gemini Soldier", in face-up Defense Position, is attacked by "Airknight Parshath". When Battle Damage is inflicted, the drawing effect of "Airknight Parshath" and the Special Summoning effect of "Gemini Soldier" both activate. They form a Chain, with the Turn Player's "Airknight Parshath" being Chain Link 1. Resolving backwards, "Gemini Soldier" first Special Summons a Gemini Monster, and then a card is drawn by the effect of "Airknight Parshath".

name: Amazoness Blowpiper
desc: Select 1 face-up monster your opponent controls during each of your Standby Phases. It loses 500 ATK until the end of this turn.

name: Amazoness Chain Master
desc: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can pay 1500 LP; look at your opponent's hand, then add 1 monster from their hand to your hand.
rulings: The effect is optional, and activates when "Amazoness Chain Master" is sent from the field to the Graveyard when destroyed by battle.

name: Amazoness Paladin
desc: This card gains 100 ATK for each "Amazoness" monster you control.
rulings: Amazoness Paladin itself counts for its ATK gaining effect.

name: Amazoness Swords Woman
desc: Your opponent takes any battle damage you would have taken from battles involving this card instead.

name: Amazoness Tiger
desc: You can only control 1 "Amazoness Tiger". This card gains 400 ATK for each "Amazoness" monster you control. Your opponent cannot attack any face-up "Amazoness" monsters, except this one.

name: Ambulanceroid
desc: When a "roid" monster is added from your Graveyard to your hand, you can Special Summon that monster.
rulings: The effect of "Ambulanceroid" is a Trigger Effect.
This card's effect does not target.
This card's effect cannot be activated during the Damage Step.

name: Ancient Dragon
desc: When this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent by a direct attack: You can increase this card's Level by 1 and ATK by 500.
rulings: This is an optional effect that can be activated when this card inflicts Battle Damage to the opponent's Life Points by a direct attack.

name: Ancient Gear
desc: If you control an "Ancient Gear", you can Special Summon this card (from your hand) in face-up Attack Position.

name: Ancient Gear Beast
desc: Cannot be Special Summoned. If this card attacks, your opponent cannot activate any Spell/Trap Cards until the end of the Damage Step. Negate the effects of an opponent's monster destroyed by battle with this card (including in the Graveyard).
rulings: The "Negate the effects of an opponent's monster destroyed by battle with this card (including in the Graveyard)." effect is a Continuous Effect.
The effects of an opponent's monster destroyed by battle with this card are negated, including effects that are applied or activated from the Graveyard.
The "If this card attacks, your opponent cannot activate any Spell/Trap Cards until the end of the Damage Step." effect is a Continuous Effect.
If "Ancient Gear Beast" is destroyed by battle, the "your opponent cannot activate any Spell/Trap Cards until the end of the Damage Step." effect is no longer applied.

name: Ancient Gear Cannon
desc: You can Tribute this card; inflict 500 damage to your opponent, and if you do, neither player can activate Trap Cards during the Battle Phase of this turn.
rulings: The effect of "Ancient Gear Cannon" is an Ignition Effect. (It does not target.)
Tributing "Ancient Gear Cannon" is a cost to activate this effect.

When the effect of "Ancient Gear Cannon" resolves, inflicting damage to your opponent is considered to be the last thing to happen. ("neither player can activate Trap Cards during the Battle Phase of this turn." is also applied.)
After the effect of "Ancient Gear Cannon" is applied, neither player can activate Trap Cards during the Battle Phase of this turn. (The effects of face-up Continuous Trap Cards can be activated.)

name: Ancient Gear Engineer
desc: Negate any Trap effects that target this card, and if you do, destroy that Trap Card. If this card attacks, your opponent cannot activate any Spell/Trap Cards until the end of the Damage Step. At the end of the Damage Step, if this card attacked: Target 1 Spell/Trap Card your opponent controls; destroy that target.
rulings: The effect "Negate any Trap effects that target this card, and if you do, destroy that Trap Card." is a Continuous Effect.
The effect "If this card attacks, your opponent cannot activate any Spell/Trap Cards until the end of the Damage Step." is a Continuous Effect.

The effect "At the end of the Damage Step, if this card attacked: Target 1 Spell/Trap Card your opponent controls; destroy that target." is a Trigger Effect. (It targets 1 Spell/Trap Card your opponent controls. It is always activated at the end of the Damage Step in which "Ancient Gear Engineer" attacked.)
Even if "Ancient Gear Engineer" attacks and is destroyed by battle, the effect "Target 1 Spell/Trap Card your opponent controls; destroy that target." is activated at the end of the Damage Step.

The effect "Target 1 Spell/Trap Card your opponent controls; destroy that target." is activated at the end of the Damage Step in which "Ancient Gear Engineer" attacked. However, if "Ancient Gear Engineer" attacks a face-down Defense Position "Shaddoll Squamata", and "Ancient Gear Engineer" is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard by the effect of "Shaddoll Squamata" after damage calculation, then the effect "Target 1 Spell/Trap Card your opponent controls; destroy that target." is not activated.

name: Ancient Gear Golem
desc: Cannot be Special Summoned. If this card attacks, your opponent cannot activate any Spell/Trap Cards until the end of the Damage Step. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage.
rulings: The "If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent. " effect is a Continuous Effect.
The "If this card attacks, your opponent cannot activate any Spell/Trap Cards until the end of the Damage Step." effect is a Continuous Effect.
If "Ancient Gear Golem" is destroyed by battle, the "your opponent cannot activate any Spell/Trap Cards until the end of the Damage Step." effect is no longer applied.
Even if this effect of "Ancient Gear Golem" is being applied, the effects of face-up Continuous Trap Cards can still be activated.

You can activate "Spell Gear" if you have 1 copy of "Ancient Gear Golem" in either your hand or Deck. You can activate "Spell Gear" if you have 1 copy of "Ancient Gear Golem" in both your hand and Deck. You cannot activate "Spell Gear" if you have no copies of "Ancient Gear Golem" in either your hand and your Deck.

"Inferno Reckless Summon" may be activated if your opponent only controls monsters like "Ancient Gear Golem" or "The Wicked Dreadroot" which cannot be Special Summoned. When resolving "Inferno Reckless Summon", your opponent cannot select a monster that cannot be Special Summoned, so only your monsters will be Special Summoned.

The text "cannot activate any Spell/Trap Cards" of "Ancient Gear Golem" means that the opponent cannot activate Quick-Play Spell Cards from the hand or Set Spell/Trap Cards. When "Ancient Gear Golem" attacks, your opponent can activate the effect of an "Ultimate Offering" which is already face-up on the field. Also, if "Ancient Gear Golem" attacks and a Set "Statue of the Wicked" is destroyed, then its effect will activate.

name: Ancient Gear Soldier
desc: If this card attacks, your opponent cannot activate any Spell/Trap Cards until the end of the Damage Step.
rulings: The effect of "Ancient Gear Soldier" is a Continuous Effect.
If "Ancient Gear Soldier" is destroyed by battle, the "your opponent cannot activate any Spell/Trap Cards until the end of the Damage Step." effect is no longer applied.
Even if the effect of "Ancient Gear Soldier" is being applied, the effects of face-up Continuous Trap Cards can still be activated.

name: Anti-Aircraft Flower
desc: By Tributing 1 Insect-Type monster on your side of the field, inflict 800 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points.

name: Arcana Force 0 - The Fool
desc: This card cannot be destroyed by battle. This card cannot be changed to Defense Position, except with a card effect. When this card is Summoned: Toss a coin and gain the appropriate effect. ● Heads: Negate your card effects that target this card, and destroy them. ● Tails: Negate your opponent's card effects that target this card, and destroy them.

name: Arcana Force EX - The Dark Ruler
desc:
Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by sending 3 monsters you control to the Graveyard, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. When this card is Special Summoned: Toss a coin and gain the appropriate effect.
● Heads: This card can make a second attack during each Battle Phase, but if it does so using this effect, change it to Defense Position at the end of the Battle Phase. Its battle position cannot be changed until the end of your next turn.
● Tails: If this card is destroyed, destroy all cards on the field.

name: Arcana Force EX - The Light Ruler
desc:
Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by sending 3 monsters you control to the Graveyard, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. When this card is Special Summoned: Toss a coin and gain the appropriate effect.
● Heads: When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: You can target 1 card in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand.
● Tails: During either player's turn, when a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, that targets this card is activated: This card loses exactly 1000 ATK and you negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.
rulings: It is not treated as an effect. It is a procedure to Special Summon this monster from the hand.
Special Summoning this way does not start a Chain Link.
The Special Summon is performed after sending 3 monsters from your Monster Zone to the Graveyard. (Sending monsters to the Graveyard and Special Summoning this card do not happen at the same time.)

As a general rule, this card can only be Special Summoned this way. However, as long as it is with an effect that Special Summons by ignoring the Summoning conditions, this card can be Special Summoned if it is in the hand or Deck, or if it was was banished face-up after being Summoned properly.
It is a Trigger Effect that activates in the Monster Zone.
It activates mandatorily.
When resolving this effect, toss a coin and this card gains the appropriate "●" effect based on the result.
It is a Trigger Effect that can be activated in the Monster Zone.
It can be activated at the end of the Damage Step.
It can be activated even if this card destroys an opponent's monster that you own by battle and sends it to the Graveyard.
It cannot be activated if this card battles a monster with the same ATK and both monsters are destroyed.
It is a Quick Effect that activates in the Monster Zone.

It is activated directly in response to the activation of a monster effect that targets this card, or the activation of a Spell/Trap Card that targets this card. (This effect cannot be activated in response to the activation of a Spell/Trap Card's effect if it is not applied as part of the card activation.)
It activates even if this card has less than 1000 ATK.
It activates even during the Damage Step.
At resolution, if this card has 1000 or more ATK, apply "This card loses exactly 1000 ATK", and this card lost 1000 ATK successfully, apply "negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it".
Decreasing this card's ATK and negating/destroying a card happen at the same time.

name: Arcana Force I - The Magician
desc:
When this card is Summoned, toss a coin:
● Heads: When a Spell Card is activated, this card's ATK becomes double its original ATK until the End Phase of that turn.
● Tails: When a Spell Card is activated, your opponent gains 500 Life Points.

name: Arcana Force III - The Empress
desc: When this card is Summoned, toss a coin: ● Heads: Each time your opponent Normal Summons or Sets a monster, you can Special Summon 1 "Arcana Force" monster from your hand. ● Tails: Each time your opponent Normal Summons or Sets a monster, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.

name: Arcana Force IV - The Emperor
desc: When this card is Summoned, toss a coin: ● Heads: All "Arcana Force" monsters you control gain 500 ATK. ● Tails: All "Arcana Force" monsters you control lose 500 ATK.

name: Arcana Force VI - The Lovers
desc: When this card is Summoned, toss a coin: ● Heads: This card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of an "Arcana Force" monster. ● Tails: You cannot Tribute Summon "Arcana Force" monsters.

name: Arcana Force VII - The Chariot
desc:
When this card is Summoned, toss a coin:
● Heads: If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle, you can Special Summon that monster to your side of the field.
● Tails: Your opponent gains control of this card.
rulings: The monster effect "When this card is Summoned, toss a coin" is a Trigger Effect that is always activated when "Arcana Force VII - The Chariot" is successfully Normal, Flip, or Special Summoned. (It does not target.)
When the effect resolves, toss a coin, and which effect is gained is determined by the result.

The monster effect "Heads: If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle, you can Special Summon that monster to your side of the field" is a Trigger Effect. (It does not target. If the "Arcana Force VII - The Chariot" itself that gained the effect destroys an opponent's monster by battle, at the end of the Damage Step the effect can optionally be activated.

If the "Arcana Force VII - The Chariot" itself that gained the effect has the same ATK as the monster it battles, the monster effect "you can Special Summon that monster to your side of the field" cannot be activated.
If "Tails: Your opponent gains control of this card" is gained as a result of the coin toss, that effect is immediately applied.

name: Arcana Force XII - The Hangman
desc:
When a card or effect is activated (Quick Effect): You can reveal this card in your hand; Special Summon 1 "Arcana Force" monster from your hand in Defense Position. You can only use this effect of "Arcana Force XII - The Hangman" once per turn. If this card is Summoned: Toss a coin.
● Heads: Destroy 1 monster you control, and if you do, take damage equal to its original ATK.
● Tails: Destroy 1 monster your opponent controls, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to its original ATK.

name: Arcana Force XIV - Temperance
desc:
During damage calculation, in either player's turn: You can discard this card; you take no Battle Damage from that battle. When this card is Summoned: Toss a coin and apply this effect. The effect lasts while this card is face-up on the field.
● Heads: Halve all Battle Damage you take.
● Tails: Halve all Battle Damage your opponent takes.

name: Arcana Force XV - The Fiend
desc:
You can discard this card; add 1 "Light Barrier" from your Deck or GY to your hand. If this card is Summoned: Toss a coin and this card gains the appropriate effect.
● Heads: When an attack is declared involving this card: You can target 1 monster on the field; destroy it, and if you do, inflict 500 damage to its controller.
● Tails: If an attack is declared involving this card: Destroy all monsters on the field.
rulings: [Regarding the effect "You can discard this card; add 1 "Light Barrier" from your Deck or GY to your hand."]
It is an Ignition Effect that can be activated in the hand.
[Regarding the effect "If this card is Summoned: Toss a coin and gain the appropriate effect."]
It is a Trigger Effect that activates in the Monster Zone.
It is mandatory to activate.
It also activates during the Damage Step.
[Regarding the effect "● Heads: When an attack is declared involving this card: You can target 1 monster on the field; destroy it, and if you do, inflict 500 damage to its controller."]
It is a Trigger Effect that can be activated in the Monster Zone.
When resolving this effect, destroy the targeted monster, and if it is successfully destroyed, inflict 500 damage to its controller.
Destroying the targeted monster and inflicting damage to its controller occur simultaneously.
[Regarding the effect "● Tails: When an attack is declared involving this card: Destroy all monsters on the field."]
It is a Trigger Effect that activates in the Monster Zone.
It is mandatory to activate.

name: Arcana Force XVIII - The Moon
desc: When this card is Summoned, toss a coin: ● Heads: During your Standby Phase, you can Special Summon 1 "Moon Token" (Fairy-Type/LIGHT/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0). ● Tails: During each of your End Phases, select 1 monster you control and give control of it to your opponent.
rulings: The effect that Special Summons 1 "Moon Token" during your Standby Phase is an optional effect.
The effect that gives the control of 1 of your monsters to the opponent during the End Phase is a mandatory effect.
The effect that gives the control of 1 of your monsters to the opponent during the End Phase targets 1 monster on your side of the field.
The monster that has switched control to the opponent with this card's effect remains on the opponent's side of the field, until it is removed from the field.

name: Arcana Force XXI - The World
desc: When this card is Summoned, toss a coin: ● Heads: During your End Phase, you can send 2 monsters you control to the Graveyard to skip your opponent's next turn. ● Tails: During your opponent's Draw Phase, add the top card of their Graveyard to their hand.
rulings: If your third End Phase is skipped by an effect like "Arcana Force XXI - The World", then "Depth Amulet" is not destroyed and remains face-up on the field.

name: Archlord Zerato
desc: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by Tributing 1 face-up "Warrior of Zera" on your side of the field while "The Sanctuary in the Sky" is on the field. If "The Sanctuary in the Sky" is on your side of the field, by discarding 1 LIGHT Monster Card from your hand to the Graveyard, destroy all monsters on your opponent's side of the field. If "The Sanctuary in the Sky" is not on your side of the field, this effect is not applied.

name: Armed Dragon LV10
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing 1 "Armed Dragon LV7". You can send 1 card from your hand to the GY; destroy all face-up monsters your opponent controls.

name: Armed Dragon LV10 White
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned by its own effect. You can banish "Armed Dragon" monsters from your field and/or GY whose total Levels equal 10; Special Summon this card from your hand, then you can add 1 "White Veil" from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Armed Dragon LV10 White" once per turn. You take no effect damage. At the start of the Damage Step, if this card attacks: You can destroy 1 card on the field.

name: Armed Dragon LV3
desc: During your Standby Phase: You can send this card to the GY; Special Summon 1 "Armed Dragon LV5" from your hand or Deck.

name: Armed Dragon LV5
desc: You can send 1 monster from your hand to the GY, then target 1 monster your opponent controls with ATK less than or equal to the sent monster's ATK; destroy that target. During the End Phase, if this card destroyed a monster by battle this turn: You can send this card to the GY; Special Summon 1 "Armed Dragon LV7" from your hand or Deck.
rulings: If "Majestic Star Dragon" negates the effects of a monster like "Armed Dragon LV5" with multiple effects, then you can activate the effects of the negated monster as the effect of "Majestic Star Dragon" a total of once. Thus, if you activate the effect "Armed Dragon LV5" which destroys a monster as the effect of "Majestic Star Dragon", then later on you cannot activate the effect of "Armed Dragon LV5" which Special Summons "Armed Dragon LV7" as the effect of "Majestic Star Dragon".

name: Armed Dragon LV7
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned by "Armed Dragon LV5". You can send 1 monster from your hand to the GY; destroy all monsters your opponent controls with ATK less than or equal to that sent monster's ATK.
rulings: If "Majestic Star Dragon" negates the effects of a monster like "Armed Dragon LV5" with multiple effects, then you can activate the effects of the negated monster as the effect of "Majestic Star Dragon" a total of once. Thus, if you activate the effect "Armed Dragon LV5" which destroys a monster as the effect of "Majestic Star Dragon", then later on you cannot activate the effect of "Armed Dragon LV5" which Special Summons "Armed Dragon LV7" as the effect of "Majestic Star Dragon".

name: Armed Samurai - Ben Kei
desc: For each Equip Card equipped to this card, it gains 1 additional attack during each Battle Phase.

name: Armor Breaker
desc: Once per turn, you can equip this card to a Warrior-Type monster you control, OR unequip it to Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position. While equipped to a monster by this effect, when that monster inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, destroy 1 card on the field. (A monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle, this card is destroyed instead.)

name: Armored Cybern
desc: Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 "Cyber Dragon" you control, or 1 Fusion Monster you control that lists "Cyber Dragon" as Fusion Material; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it. Once per turn, while equipped to a monster by this effect: You can target 1 face-up monster on the field; the equipped monster loses exactly 1000 ATK (even if this card leaves the field), and if it does, destroy that target. If the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle or card effect, destroy this card instead.
rulings: The "equip to a monster" effect of "Armored Cybern" is an Ignition Effect.
While "Armored Cybern" is equipped to a monster, its effects are treated as the effects of an Equip Spell Card.
The effect of "Armored Cybern" which inflicts damage to the opponent starts a Chain Link.
Decreasing the monster's ATK by 1000 occurs when resolving the effect of "Armored Cybern" which destroys a monster. It is not a cost to activate the effect.
While "Armored Cybern" is equipped as an Equip Card, its effect targets the one face-up monster that it destroys. The target is selected at activation.

If a monster's ATK is decreased by 1000 by the effect of "Armored Cybern", then the decrease remains only as long as "Armored Cybern" remains equipped to the monster. If "Armored Cybern" is no longer an Equip Card, then the monster's ATK returns to its original value.

name: Asura Priest
desc: Cannot be Special Summoned. During the End Phase of the turn this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up: Return it to the hand. This card can attack all monsters your opponent controls once each.
rulings: If your opponent controls one monster and you attack it with "Asura Priest", but the monster is removed from the field during the Battle Step, then a replay occurs and "Asura Priest" can attack directly.

"Asura Priest" can only attack each monster once. If "Asura Priest" attacks "Krebons" and "Krebons" uses its effect to negate the attack, then "Asura Priest" cannot attack the same "Krebons" a second time. However, it may still attack other monsters.

name: Atomic Firefly
desc: When this face-up card on the field attacks or is attacked and it is destroyed as a result of battle, the player who destroyed it takes 1000 points of damage.

name: B.E.S. Crystal Core
desc: When this card is Normal Summoned, put 3 counters on it. This card cannot be destroyed by battle. If this card attacks or is attacked, remove 1 counter from this card at the end of the Damage Step. If you cannot, destroy it. Once per turn, during your Main Phase, you can change 1 face-up Attack Position monster your opponent controls to face-up Defense Position.

name: B.E.S. Tetran
desc: When this card is Normal Summoned, put 3 counters on it. This card cannot be destroyed by battle. If this card attacks or is attacked, remove 1 counter from this card at the end of the Damage Step. If you cannot, destroy it. Once per turn, you can remove 1 counter on this card to destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card on the field.

name: Babycerasaurus
desc: If this card is destroyed by a card effect and sent to the Graveyard: Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Dinosaur-Type monster from your Deck.

name: Balloon Lizard
desc: Put 1 counter on this card during each of your Standby Phases. When this card is destroyed, inflict damage to the controller of the card that destroyed it equal to the number of counters X 400 points.

name: Beiige, Vanguard of Dark World
desc: If this card is discarded to the Graveyard by a card effect: Special Summon it from the Graveyard.
rulings: This is a Trigger Effect that begins a chain.

name: Berserk Dragon
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned with "A Deal with Dark Ruler" and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. This card can attack all monsters your opponent controls once each. During each of your End Phases, this card loses 500 ATK.
rulings: This card cannot be Special Summoned, except with "A Deal with Dark Ruler".
If "Berserk Dragon" attacks all your opponent's monsters and destroys them all by battle, then "Berserk Dragon" cannot attack directly.
When "Berserk Dragon" attacks directly, if your opponent Special Summons a monster afterwards, then "Berserk Dragon" cannot attack that monster.
If you attack with this card and then attack with a different monster, then this card can attack another monster.

If "Crystal Beast Sapphire Pegasus" is Special Summoned by "Call of the Haunted" as Chain Link 2 or higher, this effect cannot be activated.

name: Crystal Beast Topaz Tiger
desc: If this card attacks an opponent's monster, it gains 400 ATK during the Damage Step only. If this face-up card is destroyed while it is in a Monster Card Zone, you can place it face-up in your Spell & Trap Card Zone as a Continuous Spell Card, instead of sending it to the Graveyard.

name: Cyber Barrier Dragon
desc: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except with "Attack Reflector Unit". Once per turn, while this card is in Attack Position, your opponent's next attack is negated.

name: Cyber Dragon
desc: If only your opponent controls a monster, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand).
rulings: The effects of "Thunder King Rai-Oh", "Black Horn of Heaven", "Solemn Judgment", and similar cards can only be activated when a monster Special Summons itself without starting a Chain, such as when a Special Summon monster Special Summons itself.
Example: The effect of "Thunder King Rai-Oh" can negate the Special Summon of "Cyber Dragon", "Dark Armed Dragon", and "Endymion, the Master Magician".

If "Solemn Judgment" is activated to negate the Special Summon of "Cyber Dragon", then "Cyber Dragon" is not considered to be in the hand when the effect of "Solemn Judgment" resolves. Thus, if a player controls "The Fabled Unicore", both players have 5 cards in their hands, and "Solemn Judgment" is activated when "Cyber Dragon" is being Special Summoned, then when resolving the effect of "Solemn Judgment" one player has 4 cards in his hand and the other player has 5, so the effect of "The Fabled Unicore" is not applied and the effect of "Solemn Judgment" will not be negated.

name: Cyber Esper
desc: While this card is in face-up Attack Position, you can look at every card your opponent draws.

name: Cyber Gymnast
desc: Once per turn: You can discard 1 card, then target 1 face-up Attack Position monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.

name: Cyber Kirin
desc: You can Tribute this card to make any effect damage you take this turn 0.

name: Cyber Laser Dragon
desc: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except with "Photon Generator Unit". Once per turn, you can destroy 1 monster with ATK or DEF equal to or higher than the ATK of this card.

name: Cyber Ogre
desc: By discarding this card from your hand to the Graveyard, negate 1 battle involving a "Cyber Ogre" on your side of the field, and it gains 2000 ATK until the end of its next battle. This effect can be activated during either player's turn.

name: Cyber Ouroboros
desc: When this card is removed from play, you can send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard to draw 1 card.
rulings: Sending 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard is a cost to activate this effect.

name: Cyber Petit Angel
desc: If this card is Summoned: You can add 1 "Cyber Angel" monster or "Machine Angel Ritual" from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Cyber Petit Angel" once per turn.

name: Cyber Phoenix
desc: While this card is in Attack Position, negate any Spell/Trap effects that target 1 Machine monster you control (and no other cards). When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can draw 1 card.
rulings: The effect "While this card is in Attack Position, negate any Spell/Trap effects that target 1 Machine monster you control (and no other cards)" is a Continuous Effect.

It negates the effects of Spell/Trap Cards that target 1 face-up Machine monster in your Monster Zone. (It cannot negate effects that target 2 monsters, or effects that target 1 monster and 1 Spell/Trap Card.)
The effect "When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can draw 1 card" is a Trigger Effect that activates in the Graveyard. (It activates at the end of the Damage Step.)
If a face-down Defense Position "Cyber Phoenix" is attacked and destroyed after being flipped face-up by battle, its effect can be activated.

name: Cyber Prima
desc: If this card is Tribute Summoned: Destroy all face-up Spell Cards on the field.

name: Cyber Raider
desc:
If this card is Summoned: Activate 1 of these effects.
● Target 1 Equip Card on the field; destroy that target.
● Target 1 Equip Card on the field; equip that target to this card.

name: Cyber Tutu
desc: If the ATK of each monster your opponent controls is higher than the ATK of this card, this card can attack your opponent directly.

name: Cyber Valley
desc:
You can use 1 of these effects.
● When this card is targeted for an attack by an opponent's monster: You can banish this card; draw 1 card, then end the Battle Phase.
● You can target 1 face-up monster you control and this card; banish both that target and this card, then draw 2 cards.
● You can target 1 card in your GY; banish both this card and 1 card from your hand, then place that target on top of the Deck.
rulings: The "When this card is targeted for an attack by an opponent's monster: You can banish this card; draw 1 card, then end the Battle Phase." effect is a Trigger Effect. (It does not target. Banishing this card is a cost to activate this effect. Drawing 1 card and ending the Battle Phase are not considered to happen simultaneously.)

The "You can target 1 face-up monster you control and this card; banish both that target and this card, then draw 2 cards." effect is an Ignition Effect. (It targets 1 face-up monster you control and this card. Banishing and drawing 2 cards are not considered to happen simultaneously.)

The "You can target 1 card in your Graveyard; banish this card and 1 card from your hand, then place that target on top of the Deck." effect is an Ignition Effect. (It targets 1 card in your Graveyard. Banishing and placing the targeted card on top of the Deck are not considered to happen simultaneously.)

name: Cyberdark Edge
desc: If this card is Normal Summoned: Target 1 Level 3 or lower Dragon monster in your GY; equip that Dragon monster to this card. Gains ATK equal to the original ATK of the monster equipped to it by this effect. This card can attack directly. If it does using this effect, its ATK is halved during damage calculation only. If this card would be destroyed by battle, destroy the monster equipped to it by its effect, instead.
rulings: The monster effect "If this card is Normal Summoned: Target 1 Level 3 or lower Dragon monster in your GY; equip that Dragon monster to this card" is a Trigger Effect. (It targets 1 Level 3 or lower Dragon-Type monster in the player's Graveyard.)
The monster effect "Gains ATK equal to the original ATK of the monster equipped to it by this effect" is a Continuous Effect.
The monster effect "This card can attack directly. If it does using this effect, its ATK is halved during damage calculation only" is a Continuous Effect.
The monster effect "If this card would be destroyed by battle, destroy the monster equipped to it by its effect, instead" is a Continuous Effect.

name: Cyberdark Horn
desc: If this card is Normal Summoned: Target 1 Level 3 or lower Dragon monster in your GY; equip that Dragon monster to this card. Gains ATK equal to the original ATK of the monster equipped to it by this effect. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage. If this card would be destroyed by battle, destroy the monster equipped to it by its effect, instead.

name: Cyberdark Keel
desc: If this card is Normal Summoned: Target 1 Level 3 or lower Dragon monster in your GY; equip that Dragon monster to this card. Gains ATK equal to the original ATK of the monster equipped to it by this effect. If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: Inflict 300 damage to your opponent. If this card would be destroyed by battle, destroy the monster equipped to it by its effect, instead.

name: D.D. Crazy Beast
desc: A monster that this card destroys as a result of battle is removed from play.

name: D.D. Scout Plane
desc: Once per turn, during the End Phase, if this card is currently banished, and was banished this turn: Special Summon it in face-up Attack Position.
rulings: "Junk Synchron" only negates effects that activate on the field. It will not negate the effect of "D.D. Scout Plane" (which activates in the Banished Zone).
If "Prohibition" declares "D.D. Scout Plane", the effect of "D.D. Scout Plane" will not activate during the End Phase if "D.D. Scout Plane" is banished from the hand, Deck, or Graveyard.

If "Armed Sea Hunter" destroys "D.D. Scout Plane" by battle and "D.D. Scout Plane" is banished by "Macro Cosmos", then the effect of "D.D. Scout Plane" is not negated. It will be Special Summoned during the End Phase.

The effects of "Neo-Spacian Dark Panther" or "Phantom of Chaos" are only applied as long as "Phantom of Chaos" or "Neo-Spacian Dark Panther" are face-up on the field. When the monster leaves the field, then it no longer has the copied effects. If a monster like "Neo-Spacian Dark Panther" copies "Sangan" or "D.D. Scout Plane", then you cannot activate the effect of "Sangan" which activates in the Graveyard or the effect of "D.D. Scout Plane" which activates in the place to where cards are banished.

If "Hundred Eyes Dragon" gains a monster's effect(s), then it has the monster's effect(s) as long as it remains face-up on the field. If "Hundred Eyes Dragon" leaves the field, then it no longer has the monster's effect(s). Thus, if "Hundred Eyes Dragon" gains the effect of "Sangan" or "D.D. Scout Plane", then you cannot activate the gained effects.

name: D.D. Warrior Lady
desc: After damage calculation, when this card battles an opponent's monster: You can banish that monster, also banish this card.
rulings: The effects of "D.D. Warrior Lady" and "D.D. Warrior" activate after performing Damage Calculation.

If "Ally of Justice Core Destroyer" attacks a face-up "D.D. Warrior Lady", then "D.D. Warrior Lady" is destroyed by the effect of "Ally of Justice Core Destroyer" without performing damage calculation. Thus, the effect of "D.D. Warrior Lady" which activates after damage calculation cannot be activated.

name: Dandylion
desc: If this card is sent to the Graveyard: Special Summon 2 "Fluff Tokens" (Plant-Type/WIND/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) in Defense Position. These Tokens cannot be Tributed for a Tribute Summon during the turn they are Special Summoned.
rulings: If "Doppelwarrior" and "Dandylion" are used as Synchro Material Monsters to Synchro Summon "Trishula, Dragon of the Ice Barrier", the Turn Player would be able to activate all three Trigger effects, placing the effect of "Dandylion" first on the Chain (Mandatory), followed by the other two effects (the Turn Player will choose the order of which effect goes on Chain link 2 and which would go on Chain link 3).

This effect starts a Chain Link even if all of your Monster Zones are occupied. However, no "Fluff Tokens" will be Special Summoned. Also, if you have 2 or more empty Monster Zones when this effect is activated, but there's only 1 empty Monster Zone when this effect resolves, no "Fluff Tokens" will be Special Summoned.

If you Tribute Summon "Light and Darkness Dragon" by Tributing "Sangan" and "Dandylion", after you choose in which order to place their effects in a Chain, "Light and Darkness Dragon" will activate its effect as Chain Link 3. Therefore, the effect activated as Chain Link 2 will be negated by "Light and Darkness Dragon".
When "Dandylion" is sent to the Graveyard after the effect of "Calming Magic" has resolved, its effect activates, but no "Fluff Tokens" will be Special Summoned.

If "Dandylion" is discarded as a cost for "Monster Reincarnation", and that "Dandylion" that was discarded as a cost is added to the hand by "Monster Reincarnation", the effect of "Dandylion" does not activate.

name: Dark Catapulter
desc: During your Standby Phase, if this card is in Defense Position, put 1 counter on this card. You can remove from play a number of card(s) in your Graveyard equal to the number of counters on this card to destroy that many Spell or Trap Card(s) on the field. Then remove all counter(s) from this card.

name: Dark Creator
desc: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by Tributing 2 Fiend and/or Fairy monsters. Cannot be destroyed by battle. Once per turn: You can Special Summon as many "Dark Creator Tokens" (Fiend/DARK/Level 10/ATK 3000/DEF 1000) as possible, but they cannot attack directly or be destroyed by battle, destroy them when this card is destroyed, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn. If a monster(s) is destroyed by battle: Inflict 700 damage to your opponent.

name: Dark Driceratops
desc: If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage.

name: Dark Guardian
desc:
(This card is always treated as a "Gate Guardian" card.)
Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be either Special Summoned by "Dark Element", or Special Summoned (from your hand or GY) by shuffling into the Deck, 1 each of your "Sanga of the Thunder", "Kazejin", and "Suijin" that is in your hand, face-up field, GY, and/or banished. Cannot be destroyed by battle. If this card is Special Summoned by the effect of "Dark Element", it is unaffected by other monsters' effects or your opponent's activated Spell Cards or effects.

name: Dark Jeroid
desc: If this card is Summoned: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; it loses 800 ATK.

name: Dark Magician Knight
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned with "Knight's Title" and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. When this card is Special Summoned: Target 1 card on the field; destroy that target.

name: Dark Magician of Chaos
desc: During the End Phase, if this card was Normal or Special Summoned this turn: You can target 1 Spell in your GY; add it to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Dark Magician of Chaos" once per turn. If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle, after damage calculation: Banish that opponent's monster. If this face-up card would leave the field, banish it instead.
rulings: The effect "During the End Phase, if this card was Normal or Special Summoned this turn: You can target 1 Spell Card in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand." is a Trigger Effect. (It does not start a Chain Link when this card is Normal or Special Summoned. It is activated during the End Phase. It targets 1 Spell Card in your Graveyard.)
During the turn "Dark Magician of Chaos" was Normal or Special Summoned, this effect cannot be activated if it leaves the field before the End Phase, for example, by being destroyed.

The effect "If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle, after damage calculation: Banish that opponent's monster." is a Trigger Effect. (It does not target. It is a mandatory effect that activates when this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle.)
If "Dark Magician of Chaos" battles a monster with the same ATK and both monsters are destroyed by battle, this effect still activates, and the opponent's monster is banished.
The effect "If this face-up card would leave the field, banish it instead." is not treated as an Ignition, Trigger, Quick or Continuous Effect.

name: Dark Scorpion - Chick the Yellow
desc:
When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, you can activate 1 of these effects:
● Target 1 card on the field; return that target to the hand.
● Look at the top card of their Deck, then return it to the top or bottom of the Deck.

name: Dark Scorpion - Gorg the Strong
desc:
When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, you can activate 1 of these effects:
● Target 1 monster your opponent controls; return that target to the top of the Deck.
● Send the top card of their Deck to the Graveyard.

name: Dark Scorpion - Meanae the Thorn
desc:
When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, you can activate 1 of these effects:
● Add 1 "Dark Scorpion" card from your Deck to your hand.
● Target 1 "Dark Scorpion" card in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand.

name: Dark Summoning Beast
desc: You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 "Uria, Lord of Searing Flames", "Hamon, Lord of Striking Thunder", or "Raviel, Lord of Phantasms" from your hand or Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions, also monsters you control cannot attack for the rest of this turn. You can only use this effect of "Dark Summoning Beast" once per turn. You can banish this card from your Graveyard; add 1 "Uria, Lord of Searing Flames", "Hamon, Lord of Striking Thunder", or "Raviel, Lord of Phantasms" from your Deck to your hand.

name: Darkbishop Archfiend
desc: The controller of this card pays 500 Life Points during each of his/her Standby Phases (this is not optional). When an Archfiend Monster Card on your side of the field is targeted by the effect of a card controlled by your opponent, when resolving the effect, roll a six-sided die. If the result is 1, 3, or 6, negate the effect and destroy the opponent's card.

name: Darkness Destroyer
desc: Cannot be Special Summoned. This card can attack twice during each Battle Phase. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing Battle Damage to your opponent.
rulings: This monster is not a Special Summon Monster.

name: Darkness Neosphere
desc: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by sending 1 Fiend-Type monster you control and 1 Fiend-Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard when your opponent's monster declares an attack. This card cannot be destroyed by battle. Once per turn, you can return all face-up Trap Cards you control to the hand.
rulings: "Darkness Neosphere" is a Special Summon monster.
Sending a total of two monsters from your hand and Field to the Graveyard is a cost to activate the effect of "Darkness Neosphere" which Special Summons it.
The effect of "Darkness Neosphere" which Special Summons it from the hand activates when an opponent's monster declares an attack.
"Darkness Neosphere" has "Neos" in its name, so it may be used as a Fusion Material Monster for "Elemental Hero Divine Neos".
"Darkness Neosphere" can only be Special Summoned by the method written on the card. It cannot be Special Summoned from the Graveyard by an effect like "Monster Reborn".

When your opponent declares an attack, you cannot send a face-down Fiend-Type monster from your field to the Graveyard as a cost to activate the effect of "Darkness Neosphere" which Special Summons it.

If you have copies of "Ogre of the Scarlet Sorrow", "Battle Fader", and "Darkness Neosphere" in your hand and your opponent declares a second direct attack, then you can only activate one of those card's effects and Special Summon one of those cards.

name: Decoyroid
desc: While this card is face-up on your side of the field, your opponent cannot select a face-up monster as an attack target except "Decoyroid".

name: Deep Diver
desc: At the end of the Battle Phase, if this card was destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: Choose 1 monster from your Deck and place it on top of your Deck.
rulings: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, you must activate the effect. It is not optional.
You must show the card to your opponent.

name: Dekoichi the Battlechanted Locomotive
desc: FLIP: Draw 1 card, then draw 1 additional card for each face-up "Bokoichi the Freightening Car" you control.

name: Demiurge Ema
desc: If this card is in your hand: You can send 4 monsters with 2400 or more ATK and 1000 DEF from your hand, Deck, and/or face-up field to the GY; Special Summon this card. You can target 1 Spell/Trap on each field; destroy them, then Special Summon 1 "Homunculus Token" (Fairy/LIGHT/Level 2/ATK 800/DEF 800) to both players' fields in Defense Position, and if you do, this card gains 1600 ATK. You can only use each effect of "Demiurge Ema" once per turn.

name: Des Feral Imp
desc: FLIP: Target 1 card in your Graveyard; shuffle that target into the Deck.

name: Des Frog
desc: When this card is Tribute Summoned, you can Special Summon "Des Frog"(s) from your hand or Deck up to the number of "T.A.D.P.O.L.E."(s) in your Graveyard.

name: Des Kangaroo
desc: If the ATK of a monster that attacks this monster in Defense Position is lower than the DEF of this card, destroy the attacking monster. (Damage calculation is applied normally.)
rulings: The effect of "Des Kangaroo" is a Trigger Effect.
It does not target. If a Defense Position "Des Kangaroo" is attacked by an opponent's monster whose ATK is less than the DEF of "Des Kangaroo", its effect activates at the end of the Damage Step.
Even if a face-down Defense Position "Des Kangaroo" is attacked by an opponent's monster, if "the ATK of a monster that attacks this monster is lower than the DEF of this card", its effect activates.

name: Des Koala
desc: FLIP: Inflict 400 damage to your opponent for each card in their hand.

name: Des Volstgalph
desc: If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent. Each time a Normal or Quick-Play Spell Card resolves, this card gains 200 ATK until the end of this turn.
rulings: The effect that inflicts 500 damage to your opponent is a Trigger Effect that activates on the field. (It does not target. It activates mandatorily at the end of the Damage Step in which "Des Volstgalph" destroyed an opponent's monster by battle and sent it to the Graveyard.)
This effect does not activate if "Des Volstgalph" battles a monster with the same ATK and both monsters are destroyed.

The effect that makes this card gain 200 ATK is a Continuous Effect. (If a player activates a Normal Spell Card or Quick-Play Spell Card, immediately after it resolves, this effect is applied. It is applied even during the Damage Step.)

name: Despair from the Dark
desc: If this card is sent from your hand or Deck to your GY by an opponent's card effect: Special Summon this card.

name: Desrook Archfiend
desc: The controller of this card pays 500 Life Points during each of his/her Standby Phases (this is not optional). When this card is targeted by the effect of a card controlled by your opponent, when resolving the effect, roll a six-sided die. If the result is 3, negate the effect and destroy the opponent's card. When a "Terrorking Archfiend" on your side of the field is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard, you can send this card from your hand to the Graveyard to Special Summon the "Terrorking Archfiend".
rulings: "The controller of this card pays 500 Life Points during each of his/her Standby Phases (this is not optional)." is not treated as an effect. It is a cost to maintain "Desrook Archfiend" on the field.

The effect "When this card is targeted by the effect of a card controlled by your opponent, when resolving the effect, roll a six-sided die. If the result is 3, negate the effect and destroy the opponent's card." is a Continuous Effect. (It applies even if targeted by an effect during the Damage Step.)

When resolving an opponent's card effect that targeted "Desrook Archfiend", roll a die. If the result is 3, negate the opponent's card effect and destroy it, but if it is any other result that opponent's card effect resolves normally.

The effect "When a "Terrorking Archfiend" on your side of the field is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard, you can send this card from your hand to the Graveyard to Special Summon the "Terrorking Archfiend"." is a Quick Effect that is activated from the hand. (It targets 1 "Terrorking Archfiend" that was destroyed and sent to the Graveyard. It can be activated even during the Damage Step.)

name: Destiny HERO - Blade Master
desc: During your opponent's Battle Phase: You can discard this card; all face-up "Destiny HERO" monsters you control gain 800 ATK until the End Phase.
rulings: Discarding this card is a cost to activate the effect.

name: Destiny HERO - Captain Tenacious
desc: Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: You can target 1 "Destiny HERO" monster in your Graveyard that was destroyed by battle since your last Standby Phase, if you controlled this face-up card when the target was destroyed; Special Summon that target.

name: Destiny HERO - Celestial
desc: When this card declares an attack: You can target 1 face-up Spell your opponent controls; destroy it, and if you do, inflict 500 damage to your opponent. While you have no cards in your hand, except the turn this card was sent to the GY: You can banish this card and 1 "Destiny HERO" monster from your GY; draw 2 cards. You can only use this effect of "Destiny HERO - Celestial" once per turn.

name: Destiny HERO - Dark Angel
desc: If you have 3 or more "Destiny HERO" monsters in your GY: You can discard this card, then target 1 "Destiny HERO" monster in your GY; Special Summon it to your opponent's field in Defense Position. When a Spell Card or effect you activate resolves, negate that effect, and if you do, or if it did not have an effect, destroy that card. During your Standby Phase: You can banish this card and 1 "Destiny HERO" monster from your GY; each player chooses 1 Normal Spell from their Deck, and places it on top of their Deck.

name: Destiny HERO - Dasher
desc: Once per turn: You can Tribute 1 other monster; this card gains 1000 ATK until the End Phase. If this card attacks, change it to Defense Position at the end of the Battle Phase. One time only, when you draw a Monster Card during your Draw Phase while this card is in your Graveyard: You can reveal it; Special Summon it. This card must be in the Graveyard to activate and to resolve this effect.
rulings: When "Goblin Attack Force"/"Goblin Elite Attack Force"/"Giant Orc"/"Indomitable Fighter Lei Lei"/"Destiny Hero - Dasher"/etc attack a face-down "Blast Sphere", "Blast Sphere" will equip to the monster and Damage Calculation will be skipped. However, "Goblin Attack Force" still entered the Damage Step, so it still will be changed to Defense Position at the end of the Damage Step.

name: Destiny HERO - Defender
desc: During each of your opponent's Standby Phases: Your opponent draws 1 card. This card must be in face-up Defense Position to activate and to resolve this effect.

name: Destiny HERO - Departed
desc: During your Standby Phase, if this card is in your Graveyard: Special Summon it in face-up Attack Position to your opponent's side of the field. If this card is destroyed by battle, banish it instead of sending it to the Graveyard. If a card effect would send this card to the Graveyard from the hand or Deck, banish it instead.
rulings: The monster effect "During your Standby Phase, if this card is in your Graveyard: Special Summon it in face-up Attack Position to your opponent's side of the field" activates in the Graveyard.
The monster effect "If this card is destroyed by battle, banish it instead of sending it to the Graveyard" is not an Ignition Effect, Trigger Effect, Quick Effect, or Continuous Effect.
The monster effect "If a card effect would send this card to the Graveyard from the hand or Deck, banish it instead" is not an Ignition Effect, Trigger Effect, Quick Effect, or Continuous Effect.

The monster effect "If a card effect would send this card to the Graveyard from the hand or Deck, banish it instead" does not apply if "Destiny HERO - Departed" is sent from the hand or Deck to the Graveyard as a cost to activate a card effect, and it is sent to the Graveyard as normal.

name: Destiny HERO - Diamond Dude
desc: Once per turn: You can excavate the top card of your Deck, and if it is a Normal Spell, send it to the GY, otherwise place it on the bottom of your Deck. During the Main Phase of your next turn, you can activate the effect of that Spell in your GY (even if you no longer control this face-up card).
rulings: If "Light and Darkness Dragon" negates a "Once per turn" effect like "Destiny Hero - Diamond Dude", you already activated the effect, so you cannot activate it again during the same turn.

The effect of "Light and Darkness Dragon" only activates when a Spell/Trap Card is activated - that is, when it is played from the hand or flipped face-up. It activates against neither the effect of a Continuous Spell/Trap Card nor "Ojamagic" nor a Spell Card sent to the Graveyard by "Destiny Hero - Diamond Dude" - in all these situations, a Spell/Trap Card is not being activated.
If a Spell Card like "Lightning Vortex" with a cost is sent to the Graveyard by "Destiny Hero - Diamond Dude", you do not have to pay costs when activating its effect.

Counter Trap Cards like "Magic Jammer" and "Magic Drain" can only be activated when a Spell Card is activated - that is, when it is played from the hand or flipped face-up. They cannot be used when the effect of a Spell Card is activated by "Destiny Hero - Diamond Dude".
"Spell Canceller" only negates the effects of Spell Cards on the field. It will not negate the effect of a Spell Card sent to the Graveyard by "Destiny Hero - Diamond Dude".

When "Destiny Hero - Diamond Dude" sends to the Graveyard "Burst Stream of Destruction", "Ojama Delta Hurricane!!", or a similar Normal Spell Card that requires a specific Monster(s) to be on the field, you can activate the effect of the Spell Card. This is because the restriction "You can only activate this card while there is a face-up "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" on your side of the field." applies only when activating the Spell Card, and you are activating the effect of the Spell Card.

The text "Only 1 "Pot of Benevolence" can be activated per turn." of "Pot of Benevolence" refers to the activation of the card "Pot of Benevolence". If "Pot of Benevolence" was sent to the Graveyard by "Destiny Hero - Diamond Dude", then during the same turn you can both activate "Pot of Benevolence" and activate the effect of the "Pot of Benevolence" which was sent to the Graveyard.

For "Parallel World Fusion", you cannot Special Summon only during the turn in which you "activate the card". Thus, if "Parallel World Fusion" was sent to the Graveyard by "Destiny Hero - Diamond Dude" and "activate the effect" of that "Parallel World Fusion", then you can Special Summon during the same turn.
If "Destiny HERO - Diamond Dude" reveals an "Overlay Regen" in the Deck and sends it to the Graveyard, during the Main Phase of your next turn, the effect of "Overlay Regen" cannot be activated.

name: Destiny HERO - Disk Commander
desc: Cannot be Special Summoned from the GY the turn this card was sent to the GY. If this card is Special Summoned from the GY: You can draw 2 cards. You can only use this effect of "Destiny HERO - Disk Commander" once per Duel.
rulings: "Cannot be Special Summoned from the GY the turn it is sent there" is not treated as an effect.
The effect "If this card is Special Summoned from the GY: You can draw 2 cards" is a Trigger Effect. (It does not target.)
The effect "You can draw 2 cards" can optionally be activated when "Destiny HERO - Disk Commander" is Special Summoned from the Graveyard. (It can be activated during the Damage Step.)
The effect "You can draw 2 cards" cannot be activated if you have 1 or less cards in your Deck.

name: Destiny HERO - Dogma
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing 3 monsters, including at least 1 "Destiny HERO" monster. Once per turn, if you still control this face-up card during your opponent's next Standby Phase after you Special Summoned it this way: Halve your opponent's LP.
rulings: "Destiny Hero - Dogma"'s effect activates during your opponent's next Standby Phase. He needs to be on the field at this time for his effect to activate.

name: Destiny HERO - Doom Lord
desc: Once per turn: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; banish that target. You cannot declare an attack the turn you activate this effect. You must control this face-up Attack Position card to activate and to resolve this effect. The banished monster returns to the opponent's side of the field, in the same battle position, during your 2nd Standby Phase after activation.
rulings: "Burial from a Different Dimension" and "Miracle Dig" can only be activated by selecting monsters which are removed from play face-up. If a monster is removed from play face-down - such as by the effect of "Destiny Hero - Doom Lord" - then it cannot be returned to the Graveyard by effects like that of "Miracle Dig".

name: Destiny HERO - Double Dude
desc: Cannot be Special Summoned. This card can attack twice during each Battle Phase. During your Standby Phase, if this card was destroyed since your last Standby Phase: You can Special Summon 2 "Double Dude Tokens" (Warrior-Type/DARK/Level 4/ATK 1000/DEF 1000). This card must be in your Graveyard to activate and to resolve this effect.
rulings: The effect of being able to attack twice is a Continuous Effect.
The effect which Special Summons "Double Dude Token"s is a Trigger Effect. It activates during the next Standby Phase.
If you do not have 2+ open Monster Card Zones, then you cannot activate the effect to Special Summon the "Double Dude Token"s.

name: Destiny HERO - Dread Servant
desc: If this card is Normal Summoned: Place 1 Clock Counter on each "Clock Tower Prison". When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can target 1 Spell/Trap you control; destroy that target.

name: Destiny HERO - Dreadmaster
desc: If this card is Special Summoned by "Clock Tower Prison": Destroy all monsters you control, except "Destiny HERO" monsters, also, after that, you can Special Summon up to 2 "Destiny HERO" monsters from your GY. After this card is Special Summoned, for the rest of this turn, "Destiny HERO" monsters you control cannot be destroyed, also you take no battle damage when they battle. The ATK/DEF of this card are equal to the combined original ATK of all other "Destiny HERO" monsters you control.

name: Destiny HERO - Dunker
desc: You can send 1 "Destiny HERO" card from your hand to the Graveyard; inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

name: Destiny HERO - Fear Monger
desc: During your Standby Phase, if this card is in your Graveyard because it was destroyed by battle and sent there since your last Standby Phase: Target 1 "Destiny HERO" monster in your Graveyard, except a "Destiny HERO - Fear Monger"; Special Summon that target.

name: Destiny HERO - Malicious
desc: You can banish this card from your GY; Special Summon 1 "Destiny HERO - Malicious" from your Deck.
rulings: At the time of "Destiny Hero - Malicious" being sent to the Graveyard by the effect of "Foolish Burial"/"Armageddon Knight"/etc, the Turn Player cannot use Priority to activate the Ignition Effect of "Destiny Hero - Malicious". If the Turn Player passes Priority and does not activate a Spell Speed 2+ effect, then the opponent can activate the effect of "D.D. Crow" before the Turn Player can activate the effect of "Destiny Hero - Malicious".

name: Destiny HERO - Plasma
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing 3 monsters. Negate the effects of face-up monsters while your opponent controls them. Once per turn: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; equip that target to this card (max. 1). Gains ATK equal to half the original ATK of the monster equipped to it by this effect.
rulings: The effect which equips an opponent's monster targets one monster on your opponent's field.

If an effect like "Book of Moon" or "Ring of Destruction" is Chained to the effect of "Destiny Hero - Plasma"/"Relinquished"/"Thousand-Eyes Restrict"/etc so that "Destiny Hero - Plasma" is not face-up on the field at resolution, then the effect of "Destiny Hero - Plasma" etc is not negated and it is still applied. However, the opponent's monster cannot be equipped to "Destiny Hero - Plasma" etc, so the monster is sent from the opponent's Monster Card Zone to the Graveyard.

"Destiny Hero - Plasma" and "Skill Drain" do not negate an effect if the monster is not face-up on the field at resolution. When "Exiled Force"/"Cannon Soldier"/"Paladin of White Dragon"/etc Tribute themselves to activate their effects, they are not face-up on the field at the resolution, so their effects are not negated by "Skill Drain" etc.

When "Caius the Shadow Monarch" removes from play a DARK Monster Tokens or "Zoma the Spirit" etc, then no damage is inflicted. However, you do inflict damage when you remove from play a DARK Monster equipped to "Relinquished" or "Destiny Hero - Plasma".

If "Genesis Dragon" is equipped to a monster like "Relinquished" or "Destiny Hero - Plasma" and sent from the field to the Graveyard, then you can activate its effect which returns all Dragon-Type monsters from the Graveyard to the Deck.

If "Fortune Lady Light" becomes an Equip Card by an effect like "Relinquished" or "Destiny Hero - Plasma", then when it is removed from the field its owner can activate its effect which Special Summons a "Fortune Lady" monster.

name: Destroyersaurus
desc: You can discard this card to the Graveyard; add 1 "Jurassic World" from your Deck to your hand.
rulings: This effect is an Ignition Effect that is activated from the hand.
Discarding "Destroyersaurus" is a cost to activate this effect.
If you have no "Jurassic World" in your Deck, you cannot activate the effect of "Destroyersaurus".

name: Diabound Kernel
desc: When this card declares an attack: It gains 600 ATK. (Quick Effect): You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; it loses ATK equal to this card's current ATK until the end of this turn, then banish this card until the Standby Phase of the next turn. You can only use this effect of "Diabound Kernel" once per turn.

name: Dice Jar
desc: FLIP: Both players roll a six-sided die. The player with the lower result takes damage equal to their opponent's roll x 500. However, if the winner rolled a 6, the loser takes 6000 damage. If the rolls are the same, both players roll again.
rulings: You cannot activate "Crimson Fire" against an effect like "Dice Jar" or "The Paths of Destiny" where you do not know for certain that the effect will inflict damage.

name: Different Dimension Dragon
desc: This card cannot be destroyed by Spell/Trap effects that do not target it. This card cannot be destroyed by battle with a monster that has 1900 or less ATK.

name: Disc Fighter
desc: If this card attacks a Defense Position monster with DEF 2000 or more, destroy the monster with this card's effect without applying damage calculation.
rulings: The effect of "Disc Fighter" is a Trigger Effect. (It does not target.)
The effect activates before damage calculation.
Even if it attacked a face-down Defense Position monster, the effect activates after that monster is flipped face-up.
If "Disc Fighter" attacked a face-down Defense Position Flip monster, because that Flip monster was flipped face-up, its effect can be activated.

name: Divine Serpent Geh
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned by its own effect. If a monster(s) you control is destroyed by an opponent's attack or card effect: You can pay half your LP; Special Summon this card from your hand. Cannot be targeted by card effects. If this card attacks an opponent's monster, during the Damage Step only, negate the effects of that monster while it is face-up on the field (but its effects can still be activated), also its ATK becomes half its original ATK. Once per battle, if this card battles, during damage calculation (Quick Effect): You can make this card's ATK become equal to the highest original ATK on the field (your choice, if tied).

name: Don Zaloog
rulings: When this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent, you select which effect to activate.
If "Night Assailant" is discarded by "Spirit Reaper" or "Don Zaloog" during the Damage Step, then "Night Assailant"'s "return 1 Flip Effect Monster from your Graveyard to your hand" effect activates.
When you take battle damage from "Spirit Reaper" or "Don Zaloog", you can chain "Gorz the Emissary of Darkness"'s effect. He will Special Summon himself, and then you discard a card.

"Tragoedia"'s effect activates at the same time that "Don Zaloog"'s effect activate. "Tragoedia"'s effect would be activated in chain to "Don Zaloog"'s, so you would Special Summon "Tragoedia" and then resolve "Don Zaloog"'s effect.

name: Doomcaliber Knight
desc: Cannot be Special Summoned. If a monster effect is activated (Quick Effect): Tribute this face-up card; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that monster.
rulings: This is a Quick Effect that activates in chain to the Effect Monster's effect, regardless of whether or not the player wants this effect.
Tributing this card is a cost to activate the effect.
This card's effect will even activate when your own Effect Monster's effect activates.
The effect does not target.

When 1 "Light and Darkness Dragon" and 1 "Doomcaliber Knight" are on the field, if a Spell/Trap Card is activated, then "Light and Darkness Dragon" will be Chain Link 2, and "Doomcaliber Knight" will be Chain Link 3. The effect of "Light and Darkness Dragon" can only be activated once per Chain, so "Light and Darkness Dragon" will not try to negate "Doomcaliber Knight".

When you Summon a monster with a Continuous Effect like the effect of "Jinzo"/"Perfect Machine King"/"Spell Canceller"/"Muka Muka"/"Star Boy", its effect does not start a Chain Link, so you cannot chain "Divine Wrath"/"Doomcaliber Knight" to negate the effect. In addition, the effect of "Jinzo" is already being applied, so "Divine Wrath" cannot be activated.

"Divine Wrath"/"Doomcaliber Knight" can/will be chained to effects which activate in the Graveyard like "Sangan"/"Witch of the Black Forest"/"Giant Rat", and will negate them. However, the monster is already in the Graveyard, so it will not be destroyed.

When "Sangan" is Tributed to Tribute Summon "Mobius the Frost Monarch" while "Doomcaliber Knight" is on the field, "Sangan" is Chain Link 1 (because it is mandatory) and "Mobius the Frost Monarch" is Chain Link 2 (because it is optional). The effect of "Doomcaliber Knight" will then activate as Chain Link 3. When resolving the effect, "Doomcaliber Knight" will negate the effect of "Mobius the Frost Monarch", and then "Sangan" will resolve normally.

If the effect of "Bujingi Crane" is activated during damage calculation when "Doomcaliber Knight" battles and the effect of "Doomcaliber Knight" is chained to the effect of "Bujingi Crane", Tributing itself, then damage calculation is not performed and the Damage Step ends. A replay does not occur.
Even if the activation of the effect of "Snapdragon" is negated by "Doomcaliber Knight", you cannot activate the effect of another "Snapdragon" during the same turn.

name: Double Coston
desc: This card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a DARK monster.
rulings: You can Tribute Summon "The Wicked Avatar" or "The Wicked Dreadroot" by Tributing "Double Coston" and one other monster.

name: Dragonroid
desc:
Once per turn, if this card is in your GY: You can make this card become a Dragon monster while in the GY, until the end of this turn. You can discard this card, then activate 1 of these effects;
● Add 1 non-WIND "roid" monster from your Deck to your hand.
● This turn, the activation of your cards and effects that include an effect that Fusion Summons a Fusion Monster cannot be negated, also your opponent cannot activate cards or effects when a monster is Fusion Summoned this way.
You can only use this effect of "Dragonroid" once per turn.

name: Drillago
desc: If the only cards your opponent controls are face-up monsters with 1600 or more ATK, this card can attack your opponent directly.

name: Drillroid
desc: Before damage calculation, if this card attacks a Defense Position monster: Destroy that monster.
rulings: The effect of "Drillroid" is a Trigger Effect.
The effect does not target.
The effect activates before damage calculation and starts a Chain Link.
If this card attacks a face-down Defense Position monster, its effect activates after the face-down Defense Position monster is flipped face-up.

name: Dummy Golem
desc: FLIP: Your opponent selects 1 monster they control. Switch control of the selected monster and this card.

name: Dyna Base
desc: If your LP are lower than your opponent's: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. During your Main Phase: You can Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using this card you control and other monsters from your hand or field as material. You can only use each effect of "Dyna Base" once per turn.

name: Ebon Magician Curran
desc: During your Standby Phase, inflict 300 damage to your opponent for each monster they control.

name: Electromagnetic Turtle
desc: During your opponent's Battle Phase (Quick Effect): You can banish this card from your GY; end the Battle Phase. You can only use this effect of "Electromagnetic Turtle" once per Duel.
rulings: This effect is a Quick Effect.
Banishing this card from your Graveyard is a cost to activate this effect.
This effect does not target.
This effect cannot be activated during the Damage Step.
When this effect resolves, you proceed to the End Step. (If this effect was activated during attack declaration, then damage calculation is not performed.)

name: Element Dragon
desc: This monster gets the following effect(s) while there is a monster(s) with the following Attribute(s) on the field: ● FIRE: This card gains 500 ATK. ● WIND: If this card destroyed your opponent's monster by battle, it can attack once again in a row.
rulings: "This monster gets the following effect(s) while there is a monster(s) with the following Attribute(s) on the field:" is not treated as a monster effect.
If a FIRE or WIND monster is on the field, this card gains the appropriate effect. (If a FIRE monster and a WIND monster are on the field, this card gains both effects.)
The effect "● FIRE: This card gains 500 ATK." is a Continuous Effect.

The effect "● WIND: If this card destroyed your opponent's monster by battle, it can attack once again in a row." is a Trigger Effect. (It does not target. It activates at the end of the Damage Step and starts a Chain Link.)

name: Element Magician
desc: This monster gets the following effect(s) while there is a monster(s) with the following Attribute(s) on the field: ● WATER: Control of this card cannot switch. ● WIND: If this card destroyed your opponent's monster by battle, it can attack once again in a row.
rulings: "This monster gets the following effect(s) while there is a monster(s) with the following Attribute(s) on the field:" is not treated as a monster effect.
If a WATER or WIND monster is on the field, this card gains the appropriate effect. (If a WATER monster and a WIND monster are on the field, this card gains both effects.)
The effect "● WATER: Control of this card cannot switch." is a Continuous Effect.

The effect "● WIND: If this card destroyed your opponent's monster by battle, it can attack once again in a row." is a Trigger Effect. (It does not target. It activates at the end of the Damage Step and starts a Chain Link.)

name: Element Saurus
desc:
Gains the following effect(s) while there is a monster(s) with the following Attribute(s) on the field.
● FIRE: This card gains 500 ATK.
● EARTH: Negate the effects of Effect Monsters destroyed by battle with this card.
rulings: "This monster gets the following effect(s) while there is a monster(s) with the following Attribute(s) on the field:" is not treated as a monster effect.
If a FIRE or EARTH monster is on the field, this card gains the appropriate effect. (If a FIRE monster and an EARTH monster are on the field, this card gains both effects.)
The effect "● FIRE: This card gains 500 ATK." is a Continuous Effect.
The effect "● EARTH: Negate the effect of an Effect Monster that this card destroyed by battle." is a Continuous Effect.

name: Elemental HERO Bladedge
desc: If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

name: Elemental HERO Bubbleman
desc: If this is the only card in your hand, you can Special Summon it (from your hand). When this card is Summoned: You can draw 2 cards. You must control no other cards and have no cards in your hand to activate and to resolve this effect.
rulings: The "If this is the only card in your hand, you can Special Summon it (from your hand)." effect is not an Ignition, Trigger, Quick or Continuous Effect.
