Special Summoning "Elemental HERO Bubbleman" using this effect does not start a Chain Link.

The "When this card is Summoned: You can draw 2 cards. You must control no other cards and have no cards in your hand to activate and to resolve this effect." effect is a Trigger Effect. (It can be activated during the Damage Step.)
The effect of "Elemental HERO Bubbleman" cannot be activated if it is Special Summoned by a card effect activated as Chain Link 2 or higher.
If "Elemental HERO Bubbleman" is Special Summoned by "A Hero Lives" while you control no other cards and have no cards in your hand, you can activate the effect of "Elemental HERO Bubbleman".

name: Elemental HERO Necroshade
desc: Once, while this card is in the Graveyard, 1 Level 5 or higher "Elemental HERO" monster you Normal Summon can be Summoned without Tributing.
rulings: While there are 3 copies of "Elemental HERO Necroshade" in the Graveyard, if a Level 5 or higher "Elemental HERO" monster is Normal Summoned from the hand without a Tribute, 1 copy of "Elemental HERO Necroshade" is chosen and that effect is applied. (The effect of all 3 copies is not applied at once.) Furthermore, since the effect of Elemental HERO Necroshade does not let you perform multiple Normal Summons in a single turn, like "Double Summon" does, if you have already performed a Normal Summon during that turn, even if you have "Elemental HERO Necroshade" in your Graveyard, you cannot Normal Summon without a Tribute that turn.

name: Elemental HERO Neo Bubbleman
desc: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by sending an "Elemental Hero Bubbleman" you control and "Metamorphosis" in your hand to the Graveyard. This card's name is treated as "Elemental Hero Bubbleman" while it is face-up on the field. Destroy an opponent's monster that battles this card at the end of the Damage Step.

name: Elemental HERO Prisma
desc: Once per turn: You can reveal 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, then send 1 of the Fusion Materials whose name is specifically listed on that card from your Deck to the Graveyard; this card's name becomes the sent monster's until the End Phase.
rulings: This text is functionally different from the old text. Revealing 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck and sending 1 of the Fusion Material Monsters listed on that card from your Main Deck to the Graveyard is now a cost to activate the effect.

can only be used for Fusion that have at least 1 Fusion Material Monster that is specifically named, and can only be used to change its name to a specifically named Fusion Material Monster. You cannot reveal a monster like Five-Headed Dragon and send any Dragon-Type monster from your Deck to the Graveyard.
If effect activates and resolves and later that turn Skill Drain is activated, will still retain the Fusion Material Monster’s name since the effect has already been applied.

If the Fusion Material Monster that was sent to the Graveyard is removed from play, retains the name of that monster since the effect has already been applied.
You must send the Fusion Material Monster from your Main Deck to the Graveyard. You cannot send a monster from your Extra Deck.

If is already on the field and your opponent activates Prohibition naming Gladiator Beast Bestiari, then can still copy Bestiari’s name and can attack or change its battle position. If Prisma is Summoned after Prohibition is activated, you can still copy Bestiari’s name, but you cannot declare an attack or change its battle position.
You choose when during the End Phase to return Prisma’s name to normal.
The monster effect of "Elemental HERO Prisma" is an Ignition Effect.
When activating the effect, as cost, send 1 Fusion Material Monster to your Graveyard.
The effect does not target.

Fusion Material Monsters other than mentioned card names cannot be sent to the Graveyard. (In the case of "Frightfur Wolf", the card name "Edge Imp Sabres" is mentioned and thus can be sent to the Graveyard, but ""Fluffal" monster" is not a mentioned card name and thus cannot be sent to the Graveyard.)

name: Elemental HERO Wildheart
desc: This card is unaffected by Trap effects.
rulings: While this card is face-up on the field, it is unaffected by Trap Cards. This affect is applied (it does not activate).

name: Emes the Infinity
desc: Each time this card destroys an opponent's monster and sends it to the Graveyard as a result of battle, increase the ATK of this card by 700 points.
rulings: The effect of "Emes the Infinity" is a Trigger Effect. (It does not target.)
This effect activates at the end of the Damage Step.
The ATK gained by the effect of "Emes the Infinity" remains applied as long as it remains face-up on the field.
This effect does not activate if "Emes the Infinity" destroys a Monster Token or an "Embodiment of Apophis" treated as a Monster Card by battle.

name: Emissary of the Afterlife
desc: When this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard: Each player adds 1 Level 3 or lower Normal Monster from their Deck to their hand.

name: Enraged Battle Ox
desc: If a Beast, Beast-Warrior, or Winged Beast-Type monster you control attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

name: Enraged Muka Muka
desc: This card gains 400 ATK and DEF for each card in your hand.
rulings: If "Enraged Muka Muka" or "Red-Eyes Darkness Dragon" has its ATK halved by the effect of "Black Garden", then afterwards the monster's ATK does not change, even if the number of cards in your hand or the contents of the Graveyard change.

Example: If you have five cards in your hand and you Summon "Enraged Muka Muka", then the effect of "Black Garden" halves its ATK from 3200 to 1600. If there are two Dragon-Type monsters in your Graveyard and you Summon "Red-Eyes Darkness Dragon", then the effect of "Black Garden" halves its ATK from 3000 to 1500.

name: Eria the Water Charmer
desc: FLIP: Target 1 face-up WATER monster your opponent controls; take control of that target while this card is face-up on the field.

name: Etoile Cyber
desc: If this card attacks your opponent directly, it gains 500 ATK during the Damage Step only.

name: Eucalyptus Mole
desc:
If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Beast monster from your Deck in face-down Defense Position, then if this card is in Attack Position, change it to Defense Position. If this card is destroyed: You can Special Summon 1 "Koala" monster or 1 "Tree Otter" from your Deck, and if you do, apply this effect until the end of the next turn.
● Non-Effect Beast monsters you control gain ATK equal to their original DEF.
You can only use each effect of "Eucalyptus Mole" once per turn.
rulings: [Regarding the effect "If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Beast monster from your Deck in face-down Defense Position, then if this card is in Attack Position, change it to Defense Position."]
It is a Trigger Effect that can be activated in the Monster Zone.
It can also be activated during the Damage Step.

When resolving this effect, Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Beast monster from your Deck in face-down Defense Position. If the Special Summon is successful and this card is in Attack Position, you then change this card to Defense Position.
Special Summoning a monster and changing this card to Defense Position do not occur simultaneously.

[Regarding the effect "If this card is destroyed: You can Special Summon 1 "Koala" monster or 1 "Tree Otter" from your Deck, and if you do, apply this effect until the end of the next turn. ● Non-Effect Beast monsters you control gain ATK equal to their own original DEF."]
It is a Trigger Effect.

If this card is destroyed and sent to the GY, it can be activated in the GY. If this card is destroyed and banished face-up, it can be activated in your banishment. (It can be activated wherever this card is sent to first after being destroyed.)
It can also be activated during the Damage Step.
When resolving this effect, Special Summon 1 "Koala" monster from your Deck. If the Special Summon is successful, apply the "●" effect.
[Regarding the "●" effect.]
It also applies to non-Effect Beast monsters that become face-up in your Monster Zone after the effect resolves.

name: Evil HERO Infernal Gainer
desc: During your Main Phase 1: You can banish this card from the field, then target 1 Fiend monster you control; that target can make a second attack during each Battle Phase while you control it face-up. Once per turn, during your second Standby Phase after this card was banished to activate this effect: Special Summon this card in Attack Position.
rulings: The effect that allows 1 Fiend monster to make a second attack during each Battle Phase is an Ignition Effect. (Banishing "Evil HERO Infernal Gainer" is a cost to activate this effect. It targets 1 face-up Fiend monster in your Monster Zone.)

This effect remains applied as long as the affected monster remains face-up in the Monster Zone. (It remains applied even if the banished "Evil HERO Infernal Gainer" is Special Summoned during your 2nd Standby Phase after activation.)
The effect that Special Summons this card is a Trigger Effect. (It does not target.)

This effect activates once during your 2nd Standby Phase after "Evil HERO Infernal Gainer" was banished to activate the effect that allows 1 Fiend monster to make a second attack during each Battle Phase.

name: Evil HERO Infernal Prodigy
desc: If you control no monsters, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand) in Attack Position. Once per turn, during the End Phase, if this card was Tributed this turn to Tribute Summon a "HERO" monster: Draw 1 card.

name: Evil HERO Malicious Edge
desc: If your opponent controls a monster, you can Tribute Summon this card face-up with 1 Tribute. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage.
rulings: You can activate "Intercept" when a Level 7+ monster is Normal Summoned with only 1 Tribute.
Example: When "Evil HERO Malicious Edge" or "Majestic Mech - Goryu" is Normal Summoned, you can activate "Intercept" and gain control of the monster.

name: Exodia Necross
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned with "Contract with Exodia", and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. Cannot be destroyed by battle or Spell/Trap effect. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: This card gains 500 ATK. Destroy this card unless all 5 of these cards are in your Graveyard - "Exodia the Forbidden One", "Right Arm of the Forbidden One", "Left Arm of the Forbidden One", "Right Leg of the Forbidden One" and "Left Leg of the Forbidden One".
rulings: "Exodia Necross" can only be Special Summoned by the effect of "Contract with Exodia". After it is Special Summoned, if it is sent to the Graveyard, it cannot be Special Summoned by an effect like "Monster Reborn".
The effect "This card is not destroyed as a result of battle or by the effects of Spell or Trap Cards" is a Continuous Effect.
The effect "during each of your Standby Phases, increase the ATK of this card by 500 points." is a Trigger Effect. (It does not target. It is activated once during each of your Standby Phases.)

The effect "This card is destroyed when any of "Exodia the Forbidden One", "Right Arm of the Forbidden One", "Left Arm of the Forbidden One", "Right Leg of the Forbidden One" or "Left Leg of the Forbidden One" is not in your Graveyard." is a Continuous Effect. (It is also applied during the Damage Step.)

name: Exodius the Ultimate Forbidden Lord
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by shuffling all monsters in your Graveyard into the Deck, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. When this card declares an attack: Send 1 monster from your hand or Deck to the Graveyard. This card gains 1000 ATK for each Normal Monster in your Graveyard. If this face-up card would leave the field, banish it instead. If there are 5 different "Forbidden One" cards in your Graveyard that were sent there by this card's effect, you win the Duel.

name: Exploder Dragon
desc: If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: Destroy the monster that destroyed it. Neither player takes any battle damage from attacks involving this attacking card.
rulings: The effect of "Exploder Dragon" does not target.

name: Expressroid
desc: When this card is Summoned: You can target 2 "roid" monsters in your GY, except "Expressroid"; add those targets to your hand.
rulings: The effect of "Expressroid" is an optional Trigger Effect that can be activated when it is Summoned. (It targets 2 "roid" monsters in your Graveyard. It can be activated during the Damage Step.)
This effect can target "roid" Fusion Monsters like "Ambulance Rescueroid". (In this case, it is returned to the Extra Deck instead.)
When resolving this effect, even if 1 of the 2 targeted monsters is no longer in the Graveyard, the remaining target is still added to your hand.

name: Familiar Knight
desc: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: Each player can Special Summon 1 Level 4 monster from their hand.
rulings: The effect of "Familiar Knight" is a Trigger Effect that activates in the Graveyard.
The effect of "Familiar Knight" always activates when it is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard (= at the end of the Damage Step).
The effect does not target.

If the effect of "Familiar Knight" is activated, starting from the turn player, each player chooses whether or not to Special Summon a Level 4 monster from their hand. (If each player Special Summons a Level 4 monster from their hand by the effect of "Familiar Knight", those monsters are treated as being Special Summoned at the same time.)

name: Familiar-Possessed - Hiita
desc: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand or Deck) by sending 1 face-up "Hiita the Fire Charmer" and 1 face-up FIRE monster you control to the GY. If this card Special Summoned by its own effect attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage.

name: Fenrir
desc: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card can only be Special Summoned by removing from play 2 WATER monsters in your Graveyard. When this card destroys an opponent's monster as a result of battle, your opponent skips their next Draw Phase.
rulings: "This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card can only be Special Summoned by removing 2 WATER monsters in your Graveyard from play." is not treated as an effect. It is a procedure to Special Summon a Special Summon Monster. (Banishing 2 WATER monsters and Special Summoning this card are not considered to happen simultaneously.)
After "Fenrir" is Special Summoned, if it is sent to the Graveyard, it can be Special Summoned with "Monster Reborn".

The " When this card destroys an opponent's monster as a result of battle, your opponent skips his/her next Draw Phase." effect is a Trigger Effect. (It does not target. It activates at the end of the Damage Step.)
If "Fenrir" battles a monster with the same ATK and both monsters are destroyed by battle, this effect cannot be activated.

If "Fenrir" attacks a face-down "Man-Eater Bug", "Old Vindictive Magician" or "Night Assailant", even if those monsters are considered to be destroyed by battle during damage calculation, since "Fenrir" was destroyed by the effect of those monsters, the effect of "Fenrir" cannot be activated.

The effect of "D.D. Assailant" activates after damage calculation and the effect of "Fenrir" activates at the end of the Damage Step. If "Fenrir" destroys "D.D. Assailant" by battle, the effect of "D.D. Assailant" activates after damage calculation and both monsters are banished. Since "Fenrir" is no longer on the field at the end of the Damage Step, its effect cannot be activated.

name: Fiber Jar
desc: FLIP: Each player shuffles all cards from their hand, field, and Graveyard into the Deck, then draws 5 cards.
rulings: The effect of "Fiber Jar" is a Trigger Effect that always activates when "Fiber Jar" is flipped face-up. (It activates even during the Damage Step.)
The effect does not target.
The resolution of "Each player shuffles all cards from their hand, field, and Graveyard into the Deck" and the resolution of "then draws 5 cards" are not considered to happen at the same time.
When the effect of "Fiber Jar" resolves, Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, and Link Monsters on the field are returned to the Extra Deck.
When the effect of "Fiber Jar" resolves, Token Monsters on the field leave the field and disappear. (They are not returned to the Deck.)

If "Fiber Jar" is flipped face-up by a Flip Summon and it activates its effect, "Fiber Jar" itself is also returned to the Deck. However, if "Fiber Jar" is flipped face-up by an opponent's attack and it is destroyed by that battle, "Fiber Jar" itself is not returned to the Deck. After the effect of "Fiber Jar" resolves, the "Fiber Jar" that was destroyed by battle is sent to the Graveyard at the end fo the Damage Step.

name: Fire Trooper
desc: When this card is Summoned, you can send it to the Graveyard to inflict 1000 damage to your opponent.

name: Flint Cragger
desc: If this card is Special Summoned: You can discard 1 card, and if you do, send 1 "Fossil" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck to the GY. You can send this card from the field to the GY; inflict 500 damage to your opponent, then, if "Fossil Fusion" is in your GY, you can return to your GY, 1 of your banished cards that is "Fossil Fusion" or mentions it. You can only use each effect of "Flint Cragger" once per turn.

name: Flying Elephant
desc:
Once per opponent's turn, if this card would be destroyed by their card effect, it is not destroyed. Once per turn, during their End Phase, if that effect was applied this turn: Apply the following effect.
● During your next turn, if this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent by a direct attack, you win the Duel.

name: Fog King
desc: You can Tribute 1 monster, or no monsters, to Normal Summon (but not Set) this card. The ATK of this card becomes the combined original ATK of the Tributed monsters. Neither player can Tribute cards.
rulings: The effect of "Fog King" alters its current ATK; its Original ATK is still 0. If equipped with "Megamorph", "Fog King" will have 0 ATK. If targeted by "Shrink", "Fog King" will have 0 ATK, and during the End Phase the ATK of "Fog King" will remain at 0.
If "Skill Drain" is active, the ATK of "Fog King" will be 0, and monsters may be Tributed. If "Skill Drain" leaves the field, the ATK of "Fog King" remains at 0.
If "Fog King" is flipped face-down by "Book of Moon" etc, then "Fog King" will have 0 ATK. If "Fog King" is later flipped face-up, it will still have 0 ATK.

The ATK of "Fog King" is the combined Original ATK of the Tributed monsters after they were Tributed. If "Chimeratech Overdragon"/"Megarock Dragon"/"King of the Skull Servants" is Tributed, "?" ATK is treated as 0, so "Fog King" will have 0 ATK. If "Beast King Barbaros"/"Fusilier Dragon, the Dual-Mode Beast"/etc is Tributed and "Beast King Barbaros" has 1900 ATK, then the ATK of "Fog King" is 3000.
While the effect of "Fog King" is applied, you cannot Tribute "Fog King" for a Tribute Summon, and you cannot Tribute "Fog King" to activate a Spell/Trap Card with a cost of Tributing 1 monster.

name: Fortune Chariot
desc:
(This card is also always treated as a "Valkyrie" card.)
Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 Fairy monster you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it. If the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle or card effect, destroy this card instead. The equipped monster can attack directly, but when it does so using this effect, the battle damage inflicted to your opponent is halved.
rulings: The text that treats this card as a "Valkyrie" card is not an effect.
The effect that either equips this card to a Fairy monster on your field or Special Summons this card while equipped allows you to only activate 1 of those 2 effects per turn.

The effect that equips this card to a Fairy monster on your field is an Ignition Effect. (It targets 1 face-up Fairy monster in your Monster Zone. The part of the effect that will prevent the equipped monster from being destroyed by destroying this card instead is a Spell effect this card has while equipped. It does not start a Chain, and can be applied during the Damage Step.)
The effect that Special Summons this equipped card is a Spell effect this card has while equipped. (It starts a Chain, can only be activated during your Main Phase, and does not target.)
The effect that allows the equipped monster to ATK directly is a Spell effect this card has while equipped. (It does not start a Chain.)

name: Fossil Dyna Pachycephalo
desc: If this card is flipped face-up: Destroy all Special Summoned monsters on the field. Neither player can Special Summon monsters.
rulings: You will not be able to Special Summon "Lava Golem" while "Fossil Dyna Pachycephalo" is face-up on the field. The effect of "Fossil Dyna Pachycephalo" makes it so you cannot Special Summon a monster. You will not be able to perform the action to Special Summon "Lava Golem".

"Black Garden"'s effect to Special Summon a monster from the Graveyard cannot be activated if "Scapegoat" was previously activated, or if "Vanity's Fiend" is on the field. If you activate this effect of "Black Garden" and "Call of the Haunted" is chained to Special Summon "Fossil Dyna Pachycephalo", then all Plant-Type monsters are destroyed, but no monster is Special Summoned.

If your "Fossil Dyna Pachycephalo" is destroyed by battle and you take Battle Damage, you can Special Summon "Tragoedia" from your hand. This is because "Fossil Dyna Pachycephalo" is considered to be destroyed at this point, so its Continuous Effect is no longer applied.
If a card like "Vanity's Fiend" or "Fossil Dyna Pachycephalo" has its effect negated by "Skill Drain", then you still can send "Skill Drain" to the Graveyard to Special Summon "Trap Eater".
If "Vanity's Fiend" or "Fossil Dyna Pachycephalo" is on the field, then "Reasoning" and "Monster Gate" cannot be activated.

name: Freed the Brave Wanderer
desc: Once per turn: You can banish 2 LIGHT monsters from your Graveyard to target 1 face-up monster on the field with higher ATK than this face-up card; destroy that target.

name: Fushioh Richie
desc: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card can only be Special Summoned from your hand or your Deck by Tributing 1 "Great Dezard" that has fulfilled the condition. You can flip this card into face-down Defense Position once per turn during your Main Phase. As long as this monster remains face-up on the field, negate the activation and effects of all Spell and Trap Cards that target this card and destroy them. When this card is flipped face-up, you can Special Summon 1 Zombie-Type monster from your Graveyard.
rulings: If this card is sent to the Graveyard after being Special Summoned by the effect of "Great Dezard", it can be Special Summoned from the Graveyard by the effect of "Monster Reborn".
The effect "You can flip this card into face-down Defense Position once per turn during your Main Phase." is an Ignition Effect. (It does not target.)

The effect "When this card is flipped face-up, you can Special Summon 1 Zombie-Type monster from your Graveyard." is a Trigger Effect. (It targets 1 Zombie-Type monster in your Graveyard. It can be activated even during the Damage Step.)

The effect "As long as this monster remains face-up on the field, negate the activation and effects of all Spell and Trap Cards that target this card and destroy them." is a Quick Effect. (It does not target. It can be activated even during the Damage Step.)

name: Fusilier Dragon, the Dual-Mode Beast
desc: You can Normal Summon/Set this card without Tributing, but its original ATK and DEF become halved.
rulings: The effect of halving this card's ATK and DEF is part of Normal Summoning/Setting it without Tribute. It does not start a chain.

While "Fusilier Dragon, the Dual-Mode Beast" is face-down, its effect is not applied, so its ATK is 2800. You can Set it without Tributes, and then Tribute it as a cost to activate "Deck Devastation Virus".

When Tributing "Fusilier Dragon, the Dual-Mode Beast" or "Beast King Barbaros" for "Fog King", you use the printed ATK of the Tributed monsters to determine the ATK of "Fog King". If you Tribute a "Beast King Barbaros" with 1900 ATK for "Fog King", then the ATK of "Fog King" is 3000.

If "Beast King Barbaros" or "Fusilier Dragon, the Dual-Mode Beast" is Normal Summoned without Tributes and has its ATK/DEF changed, then if it is flipped face-down by an effect like "Book of Moon", then the effect which changes its ATK/DEF is no longer applied, so "Fusilier Dragon, the Dual-Mode Beast" returns to 2800/2000. Also, if it is removed from play by "Interdimensional Matter Transporter", then the effect which changes its ATK/DEF is no longer applied as soon "Fusilier Dragon, the Dual-Mode Beast" is removed from the field, so "Fusilier Dragon, the Dual-Mode Beast" returns to 2800/2000.

name: Fusion Devourer
desc: When this card battles a Fusion Monster, the ATK of the Fusion Monster becomes 0 during the Damage Step only.

name: Gaia Plate the Earth Giant
desc: You can Special Summon this card by removing from play any 2 Rock-Type monsters in your Graveyard. During your Standby Phase, remove from play 1 Rock-Type monster in your Graveyard, or send this card to the Graveyard. Halve the ATK and DEF of any monster that battles with this card.
rulings: You can Normal Summon this monster.
Removing 1 Rock-Type monster from play is a cost. If you choose not to pay the cost, this monster is sent to the Graveyard.
The effect to halve the ATK and DEF of any monster that battles with this card is applied only during damage calculation.
"Gaia Plate the Earth Giant" is a Normal Summon Monster.
Sending a Rock-Type monster to the Graveyard is an optional maintenance cost for "Gaia Plate the Earth Giant".

The effect "Halve the ATK and DEF of any monster that battles with this card." of "Gaia Plate the Earth Giant" is a Continuous Effect which is applied during damage calculation. This effect does not start a Chain.

name: Gaia Soul the Combustible Collective
desc: Once per turn: You can Tribute up to 2 Pyro-Type monsters; this card gains 1000 ATK for each. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent. During the End Phase: Destroy this card.

name: Gallis the Star Beast
desc: You can reveal this card in your hand; send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard, then, if it was a monster, inflict damage to your opponent equal to its Level x 200 and Special Summon this card from your hand, otherwise destroy this card.
rulings: The effect of "Gallis the Star Beast" is an Ignition Effect activated in the hand.
Revealing this card to your opponent is a cost to activate its effect.

"send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard" and "then, if it was a monster, inflict damage to your opponent equal to its Level x 200 and Special Summon this card from your hand, otherwise destroy this card" are not treated as occurring at the same time.

If a Monster Card is sent to the Graveyard for the effect "send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard", inflicting damage to the opponent and Special Summoning "Gallis the Star Beast" is treated as the last thing to happen. (The effect "inflict damage to your opponent equal to its Level x 200" and the effect "Special Summon this card from your hand" are treated as occurring at the same time.)
If a Spell/Trap Card is sent to the Graveyard for the effect "send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard", "Gallis the Star Beast" destroying itself is treated as the last thing to happen.

Even if cards sent to the Graveyard are banished due to the effect of "Banisher of the Radiance"/"Macro Cosmos"/etc., you can activate the effect of "Gallis the Star Beast". Also, if the effect of "Gallis the Star Beast" is activated, if the top card of your Deck is sent to the Graveyard, that card is banished without going to the Graveyard, but if it was a Monster Card, you can damage your opponent's Life Points, and "Gallis the Star Beast" is Special Summoned to the field.
Because it is not known whether "Gallis the Star Beast" will inflict damage when its effect is activated, it is not possible to chain the effect of "Performage Stilts Launcher".

Even if the effect of a "Des Wombat" that is face-up on your opponent's side of the field is applying, you can activate the effect of "Gallis the Star Beast". If the card sent to the Graveyard by the effect is a Monster Card, no damage is inflicted to your opponent, but "Gallis the Star Beast" is Special Summoned.

name: Gandora the Dragon of Destruction
desc: Cannot be Special Summoned. You can pay half your LP; destroy as many cards on the field as possible (other than this card), and if you do, banish them. This card gains 300 ATK for each card destroyed this way. Once per turn, during the End Phase, if this card was Normal or Flip Summoned this turn: Send it to the Graveyard.
rulings: If "Imperial Iron Wall" is active, then cards/effects that destroy and remove from play cards (such as "Gandora the Dragon of Destruction") cannot be activated. If "Imperial Iron Wall" is chained to such an effect, then the affected card(s) is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard, but is not removed from play.

If a Token Monster is destroyed and removed from the field by the effect of "Gandora the Dragon of Destruction", then the Token Monster was still destroyed by this effect, so it is counted for the ATK increase.

If "Book of Moon" is Chained to the effect of "Gandora the Dragon of Destruction" to flip "Gandora the Dragon of Destruction" face-down, then "Gandora the Dragon of Destruction" is not destroyed by its effect and remains on the field.
If a face-down card is destroyed and remove from play by the effect of "Gandora the Dragon of Destruction", then it is removed from play face-up.
You cannot activate the effect of "Gandora the Dragon of Destruction" if there are no other cards on the field.
You can activate the effect of "Gandora the Dragon of Destruction" multiple times in one turn, as long as there is another card on the field that will be destroyed and removed from play.

When your opponent activates the effect of "Gandora the Dragon of Destruction", if there is another monster on the field that would be destroyed and removed from play, then you can Chain "My Body as a Shield" to the effect of "Gandora the Dragon of Destruction".

Suppose "Gandora the Dragon of Destruction" is removed from play by "Interdimensional Matter Transporter" during the turn in which "Gandora the Dragon of Destruction" was Normal Summoned or Flip Summoned. During the End Phase, the effect of "Gandora the Dragon of Destruction" which sends it to the Graveyard will activate after "Gandora the Dragon of Destruction" is returned to the field.

If you activate the effect of "Gandora the Dragon of Destruction" and your opponent Chains an effect like "Enemy Controller" to gain control of "Gandora the Dragon of Destruction", then "Gandora the Dragon of Destruction" still does not destroy itself with its effect.

name: Gear Golem the Moving Fortress
desc: Once per turn, during your Main Phase 1: You can pay 800 Life Points; this card can attack your opponent directly this turn.

name: Gearfried the Swordmaster
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned with "Release Restraint". Each time an Equip Card(s) is equipped to this card: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.
rulings: The effect of "Gearfried the Swordmaster" is a Trigger Effect.
This effect targets 1 monster your opponent controls.
This effect activates even if this card is equipped with an Equip Card during the Damage Step.
This effect activates even if this card is equipped with a Trap Card like "Kunai with Chain".

name: Gemini Imps
desc: During either player's turn, when your opponent activates a Spell Card, Trap Card, or monster effect that could make you discard when it resolves: You can send this card from your hand to the Graveyard; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it. Then draw 1 card.
rulings: Sending this card from your hand to the Graveyard is a cost to activate this effect.

The effect "During either player's turn, when your opponent activates a Spell Card, Trap Card, or monster effect that could make you discard when it resolves" is a Quick Effect that is activated in a chain.
If the card is not destroyed, then you cannot draw 1 card.
This card's effect can even be activated during the Damage Step.

This effect can be activated when the "If this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, they discard all cards in their hand during the next Draw Phase, before they draw." effect of "Hino-Kagu-Tsuchi" is activated. When this effect of "Hino-Kagu-Tsuchi" is activated after damage calculation, you can chain the effect "Gemini Imps" from your hand. You cannot chain the effect of "Gemini Imps" when the "This card returns to its owner's hand during the End Phase of the turn it is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up." effect of "Hino-Kagu-Tsuchi" is activated.

name: Gernia
desc: During your next Standby Phase, after this face-up card you control was destroyed and sent to your Graveyard by an opponent's card effect: Special Summon it.
rulings: This effect is a Trigger Effect.

name: Ghost Knight of Jackal
desc: You can Special Summon an opponent's monster that is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard by this card as a result of battle to your side of the field in face-up Defense Position.

name: Giant Axe Mummy
desc: You can flip this card into face-down Defense Position once per turn during your Main Phase. If the ATK of a monster on your opponent's side of the field that attacks this card in face-down Defense Position is lower than the DEF of this monster, the attacking monster is destroyed.
rulings: The monster effect "You can flip this card into face-down Defense Position once per turn during your Main Phase" is an Ignition Effect.

The monster effect "If the ATK of a monster on your opponent's side of the field that attacks this card in face-down Defense Position is lower than the DEF of this monster, the attacking monster is destroyed" is a Trigger Effect. (It does not target.)

If at the time damage calculation was performed with a "Giant Axe Mummy" that was in face-down Defense Position when attacked, its DEF exceeds the ATK of the opponent's attacking monster, the effect activates at the end of the Damage Step.
The effect does not activate if the DEF of an attacked and flipped "Giant Axe Mummy" was the same as the ATK of the opponent's attacking monster.

name: Giant Orc
desc: If this card attacks, it is changed to Defense Position at the end of the Battle Phase. You cannot change this battle position until the end of your next turn.
rulings: The effect of "Second Goblin" which equips it to "Giant Orc" starts a Chain.

When "Goblin Attack Force"/"Goblin Elite Attack Force"/"Giant Orc"/"Indomitable Fighter Lei Lei"/"Destiny Hero - Dasher"/etc attack a face-down "Blast Sphere", "Blast Sphere" will equip to the monster and Damage Calculation will be skipped. However, "Goblin Attack Force" still entered the Damage Step, so it still will be changed to Defense Position at the end of the Damage Step.

name: Giant Rex
desc: Cannot attack directly. If this card is banished: You can Special Summon this card, and if you do, this card gains 200 ATK for each of your banished Dinosaur monsters. You can only use this effect of "Giant Rex" once per turn.

name: Gilford the Legend
desc: Cannot be Special Summoned. When this card is Normal Summoned: You can equip as many Equip Spell Cards from your Graveyard as possible to a Warrior-Type monster(s) you control.
rulings: When this card is Normal Summoned in face-up Attack Position, the player chooses whether or not to activate the effect.
If you have multiple Equip Cards in the Graveyard, you must equip as many as possible, until all your Spell and Trap Card Zones are filled.

If a Warrior-Type monster cannot be equipped with an Equip Spell Card, then you cannot use the effect of "Gilford the Legend" to equip that monster with that card. Thus, you cannot use the effect of "Gilford the Legend" to equip a monster with an Equip Spell Card like "Premature Burial" or "Snatch Steal".

name: Gilford the Lightning
desc: You can Tribute 3 monsters to Tribute Summon (but not Set) this card. If Summoned this way: Destroy all monsters your opponent controls.
rulings: Tribute Summoning this card by Tributing 3 monsters is treated as a Normal Summon.
When Tribute Summoning this card by Tributing 3 monsters, it cannot be Set in face-down Defense Position.
If this card is Tributed Summoned by Tributing 3 monsters, its Trigger Effect is activated when it is Tribute Summoned. (It does not target.)
If "Bottomless Trap Hole" is activated in a chain to this effect, even if this card is destroyed, all monsters your opponent controls are still destroyed.
You can also Tribute Summon this card by Tributing 2 monsters. In this case, you cannot activate its effect to destroy all monsters your opponent controls.
If your opponent controls no monsters, you cannot Tribute Summon "Gilford the Lightning" by Tributing 3 monsters.

When Tribute Summoning "Beast King Barbaros", "Gilford the Lightning" or "Moisture Creature" by Tributing 3 monsters, it cannot be Set in face-down Defense Position. It must be Tribute Summoned in face-up Attack Position. If "Light of Intervention" is active, you can Summon it in face-up Defense Position.

name: Glife the Phantom Bird
desc: You can discard this card; add 1 "Golden Castle of Stromberg" from your Deck to your hand. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 card in your opponent's Spell & Trap Zone; destroy it. You can only use this effect of "Glife the Phantom Bird" once per turn.

name: Goblin King
desc: While you control another Fiend-Type monster, this card cannot be attacked. The ATK and DEF of this card are each equal to the number of Fiend-Type monsters on the field (excluding this card) x 1000.
rulings: The monster effect "While you control another Fiend-Type monster, this card cannot be attacked" is a Continuous Effect.
The monster effect "The ATK and DEF of this card are each equal to the number of Fiend-Type monsters on the field (excluding this card) x 1000" is a Continuous Effect.
The ATK and DEF of "Goblin King" itself become the number of other face-up Fiend-Type monsters in either player's Monster Zones.
If the total number of other face-up Fiend-Type monsters in either player's Monster Zones changes, its ATK and DEF also change immediately.

name: Goblin Zombie
desc: If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Send the top card of their Deck to the GY. If this card is sent from the field to the GY: Add 1 Zombie monster with 1200 or less DEF from your Deck to your hand.
rulings: The effect "When this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Send the top card of their Deck to the Graveyard" is a Trigger Effect. (It does not target. It activates after damage calculation.)

The effect "When this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard: Add 1 Zombie-Type monster with 1200 or less DEF from your Deck to your hand" is a Trigger Effect. (It does not target. It activates even during the Damage Step.)

name: Golden Homunculus
desc: This card gains 300 ATK and DEF for each of your banished cards.

name: Golem Sentry
desc: Once per turn: You can change this card to face-down Defense Position. When this card is Flip Summoned: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; return that target to the hand.

name: Gradius' Option
desc: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This monster can only be Special Summoned by selecting 1 face-up "Gradius" on your side of the field. The ATK and DEF of this card becomes the same as the ATK and DEF of the selected "Gradius". If the selected "Gradius" is removed from the field, destroy this card.

name: Granmarg the Rock Monarch
desc: If this card is Tribute Summoned: Target 1 Set card on the field; destroy that target.
rulings: The effect of "Granmarg the Rock Monarch" is a mandatory Trigger Effect that is activated when it is Tribute Summoned face-up.
This effect targets 1 Set card on the field. (It can target 1 card in either player's field.)
When resolving this effect, if the targeted card is face-up, it is not destroyed.
Even if there are no Set cards on the field, this effect still activates and starts a Chain Link. (Since no card was targeted, the effect is not applied.)

name: Grave Squirmer
desc: If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: Target 1 card on the field; destroy that target.

name: Gravekeeper's Assailant
desc: When this card declares an attack while "Necrovalley" is on the field: You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; change that target's battle position.
rulings: You can only activate this card's effect during its own attack declaration.
This card's effect targets 1 face-up monster the opponent controls.

name: Gravekeeper's Chief
desc: You can only control 1 face-up "Gravekeeper's Chief". Your GY is unaffected by "Necrovalley". When this card is Tribute Summoned: You can target 1 "Gravekeeper's" monster in your GY; Special Summon that target.
rulings: When a monster like "Gravekeeper's Chief" is destroyed because you can only control one copy of "Gravekeeper's Chief", it is not treated as being destroyed by a card effect. When "Archfiend Zombie-Skull" and "DNA Surgery" declaring "Zombie" are on the field, if a second "Gravekeeper's Chief" is flipped face-up, then it will still be destroyed.

If you control "Gravekeeper's Chief", then you may activate the effect of "Hundred Eyes Dragon" by removing from play a copy of "Gravekeeper's Chief" in your Graveyard. However, when resolving the effect, the name of "Hundred Eyes Dragon" becomes "Gravekeeper's Chief", so "Hundred Eyes Dragon" is destroyed.

name: Gravekeeper's Curse
desc: If this card is Summoned: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

name: Gravekeeper's Guard
desc: FLIP: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; return that target to the hand.

name: Gravekeeper's Spear Soldier
desc: If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing Battle Damage to your opponent.

name: Gravekeeper's Watcher
desc: During either player's turn, when your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card or monster effect that could make them discard when it resolves: You can send this card from your hand to the Graveyard; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.
rulings: Sending this card from your hand to the Graveyard is a cost to activate this effect.
You can Chain this card when your opponent activates an effect that would make them discard cards.
This effect can be activated during the Damage Step.

You cannot activate the effect of "Gravekeeper's Watcher" when "The Gates of Dark World" is first activated. You also cannot activate the effect of "Gravekeeper's Watcher" when the effect of "The Gates of Dark World" is activated.
The effect of "Gravekeeper's Watcher" can be chained to the activation of "Mind Crush".

name: Great Long Nose
desc: This card cannot be Special Summoned. This card returns to the owner's hand during the End Phase of the turn that this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up. If this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points, your opponent skips their next Battle Phase.

name: Green Gadget
desc: When this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Red Gadget" from your Deck to your hand.
rulings: When "Green Gadget" is Normal/Special Summoned, you cannot activate its effect if there is no "Red Gadget" in your Deck.

name: Guardian Angel Joan
desc: When this card destroys a monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: Gain Life Points equal to the original ATK of that destroyed monster in the Graveyard.
rulings: The effect of "Guardian Angel Joan" is a Trigger Effect.
This effect does not target.
This effect activates at the end of the Damage Step in which "Guardian Angel Joan" destroyed an opponent's monster by battle and sent it to the Graveyard.
This effect does not activate if "Guardian Angel Joan" battles a monster with the same ATK and both monsters are destroyed.

name: Guardian Dreadscythe
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned by its own effect, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. If a "Guardian Eatos" is destroyed by battle or card effect and sent to your Graveyard: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. When this card is Special Summoned: You can equip 1 "Reaper Scythe - Dreadscythe" from your Deck to this card. You cannot Normal or Special Summon monsters (but you can Normal Set). If this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard: Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard, and if you do, Special Summon this card from the Graveyard.
rulings: The "If a "Guardian Eatos" is destroyed by battle or by card effect and sent to your Graveyard: You can Special Summon this card from your hand." effect is a Trigger Effect that is activated from the hand. (It does not target.)
The "When this card is Special Summoned: You can equip 1 "Reaper Scythe - Dreadscythe" from your Deck to this card." effect is a Trigger Effect. (It does not target.)
The "You cannot Normal or Special Summon monsters (but you can Normal Set)." effect is a Continuous Effect. (It is applied to the controller of "Guardian Dreadscythe".)

The "When this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard: Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard, and if you do, Special Summon this card from the Graveyard." effect is a mandatory Trigger Effect that is activated from the Graveyard. (Sending 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard is part of the effect.)

After a "Guardian Dreadscythe" that was sent from the hand or Deck to the Graveyard is equipped to "Inzektor Exa-Beetle", if it is destroyed by "Mystical Space Typhoon", since it was not Special Summoned by the "If a "Guardian Eatos" is destroyed by battle or by card effect and sent to your Graveyard: You can Special Summon this card from your hand." effect, you cannot activate the "When this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard: Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard, and if you do, Special Summon this card from the Graveyard." effect.

name: Guardian Eatos
desc: If you have no monsters in your Graveyard, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can send 1 of your Equip Spell Cards equipped to this card to the Graveyard, then target up to 3 monsters in your opponent's Graveyard; banish those targets, and if you do, this card gains 500 ATK for each monster banished by this effect, until the end of this turn.
rulings: Sending an Equip Spell to the Graveyard is a cost.
The effect targets 1-3 monsters in your opponent's Graveyard.
Removing from play the monsters and increasing this card's ATK happen at the same time.
Even if 1 of the target monsters leaves the Graveyard before this effect resolves, the remaining targets will be removed from play and this card's ATK will be increased appropriately.
You can send an opponent's Equip Spell equipped to this card to the Graveyard as a cost.
Sending an Equip Spell Card from the Field to the Graveyard is a cost to activate the effect of "Guardian Eatos". This effect targets 1 to 3 monsters in the opponent's Graveyard.
The effect of "Guardian Eatos" which increases its ATK resolves as part of the same resolution which banishes the targeted monsters.
You may send to the Graveyard an Equip Spell Card that your opponent controls as an activation cost for the effect of "Guardian Eatos".

If "Dimensional Fissure" is active, then you may still activate the effect of "Guardian Eatos" by sending to the Graveyard a Monster Card that is being treated as an Equip Spell Card, such as a Union Monster.
The effect of "Guardian Eatos" which banishes monsters from your opponent's Graveyard and the effect which increases its ATK by 500x are considered to resolve simultaneously.
Example: If "Guardian Eatos" banishes a monster(s), then the opponent can activate "Dimensional Inversion". She does not miss the timing.

name: Guardian Elma
desc: Cannot be Summoned unless you control a face-up "Butterfly Dagger - Elma". When this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 appropriate Equip Spell Card in your Graveyard; equip that target to this card.

name: Guardian Grarl
desc: Cannot be Summoned unless you control a face-up "Gravity Axe - Grarl". If this is the only card in your hand, you can Special Summon it (from your hand).
rulings: If "Guardian Grarl" is the only card in your hand, you can only Special Summon it if there is a "Gravity Axe - Grarl" on your field.

name: Guardian Kay'est
desc: Cannot be Summoned unless you control a face-up "Rod of Silence - Kay'est". This card is unaffected by Spell effects and cannot be targeted for attacks, but does not prevent your opponent from attacking you directly.

name: Guardian Sphinx
desc: Once per turn: You can change this card to face-down Defense Position. When this card is Flip Summoned: Return all monsters your opponent controls to the hand.
rulings: While the effect of "Dark Simorgh" is active, your opponent cannot activate the effect of a card like "Guardian Sphinx" or "Stealth Bird" which switches the monster to face-down Defense Position. Also, if the effect of "Guardian Sphinx" is activated and an effect like "Call of the Haunted" is chained so that "Dark Simorgh" is Special Summoned from the Graveyard, then your opponent can no longer Set, so the effect of "Guardian Sphinx" is not applied and the monster is not switched to Defense Position.
The effect "Once per turn, you can change this card to face-down Defense Position." of cards like "Guardian Sphinx" or "Stealth Bird" can only be activated during your turn's Main Phase.

You can activate the "Once per turn, you can change this card to face-down Defense Position." effect of cards like "Guardian Sphinx" or "Stealth Bird" even if you cannot change the monster's Battle Position, such as if the monster attacked or if the monster already changed its Battle Position.

name: Gyaku-Gire Panda
desc: Increase the ATK of this card by 500 points for each monster on your opponent's side of the field. When this card attacks with an ATK that is higher than the DEF of your opponent's Defense Position monster, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points.

name: Gyroid
desc: Once per turn, this card cannot be destroyed by battle.
rulings: The effect of "Gyroid" is a Continuous Effect.
If "Gyroid" battles, this effect is always applied if it would be destroyed by battle. (You cannot choose to not apply this effect.)
Even if a "Gyroid" in face-down Defense Position is attacked and flipped face-up by an opponent's monster, this effect is applied if it would be destroyed by battle.

name: Hamon, Lord of Striking Thunder
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by sending 3 face-up Continuous Spell Cards you control to the Graveyard, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: Inflict 1000 damage to your opponent. While this card is in face-up Defense Position, monsters your opponent controls cannot target monsters for attacks, except this one.
rulings: It is not treated as an effect. It is a procedure to Special Summon this monster.
This is the only way to Special Summon this card. (Even if this card leaves the field after being Special Summoned this way, it cannot be Special Summoned by other card effects.)
Special Summoning this way does not start a Chain Link.
Sending Continuous Spell Cards to the Graveyard and Special Summoning this card do not happen at the same time.
It is a Continuous Effect.
It is a Trigger Effect that activates in the Monster Zone.
It activates mandatorily.
It activates at the end of the Damage Step in which this monster destroyed an opponent's monster by battle and sent it to the Graveyard.

It does not activate if this monster is no longer face-up in the Monster Zone at the timing this effect is activated, for example, if this card battles a monster with the same ATK and both monsters are destroyed.

name: Hannibal Necromancer
desc: If this card is Normal Summoned: Place 1 Spell Counter on it (max. 1). You can remove 1 Spell Counter from this card, then target 1 face-up Trap Card on the field; destroy that target.
rulings: The effect which places a Spell Counter activates when this card is Normal Summoned in face-up Attack Position.
Removing one Spell Counter from this card is a Cost to activate the effect which destroys a face-up Trap Card. This effect targets the Trap Card.

name: Heavy Mech Support Platform
desc: Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 Machine monster you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it. A monster equipped with this card gains 500 ATK/DEF, also if the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle or card effect, destroy this card instead.
rulings: If "Ally of Justice Catastor" battles with a monster equipped with a card like "Heavy Mech Support Platform" or "Spirit of the Six Samurai", then "Heavy Mech Support Platform" is destroyed, but afterwards you still perform Damage Calculation because the equipped monster is still on the field.

If the effect of "Ally of Justice Core Destroyer" does not destroy the battling monster - for example, the monster is equipped with "Heavy Mech Support Platform" or "Spirit of the Six Samurai", and the Equip Card is destroyed instead - then afterwards, you still perform damage calculation.

name: Helios - The Primordial Sun
desc: This card's ATK and DEF are each equal to the number of removed from play monsters x 100.

name: Helios Duo Megistus
desc: You can Special Summon this card by Tributing 1 "Helios - The Primordial Sun". This card's ATK and DEF are equal to the number of removed from play monsters x 200. If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, Special Summon it during the End Phase, and it gains 300 ATK and DEF.

name: Helios Trice Megistus
desc: You can Special Summon this card by Tributing 1 "Helios Duo Megistus". This card's ATK and DEF are each equal to the number of removed from play monsters x 300. After this card attacks, it can attack once more if your opponent controls a monster. If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, Special Summon it during the End Phase and it gains 500 ATK and DEF.

name: Helpoemer
desc: Cannot be Special Summoned from the GY. At the end of your opponent's Battle Phase, if this card is in the GY because it was destroyed by battle: Make your opponent discard 1 random card. This card must be in the GY to activate and to resolve this effect.
rulings: The effect of "Helpoemer" does not target.
The effect of "Helpoemer" which discards from the hand starts a Chain Link.
You cannot activate a card like "Monster Reborn" by targeting "Helpoemer".

name: Hero Kid
desc: When this card is Special Summoned: You can Special Summon any number of "Hero Kid"(s) from your Deck.

name: Hexe Trude
desc: If "Golden Castle of Stromberg" is in a Field Zone, you can Normal Summon this card without Tributing. Once per turn, if "Golden Castle of Stromberg" is in a Field Zone: You can target 1 card on the field, except this one; destroy it, and if you do, this card can make up to 2 attacks on monsters during each Battle Phase this turn. When this card destroys a monster by battle: You can target 1 face-up monster you control; it gains 400 ATK.

name: Hino-Kagu-Tsuchi
desc: This card cannot be Special Summoned. This card returns to its owner's hand during the End Phase of the turn it is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up. If this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, they discard all cards in their hand during the next Draw Phase, before they draw.
rulings: The effect "This card returns to its owner's hand during the End Phase of the turn it is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up." is a Trigger Effect that activates only once during the End Phase of the turn "Hino-Kagu-Tsuchi" itself was Normal Summoned or flipped face-up. (It does not target.)

If "Hino-Kagu-Tsuchi" is flipped to face-down Defense Position by "Book of Moon", or destroyed by battle or card effect and sent to the Graveyard, etc., the effect "This card returns to its owner's hand during the End Phase of the turn it is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up." will not activate during the End Phase.

The effect "If this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, they discard all cards in their hand during the next Draw Phase, before they draw." is a Trigger Effect that activates after damage calculation, when your opponent takes battle damage due to battling "Hino-Kagu-Tsuchi". (It does not target.)

Even in the case that a face-down Defense Position "Hino-Kagu-Tsuchi" is attacked by an opponent's monster, if the opponent takes battle damage, the effect "they discard all cards in their hand during the next Draw Phase, before they draw." will activate.

The "If either player has no cards in their hand at the start of their Draw Phase, they can draw 1 more card in addition to their normal draw." effect of "Cyber Archfiend" can be activated after the normal draw if at the start of your turn you have no cards in your hand. Therefore, if you have have 1 or more cards in your hand at the start of your turn, even if the "they discard all cards in their hand during the next Draw Phase, before they draw." of "Hino-Kagu-Tsuchi" is applied, this effect cannot be activated.

After "Hino-Kagu-Tsuchi" inflicts battle damage to your opponent, if the Draw Phase of the next turn is skipped by a card like "Offerings to the Doomed", "they discard all cards in their hand during the next Draw Phase, before they draw." is not applied.

After "Hino-Kagu-Tsuchi" inflicts battle damage to your opponent, if during the Draw Phase of the next turn you control "Diabolos, King of the Abyss", the "they discard all cards in their hand during the next Draw Phase, before they draw." of "Hino-Kagu-Tsuchi" is applied first. Then, the "During your opponent's Draw Phase, before their draw, look at the top card of their Deck, then put that card on the top or bottom of their Deck." effect of "Diabolos, King of the Abyss" is activated. (After that, the normal draw is performed.)

After "Hino-Kagu-Tsuchi" inflicts battle damage to your opponent, if during the Draw Phase of the next turn "Broww, Huntsman of Dark World" is discarded by by the effect of "Hino-Kagu-Tsuchi" and you control "Diabolos, King of the Abyss", the "During your opponent's Draw Phase, before their draw, look at the top card of their Deck, then put that card on the top or bottom of their Deck." effect of "Diabolos, King of the Abyss" and the "If this card is discarded to the Graveyard by a card effect: Draw 1 card, plus another card if this card was discarded from your hand to your Graveyard by an opponent's card effect." effect of "Broww, Huntsman of Dark World" can be activated in a chain. As the turn player, the effect of "Broww, Huntsman of Dark World" is activated as Chain Link 1, and the effect of "Diabolos, King of the Abyss" is activated as Chain Link 2.

name: Holding Arms
desc: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; while this card is face-up on the field, that face-up monster cannot attack, also its effects are negated. While that face-up monster is on the field, this card cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects.

name: Holding Legs
desc: If this card is Summoned: Return all Set Spell and Trap Cards on the field to the hand. You can banish this card from your Graveyard, then target 1 Set Spell/Trap Card your opponent controls; that Set card cannot be activated until the end of your opponent's next turn.

name: Honest
desc: During your Main Phase: You can return this face-up card from the field to the hand. During the Damage Step, when a LIGHT monster you control battles (Quick Effect): You can send this card from your hand to the GY; that monster gains ATK equal to the ATK of the opponent's monster it is battling, until the end of this turn.
rulings: This effect does not target.
Sending "Honest" from your hand to the Graveyard is a cost to activate its effect.
You can activate the effect of "Honest" when a LIGHT monster you control battles during your opponent's turn.

During the Damage Step in which a LIGHT monster you control battles, you can activate the effect from the start of the Damage Step until before damage calculation. Furthermore, it cannot be activated during damage calculation. (It cannot be activated in the same timing as "Kuriboh".) Sending this card from the hand to the Graveyard is a cost. The ATK increase is equal to the ATK of the opponent's monster when the effect of "Honest" resolves.

While the effect of "Dimensional Fissure" or "Macro Cosmos" is active, you cannot activate effects which have "discard to the Graveyard" or "send to the Graveyard" as costs. Thus, you cannot activate the effect of "Honest" which increases ATK, since you cannot send it to the Graveyard as a cost.

The ATK-increasing effect of "Honest" is considered to activate in the hand. Thus, if the effect of "Light-Imprisoning Mirror" is active, then the effect of "Honest" will not be negated. If "Necro Gardna" activates its effect by banishing itself from the Graveyard, then the effect is considered to activate in the Graveyard. Thus, if the effect of "Shadow-Imprisoning Mirror" is active, then the activated effect of "Necro Gardna" will be negated.
You can activate the effect of a card like "Gem-Merchant", "Honest", or "Blackwing - Kalut the Moon Shadow" during the Damage Step only while the monster is face-up.
Example: If a face-down "Gem-Knight Garnet" is attacked, then you can activate the effect of "Gem-Merchant" after the face-down "Gem-Knight Garnet" is flipped face-up.
After a monster has had its ATK increased by "Honest", when it is targetted by "Shrink", the monster's ATK becomes half its Original ATK.

name: Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV4
desc: Control of this face-up card cannot switch. During the End Phase, if this card destroyed a monster by battle this turn: You can send this face-up card to the Graveyard; Special Summon 1 "Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV6" from your hand or Deck.

name: Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV6
desc: This card is unaffected by Spell effects. During the End Phase, if this card destroyed a monster by battle this turn: You can send this face-up card to the Graveyard; Special Summon 1 "Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV8" from your hand or Deck.
rulings: "This card is unaffected by Spell effects" is a Continuous Effect.

"Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV6" is unaffected by the effects of activated Spell Cards of the controller of "Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV6" and the effects of activated Spell Cards of the opponent.

The effect "During the End Phase, if this card destroyed a monster by battle this turn: You can send this face-up card to the Graveyard; Special Summon 1 "Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV8" from your hand or Deck" is a Trigger Effect. (It does not target. Sending "Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV6" itself to the Graveyard is a cost to activate this effect.)

Even if your "Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV6" would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can apply the effect of "Return of the Dragon Lords" in your Graveyard. (The effect is applied normally, so "Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV6" is not destroyed, and "Return of the Dragon Lords" is banished instead.)

Even if a monster that is unaffected by Spell effects, such as "Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV6" etc., is Normal or Special Summoned, the effect of "Black Garden" to halve the monster's ATK and Special Summon a "Rose Token" will still activate. However, because "Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV6" etc. is unaffected by Spell effects, its ATK is not halved. Also, even if the ATK of "Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV6" etc. is not halved, a "Rose Token" will still be Special Summoned.

If "Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV6" is Tribute Summoned while the effect of "Level Limit - Area B" is applying, or if "Level Limit - Area B" is activated while "Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV6" is face-up on the field, since "Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV6" is unaffected by Spell effects while it is face-up on the field, it is not changed to Defense Position by the effect of "Level Limit - Area B".

The effect "While you control 2 or more face-up Attack Position monsters, your opponent cannot target your monster(s) with the lowest ATK for an attack" of "The Seal of Orichalcos" affects the opponent's monsters. Therefore, an opponent's monster that is unaffected by Spell effects (due to the "This card is unaffected by Spell effects" effect of "Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV6" or the effect of "Forbidden Lance") can still attack monsters in your Monster Zones with the lowest ATK.

"Phantom of Chaos" can activate the effect of "Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV6" it gained during the End Phase after it destroyed a monster by battle, and Special Summon "Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV8".

Even if "Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV6" is the only Level 5 or higher Dragon-Type monster on your field, you can activate "A Wingbeat of Giant Dragon". Also, "Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV6" can be chosen to be returned to the hand, but because "Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV6" is unaffected by Spell Card effects, it is not returned to the hand and the effect "destroy all Spell and Trap Cards on the field" is not applied.
"Starlight Road" can be activated in Chain to "Lightning Vortex" if there are two monsters on your field, even if one of them is "Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV6".

If monsters on your field could not be destroyed by "Assault Revival", the effect to Special Summon is not applied. Also, if "Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV6", which is unaffected by Spell Card effects, is on the field, monsters other than "Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV6" are destroyed, but because not all monsters on your field were destroyed, an ":/Assault Mode" monster cannot be Special Summoned from your Graveyard.

If the opponent activates "Raigeki Break" targeting "Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV6", since "Raigeki Break" was already activated targeting "Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV6", even if "Horus' Servant" is Special Summoned in a Chain, the effect of "Raigeki Break" resolves normally.

name: Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV8
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned by "Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV6", and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. During either player's turn, when a Spell Card is activated: You can negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it. You must control this face-up card to activate and to resolve this effect.
rulings: You can activate the effect of "Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV8" during the Damage Step.

If "Offerings to the Doomed"/"Raigeki Break"/etc is chained to the Spell/Trap Card-negating effect of "Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV8"/"Dark Paladin"/"Sorcerer of Dark Magic"/"Gladiator Beast Heraklinos" so that "Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV8" etc is not face-up on the field at resolution, then the Spell/Trap Card is neither negated nor destroyed.
The effect of "Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV8" is not considered to destroy Spell Cards on the field. Therefore, its activation cannot be negated by the effect of "Stardust Dragon".

name: Hydrogeddon
desc: When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the GY: You can Special Summon 1 "Hydrogeddon" from your Deck.
rulings: The effect of "Hydrogeddon" is a Trigger Effect.
This effect can optionally be activated at the end of the Damage Step in which "Hydrogeddon" destroyed an opponent's monster by battle and sent it to the Graveyard.
This effect does not target.
This effect cannot be activated if "Hydrogeddon" battles a monster with the same ATK and both monsters are destroyed.

name: Hyper Hammerhead
desc: At the end of the Damage Step, if an opponent's monster that battled this card is not destroyed: Return that opponent's monster to the hand.

name: Ice Knight
desc: Gains 400 ATK for each Aqua monster you control. Once per turn: You can activate this effect; you can Normal Summon 1 WATER monster during your Main Phase this turn, in addition to your Normal Summon/Set (you can only gain this effect once per turn), also you cannot Normal or Special Summon monsters for the rest of this turn, except WATER monsters.

name: Inaba White Rabbit
desc: This card cannot be Special Summoned. This card returns to the owner's hand during the End Phase of the turn that this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up. This monster attacks your opponent's Life Points directly.

name: Indomitable Fighter Lei Lei
desc: If this card attacks, it is changed to Defense Position at the end of the Battle Phase. This card's battle position cannot be changed until the end of your next turn, except with a card effect.
rulings: The effect of "Protective Soul Ailin" which equips it to "Indomitable Fighter Lei Lei" starts a Chain.

When "Goblin Attack Force"/"Goblin Elite Attack Force"/"Giant Orc"/"Indomitable Fighter Lei Lei"/"Destiny Hero - Dasher"/etc attack a face-down "Blast Sphere", "Blast Sphere" will equip to the monster and Damage Calculation will be skipped. However, "Goblin Attack Force" still entered the Damage Step, so it still will be changed to Defense Position at the end of the Damage Step.

name: Infernal Dragon
desc: Once per turn, during the End Phase, if this card attacked this turn: Destroy this card. When this card on the field is destroyed and sent to the GY: You can Tribute 1 monster; Special Summon this card from the GY.

name: Infernal Flame Emperor
desc: This card cannot be Special Summoned. When this card is Tribute Summoned, you can remove from play up to 5 FIRE monsters in your Graveyard. Destroy a number of Spell/Trap Cards on the field equal to the number of monsters removed from play for this effect.
rulings: This is a Normal Summon Monster.
The effect of "Infernal Flame Emperor" is a Trigger Effect. (It does not target. Banishing up to 5 FIRE monsters from your Graveyard is a cost to activate this effect.)
If you activate the effect of "Infernal Flame Emperor", you will destroy a number of Spell/Trap Cards on the field equal the number of FIRE monsters banished.
You cannot banish more FIRE monsters from your Graveyard than the number of Spell/Trap Cards on the field.
You cannot banish 0 FIRE monsters from your Graveyard.

name: Infernal Incinerator
desc: This card can only be Normal Summoned or Set by discarding all other card(s) in your hand and Tributing 1 card you control with 2000 or more ATK. This card gains 200 ATK for each monster your opponent controls. This card loses 500 ATK for each other monster you control.
rulings: "This card can only be Normal Summoned or Set by discarding all other card(s) in your hand and Tributing 1 card you control with 2000 or more ATK" is not treated as an effect. (It is a condition to Normal Summon/Set "Infernal Incinerator".)

As the Normal Summon/Set procedure for "Infernal Incinerator", discard all cards in your hand other than the "Infernal Incinerator" being Normal Summoned/Set, Tribute 1 monster in your Monster Zone with 2000 or more ATK, then perform the Normal Summon/Set. (Discarding your hand and Tributing the monster are not treated as being done at the same time as the Normal Summon/Set.)
Because "Infernal Incinerator" is a Normal Summon Monster, it can be Special Summoned by other card effects.

The monster effect "This card gains 200 ATK for each monster your opponent controls. This card loses 500 ATK for each other monster you control" is a Continuous Effect. (If the number of monsters in either player's Monster Zone changes, its ATK changes immediately.)

name: Infernalqueen Archfiend
desc: The controller of this card pays 500 Life Points during each of his/her Standby Phases (this is not optional). When this card is targeted by the effect of a card controlled by your opponent, when resolving the effect, roll a six-sided die. If the result is 2 or 5, negate the effect and destroy the opponent's card. As long as this card remains on the field, during each Standby Phase, increase the ATK of 1 Archfiend Monster Card by 1000 points until the End Phase.
rulings: The effect to increase a monster's ATK also activates during your opponent's Standby Phase.

name: Inferno Hammer
desc: When this card destroys your opponent's monster and sends it to the Graveyard as a result of battle, you can select 1 face-up monster on your opponent's side of the field and flip it into face-down Defense Position.
rulings: The effect of "Inferno Hammer" is a Trigger Effect.
This effect targets 1 face-up monster your opponent controls.
This effect activates at the end of the Damage Step.
This effect cannot be activated if "Inferno Hammer" battles a monster with the same ATK and both monsters are destroyed.

name: Injection Fairy Lily
desc: If this card attacks or is attacked, during damage calculation (in either player's turn): You can pay 2000 LP once per battle; this card gains 3000 ATK during that damage calculation only.
rulings: This card's effect is Quick Effect that can be activated on the field. (Paying 2000 Life Points is the cost to activate this effect.)

This effect can be activated once during damage calculation when this monster battles. (Even if this monster battles multiple times during the same turn, its effect can be activated once per damage calculation.)

name: Insect Princess
desc: All Insect monsters your opponent controls are changed to Attack Position. If this card destroys an Insect monster by battle: This card gains 500 ATK.

name: Invincible Demise Lord
desc: During the End Phase, if a monster(s) was destroyed by battle this turn: You can Special Summon this card from your hand or GY, and if "Invincible Demise Lord" was destroyed by battle this turn, this card's original ATK becomes 3000, also it cannot be destroyed by card effects. During your Main Phase: You can reveal cards in your Deck, including "Slash Draw", equal to the number of cards your opponent controls +1 and place those revealed cards on top of the Deck in any order. You can only use each effect of "Invincible Demise Lord" once per turn.

name: Ipiria
desc: If this card is Summoned: Draw 1 card. You can only use this effect of "Ipiria" once per turn.
rulings: This card's effect is a Trigger Effect.
This effect does not target.
This card's effect will activate when it is Normal Summoned, Flip Summoned, or Special Summoned face-up. (It will also activate during the Damage Step.)
Even if "Ipiria" is Normal Summoned face-up using the effect of Ultimate Offering or Special Summoned by Call of the Haunted, that was activated as Chain Link 2 or higher, its effect will activate.

name: Iron Hans
desc: If this card is Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Iron Knight" from your Deck, also if "Golden Castle of Stromberg" is not in a Field Zone when this effect resolves, you cannot Special Summon monsters from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn. You can only use this effect of "Iron Hans" once per turn. Gains 1000 ATK for each "Iron Knight" you control, while "Golden Castle of Stromberg" is in a Field Zone.

name: Iron Knight
desc: Loses 1000 ATK while you control "Iron Hans". If this card on the field is destroyed by battle or sent to the GY by a card effect: You can add 1 "Iron Hans" from your Deck to your hand, or, if "Golden Castle of Stromberg" is in a Field Zone, you can add 1 Warrior monster from your Deck to your hand, instead. You can only use this effect of "Iron Knight" once per turn.

name: Jetroid
desc: At the time this card is selected as an attack target by an opponent's monster, you can activate Trap Card(s) from your hand.

name: Jinzo - Lord
desc: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by sending 1 face-up "Jinzo" you control to the Graveyard. Trap Cards cannot be activated and the effects of all Trap Cards on the field are negated. Once per turn, you can destroy all face-up Trap Cards. Inflict 300 damage to your opponent for each card destroyed by this effect.

name: Jinzo - Returner
desc: This card can attack your opponent directly. When this card is sent to the Graveyard, you can Special Summon 1 "Jinzo" from your Graveyard. Destroy it during your End Phase.
rulings: For "Foolish Burial", after you send the card to the Graveyard, you shuffle the Deck. However, this is not treated as the effect of a card, so the last thing to resolve is sending the card from the Deck to the Graveyard. Because of this, you can activate the effect of "Jinzo - Returner" or "Peten the Dark Clown" if it is sent from the Deck to the Graveyard by "Foolish Burial".

name: Juragedo
desc: During the Battle Step (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon this card from your hand, and if you do, gain 1000 LP. You can only use this effect of "Juragedo" once per turn. (Quick Effect): You can Tribute this card, then target 1 face-up monster you control; it gains 1000 ATK until the end of the next turn.

name: KA-2 Des Scissors
desc: When this card destroys a monster and sends it to the Graveyard as a result of battle, inflict damage to your opponent's Life Points equal to the Level of the destroyed monster x 500 points.
rulings: The effect of "KA-2 Des Scissors" is a Trigger Effect.
This effect does not target.
This effect activates mandatorily at the end of the Damage Step.
This effect cannot be activated if "KA-2 Des Scissors" battles a monster with the same ATK and both monsters are destroyed.
Inflict damage to your opponent equal to the original Level of the monster that was destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard x 500.

name: Kaibaman
desc: You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" from your hand.

name: Kaiser Glider
desc: Cannot be destroyed by battle with a monster that has the same ATK. If this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: Target 1 monster on the field; return that target to the hand.

name: Kaiser Sea Horse
desc: This card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a LIGHT monster.
rulings: You decide to use the effect while "Kaiser Sea Horse" is on the field, before Tributing it.

name: Kaitoptera
desc: If your opponent controls 2 or more face-up monsters, except WIND monsters, those monsters cannot target this card for attacks. You can only use each of the following effects of "Kaitoptera" once per turn. During your Main Phase: You can add 1 "Polymerization" from your Deck to your hand. If this card is banished: You can Special Summon it, then you can add 1 "Polymerization" from your GY to your hand.
rulings: [Regarding the effect "If your opponent controls 2 or more face-up non-WIND monsters, those monsters cannot target this card for attacks."]
It is a Continuous Effect that applies in the Monster Zone.
If there are 2 or more monsters in your opponent's Monster Zone that do not have the WIND Attribute, this effect applies to those monsters.
[Regarding the effect "During your Main Phase: You can add 1 "Polymerization" from your Deck to your hand."]
