It is an Ignition Effect that can be activated in the Monster Zone.
[Regarding the effect "If this card is banished: You can Special Summon it, then you can add 1 "Polymerization" from your GY to your hand."]
It is a Trigger Effect that can be activated if this card is banished face-up.
It can also be activated during the Damage Step.
When resolving this effect, Special Summon this card. Then, if it is successfully Special Summoned, you can add "Polymerization" from your GY to your hand.
Special Summoning this card and adding "Polymerization" from your GY to your hand do not occur simultaneously.

name: Kelbek
desc: A monster that attacks this card returns to the hand. Damage calculation is applied normally.
rulings: The effect of "Kelbek" is a Trigger Effect. (It does not target.)
Its effect always activates after damage calculation in which "Kelbek" was attacked by an opponent's monster, and makes a Chain Link.
Its effect activates whether "Kelbek" was attacked while face-up or it was attacked in face-down Defense Position and flipped face-up.
Its effect activates even if "Kelbek" itself was destroyed by battle.

name: Keldo
desc: When this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard as a result of battle, select 2 cards from your opponent's Graveyard, add them to your opponent's Deck and the Deck is then shuffled.

name: King of the Skull Servants
desc: The original ATK of this card is the combined number of "King of the Skull Servants" and "Skull Servant" in your GY x 1000. When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can banish 1 other "King of the Skull Servants" or 1 "Skull Servant" from your GY; Special Summon this card.

name: King of the Swamp
desc: This card can be used as a substitute for any 1 Fusion Material whose name is specifically listed on the Fusion Monster Card, but the other Fusion Material(s) must be correct. You can discard this card to the Graveyard; add 1 "Polymerization" from your Deck to your hand.
rulings: If you have no copy of "Polymerization" in your Deck, you cannot activate the effect of "King of the Swamp", and you cannot activate "Fusion Sage".

name: King's Knight
desc: When this card is Normal Summoned while you control "Queen's Knight": You can Special Summon 1 "Jack's Knight" from your Deck.

name: Kiryu
desc: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, if you control this card on the field, you can equip it to your "Dark Blade" as an Equip Spell Card, OR unequip the Union equipment and Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position. While equipped to a monster by this card's effect, increase the ATK/DEF of the equipped monster by 900 points, and you can Tribute this card to allow the equipped monster to attack your opponent's Life Points directly this turn. (1 monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster is destroyed as a result of battle, destroy this card instead.)

name: Knight of Twin Swords
desc: Can make up to 2 attacks on monsters during each Battle Phase. You can only use each of the following effects of "Knight of Twin Swords" once per turn. If this card is in your hand and you control a card with an effect that requires a die roll: You can Special Summon this card. During your Main Phase: You can roll a six-sided die 3 times, and if you do, this card gains ATK equal to the total x 350 (until the end of this turn), then if 2 or more of the results were the same, you can Special Summon 1 monster from your hand.

name: Kuribabylon
desc:
Gains 300 ATK/DEF for each "Kuriboh" monster you control and in your GY. You can only use 1 of the following effects of "Kuribabylon" per turn, and only once that turn.
● If you have more monsters in your GY than your opponent: You can Special Summon this card from your hand.
● During your Main or Battle Phase: You can return this card to the hand, and if you do, Special Summon 5 monsters (1 "Kuribah", 1 "Kuribee", 1 "Kuriboo", 1 "Kuribeh", and 1 "Kuriboh") from your hand and/or GY in Attack Position.

name: Kuribah
desc:
(This card is always treated as a "Kuriboh" card.)
When this card, or another "Kuriboh" monster, you control is destroyed by battle: You can Special Summon 1 monster with 300 ATK/200 DEF from your Deck, except "Kuribah". You can only use this effect of "Kuribah" once per turn. You can Tribute this card you control and 1 each of "Kuribee", "Kuriboo", "Kuribeh" and "Kuriboh" from your hand and/or field; Special Summon 1 "Kuribabylon" from your hand, Deck, or GY.

name: Kuribandit
desc: During the End Phase, if this card was Normal Summoned this turn: You can Tribute this card; excavate the top 5 cards of your Deck, you can add 1 excavated Spell/Trap to your hand, also send the remaining cards to the GY.
rulings: This is an optional Trigger Effect that can be activated during the End Phase of the turn this card was Normal Summoned. (It cannot be activated if you have 4 or less cards in your Deck.)
"excavate the top 5 cards of your Deck" is performed when the effect resolves. (This is not a cost.)
"you can add 1 excavated Spell/Trap Card to your hand" and "send the remaining cards to the Graveyard" are considered to happen simultaneously.
Even if you excavated a Spell/Trap Card by this effect, you can send all of them to the Graveyard without adding any of them to your hand.

A monster that has its effects negated by "Breakthrough Skill" has its effects negated until the end of the turn. Therefore, if the effect of "Kuribandit" is negated by "Breakthrough Skill", it effect can be activated during the End Phase by Tributing it, but that effect is not applied.

After performing "excavate the top 5 cards of your Deck", if all 5 excavated cards are Monster Cards, since "you can add 1 excavated Spell/Trap Card to your hand" cannot be applied, only "send the remaining cards to the Graveyard." is applied.

You can activate the effect of "Kuribandit" during the End Phase even while the effect of "Thunder King Rai-Oh" is being applied. In that case, since the "Neither player can add cards from their Deck to their hand except by drawing them." effect of "Thunder King Rai-Oh" is being applied, even if a Spell/Trap Card is excavated by "Kuribandit", all 5 excavated cards are sent to the Graveyard.

name: Kuribee
desc:
(This card is always treated as a "Kuriboh" card.)
When this card, or another "Kuriboh" monster, you control is destroyed by battle: You can add 1 Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand that lists the card "Kuriboh" in its text. You can only use this effect of "Kuribee" once per turn. Once per turn, when an opponent's monster declares an attack while you control another "Kuriboh" monster: You can change the ATK of all other monsters you control to 0 until the end of this turn, and if you do, negate the attack.

name: Kuribeh
desc:
(This card is always treated as a "Kuriboh" card.)
(Quick Effect): You can discard this card, then target 1 "Kuriboh" monster you control; it gains 1500 ATK. You can Tribute this card you control and 1 each of "Kuribah", "Kuribee", "Kuriboo" and "Kuriboh" from your hand and/or field; add 1 "Kuribandit" from your Deck or GY to your hand, then, immediately after this effect resolves, you can Normal Summon 1 Fiend monster from your hand.

name: Kuriboo
desc:
(This card is always treated as a "Kuriboh" card.)
When an opponent's monster declares an attack: You can discard this card; add 1 "Kuriboh" monster from your Deck to your hand, except "Kuriboo". Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can discard 1 Trap, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; it loses 1500 ATK until the end of this turn.

name: Lady Ninja Yae
desc: By discarding 1 WIND monster from your hand to the Graveyard, return all Spell and Trap Cards on your opponent's side of the field to the owner's hand.

name: Lava Golem
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) to your opponent's field by Tributing 2 monsters they control. You cannot Normal Summon/Set the turn you Special Summon this card. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Take 1000 damage.
rulings: Summoning "Lava Golem" makes it so that player is unable to Normal Summon for the turn. Similar to how if your Normal Summon gets negated, you are still unable to perform another Normal Summon for the turn, the same applies to the Special Summoning of "Lava Golem".
This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set.
You cannot Normal Summon or Set during the turn in which you Special Summon "Lava Golem" with its Special Summoning Condition.
"Vennominaga the Deity of Poisonous Snakes" can be Tributed to Special Summon "Lava Golem"
When you Special Summon "Lava Golem" to your opponent's field, your opponent can activate the effect of "Thunder King Rai-Oh".

name: Legacy Hunter
desc: When this card attacks a face-down Defense Position monster and destroys it and sends it to the Graveyard as a result of battle, your opponent returns 1 random card from their hand to their Deck. Their Deck is then shuffled.
rulings: The effect of "Legacy Hunter" is a Trigger Effect.

This effect activates mandatorily if "Legacy Hunter" battles a face-down Defense Position monster and destroys it by battle and sends it to the Graveyard. (It activates mandatorily at the end of the Damage Step.)
This effect does not target.

name: Legendary Fiend
desc: Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: This card gains 700 ATK.

name: Legendary Knight Critias
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned with "Legend of Heart". When this card is Special Summoned: You can target 1 face-up Spell/Trap on the field; banish that target. When this card is targeted for an attack: You can target 1 Trap in your GY; Set that target. It can be activated this turn.

name: Legendary Knight Hermos
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned with "Legend of Heart". When this card is Special Summoned: You can target 1 face-up Spell/Trap on the field; banish that target. Once per turn, when this card is targeted for an attack: You can target 1 Effect Monster in your GY; until the End Phase of your next turn, this card's name becomes that target's original name, and replace this effect with that target's original effects.

name: Legendary Knight Timaeus
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned with "Legend of Heart". When this card is Special Summoned: You can target 1 face-up Spell/Trap on the field; banish that target. When this card is targeted for an attack: You can target 1 Spell in your GY; Set that target.
rulings: This is a Special Summon monster.
Even if this card is Special Summoned by the proper procedure, it cannot be Special Summoned from the Graveyard, except by the effect of "Legend of Heart".

"When this card is Special Summoned: You can target 1 face-up Spell/Trap Card on the field; banish that target." effect is an optional Trigger Effect that can be activated when this card is Special Summoned. (This effect targets.)

"When this card is targeted for an attack: You can target 1 Spell Card in your Graveyard; Set that target." effect is an optional Trigger Effect that can be activated when this card is targeted for an attack. (This effect targets.)

name: Legion the Fiend Jester
desc: During your Main Phase, you can Tribute Summon 1 Spellcaster monster in face-up Attack Position, in addition to your Normal Summon/Set. (You can only gain this effect once per turn.) If this card is sent from the field to the GY: You can add 1 Spellcaster Normal Monster from your Deck or GY to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Legion the Fiend Jester" once per turn.

name: Lekunga
desc: You can banish 2 WATER monsters from your Graveyard; Special Summon 1 "Lekunga Token" (Plant-Type/WATER/Level 2/ATK 700/DEF 700) in Attack Position.

name: Levia-Dragon - Daedalus
desc: You can send 1 face-up "Umi" you control to the GY; destroy all other cards on the field.
rulings: If you control multiple cards like "A Legendary Ocean" and "Forgotten Temple of the Deep" that are all treated as "Umi", then you can activate the effect of "Codarus" or "Levia-Dragon - Daedalus" or "Ocean Dragon Lord - Neo-Daedalus" by only sending one of those cards to the Graveyard; you do not send all of them.

name: Little-Winguard
desc: Once per turn, during your End Phase: You can change the battle position of this card.
rulings: The effect of "Little-Winguard" is a Trigger Effect that activates on the field. (The effect does not target. It can optionally be activated once during your End Phase if "Little-Winguard" is face-up in the Monster Zone.)

name: Lord Poison
desc: If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: Target 1 Plant-Type monster in your Graveyard, except "Lord Poison"; Special Summon that target.
rulings: The effect of "Card of Safe Return" cannot be activated during the Damage Step, such as when "Lord Poison" is destroyed by battle.

name: Mad Reloader
desc: If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: Send 2 cards from your hand to the GY, and if you do, draw 2 cards.

name: Magical Merchant
desc: FLIP: Excavate cards from the top of your Deck until you excavate a Spell/Trap, then add that card to your hand, also send the remaining cards to the GY.
rulings: This card's effect is a Trigger Effect that activates in the Monster Zone.
It activates mandatorily if this card is flipped face-up.
It activates even during the Damage Step.
The application of "add that card to your hand" and the application of "send the remaining cards to the GY" are treated as being done at the same time.
It activates even if you have no Spell/Trap Cards in your Deck, but the effect is not applied.
At resolution, if you have no Spell/Trap Cards in your Deck, the effect is not applied.

name: Magical Scientist
desc: Pay 1000 Life Points to Special Summon 1 level 6 or lower Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck in face-up Attack or Defense Position. That Fusion Monster cannot attack your opponent's Life Points directly, and is returned to your Extra Deck at the end of the turn.

name: Magician's Valkyria
desc: Monsters your opponent controls cannot target face-up Spellcaster-Type monsters for attacks, except this one.

name: Maharaghi
desc: This card cannot be Special Summoned. This card returns to the owner's hand during the End Phase of the turn that this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up. If this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up, look at 1 card on the top of your Deck during your next Draw Phase (before you draw), and return the card to the top or the bottom of your Deck.

name: Maiden in Love
rulings: [Regarding the effect "Monsters your opponent controls that can attack must attack this card."]
It is a Continuous Effect that applies in the Monster Zone.
It is an effect that affects your opponent's monsters.
[Regarding the effect "Cannot be destroyed by battle."]
It is a Continuous Effect that applies in the Monster Zone.

[Regarding the effect "At the end of the Damage Step, if this card battled an opponent's monster: You can activate 1 of these effects; ● Place 1 Maiden Counter on 1 face-up monster your opponent controls. ● Take control of 1 opponent's monster with a Maiden Counter."]
It is a Trigger Effect that can be activated in the Monster Zone.
When activating this effect, choose 1 "●" effect and activate it as that effect.

name: Maiden of the Aqua
desc: As long as this card remains face-up on the field, the field is treated as "Umi" (however there is no increasing or decreasing of ATK/DEF due to "Umi"'s effect). If there is an active Field Spell Card on the field, this effect is not applied.
rulings: While this monster is face-up on the field, the field is treated as "Umi".
Because there is no effect of "Umi", ATK and DEF do not change.
If a Field Spell Card is activated while this monster is face-up on the field, the field becomes the activated Field Spell Card.

The effect of either "Maiden of the Aqua" or "Gravekeeper's Priestess" only applies while there is no Field Spell Card in either player's Field Zone. Even if there is no Field Spell Card in the Field Zone of the player who controls "Maiden of the Aqua" (or "Gravekeeper's Priestess"), if there is a Field Spell Card in their opponent's Field Zone, its effect is not applied.
Even if the effect of "Maiden of the Aqua" is applying and treating the field as "Umi", each effect of "The Legendary Fisherman" is applied.

When "Abyss-strom" is activated, "A Legendary Ocean" or "Lemuria, the Forgotten City" can be sent to the Graveyard. Furthermore, when "Abyss-strom" is activated, "Maiden of the Aqua" cannot be sent to the Graveyard. (While the effect of "Maiden of the Aqua" is applying, the field is treated as "Umi", but that does not mean that the name of "Maiden of the Aqua" becomes "Umi".

name: Maju Garzett
desc: The ATK of this card becomes equal to the combined original ATK of the 2 monsters you Tributed for the Tribute Summon of this card.

name: Makyura the Destructor
desc: If this card is sent from the Monster Zone to the GY: You can activate 1 Trap Card from your hand this turn. You can only use this effect of "Makyura the Destructor" once per turn.

name: Malice Doll of Demise
desc: During your next Standby Phase after this card was sent from the field to the Graveyard by the effect of a Continuous Spell Card: Special Summon this card from the Graveyard.

name: Manju of the Ten Thousand Hands
desc: When this card is Normal or Flip Summoned: You can add 1 Ritual Monster or 1 Ritual Spell from your Deck to your hand.

name: Marauding Captain
desc: Your opponent cannot target Warrior monsters for attacks, except this one. When this card is Normal Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower monster from your hand.
rulings: "XX-Saber Boggart Knight", "Marauding Captain", and "Trishula, Dragon of the Ice Barrier" have Trigger Effects. The effect of "Stumbling" will not keep the controller of the card from activating their effects.

"Brionac, Dragon of the Ice Barrier" and "Lonefire Blossom" have Ignition Effects. The effect of "Stumbling" will prevent the controller from activating the effect during the initial chain responding to the successfull Summon.

If "Marauding Captain" is Normal Summoned by the effect of "Ultimate Offering" in the middle of a chain (and is not the last step of the chain to resolve), then you have missed the timing on his effect and you cannot activate his effect to Special Summon a monster from your hand.

name: Marshmallon
desc: Cannot be destroyed by battle. After damage calculation, if this card was attacked, and was face-down at the start of the Damage Step: The attacking player takes 1000 damage.
rulings: When "Ally of Justice Nullfier" battles with a face-down "Marshmallon", first "Marshmallon" is not considered to be destroyed by battle. Afterwards, "Ally of Justice Nullfier"'s effect and "Marshmallon"'s effect to inflict 1000 damage form a chain. "Marshmallon" will be Chain Link 2, so it will resolve first and inflict damage, and then "Ally of Justice Nullfier"'s effect resolves and negates "Marshmallon"'s effects. However, "Marshmallon" is still not destroyed by battle.

If a Warrior-Type monster attacks, performs damage calculation, does not destroy the other monster, and afterwards the other monster is destroyed by a card effect, then the effect of "Sword Master" which Special Summons it can still be activated.

Example: If your Warrior-Type monster attacks an opponent's "Marshmallon", and "Divine Wrath" negates the activation of the damage-inflicting effect of "Marshmallon" and destroys "Marshmallon", then you can still Special Summon "Sword Master".

name: Masked Beast Des Gardius
desc: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by Tributing 2 monsters, including at least 1 "Grand Tiki Elder" or "Melchid the Four-Face Beast". When this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard, equip 1 "The Mask of Remnants" from your Deck to 1 monster on the field.
rulings: This is a Special Summon Monster.
This card can be Special Summoned from the hand using the procedure written on the card. (Special Summoning this card using this procedure does not start a Chain Link.)
After this card is Special Summoned using the procedure written on the card, if it is sent to the Graveyard, it can be Special Summoned from the Graveyard with "Monster Reborn".
The effect of "Masked Beast Des Gardius" is a Trigger Effect that is activated from the Graveyard. (It targets 1 face-up monster your opponent controls. It also activates during the Damage Step.)

name: Masked Dragon
desc: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 Dragon-Type monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck.

name: Mathematician
desc: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can send 1 Level 4 or lower monster from your Deck to the GY. When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can draw 1 card.
rulings: The "When this card is Normal Summoned: You can send 1 Level 4 or lower monster from your Deck to the Graveyard." effect is a Trigger Effect. (This effect does not target.)
The "When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can draw 1 card." effect is a Trigger Effect. (This effect activates and resolves at the end of the Damage Step.)

name: Maximum Six
desc: When this card is Tribute Summoned: Roll a six-sided die, and this card gains ATK equal to the result x 200.

name: Mefist the Infernal General
desc: If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage. If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Make your opponent discard 1 random card.

name: Megarock Dragon
desc: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by removing from play a Rock-Type monster(s) in your Graveyard. The original ATK and DEF of this card become the number of Rock-Type monsters you removed from play when you Special Summoned this card x 700.

name: Mermaid Knight
desc: While "Umi" is face-up on the field, this card can attack twice during the same Battle Phase.

name: Metallizing Parasite - Lunatite
desc: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, if you control this monster on the field, you can equip it to a face-up monster on your side of the field as an Equip Spell Card, OR unequip the Union equipment and Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position. While equipped to a monster by this card's effect, that monster will be unaffected by the effects of Spell Cards controlled by your opponent. (1 monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the monster that this card is equipped to is destroyed as a result of battle, destroy this card instead.)
rulings: When "Mermaid Archer" is equipped with a Union Monster like "Metallizing Parasite - Lunatite" and a Level 3 or lower monsters, if "Mermaid Archer" would be destroyed by battle, then "Metallizing Parasite - Lunatite" is destroyed instead. "Mermaid Archer" would not be destroyed, so you cannot destroy the Level 3 or lower monster instead.

name: Mid Shield Gardna
desc: Once per turn, you can flip this card into face-down Defense Position. Negate the activation of any Spell Card that targets this 1 face-down monster. At that time, flip this card into face-up Defense Position.
rulings: The "Once per turn, you can flip this card into face-down Defense Position." effect is an Ignition Effect. (It does not target.)

The "Negate the activation of a Spell Card that targets this 1 face-down monster. At that time, flip this card into face-up Defense Position." effect is a Quick Effect. (This effect must be activated in chain to the activation of a Spell Card that targeted this face-down card and no other cards. It does not target.)
This effect cannot be activated in a chain to the activation of the effect of a Spell Card. It must be chained to the activation of a Spell Card.
Changing "Mid Shield Gardna" to face-up Defense Position and negating the activation of a Spell Card are considered to happen simultaneously.

name: Mind on Air
desc: Your opponent must play with their hand revealed.

name: Mine Golem
desc: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

name: Miracle Flipper
desc: If you control a "Miracle Flipper", you cannot Summon this card. Your opponent cannot select another face-up monster as an attack target. If this card is destroyed by battle, Special Summon it to your opponent's side of the field at the end of the Battle Phase. If this card is destroyed by the effect of a Spell or Trap Card, destroy 1 monster your opponent controls.
rulings: "If you control a "Miracle Flipper", you cannot Summon this card." is not an effect.
When this card is destroyed by the effect of a Spell/Trap, the effect which destroys one opponent's monster targets the monster.
When this card is destroyed by battle, the effect which Special Summons this card activates during the End Step of the Battle Phase.

name: Mirage Dragon
desc: Your opponent cannot activate Trap Cards during the Battle Phase.

name: Mirage Knight
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned by "Dark Flare Knight" and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. During damage calculation only, this card gains ATK equal to the original ATK of the opponent's monster it is battling. During the End Phase of a turn this card attacked or was attacked: Banish this card.

name: Moai Interceptor Cannons
desc: Once per turn, you can flip this card into face-down Defense Position.

name: Mobius the Frost Monarch
desc: When this card is Tribute Summoned: You can target up to 2 Spell/Trap Cards on the field; destroy those targets.
rulings: This effect targets 1 to 2 cards on the field.
The effect is optional, and activates after this card's successful Tribute Summon.
If you choose to activate the effect, you must target at least one Spell/Trap Card.

If "Mobius the Frost Monarch" is Tribute Summoned by the effect of "Ultimate Offering" in the middle of a chain (and is not the last step of the chain to resolve), then you have missed the timing on his effect and you cannot activate his effect to destroy 2 Spell or Trap Cards.
If "Mobius the Frost Monarch"'s effect targets two cards, you can activate "Dragonic Knight"'s effect by sending the two targetted Spell/Trap Cards to the Graveyard.

When "Sangan" is Tributed to Tribute Summon "Mobius the Frost Monarch" while "Doomcaliber Knight" is on the field, "Sangan" is Chain Link 1 (because it is mandatory) and "Mobius the Frost Monarch" is Chain Link 2 (because it is optional). The effect of "Doomcaliber Knight" will then activate as Chain Link 3. When resolving the effect, "Doomcaliber Knight" will negate the effect of "Mobius the Frost Monarch", and then "Sangan" will resolve normally.

If you Tribute "Mobius the Frost Monarch" for the Tribute Summon of "The Tyrant Neptune", then after "The Tyrant Neptune" gains the effect of "Mobius the Frost Monarch" it is no longer "When this card is successfully Summoned", so you cannot activate the effect of "Mobius the Frost Monarch" which destroys up to two cards on the field.

name: Molten Zombie
desc: When this card is Special Summoned from the Graveyard: Draw 1 card.

name: Mudora
desc: This card gains 200 ATK for each Fairy-Type monster in your Graveyard.

name: Mystic Swordsman LV2
desc: At the start of the Damage Step, if this card attacked a face-down Defense Position monster: Destroy that monster. During the End Phase, if this card destroyed a monster by battle this turn: You can send this face-up card to the Graveyard; Special Summon 1 "Mystic Swordsman LV4" from your hand or Deck.

name: Necro Gardna
desc: During your opponent's turn: You can banish this card from your Graveyard; negate the next attack this turn from a monster your opponent controls (this is a Quick Effect).
rulings: If multiple "Necro Gardna" are removed from play, they will not each negate one attack. Instead, they will all negate your opponent's next attack.

If "Prohibition" declares "Necro Gardna", then you cannot activate the effect of a "Necro Gardna" which was in the Graveyard when "Prohibition" was activated. If a "Necro Gardna" is on the field when "Prohibition" is activated, and later that "Necro Gardna" is sent to the Graveyard, then you can activate the effect of that "Necro Gardna".

You do not choose which attack to negate. If the effect of "Necro Gardna" is activated in the Battle Step, it negates the current attack. Otherwise, it automatically negates the next attack your opponent declares.
"Necro Gardna" can only negate an attack during the turn the effect was activated. You cannot negate an attack on a subsequent turn.

You can activate the effect of "Necro Gardna" during the Draw Phase, Standby Phase, Main Phase 1, and the Start Step and Battle Step of the Battle Phase. You cannot activate it during the Damage Step, End Step, Main Phase 2, or End Phase. You cannot activate it during your turn.

The effects of "Hero Barrier" and "Necro Gardna" negate the first attack declared after the effect resolves. If multiple copies of "Hero Barrier" are activated, then the effects will all negate the next attack declared.

The ATK-increasing effect of "Honest" is considered to activate in the hand. Thus, if the effect of "Light-Imprisoning Mirror" is active, then the effect of "Honest" will not be negated. If "Necro Gardna" activates its effect by removing itself from play from the Graveyard, then the effect is considered to activate in the Graveyard. Thus, if the effect of "Shadow-Imprisoning Mirror" is active, then the activated effect of "Necro Gardna" will be negated.

name: Neko Mane King
desc: During your opponent's turn, when this card in your possession is sent to your Graveyard by an opponent's card effect: It becomes the End Phase of this turn.

name: Neo-Spacian Air Hummingbird
desc: Once per turn: You can gain 500 LP for each card in your opponent's hand.
rulings: Count the number of cards in your opponent's hand when the effect is resolved.

name: Neo-Spacian Aqua Dolphin
desc: Once per turn: You can discard 1 card; look at your opponent's hand and choose 1 monster. If you control a monster with ATK greater than or equal to the ATK of the chosen card, destroy the chosen card, and if you do, inflict 500 damage to your opponent. Otherwise, take 500 damage.
rulings: The effect of "Neo-Spacian Aqua Dolphin" is an Ignition Effect. (Discarding 1 card from your hand is a cost to activate the effect.)
You cannot activate the effect of "Neo-Spacian Aqua Dolphin" if there are 0 cards in your opponent's hand.
The effect does not target. When the effect resolves, look at your opponent's hand and choose 1 monster.

If the ATK of a face-up monster in your Monster Zone monster is greater than or equal to the monster chosen when this effect resolves, apply "destroy the chosen card and inflict 500 damage to your opponent". If no such monster is in your Monster Zone, apply "take 500 damage".
If you apply "destroy the chosen card and inflict 500 damage to your opponent", destroying the chosen monster and inflicting damage are treated as being done at the same time.

When a Fusion or Synchro Monster is Special Summoned, it is possible to activate "Chain Disappearance". The Summoned monster will be banished, but banishing cards with the same name from the hand and Deck does not include the Extra Deck. Therefore, monsters with the same name as the banished Fusion/Synchro Monster will not be banished from the Extra Deck. However, if the Special Summoned monster is "Neo-Spacian Marine Dolphin", as its name is also treated as "Neo-Spacian Aqua Dolphin", "Chain Disappearance" will banish copies of "Neo-Spacian Aqua Dolphin" from the hand and Deck.

When you look at your opponent's hand when resolving the effect of "Neo-Spacian Aqua Dolphin", if there are no monsters in your opponent's hand, the effect finishes resolving. (Neither player will take 500 damage.)

name: Neo-Spacian Dark Panther
desc: Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; until the End Phase, this card's name becomes that monster's original name, also replace this effect with that monster's original effects (if any).
rulings: If "Neo-Spacian Dark Panther" copies a Gemini Monster, he will be treated as a Normal Monster. You will have to Gemini Summon him to get his effect.

If "Neo-Spacian Dark Panther" copies "Phantom of Chaos", you can activate the copied effect and remove from play a monster in your Graveyard. "Neo-Spacian Dark Panther" will gain the name and effect as normal, and its Original ATK will be treated as the removed monster's Original ATK.

When "Neo-Spacian Dark Panther" or "Phantom of Chaos" has its name changed to "Junk Synchron", you can only use it as a Synchro Material Monster for "Junk Warrior" if it becomes a Tuner monster with "Lightwave Tuning".

While you control "Earthbound Immortal Ccapac Apu"/"Earthbound Immortal Aslla piscu"/etc, you can activate the effect of "Phantom of Chaos"/"Neo-Spacian Dark Panther"/etc and target a "Earthbound Immortal Ccapac Apu". After the effect of "Phantom of Chaos"/etc resolves, it is destroyed.

If "Neo-Spacian Dark Panther" copies a Gemini Monster, then "Neo-Spacian Dark Panther" is not treated as a Gemini Monster, even though it has the effect of one. Thus, you cannot equip "Supervise" to a "Neo-Spacian Dark Panther" which has the effect of a Gemini Monster.

The effects of "Neo-Spacian Dark Panther" or "Phantom of Chaos" are only applied as long as "Phantom of Chaos" or "Neo-Spacian Dark Panther" are face-up on the field. When the monster is removed from the field, then it no longer has the copied effects. If a monster like "Neo-Spacian Dark Panther" copies "Sangan" or "D.D. Scout Plane", then you cannot activate the effect of "Sangan" which activates in the Graveyard or the effect of "D.D. Scout Plane" which activates in the place to where cards are removed from play.

The text "This card cannot be used as a Synchro Material Monster, except for the Synchro Summon of a Dragon-Type Synchro Monster. The other Synchro Material Monster(s) cannot be Level 4." of "Debris Dragon" is not treated as an effect, so if "Neo-Spacian Dark Panther" or "Phantom of Chaos" copies "Debris Dragon", then you do not apply this text. Thus, if "Neo-Spacian Dark Panther" copies "Debris Dragon", then you can use it for the Synchro Summon of a non-Dragon-Type Synchro Monster, and the other Synchro Material Monsters may be Level 4.

"Majestic Star Dragon" can only activate the effect of a negated monster only once. If "Majestic Star Dragon" negates the effect of a monster like "Neo-Spacian Dark Panther" or "Phantom of Chaos" and then uses the negated monster's effect to gain the effects of another Effect Monster, then you cannot activate the effect of the other Effect Monster because you already activated the effect of "Phantom of Chaos".

If "Neo-Spacian Dark Panther" gains the effect of "Victory Viper XX03", destroys a monster by battle, and Special Summons an "Option Token", then during the End Phase when the card's name turns from "Victory Viper XX03" back into "Neo-Spacian Dark Panther" there is now no "Victory Viper XX03" on the field, so the "Option Token" which was Special Summoned disappears.

For the effect of a monster like "Neo-Spacian Dark Panther" or "Phantom of Chaos" or "Hundred Eyes Dragon" or "Dragon Knight Draco-Equiste", you choose the time during the End Phase that you stop applying the effect. The effect does not last until the end of the turn.

name: Neo-Spacian Flare Scarab
desc: Gains 400 ATK for each Spell/Trap your opponent controls.

name: Neo-Spacian Glow Moss
desc:
If this card attacks or is attacked: Your opponent draws 1 card and shows it, then, based on its type apply this effect.
● Monster: End the Battle Phase of this turn.
● Spell: If this card is attacking, you can change it to a direct attack instead.
● Trap: Change this card to Defense Position.
rulings: The effect of "Neo-Spacian Glow Moss" is a Trigger Effect. (It always activates when an attack is declared involving "Neo-Spacian Glow Moss". It does not target.)
Your opponent draws a card due to this effect, then you apply the appropriate "●" depending on the card type. (Drawing a card is not treated as the last thing to happen.)
Applying "● Monster: End the Battle Phase" proceeds to the end of the Battle Phase (the End Step) without performing damage calculation.

If "Neo-Spacian Glow Moss" declared the attack, applying "● Spell: If this card is attacking, you can change it to a direct attack instead" causes a replay and you can choose the attack target again (you can also make the attack a direct attack). Also, if "Neo-Spacian Glow Moss" is targeted for an attack, because it cannot attack during the opponent's turn, the attack is performed as normal.

Applying "● Trap: Change this card to Defense Position" changes "Neo-Spacian Glow Moss" itself to Defense Position. (If "Neo-Spacian Glow Moss" declared the attack, the battle ends without performing damage calculation.)

name: Neo-Spacian Grand Mole
desc: At the start of the Damage Step, if this card battles an opponent's monster: You can return both the opponent's monster and this card to the hand.
rulings: The effect activates in the Damage Step before flipping the monster face-up. When "Neo-Spacian Grand Mole" attacks a face-down monster, the monsters are returned to the hand without flipping the monster. Flip Effects will not activate.
If "Neo-Spacian Grand Mole" is attacked while face-down, or is otherwise not face-up at the beginning of the Damage Step, then you cannot activate its effect.

If "Ally of Justice Catastor" battles with "Neo-Spacian Grand Mole", the mandatory effect of "Ally of Justice Catastor" activates as Chain Link 1, and the optional effect of "Neo-Spacian Grand Mole" can activate as Chain Link 2. "Neo-Spacian Grand Mole" will resolve first and return itself to the Hand and "Ally of Justice Catastor" to the Extra Deck. Then, the effect of "Ally of Justice Catastor" will resolve without effect.
The effects of "Ally of Justice Catastor" and "Neo-Spacian Grand Mole" activate before a monster is flipped face-up on the damage step.
If "Ally of Justice Catastor" or "Neo-Spacian Grand Mole" is being attacked while face-down, its effect will miss the timing.

If "Ally of Justice Catastor" battles with "Neo-Spacian Grand Mole" and both monsters are face-up, each effect activates at the same time. "Ally of Justice Catastor" is a mandatory effect, so it will be placed on the Chain first. "Neo-Spacian Grand Mole" is an optional effect, and it will be placed on the Chain second.

When the Chain resolves, the effect of "Neo-Spacian Grand Mole" will return "Neo-Spacian Grand Mole" to its owner's hand and "Ally of Justice Catastor" to its owner's Extra Deck. When "Ally of Justice Catastor" resolves, "Neo-Spacian Grand Mole" is no longer on the Field so it will not be destroyed.

name: Neos Wiseman
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by sending 1 face-up "Elemental HERO Neos" and 1 face-up "Yubel" you control to the Graveyard, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. This card cannot be destroyed by card effects. At the end of the Damage Step, if this card battled an opponent's monster: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to the ATK of the monster it battled, and you gain Life Points equal to that monster's DEF.
rulings: "Cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by sending 1 face-up "Elemental HERO Neos" and 1 face-up "Yubel" you control to the Graveyard, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways" is not treated as an effect. It is a Special Summon Monster's Special Summoning procedure. (Because it sends 1 face-up "Elemental HERO Neos" and "Yubel" on your field to the Graveyard for a Special Summoning procedure, sending them to the Graveyard and the Special Summon are not treated as being done at the same time.)
Even if a "Neos Wiseman" that was successfully Special Summoned is sent to the Graveyard, it cannot be Special Summoned from the Graveyard by the effect of "Monster Reborn".

The effect "At the end of the Damage Step, if this card battled an opponent's monster: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to the ATK of the monster it battled, and you gain Life Points equal to that monster's DEF" is a Trigger Effect. (It does not target. It activates at the end of the Damage Step.)
Applying "Inflict damage to your opponent equal to the ATK of the monster it battled" and "you gain Life Points equal to that monster's DEF" are treated as being done at the same time.
The effect "This card cannot be destroyed by card effects" is a Continuous Effect.

Even if "Neos Wiseman" destroyed "Flash Knight" by battle, the effect of "Neos Wiseman" activates. First, the "Flash Knight" that was destroyed by battle is added to the Extra Deck face-up at the end of the Damage Step. Next, the effect of "Neos Wiseman" is activated. Even in this case, the effect resolves normally, inflicting damage to the opponent equal to the ATK of "Flash Knight" (= 1800) and increasing LP by the DEF of "Flash Knight" (= 600).

name: Newdoria
desc: If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: Target 1 monster on the field; destroy that target.
rulings: This effect targets 1 monster on the field. You can target a face-down monster.

name: Nightmare Penguin
desc: All face-up WATER monsters you control gain 200 ATK. When this card is flipped face-up: Target 1 card your opponent controls; return that target to the hand.
rulings: A Flip Effect Monster is an Effect Monster with "FLIP:" in its text. "Nightmare Penguin" and "Fossil Dyna Pachycephalo" lack this text, so they are not Flip Effect Monsters. Thus, when a face-down "Fossil Dyna Pachycephalo" is flipped by "Ceasefire", its effect will activate.

name: Ninja Grandmaster Sasuke
desc: At the start of the Damage Step, if this card attacks a face-up Defense Position monster: Destroy that monster.

name: Nubian Guard
desc: If this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points, you can return 1 Continuous Spell Card from your Graveyard to the top of your Deck.

name: Old Vindictive Magician
desc: FLIP: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.

name: Orca Mega-Fortress of Darkness
desc: By Tributing 1 "Torpedo Fish" on your side of the field, destroy 1 monster on the field. By Tributing 1 "Cannonball Spear Shellfish" on your side of the field, destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card on the field.

name: Orgoth the Relentless
desc:
Once per turn, during your Main Phase: You can roll a six-sided die 3 times and this card gains ATK/DEF equal to the total x 100 (until the end of your opponent's turn), then, if 2 of the results were the same, apply the appropriate effect. If all 3 were the same, apply all of these effects.
● 1 or 2: This card cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects, until the end of your opponent's turn. ● 3 or 4: Draw 2 cards. ● 5 or 6: This card can attack directly this turn.
rulings: The effect of "Orgoth the Relentless" is an Ignition Effect. (It does not target. It can be activated even during a turn in which you cannot conduct your Battle Phase, or during a turn in which you have already conducted your Battle Phase.)
When this effect resolves, roll a six-sided die 3 times and apply the appropriate effects.

Applying "this card gains ATK/DEF equal to the total x 100 (until the end of your opponent's turn)" and "then, if 2 of the results were the same, apply the appropriate effect. If all 3 were the same, apply all of these effects" do not happen at the same time.
The effect "● 1 or 2: This card cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects, until the end of your opponent's turn" is applied if 2 of the 3 results are 1 or 2.
The effect "● 3 or 4: Draw 2 cards" is applied if 2 of the 3 results are 3 or 4.
The effect "● 5 or 6: This card can attack directly this turn" is applied if 2 of the 3 results are 5 or 6.

name: Orichalcos Shunoros
desc: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. If a Normal Monster you control is destroyed by battle, you can Special Summon this card from your hand. This card gains 1000 ATK for each monster your opponent controls. Face-up Level 4 Normal Monsters on the field cannot be destroyed by card effects.
rulings: "Orichalcos Shunoros" is a Special Summon monster.

The " If a Normal Monster you control is destroyed by battle, you can Special Summon this card from your hand." effect is a Trigger Effect that is activated from the hand at the end of the Damage Step.
After this card is Special Summoned using the procedure written on the card, if it is sent to the Graveyard, it can be Special Summoned from the Graveyard with "Monster Reborn".
The "This card gains 1000 ATK for each monster your opponent controls." effect is a Continuous Effect.
The "Face-up Level 4 Normal Monsters on the field cannot be destroyed by card effects." effect is a Continuous Effect.
"Orichalcos Shunoros" can be Special Summoned when a Gemini monster you control is destroyed by battle while it is being treated as a Normal Monster.

name: Otohime
desc: Cannot be Special Summoned. During the End Phase of the turn this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up: Return it to the hand. When this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up: You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; change that target's battle position.
rulings: The effect "When this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up: You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; change that target's battle position." is a Trigger Effect that activates when "Otohime" is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up. (This effect targets 1 monster face-up in your opponent's Monster Zone.)

Even if "Otohime" is flipped face-up by battle during the Damage Step, the effect "When this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up: You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; change that target's battle position." can be activated. (In this case, it can be activated after damage calculation.)

name: Outstanding Dog Marron
desc: When this card is sent to your Graveyard, add it to your Deck and shuffle it.

name: Oxygeddon
desc: If this card is destroyed by battle with a Pyro monster and sent to the GY: Each player takes 800 damage.
rulings: This effect is a Trigger Effect that activates when it is sent to the Graveyard when destroyed by battle with a Pyro-Type monster.

name: Pandemonium Watchbear
desc: As long as this card remains face-up on your side of the field, "Pandemonium" on your side of the field is not destroyed by your opponent's card effects.

name: Patroid
desc: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, you can look at 1 face-down card your opponent controls, then return it to its original position.

name: Penguin Torpedo
desc: This card can attack directly. When this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: You can target 1 Level 6 or lower monster your opponent controls; take control of it until the End Phase, but its effects are negated, also it cannot declare an attack, while you control it. You can only use this effect of "Penguin Torpedo" once per turn. At the end of the Damage Step, if this card attacked: Destroy this card.

name: Perfect Machine King
desc: This card gains 500 ATK for each other Machine-Type monster on the field.

name: Phantom of Chaos
desc: Your opponent takes no battle damage from attacks involving this card. Once per turn: You can target 1 Effect Monster in your GY; banish that target, and if you do, until the End Phase, this card's name and original ATK become that monster's name and original ATK, and replace this effect with that monster's original effects. You must control this face-up card to activate and to resolve this effect.
rulings: The effect of "Phantom of Chaos" targets one monster in your Graveyard. The monster is removed from play at resolution - it is not a cost.
"Phantom of Chaos" always inflicts 0 Battle Damage to your opponent, regardless of whether or not you use its other effect to gain the effects of another monster.
When you choose to have the effect of "Phantom of Chaos" disappear during the End Phase, it does not start a Chain.

If you have three copies of "Phantom of Chaos", and one of each is copying "Uria, Lord of Searing Flames", "Hamon, Lord of Striking Thunder", and "Raviel, Lord of Phantasms", then you can remove from play the three copies of "Phantom of Chaos" as Fusion Material Monsters to Special Summon "Armityle the Chaos Phantom".

When "Neo-Spacian Dark Panther" or "Phantom of Chaos" has its name changed to "Junk Synchron", you can only use it as a Synchro Material Monster for "Junk Warrior" if it becomes a Tuner monster with "Lightwave Tuning".

If "Gladiator Beast Bestiari" is declared by "Prohibition", "Elemental Hero Prisma"/"Phantom of Chaos"/etc can have its name changed to "Gladiator Beast Bestiari". If "Elemental Hero Prisma" etc was on the field before having its name changed, then it can attack, change its Battle Position, etc. If "Prohibition" was activated and later "Elemental Hero Prisma" etc was Summoned, then when the name of "Elemental Hero Prisma" is changed to "Gladiator Beast Bestiari", it cannot attack, change its Battle Position, etc.

While you control "Earthbound Immortal Ccapac Apu"/"Earthbound Immortal Aslla piscu"/etc, you can activate the effect of "Phantom of Chaos"/"Neo-Spacian Dark Panther"/etc and target a "Earthbound Immortal Ccapac Apu". After the effect of "Phantom of Chaos"/etc resolves, it is destroyed.

The effects of "Neo-Spacian Dark Panther" or "Phantom of Chaos" are only applied as long as "Phantom of Chaos" or "Neo-Spacian Dark Panther" are face-up on the field. When the monster is removed from the field, then it no longer has the copied effects. If a monster like "Neo-Spacian Dark Panther" copies "Sangan" or "D.D. Scout Plane", then you cannot activate the effect of "Sangan" which activates in the Graveyard or the effect of "D.D. Scout Plane" which activates in the place to where cards are removed from play.

The text "This card cannot be used as a Synchro Material Monster, except for the Synchro Summon of a Dragon-Type Synchro Monster. The other Synchro Material Monster(s) cannot be Level 4." of "Debris Dragon" is not treated as an effect, so if "Neo-Spacian Dark Panther" or "Phantom of Chaos" copies "Debris Dragon", then you do not apply this text. Thus, if "Neo-Spacian Dark Panther" copies "Debris Dragon", then you can use it for the Synchro Summon of a non-Dragon-Type Synchro Monster, and the other Synchro Material Monsters may be Level 4.

"Majestic Star Dragon" can only activate the effect of a negated monster only once. If "Majestic Star Dragon" negates the effect of a monster like "Neo-Spacian Dark Panther" or "Phantom of Chaos" and then uses the negated monster's effect to gain the effects of another Effect Monster, then you cannot activate the effect of the other Effect Monster because you already activated the effect of "Phantom of Chaos".

If "Phantom of Chaos" copies "Fairy Archer" and activates its effect, then you still cannot activate the damage-inflicting effect again even if you change the name of "Phantom of Chaos" with the effect of "Hero Mask".

For the effect of a monster like "Neo-Spacian Dark Panther" or "Phantom of Chaos" or "Hundred Eyes Dragon" or "Dragon Knight Draco-Equiste", you choose the time during the End Phase that you stop applying the effect. The effect does not last until the end of the turn.

name: Pinch Hopper
desc: When this card you control is sent to your GY: You can Special Summon 1 Insect monster from your hand.

name: Pitch-Black Warwolf
desc: Your opponent cannot activate Trap Cards during the Battle Phase.

name: Pitch-Dark Dragon
desc: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, if you control this card on the field, you can equip it to your "Dark Blade" as an Equip Spell Card, OR unequip the Union equipment and Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position. While equipped to a monster by this card's effect, increase the ATK/DEF of the equipped monster by 400 points. When it attacks with an ATK that is higher than the DEF of a Defense Position monster, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points. (1 monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster is destroyed as a result of battle, destroy this card instead.)

name: Plasma Warrior Eitom
desc:
(This card is always treated as a "Magna Warrior" card.)
Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand or GY) by Tributing 1 Level 7 or higher monster. You can only Special Summon "Plasma Warrior Eitom" once per turn this way. Once per turn: You can send 1 "Magnet Warrior" or "Magna Warrior" monster from your Deck to the GY, except "Plasma Warrior Eitom"; for the rest of this turn, this card's original ATK becomes 1500, also it can attack directly.

name: Possessed Dark Soul
desc: You can Tribute this face-up card; take control of all face-up Level 3 or lower monsters your opponent currently controls.
rulings: If this card is face-down on the field, you cannot activate its effect.
If "Possessed Dark Soul" has you gain control of a Level 3 or lower monster, then you still retain control of the monster even if the monster's Level is increased to 4 or higher.

Example: If "Possessed Dark Soul" has you gain control of "Sangan" (Level 3), then "Sangan" is not returned to the opponent's control if its Level is increased to 4 because it is equipped with "Synchro Boost".

name: Prickle Fairy
desc: Your opponent cannot attack Insect monsters. If this card battled a monster, at the end of the Damage Step: Change that monster to Defense Position.

name: Proto-Cyber Dragon
desc: This card's name becomes "Cyber Dragon" while on the field.
rulings: The effect of "Proto-Cyber Dragon" is a Continuous Effect.
"Proto-Cyber Dragon" is treated as "Cyber Dragon" only while it is face-up in the Monster Zone. It is treated as "Proto-Cyber Dragon" in the hand, Deck, Graveyard, etc.

The effect of "Proto-Cyber Dragon" is a Continuous Effect, so if it is treated as an Equip Spell Card by the effect of a card such as "Relinquished", the effect will not be applied and it will not be treated as "Cyber Dragon".

name: Pumpkin Carriage
desc: "Prinzessin" you control can attack directly. Your opponent cannot target "Golden Castle of Stromberg" you control with card effects, also it cannot be destroyed by card effects.

name: Puppet Master
desc: When this card is Tribute Summoned: You can pay 2000 LP, then target 2 Fiend monsters in your GY; Special Summon those targets, but they cannot attack this turn.

name: Pyramid Turtle
desc: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can Special Summon 1 Zombie monster with 2000 or less DEF from your Deck.

name: Ra's Disciple
desc: When this card is Summoned: You can Special Summon up to 2 "Ra's Disciple" from your hand and/or Deck. Cannot be Tributed, except for the Tribute Summon of "Slifer the Sky Dragon", "Obelisk the Tormentor", or "The Winged Dragon of Ra". You cannot Special Summon monsters, except by the effect of "Ra's Disciple".

name: Rainbow Dark Dragon
desc:
(This card is always treated as an "Ultimate Crystal" card.)
Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 7 DARK monsters with different names from your GY. You can banish all other DARK monsters from your field and GY; this card gains 500 ATK for each card banished this way.
rulings: This card can only be Special Summoned by the method described in its text. Even if this card is Special Sumoned once, it cannot be Special Summoned from the Graveyard with effects like "Monster Reborn".
The effect of "Rainbow Dark Dragon" is an Ignition Effect.
Banishing all other face-up DARK monsters you control and from your Graveyard is a cost to activate this effect. (Face-down DARK monsters are not banished.)
The ATK gained by this effect remains as long as this card remains face-up on the field.

name: Rainbow Dragon
desc:
(This card is always treated as an "Ultimate Crystal" card.)
Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by having 7 "Crystal Beast" cards with different names on your field and/or GY. This card cannot activate the following effects the turn it is Special Summoned. (Quick Effect): You can send all face-up "Crystal Beast" monsters you control to the GY; this card gains 1000 ATK for each monster sent to the GY. You can banish all "Crystal Beast" monsters from your GY; shuffle all cards on the field into the Deck.
rulings: This card can only be Special Summoned by the method described in its text. Even if this card is Special Sumoned once, it cannot be Special Summoned from the Graveyard with effects like "Monster Reborn".

The "During either player's turn: You can send all "Crystal Beast" monsters you control to the Graveyard; this card gains 1000 ATK for each card sent." effect is a Quick Effect. (It does not target. Sending all face-up "Crystal Beast" monsters you control to the Graveyard is a cost to activate this effect. Face-down monsters are not sent to the Graveyard.)
If this effect is activated during the Damage Step, it can be activated from the start of the Damage Step until before damage calculation.
The ATK gained by this effect remains as long as this card remains face-up on the field.

The "You can banish all "Crystal Beast" monsters in your Graveyard; shuffle all cards on the field into the Decks." effect is an Ignition Effect. (It does not target. Banishing all "Crystal Beast" monsters in your Graveyard is a cost to activate this effect. When resolving this effect, "Rainbow Dragon" is also shuffled into the Deck.)

name: Rallis the Star Bird
desc: This card gains ATK equal to the Level of the monster that it battles x 200 during the Damage Step only. If this card attacks, it is removed from play at the end of the Damage Step and returned to your side of the field in face-up Attack Position at the beginning of your next turn's Battle Phase.

name: Rare Metal Dragon
desc: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set.
rulings: This is a Special Summon Monster.

name: Raviel, Lord of Phantasms
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing 3 Fiend-Type monsters, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. If your opponent Normal Summons a monster(s): Special Summon 1 "Phantasm Token" (Fiend-Type/DARK/Level 1/ATK 1000/DEF 1000) for each monster Summoned, but it cannot declare an attack. Once per turn: You can Tribute 1 monster; this card gains ATK equal to the original ATK of the Tributed monster until the end of this turn.
rulings: If you have three copies of "Phantom of Chaos", and one of each is copying "Uria, Lord of Searing Flames", "Hamon, Lord of Striking Thunder", and "Raviel, Lord of Phantasms", then you can remove from play the three copies of "Phantom of Chaos" as Fusion Material Monsters to Special Summon "Armityle the Chaos Phantom".

name: Reborn Zombie
desc: While you have no cards in your hand and this card is in Attack Position, it cannot be destroyed by battle.

name: Red Gadget
desc: When this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Yellow Gadget" from your Deck to your hand.
rulings: When "Green Gadget" is Normal/Special Summoned, you cannot activate its effect if there is no "Red Gadget" in your Deck.

name: Red-Eyes Darkness Dragon
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing 1 "Red-Eyes B. Dragon" and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. This card gains 300 ATK for each Dragon-Type monster in your Graveyard.
rulings: "Red-Eyes Darkness Dragon" is a Special Summon monster.
This card cannot be Special Summoned from the Graveyard.

If "Enraged Muka Muka" or "Red-Eyes Darkness Dragon" has its ATK halved by the effect of "Black Garden", then afterwards the monster's ATK does not change, even if the number of cards in your hand or the contents of the Graveyard change.

Example: If you have five cards in your hand and you Summon "Enraged Muka Muka", then the effect of "Black Garden" halves its ATK from 3200 to 1600. If there are two Dragon-Type monsters in your Graveyard and you Summon "Red-Eyes Darkness Dragon", then the effect of "Black Garden" halves its ATK from 3000 to 1500.

name: Red-Eyes Darkness Metal Dragon
desc: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by banishing 1 face-up Dragon monster you control. You can only Special Summon "Red-Eyes Darkness Metal Dragon" once per turn this way. During your Main Phase: You can Special Summon 1 Dragon monster from your hand or GY, except "Red-Eyes Darkness Metal Dragon". You can only use this effect of "Red-Eyes Darkness Metal Dragon" once per turn.
rulings: This card is a Normal Summon Monster.
The effect which Special Summons a Dragon-Type monster does not target.

"Red-Eyes Darkness Metal Dragon" and "Dark Simorgh" are Normal Summon Monsters, so they can be Tribute Summoned from the hand. They may also be Special Summoned from the Graveyard with another card effect, even if the monster is sent directly to the Graveyard from the hand or Deck.
You can remove from play a Dragon-Type Token Monster from the field to Special Summon "Red-Eyes Darkness Metal Dragon".

name: Red-Eyes Wyvern
desc: During your End Phase, if you did not Normal Summon/Set a monster this turn: You can banish this card from your Graveyard; Special Summon 1 "Red-Eyes" monster from your Graveyard, except "Red-Eyes B. Chick".
rulings: The effect of "Red-Eyes Wyvern" is a Trigger Effect that activates in the Graveyard.
Banishing "Red-Eyes Wyvern" is a cost to activate this effect.
This effect targets 1 "Red-Eyes" monster in your Graveyard.

During the End Phase of a turn in which you have not Normal Summoned/Set a monster, if "Red-Eyes Wyvern" is sent from the hand to the Graveyard because you had more cards than your hand size limit, the effect of "Red-Eyes Wyvern" cannot be activated.

name: Reflect Bounder
desc: Before damage calculation, if this card is being attacked by an opponent's monster, and was in face-up Attack Position at the start of the Damage Step: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to the attacking monster's ATK. If you do, after damage calculation: Destroy this card.

name: Regenerating Rose
desc: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, you can Special Summon 2 "Regenerating Rose Tokens" (Plant-Type/DARK/Level 3/ATK 1200/DEF 1200).
rulings: "Regenerating Rose" and "Regenerating Rose Token" are not "Archfiend" monsters.

name: Reign-Beaux, Overlord of Dark World
desc: If this card is discarded from your hand to your Graveyard by an opponent's card effect: Special Summon this card from the Graveyard. When this card is Special Summoned this way: Destroy all monsters your opponent controls OR all Spell/Trap Cards they control.

name: Rescue Cat
desc: You can send this card to the GY; Special Summon 2 Level 3 or lower Beast monsters from your Deck, but their effects are negated, also they are destroyed during the End Phase. You can only use this effect of "Rescue Cat" once per turn.
rulings: The effect of "Rescue Cat" is an Ignition Effect.
Sending "Rescue Cat" from your Monster Zone to the Graveyard is a cost to activate its effect.
This effect does not target. (If you do not have 2 Level 3 or lower Beast-Type monsters in your Deck, the effect of "Rescue Cat" cannot be activated.)
2 Level 3 or lower Beast-Type monsters are Special Summoned from your Deck at the same time.
Resolving "they are destroyed during the End Phase." does not start a Chain Link.

name: Rescueroid
desc: When a "roid" monster you control is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, you can return that monster to its owner's hand.
rulings: This effect is an optional Trigger Effect that can be activated at the end of the Damage Step. (It does not target.)
This effect cannot be activated when this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard.

When resolving the effect of "Rescueroid", if "Rescueroid" is no longer on the field, the effect is not applied. (The monster that was destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard is not returned to the hand.)

The effect of "Rescueroid" can be activated when a "roid" monster you control owned by your opponent is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard. In this case, when resolving the effect of "Rescueroid", the monster is not returned to the hand of the player who activated the effect of "Rescueroid", it is returned to its owner's hand.

Since "Elemental HERO Necroid Shaman" and "Dark Jeroid" are "roid" monsters, the effect of "Rescueroid" can be activated when they are destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard. If this effect is activated when "Elemental HERO Necroid Shaman" is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, "Elemental HERO Necroid Shaman" is returned to the Extra Deck.

name: Return Zombie
desc: During your Standby Phase: You can pay 500 Life Points; add this card from your Graveyard to your hand. You must have no cards in your hand to activate and to resolve this effect.

name: Royal Magical Library
desc: Each time a Spell Card is activated, place 1 Spell Counter on this card when that Spell resolves (max. 3). You can remove 3 Spell Counters from this card; draw 1 card.
rulings: Removing three Spell Counters from "Royal Magical Library" is a cost to activate the effect card-drawing effect.

When you use the Spell Counter-substituting effect of "Magical Citadel of Endymion", all Spell Counters must be removed from "Magical Citadel of Endymion". When you activate the effect of "Royal Magical Library", you must remove all three Spell Counters from "Magical Citadel of Endymion" if you are using the effect. (You cannot remove one Spell Counter from "Royal Magical Library" and two from "Magical Citadel of Endymion", etc.)

name: Royal Straight Slasher
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned with "Royal Straight". If you have all of "Queen's Knight", "King's Knight", and "Jack's Knight" in your GY: You can send 5 monsters, with different Levels of 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5, from your hand and/or Deck to the GY, and if you do, destroy all cards your opponent controls. When this card is destroyed by battle: You can target up to 3 LIGHT Warrior monsters in your GY; Special Summon them. You can only use each effect of "Royal Straight Slasher" once per turn.

name: Ryu Kokki
desc: At the end of the Damage Step, if this card battled a Warrior or Spellcaster-Type monster: Destroy that monster.
rulings: The effect does not target.
The Warrior/Spellcaster-Type monster with which this card battles is destroyed at the end of the Damage Step only when it is not already destroyed (by battle, another effect, etc).

name: Samsara Lotus
desc: During your End Phase, if you control no Spell or Trap Cards, you can Special Summon this card from your Graveyard in face-up Attack Position. This card's controller takes 1000 damage during each of their Standby Phases.

name: Sand Gambler
desc: Toss a coin 3 times. If all 3 results are Heads, destroy all monsters on your opponent's side of the field. If all 3 results are Tails, destroy all monsters on your side of the field. You can only activate this effect once per turn, during your Main Phase.
rulings: You cannot chain "Stardust Dragon"'s effect to effects if you don’t know for certain that they will destroy card(s) when the effect is activated. "Stardust Dragon"'s effect cannot be used against ... "Sand Gambler", ... etc.

name: Sasuke Samurai
desc: At the start of the Damage Step, if this card attacks a face-down Defense Position monster: Destroy that face-down monster.

name: Sasuke Samurai
desc: At the start of the Damage Step, if this card attacks a face-down Defense Position monster: Destroy that face-down monster.

name: Satellite Cannon
desc: This card cannot be destroyed by battle with a Level 7 or lower monster. During each of your End Phases: This card gains 1000 ATK. If this card attacks, this increased ATK returns to 0, after damage calculation.
rulings: The effect that makes "Satellite Cannon" unable to be destroyed by battle with Level 7 or lower monsters is a Continuous Effect.
The effect that increases the ATK of "Satellite Cannon" by 1000 is a Trigger Effect that activates on the field. (This effect does not target. It always activates once during the End Phase.)

While "Satellite Cannon" is face-up in the Monster Zone, and has not attacked, the ATK gained by its effect remains applied. (The increased ATK does not return to 0 if "Satellite Cannon" is attacked by an opponent's monster.)
The effect that returns the increased ATK to 0 after damage calculation if "Satellite Cannon" attacks is a Continuous Effect.

name: Sauropod Brachion
desc: Cannot be Special Summoned from the Deck. You can Tribute Summon this card face-up by Tributing 1 Dinosaur-Type monster. Once per turn: You can change this card to face-down Defense Position. If this card is Flip Summoned: Change all other monsters on the field to face-down Defense Position. If this card is attacked, any battle damage your opponent takes from that battle is doubled.
rulings: "You cannot Special Summon this card" and "You can Tribute Summon this card by Tributing 1 Dinosaur-Type monster" are not effects.
You can Tribute a face-down monster to Tribute Summon this card.
The text "You cannot Special Summon this card from your Deck. You can Tribute Summon this card by Tributing 1 Dinosaur-Type monster." of "Sauropod Brachion" is not treated as an effect.
You can Normal Summon "Sauropod Brachion" by Tributing one face-down Dinosaur-Type monster.

name: Scarr, Scout of Dark World
desc: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: Add 1 Level 4 or lower "Dark World" monster from your Deck to your hand.

name: Second Goblin
desc: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, if you control this monster on the field, you can equip it to your "Giant Orc" as an Equip Spell Card, OR unequip the Union equipment and Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position. While equipped to a monster by this card's effect, you can change the equipped monster's battle position once per turn. (1 monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster is destroyed as a result of battle, destroy this card instead.)
rulings: The effect of "Second Goblin" which changes the equipped monster's Battle Position can only be activated once per turn.

name: Serpentine Princess
desc: If this face-up card is returned from the field to your Deck, select and Special Summon 1 Level 3 or lower monster from your Deck to your side of the field. Then shuffle your Deck.
rulings: This card's effect is a Trigger Effect that activates in the Deck.
It activates mandatorily.
It activates even during the Damage Step.

name: Shadow Tamer
desc:
(This card is always treated as an "Archfiend" card.)
FLIP: Target 1 Fiend-Type monster your opponent controls; take control of that target until the End Phase.
rulings: This card is considered an "Archfiend" card. "Archfiend" cards are:
Anything with "Archfiend" in the name.
A Deal with Dark Ruler
Axe of Despair
B. Skull Dragon
Beast of Talwar
Fiend Skull Dragon
Lesser Fiend
Shadow Tamer
Summoned Skull
Toon Summoned Skull

name: Shell Knight
desc: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can change this card to Defense Position, and if you do, inflict 500 damage to your opponent. If this card is destroyed by battle or sent to the GY by a card effect: You can add 1 Level 8 Rock monster from your Deck to your hand, or if "Fossil Fusion" is in your GY, you can Special Summon it instead. For the rest of this turn, you cannot activate cards, or the effects of cards, with the same name as that card. You can only use this effect of "Shell Knight" once per turn.

name: Silent Swordsman LV3
desc: Negate your opponent's Spell effects that target this card. During your Standby Phase: You can send this face-up card to the Graveyard; Special Summon 1 "Silent Swordsman LV5" from your hand or Deck. You cannot activate this effect the turn this card is Summoned or flipped face-up.

name: Silent Swordsman LV5
desc: Unaffected by your opponent's Spell effects. During your next Standby Phase after this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent by a direct attack: You can send this face-up card to the Graveyard; Special Summon 1 "Silent Swordsman LV7" from your hand or Deck.
rulings: You can target "Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV6" or "Silent Swordsman LV5" with "Level Down!?", but you won't return the monster to the deck and you won't Special Summon any monster.

name: Silent Swordsman LV7
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned by "Silent Swordsman LV5", and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. Negate all Spell effects on the field.

name: Simorgh, Bird of Divinity
desc: This card cannot be Special Summoned. If you Tribute Summon this card, all Tributes must be WIND. Each player takes 1000 damage during each of their End Phases, while this card remains face-up on the field. This damage is decreased by 500 for each Spell/Trap Card the player controls.
rulings: You can use the effect of "Mausoleum of the Emperor" to Normal Summon or Set monsters like "Simorgh, Bird of Divinity" or "Diabolos, King of the Abyss" from your hand, without Tributing monsters.

name: Singularity Fiend
desc: When your opponent Special Summons a monster(s) (except during the Damage Step): You can discard this card and 1 Spell; destroy that monster(s). You can only use this effect of "Singularity Fiend" once per turn.
rulings: [Regarding the effect "When your opponent Special Summons a monster(s): You can discard this card and 1 Spell; destroy that monster(s)."
This is a Trigger Effect that can be activated in the hand.

This effect can only be activated immediately after your opponent Special Summons a monster. It cannot be activated if another action continues after the Special Summon, such as if the monster was Special Summoned by an effect activated at Chain Link 2 or higher.

name: Skilled Dark Magician
desc: Each time a Spell Card is activated, place 1 Spell Counter on this card when that Spell resolves (max. 3). You can Tribute this card with 3 Spell Counters on it; Special Summon 1 "Dark Magician" from your hand, Deck, or GY.
rulings: Tributing "Skilled Dark Magician" with three Spell Counters on it is a cost to activate its effect which Special Summons "Dark Magician".
You cannot activate the effect of "Skilled Dark Magician" or "Skilled White Magician" if you have no "Dark Magician" or "Buster Blader" in your hand/Deck/Graveyard.

The effects of "Skilled Dark Magician" and "Skilled White Magician" are not activated by removing Spell Counters, so you cannot remove the Spell Counters from "Magical Citadel of Endymion" instead, regardless of the number of Spell Counters on "Skilled White Magician".

name: Skull Archfiend of Lightning
desc: During each of your Standby Phases, you must pay 500 Life Points (this is not optional), or this card is destroyed. Before resolving an opponent's card effect that targets this card, roll a six-sided die, negate the effect if you roll 1, 3, or 6, and if you do, destroy that card.

name: Skull-Mark Ladybug
desc: When this card is sent to the Graveyard, increase your Life Points by 1000 points.

name: Spear Dragon
desc: During battle between this attacking card and a Defense Position monster whose DEF is lower than the ATK of this card, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent. If this card attacks, it is changed to Defense Position at the end of the Damage Step.

name: Spell Canceller
desc: Spell Cards, and their effects on the field, cannot be activated. Negate all Spell effects on the field.
rulings: When the effect of "Imperial Order"/"Spell Canceller"/etc negates the effect of "Arcane Barrier"/"Magical Citadel of Endymion"/etc while the latter has Spell Counters on it, all Spell Counters are removed from "Magical Citadel of Endymion"/etc.
If the effect of "Brain Research Lab" is negated by an effect like "Imperial Order" or "Spell Canceller", then all Psychic Counters on "Brain Research Lab" are removed.

name: Spell Striker
desc: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by banishing 1 Spell Card from your Graveyard. This card can attack directly. You take no battle damage from attacks involving this card.
rulings: The effect "You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by banishing 1 Spell Card from your Graveyard." is not an Ignition, Trigger, Quick or Continuous Effect. (Special Summoning this card this way does not start a Chain Link.)

When Special Summoning this card using its own effect, banish 1 Spell Card from your Graveyard as a procedure, then perform the Special Summon. (Banishing 1 Spell Card from your Graveyard is not considered the last thing to happen.)
The effect "This card can attack your opponent directly." is a Continuous Effect.
The effect "You take no battle damage from attacks involving this card." is a Continuous Effect.

name: Spirit Caller
desc: FLIP: You can Special Summon 1 Level 3 or lower Normal Monster from your Graveyard to your side of the field.

name: Spirit Ryu
desc: During your Battle Step, if this card battles (Quick Effect): You can discard 1 Dragon monster to the GY; this card gains 1000 ATK/DEF until the end of the Battle Phase.
rulings: The effect that increases ATK and DEF is a Quick Effect.
Discarding 1 Dragon-Type monster is a cost to activate this effect.

name: Spirit of the Pharaoh
desc: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by the effect of "The First Sarcophagus". When this card is Special Summoned, you can Special Summon up to 4 Level 2 or lower Zombie-Type Normal Monsters from your Graveyard.
rulings: Sending "The First Sarcophagus", "The Second Sarcophagus" and "The Third Sarcophagus" to the Graveyard is a cost to activate the effect of "The First Sarcophagus" which Special Summons "Spirit of the Pharaoh".
When the effect activates, you target the 1-4 Zombie-Type monsters which are to be Special Summoned.

name: Spirit of the Pot of Greed
desc: While this card is in face-up Attack Position on the field, if a player activates "Pot of Greed", they can draw 1 more card.

name: Stealthroid
desc: If this card attacks, destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card at the end of the Battle Phase if you control another "roid" monster.
rulings: This effect is a Trigger Effect that can be activated at the end of the Battle Phase (End Step).
This effect targets 1 Spell/Trap Card on the field.
When resolving the effect of "Stealthroid", if you no longer control another "roid" monster, the effect is not applied. (The targeted Spell/Trap Card is not destroyed.)

name: Steamroid
desc: If this card attacks an opponent's monster, this card gains 500 ATK during the Damage Step only. If this card is attacked by an opponent's monster, this card loses 500 ATK during the Damage Step only.
rulings: The "If this card attacks an opponent's monster, this card gains 500 ATK during the Damage Step only." effect is a Continuous Effect.
The "If this card is attacked by an opponent's monster, this card loses 500 ATK during the Damage Step only." effect is a Continuous Effect.
Even if a "Steamroid" in face-down Defense Position is attacked by an opponent's monster, this effect is applied when it is flipped face-up, and it loses 500 ATK.

name: Stone Statue of the Aztecs
