desc: Double any Battle Damage your opponent takes when they attack this monster.

name: Strike Ninja
desc: (Quick Effect): You can banish 2 DARK monsters from your GY; banish this face-up card until the End Phase. You can only use this effect of "Strike Ninja" once per turn.
rulings: The effect of "Strike Ninja" is a Quick Effect.
The effect does not target.
Banishing 2 DARK monsters from your Graveyard is a cost to activate the effect.
It cannot be activated during the Damage Step.

name: Submarineroid
desc: This card can attack your opponent directly, but when it does so using this effect, the battle damage inflicted to your opponent is the original ATK of this card. At the end of the Damage Step, if this card attacked or was attacked: You can change this card to Defense Position.
rulings: The effect "This card can attack your opponent directly, but when it does so using this effect, the battle damage inflicted to your opponent is the original ATK of this card" is a Continuous Effect.

The effect "but when it does so using this effect, the battle damage inflicted to your opponent is the original ATK of this card" is applied if "Submarineroid" attacks directly using its own effect. (It is not applied if there are no monsters in the opponent's Monster Zone and it is attacking directly.)
The effect "At the end of the Damage Step, if this card attacked or was attacked: You can change this card to Defense Position" is a Trigger Effect. (It does not target.)

The effect "You can change this card to Defense Position" can be activated not only at the end of a Damage Step in which "Submarineroid" attacked, but also at the end of a Damage Step in which an opponent's monster attacked "Submarineroid".

name: Super Conductor Tyranno
desc: Once per turn: You can Tribute 1 monster; inflict 1000 damage to your opponent. This card cannot declare an attack the turn this effect is activated.

name: Susa Soldier
desc: This card cannot be Special Summoned. This card returns to the owner's hand during the End Phase of the turn that this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up. The Battle Damage this card inflicts to your opponent's Life Points is halved.

name: Swarm of Locusts
desc: Once per turn: You can change this card to face-down Defense Position. When this card is Flip Summoned: Target 1 Spell/Trap Card your opponent controls; destroy that target.

name: Swift Gaia the Fierce Knight
desc: If this is the only card in your hand, you can Normal Summon it without Tributing.

name: T.A.D.P.O.L.E.
desc: When this card you control is destroyed by battle and sent to your Graveyard, you can add any "T.A.D.P.O.L.E."(s) from your Deck to your hand.

name: Terrorking Archfiend
desc: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Flip Summoned unless you have an Archfiend Monster Card on your side of the field. The controller of this card pays 800 Life Points during each of his/her Standby Phases (this is not optional). When this card is targeted by the effect of a card controlled by your opponent, when resolving the effect, roll a six-sided die. If the result is 2 or 5, negate the effect and destroy the opponent's card. The effects of an Effect Monster that this card destroyed as a result of battle are negated.

name: The Agent of Wisdom - Mercury
desc: During your Standby Phase, if you controlled this face-up card and had no cards in your hand at the end of the opponent's last End Phase: Draw 1 card.

name: The Creator
desc: Cannot be Special Summoned from the Graveyard. Once per turn: You can target 1 monster in your Graveyard; send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard, and if you do, Special Summon that target.
rulings: Sending a card from your hand is not a cost to activate the effect of "The Creator". The card is sent from the hand to the Graveyard when the effect resolves.

The card sent to the Graveyard by the effect of "The Creator" is sent to the Graveyard when resolving the effect. The monster to be Special Summoned is chosen when the effect of "The Creator" activates, and at this time card to be sent is not in the Graveyard, so if you send a monster to the Graveyard then you cannot choose to Special Summon that same monster.

name: The End of Anubis
desc: While this card is face-up on the field, all effects of Spell, Trap, and Monster Cards that target a card(s) in the Graveyard or that activate in the Graveyard are negated.
rulings: The damage-inflicting effect of "Core Reinforcement" activates when the "Koa'ki Meiru" monster is sent to the Graveyard (or removed from play, etc). If "Core Reinforcement" is sent to the Graveyard, then its effect activates in the Graveyard, so "Core Reinforcement" will negate it.

The "all effects of Spell, Trap, and Monster Cards that target a card(s) in the Graveyard or that activate in the Graveyard are negated." effect of "The End of Anubis" is not negated by the effect of "Necrovalley" because it is not treated as an effect that affects a card in the Graveyard.

name: The Kick Man
desc: When this card is Special Summoned, you can equip 1 appropriate Equip Spell Card from your Graveyard to this card.

name: The Tricky
desc: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by discarding 1 card.
rulings: "The Tricky" is not a Special Summon monster. Despite being a monster that can be Normal Summoned, it is a monster that can also be Special Summoned by performing the procedure of discarding 1 card from the hand. In other words, Special Summoning "The Tricky" from the hand by discarding 1 card from the hand does not start a Chain, and is not an effect that activates. Therefore, even if "Goblin of Greed" is applying its effect that prevents effects from being activated by discarding cards, "The Tricky" can be Special Summoned by the method described in its text.

name: The Trojan Horse
desc: When Tribute Summoning an EARTH monster, you can treat this 1 monster as 2 Tributes.

name: The Winged Dragon of Ra - Sphere Mode
desc: Cannot be Special Summoned. Requires 3 Tributes from either side of the field to Normal Summon to that side of the field (cannot be Normal Set), then shift control to this card's owner during the End Phase of the next turn. Cannot attack. Your opponent cannot target this card for attacks or by card effects. You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 "The Winged Dragon of Ra" from your hand or Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions, and if you do, its ATK/DEF become 4000.
rulings: Since the ATK and DEF of "The Winged Dragon of Ra - Sphere Mode" are ?, its ATK and DEF on the field are treated as 0.

"Cannot be Special Summoned. Requires 3 Tributes from either side of the field to Normal Summon to that side of the field (cannot be Normal Set), then shift control to this card's owner during the End Phase of the next turn." is not treated as the effect of an Effect Monster.

To Tribute Summon "The Winged Dragon of Ra - Sphere Mode" to your Monster Zone, you must Tribute 3 monsters in your Monster Zone. To Tribute Summon "The Winged Dragon of Ra - Sphere Mode" to your opponent's Monster Zone, you must Tribute 3 monsters in your opponent's Monster Zone. (It cannot be Set in face-down Defense Position.)

To Tribute Summon "The Winged Dragon of Ra - Sphere Mode", you must Tribute 3 monsters. You cannot Normal Summon "The Winged Dragon of Ra - Sphere Mode" without Tributing monsters with the effect of "Mausoleum of the Emperor".

If "The First Monarch" has declared DIVINE with its effect, it can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a DIVINE monster. To Tribute Summon "The Winged Dragon of Ra - Sphere Mode" to your Monster Zone, you can Tribute "The First Monarch" treated as 2 Tributes and 1 other monster you control. To Tribute Summon "The Winged Dragon of Ra - Sphere Mode" to your opponent's Monster Zone, you can use a "The First Monarch" in your opponent's Monster Zone that has declared DIVINE as 2 Tributes.

When Normal Summoning "The Winged Dragon of Ra - Sphere Mode", you must choose to Tribute Summon it to your Monster Zone, or Tribute Summon it to your opponent's Monster Zone. To Tribute Summon "The Winged Dragon of Ra - Sphere Mode" to your opponent's Monster Zone, you must Tribute 3 monsters in your opponent's Monster Zone. To Tribute Summon "The Winged Dragon of Ra - Sphere Mode" to your Monster Zone, you must Tribute 3 monsters in your Monster Zone. While the effect of "The Monarchs Stormforth" or "Soul Exchange" is applying, you can Tribute monsters in your opponent's Monster Zone to Tribute Summon it to your Monster Zone. Otherwise, you cannot Tribute monsters from both sides of the field to Tribute Summon "The Winged Dragon of Ra - Sphere Mode".
If "The Winged Dragon of Ra - Sphere Mode" would be Tribute Summoned to your Monster Zone, or to your opponent's Monster Zone, the Tribute Summon can be negated with "Solemn Judgment".
During the End Phase of the next turn after "The Winged Dragon of Ra - Sphere Mode" was Tribute Summoned, control of it returns to its owner if its owner does not control it.

Since this is not treated as the effect of a monster, even if the effect of "The Winged Dragon of Ra - Sphere Mode" is negated by "Skill Drain", control of it returns to its owner during the End Phase of the next turn.

Since this is not treated as the effect of a monster, control of "The Winged Dragon of Ra - Sphere Mode" returns to its owner during the End Phase of the next turn even if it is in face-down Defense Position.

This is not only applied when "The Winged Dragon of Ra - Sphere Mode" is Tribute Summoned to your opponent's Monster Zone. If the control of "The Winged Dragon of Ra - Sphere Mode" is changed to your opponent by the effect of "Creature Swap", control of it returns to its owner during the End Phase of the next turn.

If a "The Winged Dragon of Ra - Sphere Mode" that was Tribute Summoned to your opponent's Monster Zone is banished by "Interdimensional Matter Transporter", it returns to the same side of the field as it was banished from during the End Phase. In this case, control of it does not return to its owner during the End Phase of the next turn.

The "Cannot attack. Your opponent cannot target this card for attacks or by card effects." effect is a Continuous Effect. (Only "The Winged Dragon of Ra - Sphere Mode" cannot attack or be targeted by an opponent's card effects or for attacks.)
While "Skill Drain" is active, since this effect is negated, "The Winged Dragon of Ra - Sphere Mode" can attack and can be targeted by opponent's card effects or for attacks.

If "The Winged Dragon of Ra - Sphere Mode" attacks, and "Skill Drain" is destroyed during the Battle Step by "Mystical Space Typhoon", since "The Winged Dragon of Ra - Sphere Mode" can no longer attack, the attack stops. (A replay does not occur.)

After "The Winged Dragon of Ra - Sphere Mode" is targeted by an opponent's card effect or attack, even if "Skill Drain" is destroyed by "Mystical Space Typhoon", the attack or effect is applied normally.

The "You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 "The Winged Dragon of Ra" from your hand or Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions, and if you do, its ATK and DEF become 4000." effect is an Ignition Effect. (It does not target. Tributing "The Winged Dragon of Ra - Sphere Mode" is a cost to activate this effect.)
The ATK and DEF of a "The Winged Dragon of Ra" that was Special Summoned by "The Winged Dragon of Ra - Sphere Mode" remain at 4000 as long as it remains face-up in the Monster Zone.

While "Macro Cosmos" is active, this effect can still be activated. "The Winged Dragon of Ra - Sphere Mode" is banished instead of being sent to the Graveyard, but "The Winged Dragon of Ra" is Special Summoned normally.

The ATK and DEF of a "The Winged Dragon of Ra" that was Special Summoned by the effect of "The Winged Dragon of Ra - Sphere Mode" become 4000. Even if its effects are negated by "Skill Drain", its ATK and DEF remain at 4000.

"The Winged Dragon of Ra" cannot be Special Summoned normally. It can be Special Summoned by the effect of "The Winged Dragon of Ra - Sphere Mode", but it cannot be Special Summoned with "Monster Reborn" or other card effects.
If a "The Winged Dragon of Ra" that was Special Summoned by the effect of "The Winged Dragon of Ra - Sphere Mode" is changed to face-down Defense Position, its ATK and DEF return to 0.
This effect cannot be activated if you do not have any "The Winged Dragon of Ra" in your hand or Deck.
This effect cannot Special Summon "The Winged Dragon of Ra - Sphere Mode". This effect can only Special Summon "The Winged Dragon of Ra".

name: Theban Nightmare
desc: Gains 1500 ATK while you have no cards in your hand nor in your Spell & Trap Zones.

name: Thestalos the Firestorm Monarch
desc: If this card is Tribute Summoned: Discard 1 random card from your opponent's hand, then, if it was a Monster Card, inflict damage to your opponent equal to its original Level x 100.
rulings: The effect of "Lifeforce Harmonizer" cannot be activated against an effect which may or may not inflict damage, like "Thestalos the Firestorm Monarch".

name: Thunder Ball
desc: At the end of the Damage Step, if a monster battled: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. You can send 1 Trap from your hand or that's Set on your field to the GY; destroy all other monsters in this card's column. If this card in the Monster Zone is destroyed by battle or card effect and sent to the GY: You can target 1 card in your GY; roll a six-sided die, and if the result is 6, add that target to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Thunder Ball" once per turn.

name: Thunder Nyan Nyan
desc: If there is a non-LIGHT monster on your side of the field, destroy this face-up card.

name: Timeater
desc: If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: Your opponent skips their next Main Phase 1.

name: Toon Ancient Gear Golem
desc: Cannot attack the turn it is Summoned. While you control "Toon World" and your opponent controls no Toon monsters, this card can attack your opponent directly. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent. If this card attacks, your opponent cannot activate any Spell/Trap Cards until the end of the Damage Step.

name: Toon Dark Magician Girl
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing 1 monster, while you control "Toon World". If "Toon World" on the field is destroyed, destroy this card. Can attack your opponent directly, unless they control a Toon monster, in which case this card must target a Toon monster for its attacks. Gains 300 ATK for every "Dark Magician" or "Magician of Black Chaos" in either player's GY.

name: Toon Masked Sorcerer
desc: Cannot attack the turn it is Summoned. If "Toon World" on the field is destroyed, destroy this card. While you control "Toon World" and your opponent controls no Toon monsters, this card can attack your opponent directly. If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Draw 1 card.
rulings: This monster is a Normal Summon Monster.
After this card has been Special Summoned, if it is flipped face-down and then Flip Summoned, then it cannot attack during this turn.

name: Torpedo Fish
desc: While "Umi" is face-up on the field, this card is unaffected by any Spell Cards.

name: Toy Soldier
desc: You can Set this card from your hand to your Spell & Trap Zone as a Spell. You can only use each of the following effects of "Toy Soldier" once per turn. If this Set card in the Spell & Trap Zone is sent to the GY: You can Special Summon this card. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Toy Box" from your Deck to your hand, or, if you control "Toy Box", you can add 1 Level 4 LIGHT monster instead.
rulings: [Regarding the effect "You can Set this card from your hand to your Spell & Trap Zone as a Spell."
This effect is not classified as an Ignition, Trigger, Quick, or Continuous Effect.
[Regarding the effect "If this Set card in the Spell & Trap Zone is sent to the GY: You can Special Summon this card."
This is a Trigger Effect that can be activated in the GY.
It can also be activated during the Damage Step.
[Regarding the effect "If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Toy Box" from your Deck to your hand, or, if you control "Toy Box", you can add 1 Level 4 LIGHT monster instead."
This is a Trigger Effect that can be activated in the Monster Zone.
It can also be activated during the Damage Step.
If you control a face-up "Toy Box" when resolving this effect, you can add a Level 4 LIGHT monster from your Deck to your hand instead of a "Toy Box".
Even if you do not have a "Toy Box" in your Deck, you can still activate this effect if you control a face-up "Toy Box" and have a Level 4 LIGHT monster in your Deck.

name: Treeborn Frog
desc: Once per turn, during your Standby Phase, if this card is in your Graveyard and you do not control "Treeborn Frog": You can Special Summon this card. You must control no Spell/Trap Cards to activate and to resolve this effect.
rulings: If "Dark Ruler Ha Des" is on the field when a monster that has an effect that activates from the Graveyard like "Witch of the Black Forest", "Cockroach Knight", "Treeborn Frog" or "Sinister Serpent" is destroyed by a Fiend-Type monster, then their effects will be negated. Also, even if "Dark Ruler Ha Des" is destroyed, the effect of cards like "Sinister Serpent" will remain negated.

When a monster's effects are negated by "Armed Sea Hunter", its effects remain negated even after damage calculation. When "Armed Sea Hunter" destroys "Treeborn Frog" by battle, the effect of "Treeborn Frog" will be negated and it cannot Special Summon itself during the Standby Phase.

If you have multiple copies of a monster like "Treeborn Frog", "The Immortal Bushi" or "Totem Dragon" in your Graveyard during your Standby Phase, then after you Special Summon one copy of "Treeborn Frog", you control a monster, so you cannot Special Summon a second copy of "Treeborn Frog". Therefore, you can only Special Summon one monster like "Treeborn Frog", "The Immortal Bushi" or "Totem Dragon".
While "Necrovalley" is on the field you cannot banish cards from the Graveyard. Therefore, "Debunk" cannot be activated when "Mystic Tomato" or "Treeborn Frog" activates its effect.

name: Troop Dragon
desc: If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: Special Summon 1 "Troop Dragon" from your Deck.

name: Truckroid
desc: When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: Equip the destroyed monster to this card. This card gains ATK equal to the combined ATK of the monsters equipped to it by this effect.
rulings: The effect that equips the destroyed monster to this card is a Trigger Effect. (It does not target.)
This effect activates mandatorily at the end of the Damage Step in which "Truckroid" destroyed an opponent's monster by battle and sent it to the Graveyard.
This effect does not activate if "Truckroid" battles an opponent's monster with the same ATK and both monsters are destroyed.
The effect that makes this card gain ATK equal to the combined ATK of the monsters equipped to it is a Continuous Effect.

name: Twin-Headed Behemoth
desc: During the End Phase, if this card is in the GY because it was destroyed on the field and sent there this turn: You can Special Summon this card, but its ATK/DEF become 1000. You can only use this effect of "Twin-Headed Behemoth" once per Duel.
rulings: The effect of this card which Special Summons it during the End Phase is a Trigger Effect.
This effect can only be used once per Duel. If "Twin-Headed Behemoth" is banished after using its effect, then you still cannot activate its effect a second time.

When you have multiple copies of "Twin-Headed Behemoth" in your Deck, if the effect of one copy activates, then you cannot activate the effect of any copy of "Twin-Headed Behemoth" for the remainder of the Duel.

After "Twin-Headed Behemoth" is Special Summoned by its own effect, if it is changed to face-down Defense Position by "Book of Moon" and then flipped face-up, its ATK and DEF return to the values written on the card (1500 ATK/1200 DEF).

The effect of "Twin-Headed Behemoth" is activated from the Graveyard. It is not negated by "Skill Drain". If "Twin-Headed Behemoth" is Special Summoned by its own effect while "Skill Drain" is active, its ATK and DEF still become 1000.

name: Twinheaded Beast
desc: This card can attack twice during the same Battle Phase.
rulings: The effect does not start a Chain.

name: Tyranno Infinity
desc: The original ATK of this card is the number of your banished Dinosaur-Type monsters x 1000.

name: Tyrant Dragon
desc: During your Battle Phase, if your opponent controls a monster after this card's first attack, this card can make a second attack. Negate any Trap effects that target this card on the field, and if you do, destroy that Trap. This card cannot be Special Summoned from the GY, unless you Tribute 1 Dragon monster.
rulings: After performing the first attack, if your opponent controls another monster, then this card can attack a second time.
The effect that negates the effect of Trap Cards is a Continuous Effect.
The effect that negates the effect of Trap Cards negates the effect of a Trap Card when it resolves.
When "Tyrant Dragon" or "Fiend Skull Dragon" etc. attacks, "Negate Attack" can be activated. However, "Negate Attack" targets, so when it resolves its effect will be negated and it will be destroyed.

name: UFOroid
desc: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, you can Special Summon 1 Machine-Type monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck in face-up Attack Position.

name: Ultimate Obedient Fiend
desc: This card can only attack if this card is the only card on your side of the field and if you also have no cards in your hand. The effects of Effect Monsters that this card destroys are negated.
rulings: The effect "This card can only attack if this card is the only card on your side of the field and if you also have no cards in your hand." of "Ultimate Obedient Fiend" will be negated by "Skill Drain", so that "Ultimate Obedient Fiend" can attack while you have one or more cards in your hand.

name: Ultimate Tyranno
desc: This card can attack all monsters your opponent controls, once each. During your Battle Phase, if you control an "Ultimate Tyranno" that can attack, monsters other than "Ultimate Tyranno" cannot attack.

name: Unshaven Angler
desc: When Tribute Summoning a WATER monster, you can treat this 1 monster as 2 Tributes.

name: Uria, Lord of Searing Flames
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by sending 3 face-up Traps you control to the GY. Gains 1000 ATK for each Continuous Trap in your GY. Once per turn: You can target 1 Set Spell/Trap your opponent controls; destroy that target. Neither player can activate Spell/Trap Cards in response to this effect's activation.
rulings: If you have three copies of "Phantom of Chaos", and one of each is copying "Uria, Lord of Searing Flames", "Hamon, Lord of Striking Thunder", and "Raviel, Lord of Phantasms", then you can remove from play the three copies of "Phantom of Chaos" as Fusion Material Monsters to Special Summon "Armityle the Chaos Phantom".

When the effect of "Blackwing - Gale the Whirlwind" targets "Uria, Lord of Searing Flames", the ATK/DEF of "Uria, Lord of Searing Flames" will remain at the halved value, even if the number of Continuous Trap Cards in the Graveyard changes.

If the ATK & DEF of "Uria, Lord of Searing Flames" are halved by the effect of "Elemental HERO Great Tornado", then its ATK & DEF will remain at the halved value, even if the number of Continuous Trap Cards in the Graveyard changes afterwards.

name: Valkyrie Brunhilde
desc: Unaffected by your opponent's Spell effects. Gains 500 ATK for each monster your opponent controls. When an opponent's monster declares an attack: You can have this card lose exactly 1000 DEF, and if you do, your "Valkyrie" monsters cannot be destroyed by battle this turn.
rulings: The effect that increases this card's ATK by 500 for each monster on your opponent's field is a Continuous Effect.
This card's effect that makes it unaffected by the effects of Spell Cards is a Continuous Effect.
This card's effect that decreases its DEF by 1000 and makes it so "Valkyrie" monsters are not destroyed by battle that turn is a Trigger Effect. (It does not target.)

The 1000 DEF decrease is only applied to the "Valkyrie Brunhilde" that activated this effect, while the part of the effect that makes it so "Valkyrie" monsters are not destroyed by battle that turn is applied to all "Valkyrie" monsters in your Monster Zone. (This includes "Valkyrie" monsters that were in your Monster Zone when the effect resolved, as well as "Valkyrie" monsters that were Special Summoned afterward that turn.)

name: Valkyrie Dritte
desc: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Valkyrie" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Valkyrie Dritte". You can only use this effect of "Valkyrie Dritte" once per turn. Gains 200 ATK for each of your opponent's banished monsters.
rulings: This card's effect that adds a "Valkyrie" card from your Deck to your hand is a Trigger Effect. (It does not target, and can be activated during the Damage Step.)
The effect that increases this card's ATK by 200 for each of your opponent's banished monsters is a Continuous Effect.

This effect increases this card's ATK by 200 for each of your opponent's monsters that are banished face-up. (If the number of your opponent's monsters that are banished face-up changes, this card's ATK changes accordingly.)

name: Valkyrie Erste
desc: If this card is Special Summoned from your hand by a Spell effect: You can target 1 "Mischief of the Time Goddess" in your GY; add it to your hand. If you control a "Valkyrie" monster other than "Valkyrie Erste" (Quick Effect): You can banish 1 monster from your opponent's GY, then this card's ATK becomes equal to the banished monster's original ATK until the end of this turn. You can only use each effect of "Valkyrie Erste" once per turn.
rulings: This card's effect that adds a "Mischief of the Time Goddess" from your GY to your hand is a Trigger Effect. (It targets 1 "Mischief of the Time Goddess" in your GY.)
This effect can be activated optionally when this card is Special Summoned from your hand by the effect of a Spell Card.

This card's effect that banishes a monster from your opponent's GY is a Quick Effect. (It does not target; you choose 1 monster in your opponent's GY when the effect resolves, and banish it. It can also be activated during the Damage Step.)
Banishing the monster from your opponent's GY and changing this card's ATK do not happen simultaneously.

name: Valkyrie Zweite
desc: If this card is Summoned: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy it. After damage calculation, if this card battled: You can target 1 Continuous Spell in your GY; add it to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Valkyrie Zweite" once per turn.
rulings: This card's effect that destroys a monster on your opponent's field is a Trigger Effect. (It targets 1 monster in your opponent's Monster Zone, and can be activated during the Damage Step.)
This card's effect that adds a Continuous Spell Card from your GY to your hand is a Trigger Effect. (It targets 1 Continuous Spell Card in your GY.)
This effect can be activated after damage calculation not only when this card attacks, but also when this card is attacked by an opponent's monster, and even if this card is destroyed by battle.

name: Vampire Genesis
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 "Vampire Lord" you control, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. Once per turn: You can discard 1 Zombie-Type monster to the Graveyard, then target 1 Zombie-Type monster in your Graveyard with a Level less than the discarded Zombie-Type monster's; Special Summon that target.
rulings: Discarding 1 Zombie-Type monster is a cost to activate the effect.
This card cannot be Summoned through any method, other than the one printed on the card.

name: Vampire Lady
desc: When this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Declare 1 card type (Monster, Spell, or Trap); your opponent sends 1 card of that type from their Deck to the Graveyard.

name: Vampire Lord
desc: If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Declare 1 type of card (Monster, Spell, or Trap); your opponent sends 1 card of that type from their Deck to the GY. Once per turn, during your next Standby Phase after this card in your possession was destroyed and sent to your GY by an opponent's card effect: Special Summon this card from the GY.
rulings: When destroyed by a Spell/Trap Card or a Monster Card's effect, the effect activates during the next Standby Phase and starts a chain.
The effect does not activate when "Vampire Lord" is destroyed by battle.
The effect only activates and starts a chain when the original owner controls it. It does not activate when the opponent controls it.
"Royal Oppression" can negate the effect of "Vampire Lord" which Special Summons itself. During the next Standby Phase, the effect of "Vampire Lord" will not activate again.

name: Vampire's Curse
desc: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can pay 500 Life Points; Special Summon it during the Standby Phase of the next turn. When you do: It gains 500 ATK.
rulings: It is a Trigger Effect that activates in the Graveyard. (It does not target. Paying 500 Life Points is the cost to activate this effect.)
It can be activated at the end of the Damage Step in which this card was destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard.
"Special Summon it during the Standby Phase of the next turn" is applied when this effect's Chain Link resolves.
Special Summoning this card during the Standby Phase of the next turn does not start a Chain Link.
It is a Trigger Effect that activates in the Monster Zone. (It does not target.)
If this card is no longer in the Monster Zone, if this face-up card is flipped face-down, or if this card's effects are negated, the effect "It gains 500 ATK" stops being applied.

name: Van'Dalgyon the Dark Dragon Lord
desc:
If you negate the activation of an opponent's Spell/Trap Card(s), or opponent's monster effect(s), with a Counter Trap Card (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If Summoned this way, activate these effects and resolve in sequence, depending on the type of card(s) negated by that Counter Trap:
● Spell: Inflict 1500 damage to your opponent.
● Trap: Target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy that target.
● Monster: Target 1 monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon it.
rulings: The "After a Counter Trap Card you control negates the activation of an opponent's card(s) or effect(s), you can Special Summon this card from your hand." effetc is a Trigger Effect that is activated from the hand. (It cannot be activated during the Damage Step.)

The "Then activate the appropriate effects, based on the type of cards negated:" effect is a Trigger Effect that is activated when this card is Special Summoned by its own effect. (The "● Spell:" effect does not target. The "● Trap:" and "● Effect Monster:" effect targets.)

Suppose "Vanity's Call" negates the activation of 2 of your opponent's Spell Cards and "Van'Dalgyon the Dark Dragon Lord" is Special Summoned from the hand. In this case, its effect will only activate once. Since only 1 type of cards was negated, the "● Spell: Inflict 1500 damage to your opponent." is applied once.

Suppose "Vanity's Call" negates the activation of an opponent's monster effect, Spell Card and Trap Card, and "Van'Dalgyon the Dark Dragon Lord" is Special Summoned from the hand. In this case, its effect will only activate once. ("● Spell:", "● Trap:" and "● Effect Monster:" are all applied, and when this effect is activated you target 1 card your opponent controls and 1 monster in your Graveyard. Each of the "●" is applied in sequence in the same order as they are written on the card text. All of them resolves as part of the same effect, but they are not treated as being applied simultaneously.)

name: Vennominaga the Deity of Poisonous Snakes
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. Must first be Special Summoned with "Rise of the Snake Deity" and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways except by its own effect. This card gains 500 ATK for each Reptile-Type monster in your Graveyard. This card cannot be targeted by, and is unaffected by, Spell/Trap effects and other Effect Monsters' effects. When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can banish 1 other Reptile-Type monster from your Graveyard; Special Summon this card. When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent: Place 1 Hyper-Venom Counter on it. When 3 Hyper-Venom Counters are on this card, you win the Duel.
rulings: "Cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. Must first be Special Summoned with "Rise of the Snake Deity" and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways except by its own effect" is not treated as an effect. (This card can only be Special Summoned from the hand or Deck by the effect of "Rise of the Snake Deity". This card can only be Special Summoned from the Graveyard by its own effect.)
The effect that makes this card gain 500 ATK for each Reptile monster in your Graveyard is a Continuous Effect.
The effect that makes this card be unaffected by, and unable to be targeted by, other cards and effects is a Continuous Effect.

The effect that Special Summons this card is a Trigger Effect that can optionally be activated when "Vennominaga the Deity of Poisonous Snakes" is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard (= at the end of the Damage Step). (It activates in the Graveyard. It does not target. Also, banishing 1 other Reptile monster from your Graveyard is a cost to activate this effect.)

The effect that places 1 Hyper-Venom Counter on this card is a Trigger Effect that always activates when "Vennominaga the Deity of Poisonous Snakes" inflicts battle damage to your opponent (= after damage calculation). (It activates on the field. It does not target.)
"When 3 Hyper-Venom Counters are on this card, you win the Duel" is not treated as a monster effect. It is a Victory condition.

name: Vennominon the King of Poisonous Snakes
desc: Cannot be Special Summoned by another Effect Monster's effect. This card is unaffected by "Venom Swamp". This card gains 500 ATK for each Reptile-Type monster in your Graveyard. When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can banish 1 other Reptile-Type monster from your Graveyard; Special Summon this card.
rulings: "This card is unaffected by "Venom Swamp"." is a Continuous Effect. If the effect of "Vennominon the King of Poisonous Snakes" is negated by "Skill Drain" etc, then it will be affected by "Venom Swamp".
When "Vennominon the King of Poisonous Snakes" or "Vennominaga the Deity of Poisonous Snakes" is destroyed by battle, removing from play the Reptile-Type monster is a cost. This effect is optional.

name: Venom Boa
desc: Once per turn, you can place 2 Venom Counters on 1 monster your opponent controls. If you activate this effect, this card cannot attack during this turn.
rulings: The effect of "Venom Boa" is an Ignition Effect.
The effect targets 1 face-up monster in your opponent's Monster Zone.
The effect of "Venom Boa" cannot be activated during the Main Phase 2 of the turn in which "Venom Boa" attacked.
"Venom Boa" cannot attack during the turn in which the effect of that "Venom Boa" was activated.

name: Venom Serpent
desc: Once per turn, you can place 1 Venom Counter on 1 monster your opponent controls.
rulings: The effect of "Venom Serpent" is an Ignition Effect.
The effect targets 1 face-up monster in your opponent's Monster Zone.

name: Venom Snake
desc: Once per turn, you can place 1 Venom Counter on 1 monster your opponent controls. If you activate this effect, this card cannot attack during this turn.
rulings: The effect of "Venom Snake" is an Ignition Effect.
The effect targets 1 face-up monster in your opponent's Monster Zone.
The effect of "Venom Snake" cannot be activated during the Main Phase 2 of the turn in which "Venom Snake" attacked.
"Venom Snake" cannot attack during the turn in which the effect of that "Venom Snake" was activated.

name: Victory Dragon
desc: This card cannot be Special Summoned. To Tribute Summon this card, you must Tribute 3 Dragon-Type monsters. If this card attacks your opponent directly and reduces their Life Points to 0, you win the Match.
rulings: "Victory Dragon" is a Normal Summon Monster.

name: Volcanic Blaster
desc: When this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard by battle, you can place 1 "Volcanic" monster in your Deck on top of your Deck.
rulings: The effect of "Volcanic Blaster" is a Trigger Effect that is activated from the Graveyard.
This is an optional effect that can be activated when "Volcanic Blaster" is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard (at the end of the Damage Step.)
This effect does not target. If you have no "Volcanic" monsters in your Deck, this effect cannot be activated.
The effect of "Volcanic Blaster" can be activated when it attacks an opponent's monster and is destroyed by battle, or when it is attacked by an opponent's monster and is destroyed by battle.

name: Volcanic Counter
desc: When you take battle damage while this card is in your Graveyard: Banish it from your Graveyard, then if there is a FIRE monster other than "Volcanic Counter" in your Graveyard, inflict damage to your opponent equal to the amount of battle damage you took.
rulings: The effect of "Volcanic Counter" is a mandatory Trigger Effect that is activated from the Graveyard.
This effect does not target.
Banishing "Volcanic Counter" and inflicting damage are considered to happen simultaneously.
This effect activates even if there are no FIRE monsters other than "Volcanic Counter" in your Graveyard.

name: Volcanic Doomfire
desc: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card can only be Special Summoned by sending a face-up "Tri-Blaze Accelerator" you control to the Graveyard. During your opponent's Battle Phase, your opponent must attack this monster with any Attack Position monsters they control. When this card destroys a monster and sends it to the Graveyard, destroy all monsters your opponent controls and inflict 500 damage to your opponent for each monster destroyed by this effect.
rulings: It is not treated as an effect.
It is not treated as an effect. This is the way/procedure to Special Summon this monster.
After sending 1 face-up "Tri-Blaze Accelerator" you control to the Graveyard, Special Summon this card from your hand. (They do not happen at the same time.)
If this card is sent to the Graveyard or banished face-up after being Special Summoned this way, it can be Special Summoned by other card effects.
It is a Continuous Effect that is applied in the Monster Zone.
It is a Trigger Effect that activates in the Monster Zone.
It activates mandatorily if its activation condition is met.
If this card destroys a monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard, this effect activates at the end of the Damage Step. However, it does not activate if this card is also destroyed by battle.

At resolution, apply "Destroy as many monsters your opponent controls as possible". If 1 or more monsters were destroyed, apply "inflict 500 damage to your opponent for each monster destroyed by this effect".
Destroying monsters and inflicting damage happen at the same time.

name: Volcanic Hammerer
desc: Once per turn, you can inflict damage to your opponent equal to the number of "Volcanic" monsters in your Graveyard x 200. If you activate this effect, this card cannot attack during this turn.
rulings: The effect of "Volcanic Hammerer" is an Ignition Effect. (It does not target.)
If you have no "Volcanic" monsters in your Graveyard, you cannot activate this effect.
If "Volcanic Hammerer" already attacked, you cannot activate this effect.
The effect of "Volcanic Hammerer" can be activated during the first turn of the Duel. If "Volcanic Hammerer" is Summoned during your Main Phase 2, its effect can be activated.

name: Volcanic Queen
desc:
This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card can only be Special Summoned from your hand to your opponent's side of the field by Tributing 1 monster your opponent controls. If you Special Summon this card, you cannot Normal Summon or Set this turn.
Once per turn, you can send 1 other card you control to the Graveyard to inflict 1000 damage to your opponent. During your End Phase, either Tribute 1 other monster or take 1000 damage.

name: Volcanic Scattershot
desc: If this card is sent to the Graveyard: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent. If this card is sent to the Graveyard by the effect of a "Blaze Accelerator" card: You can send 2 "Volcanic Scattershots" from your hand and/or Deck to the Graveyard; destroy all monsters your opponent controls.
rulings: After this card is sent to the Graveyard by the effect of a "Blaze Accelerator" card, if the effect that destroys all monsters your opponent controls is activated, 2 "Volcanic Scattershot" are sent from your hand and/or Deck to the Graveyard as a cost.
The "When this card is sent to the Graveyard, inflict 500 damage to your opponent." effect is activated even if this card is sent to the Graveyard as a cost.

Example: If this card is sent to the Graveyard by the effect of "Blaze Accelerator" or "Tri-Blaze Accelerator", the "When this card is sent to the Graveyard, inflict 500 damage to your opponent." effect is activated, and the "destroy all monsters your opponent controls." effect can be activated in a chain by sending 2 "Volcanic Scattershot" from your hand and/or Deck to the Graveyard as a cost. After the chain resolves, the "When this card is sent to the Graveyard, inflict 500 damage to your opponent." effect of the 2 "Volcanic Scattershot" that were sent from the Deck to the Graveyard are activated in a chain.

name: Volcanic Shell
desc: Once per turn: You can pay 500 LP; add 1 "Volcanic Shell" from your Deck to your hand. This card must be in the GY to activate and to resolve this effect.

name: Volcanic Slicer
desc: Once per turn, you can inflict 500 damage to your opponent. If you activate this effect, this card cannot attack during this turn.
rulings: The effect of "Volcanic Slicer" is an Ignition Effect.
This effect does not target.
If "Volcanic Slicer" already attacked, you cannot activate this effect.
The effect of "Volcanic Slicer" can be activated during the first turn of the Duel. If "Volcanic Slicer" is Summoned during your Main Phase 2, its effect can be activated.

name: Vortex Trooper
desc: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can shuffle 2 cards from your hand into the Deck, then draw 2 cards. If this card is destroyed: Draw 1 card.

name: W-Wing Catapult
desc: Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 "V-Tiger Jet" you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it. A monster equipped with this card gains 400 ATK/DEF, also if the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle or card effect, destroy this card instead.

name: Wandering Mummy
desc: You can flip this card into face-down Defense Position once per turn during your Main Phase. After you use this effect, rearrange the face-down Defense Position monsters in your Main Monster Zones, then return them in face-down Defense Position.
rulings: In "After you use this effect, rearrange the face-down Defense Position monsters on your side of the field, then return them in face-down Defense Position.", the text "your side of the field" should read "your Main Monster Zone". (This is effective from March 25, 2017.)
The effect of "Wandering Mummy" is an Ignition Effect. (It does not target.)

The resolution of "You can flip this card into face-down Defense Position once per turn during your Main Phase." and the resolution of "After you use this effect, rearrange the face-down Defense Position monsters on your side of the field, then return them in face-down Defense Position." are not considered to happen at the same time.

Even if you only control 1 "Wandering Mummy" in your Monster Zone, its effect can be activated. In that case, the resolution of "After you use this effect, rearrange the face-down Defense Position monsters on your side of the field, then return them in face-down Defense Position." is not applied.
The monsters rearranged by the effect of "Wandering Mummy" are rearranged in the same Monster Zones they were in. They are not placed in unused Monster Zones.

name: Warrior Lady of the Wasteland
desc: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 EARTH Warrior-Type monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck, in face-up Attack Position.

name: Watapon
desc: If this card is added from your Deck to your hand by a card effect: You can Special Summon this card.
rulings: The effect of "Watapon" activates in the hand.
This card's effect does not target.
This card's effect can be activated during the Damage Step.
If "Watapon" is added to the hand by a card effect that was activated at Chain Link 2 or higher, you can activate its effect after the chain resolves.
The effect of "Watapon" can be activated not only when the effect of "Dogu", etc. adds it to the hand, but also when it is added to the hand by drawing it with the effect of "Jar of Greed", etc.

name: Water Dragon
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned with "Bonding - H2O". The ATK of FIRE monsters and Pyro monsters on the field becomes 0. When this card is destroyed and sent to the GY: You can target 2 "Hydrogeddon" and 1 "Oxygeddon" in your GY; Special Summon them.

name: Weathering Soldier
desc: If this card is destroyed by battle or sent to the GY by a card effect: You can add 1 "Fossil Fusion", or 1 card that specifically lists "Fossil Fusion" in its text except "Weathering Soldier", from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Weathering Soldier" once per turn. Once per turn, during your End Phase: This card loses 600 ATK.

name: Whirlwind Prodigy
desc: When Tribute Summoning a WIND monster, you can treat this 1 monster as 2 Tributes.

name: White Knight Lord
desc:
You can banish 3 monsters from your GY; Special Summon this card from your hand, then you can apply 1 of these effects.
● Special Summon 1 "White Knight" or "White Night" monster from your hand or Deck.
● Add 1 "White Veil" from your Deck to your hand.
You can only use this effect of "White Knight Lord" once per turn. When an attack is declared involving this card and an opponent's monster: Change that opponent's monster's ATK to 0. If this card in its owner's possession is destroyed by an opponent's card: Inflict 1000 damage to your opponent.

name: White Magician Pikeru
desc: During your Standby Phase, increase your Life Points by 400 points for each monster on your side of the field.

name: White Night Dragon
desc: During either player's turn, when a Spell/Trap Card that targets this card is activated: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it. When another face-up monster you control is targeted for an attack: You can send 1 Spell/Trap Card you control to the Graveyard; change the attack target to this card.
rulings: You can activate the effect to negate Spell and Trap Cards more than once in a Chain.
The effect to negate the activation of a Spell and Trap Cards is a Quick Effect.
The effect to change attack targets is a Trigger Effect.
Sending a Spell or Trap Card to the Graveyard is a cost.
The effect to change the attack target does not target.

If you control your opponent's monster with "Snatch Steal" while you have "White Night Dragon" in play and your opponent attacks the equipped monster, if you send "Snatch Steal" to the Graveyard to change the attack target no replay occurs. If the effect of "White Night Dragon" is negated by "Skill Drain" a replay does occur.
The effect of "White Night Dragon" which negates the activation of a Spell or Trap Card is a Quick Effect. It can be activated multiple times in the same Chain.
The effect of "White Night Dragon" which changes the attack target is a Trigger Effect. It does not target. Sending one Spell or Trap Card to the Graveyard is a cost to activate this effect.

While "Skill Drain" is active and you control your opponent's "White Night Dragon" because of "Snatch Steal", if your opponent attacks, then you can activate the effect of "White Night Dragon" and send "Snatch Steal" to the Graveyard. However, "White Night Dragon" will not change the attack target to itself because it changed sides. After this, a Replay occurs because the number of monster you control changed.

If you only control "White Night Dragon" and a monster equipped with "Snatch Steal", then when your opponent attacks the equipped monster, you can send "Snatch Steal" to the Graveyard to activate the effect of "White Night Dragon". The attack target will be changed to "White Night Dragon", and no Replay occurs.
After changing the attack target with the effect of a card like "Card Blocker" or "White Night Dragon" or "Crystal Beast Amber Mammoth", you cannot activate the effect of a second "Card Blocker" etc.

The effect of "White Night Dragon" which negates the activation of a Spell or Trap Card is not optional - you cannot choose to not activate it. It will also negate the activation of your own Spell and Trap Cards.

name: White Night Queen
desc: Cannot be Special Summoned. Once per turn: You can target 1 Set card; destroy that target.
rulings: This monster is not a Special Summon Monster.
The effect targets one Set card on the field.

name: Winged Kuriboh
desc: If this card on the field is destroyed and sent to the GY: For the rest of this turn, you take no battle damage.
rulings: You can target "Winged Kuriboh LV10" with "Level Down!?". You cannot Special Summon "Winged Kuriboh" (since it is not a "LV" monster), but you can Special Summon "Winged Kuriboh LV9".

name: Winged Kuriboh LV10
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned with "Transcendent Wings". During your opponent's Battle Phase (Quick Effect): You can Tribute this face-up card; destroy as many Attack Position monsters your opponent controls as possible, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to the combined original ATK of those destroyed monster(s).
rulings: "Cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. Must be Special Summoned with "Transcendent Wings" and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways" is not treated as an effect.
Even if it is sent to the Graveyard after being Special Summoned by the effect of "Transcendent Wings", it cannot be Special Summoned by the effect of "Monster Reborn" etc.

The monster effect "During your opponent's Battle Phase: You can Tribute this face-up card; destroy all Attack Position monsters your opponent controls and inflict damage to your opponent equal to the combined original ATK of those destroyed monster(s)" is a Quick Effect that can only be activated during your opponent's Battle Phase. (It does not target. Tributing "Winged Kuriboh LV10" itself is a cost to activate this effect. Also, it cannot be activated during the Damage Step.)
Even if it is sent to the Graveyard after being Special Summoned by the effect of "Transcendent Wings", it cannot be Special Summoned by the effect of "Monster Reborn" etc.

Applying "destroy all Attack Position monsters your opponent controls" and "inflict damage to your opponent equal to the combined original ATK of those destroyed monster(s)" are treated as being done at the same time.

If "Level Down!?" is activated, there must be a monster "with the same name but lower "LV"" in your Graveyard, and you must be able to Special Summon that monster. Therefore, if you target "Winged Kuriboh LV10" with "Level Down!?", there must be a "Winged Kuriboh LV9" in your Graveyard. (You cannot Special Summon "Winged Kuriboh" with the effect of "Level Down!?".)

"Winged Kuriboh LV10" is a Special Summon-only monster that cannot be Special Summoned except by the effect of "Transcendent Wings". Therefore, it cannot be targeted with the second effect of "Kuribohrn".

name: Wroughtweiler
desc: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: Target 1 "Elemental HERO" card and 1 "Polymerization" in your Graveyard; add both those targets to your hand.

name: Y-Dragon Head
desc: Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 "X-Head Cannon" you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it. A monster equipped with this card gains 400 ATK/DEF, also if the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle or card effect, destroy this card instead.

name: Yamata Dragon
desc: This card cannot be Special Summoned. This card returns to its owner's hand during the End Phase of the turn it is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up. When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand.

name: Yata-Garasu
desc: This card cannot be Special Summoned. This card returns to its owner's hand during the End Phase of the turn it is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up. When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, they skip their next Draw Phase.

name: Yellow Gadget
desc: When this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Green Gadget" from your Deck to your hand.

name: Yowie
desc: If this card is Summoned (and no other cards): You can activate this effect; your opponent skips their next Draw Phase. You can only Special Summon once, the turn you activate this effect. You can only use this effect of "Yowie" once per Duel.

name: Yubel
desc: This card cannot be destroyed by battle. You take no Battle Damage from battles involving this card. Before damage calculation, when this face-up Attack Position card is attacked by an opponent's monster: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to that monster's ATK. During your End Phase: Tribute 1 other monster or destroy this card. When this card is destroyed, except by its own effect: Its owner can Special Summon 1 "Yubel - Terror Incarnate" from their hand, Deck, or Graveyard.
rulings: The effect "This card cannot be destroyed by battle. You take no Battle Damage from battles involving this card." is a Continuous Effect that is applied in the Monster Zone.

The effect "Before damage calculation, when this face-up Attack Position card is attacked by an opponent's monster: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to that monster's ATK." is a Trigger Effect that activates in the Monster Zone. (It activates mandatorily. It activates before damage calculation during a battle in which this Attack Position card was targeted for an attack.)
The effect "During your End Phase: Tribute 1 other monster or destroy this card." is a Trigger Effect that activates in the Monster Zone. (It activates mandatorily during each of your End Phases.)

The effect "When this card is destroyed, except by its own effect: Its owner can Special Summon 1 "Yubel - Terror Incarnate" from their hand, Deck, or Graveyard." is a Trigger Effect that can be activated by this destroyed card. (It can be activated even during the Damage Step.)

This effect can only be activated immediately after this card is destroyed. It cannot be activated if another effect resolution takes place after this card is destroyed, for example if this card is destroyed by a card effect activated as Chain 2 or higher.

name: Yubel - Terror Incarnate
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. Must be Special Summoned by "Yubel", and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. This card cannot be destroyed by battle. You take no Battle Damage from battles involving this card. Before damage calculation, when this face-up Attack Position card is attacked by an opponent's monster: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to that monster's ATK. During your End Phase: Destroy all other monsters on the field. When this face-up card leaves the field: You can Special Summon 1 "Yubel - The Ultimate Nightmare" from your hand, Deck, or Graveyard.
rulings: It is not treated as an effect.
It is a Continuous Effect that is applied in the Monster Zone.
It is a Trigger Effect that activates in the Monster Zone.
It activates mandatorily if its activation condition is met.
It is a Trigger Effect that activates in the Monster Zone.
It activates mandatorily once during your End Phase.
It is a Trigger Effect.
It can be activated when this face-up card leaves the field. (This card is considered leaving the field if it is sent from the Monster Zone or Spell & Trap Zone to somewhere other than the field.)

It can be activated (immediately) when this face-up card leaves the field. It cannot be activated if another effect resolution takes place after this card leaves the field, for example, if this card leaves the field by a card effect activated as Chain 2 or higher.

It can be activated in the hand if this card leaves the field and is returned to the hand. It can be activated in the Graveyard if this card leaves the field and is sent to the Graveyard. It can be activated while banished if this card leaves the field and is banished face-up. (It cannot be activated if this card is banished face-down or returned to the Deck.)
It can be activated even if its activation condition is met during the Damage Step.

name: Yubel - The Ultimate Nightmare
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. Must be Special Summoned by "Yubel - Terror Incarnate", and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. This card cannot be destroyed by battle. You take no Battle Damage from battles involving this card. At the end of the Damage Step, if this face-up Attack Position card battles an opponent's monster: Inflict damage equal to that monster's ATK to your opponent, also destroy that monster.
rulings: It is not treated as an effect.
It is a Continuous Effect that is applied in the Monster Zone.
It is a Trigger Effect.

It activates in the Monster Zone if this card is not destroyed by battle. It activates in the Graveyard if this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard. It activates while banished if this card is destroyed by battle and banished face-up.
It activates mandatorily if its activation condition is met. (It activates even if your opponent's monster has 0 ATK, and even if your opponent's monster is destroyed by battle.)
At resolution, apply "Inflict damage to your opponent equal to that opponent's monster's ATK". If damage was inflicted successfully, apply "destroy that monster".
Inflicting damage and destroying your opponent's monster happen at the same time.

name: Z-Metal Tank
desc: Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 "X-Head Cannon" or "Y-Dragon Head" you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it. A monster equipped with this card gains 600 ATK/DEF, also if the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle or card effect, destroy this card instead.

name: Zaborg the Thunder Monarch
desc: If this card is Tribute Summoned: Target 1 monster on the field; destroy that target.
rulings: If "Zaborg the Thunder Monarch" is Tribute Summoned by the effect of "Ultimate Offering" in the middle of a chain, then you will still activate "Zaborg the Thunder Monarch"'s effect. This is because the effect is not optional and you cannot "miss the timing".

name: Zombie Master
desc: Once per turn: You can send 1 monster from your hand to the GY, then target 1 Level 4 or lower Zombie monster in either GY; Special Summon that target. This monster must be face-up on the field to activate and to resolve this effect.
rulings: Sending one Monster Card from your hand to the Graveyard is a cost to activate the effect of "Zombie Master". This effect targets one Level 4 or lower Zombie-Type monster in the Graveyard.

If the Zombie-Type monster targeted by an effect like "Book of Life" or "Mezuki" or "Zombie Master" is not a Zombie-Type monster at resolution - for example, "Mystical Space Typhoon" was chained and destroyed "Zombie World" - then the effect which Special Summons the monster from the Graveyard is not applied. Also, for "Book of Life", its effect which removes from play one card in your opponent's Graveyard is still applied.

name: Ambulance Rescueroid
desc:
"Rescueroid" + "Ambulanceroid"
This monster cannot be Special Summoned except by Fusion Summon. Once per turn, when a monster on your side of the field is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, you can Special Summon that monster in Defense Position.
rulings: "This monster cannot be Special Summoned except by Fusion Summon." is not treated as an effect.
The effect of "Ambulance Rescueroid" is an optional Trigger Effect that can be activated at the end of the Damage Step. (It does not target.)
This effect cannot be activated when "Ambulance Rescueroid" is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard.

name: Amulet Dragon
desc:
"Dark Magician" + 1 Dragon monster
Must be Fusion Summoned with the above Fusion Materials or with "The Eye of Timaeus". If this card is Special Summoned: Target any number of Spells in any GY(s) (min.1); banish those targets, and if you do, this card gains 100 ATK for each card banished by this effect. If this card is destroyed: You can target 1 Spellcaster monster in your GY; Special Summon that target.

name: Blue-Eyes Tyrant Dragon
desc:
"Blue-Eyes White Dragon" + 1 Dragon monster
Must first be either Fusion Summoned, or Special Summoned from your Extra Deck by Tributing 1 "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" equipped with a Fusion Monster. Unaffected by Trap Cards or effects. This card can attack all monsters your opponent controls, once each. Once per turn, at the end of the Damage Step, if this card battled: You can target 1 Trap in your GY; Set it to your Spell & Trap Zone.

name: Chimeratech Fortress Dragon
desc:
"Cyber Dragon" + 1+ Machine monsters
Cannot be used as Fusion Material. Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by sending the above cards from either field to the GY. (You do not use "Polymerization".) The original ATK of this card becomes 1000 x the number of Fusion Materials used for its Special Summon.
rulings: You cannot Special Summon this card from the Extra Deck, except by the method written on the card.

You may Special Summon "Chimeratech Fortress Dragon" with "Call of the Haunted" or "Dimension Fusion" only if it was properly Special Summoned beforehand. If it was sent directly from the Extra Deck to the Graveyard, then it cannot be Special Summoned.
The effect which alters its ATK is a Continuous Effect. The other effects are not treated as effects.

A Fusion Material Monster is a monster written on the card of a Fusion Monster, and which is needed to Special Summon or Fusion Summon the monster from the Extra Deck. Because of this, you cannot send "Chimeratech Fortress Dragon" from your field to the Graveyard to Special Summon another "Chimeratech Fortress Dragon" from your Extra Deck, since you are still using "Chimeratech Fortress Dragon" as a Fusion Material Monster.
If "DNA Surgery" turns "Vanity's Fiend" into a Machine, you still cannot Special Summon, so you cannot send "Vanity's Fiend" to the Graveyard to Special Summon "Chimeratech Fortress Dragon".

You may send "Cyber Dragon" equipped to "Relinquished" to the Graveyard to Special Summon "Chimeratech Fortress Dragon". If a Machine-Type Monster is equipped to "Relinquished", you cannot send it to the Graveyard to Special Summon "Chimeratech Fortress Dragon", since while equipped to "Relinquished" monsters do not have Types.

When "Chimeratech Fortress Dragon" is flipped face-down, removed from play, sent to the Graveyard or otherwise no longer face-up on the field, its ATK will be 0. Even if it returns to being face-up on the field, its ATK will remain 0.
If "Chimeratech Fortress Dragon" is affected by "Skill Drain", then "Chimeratech Fortress Dragon" will have 0 ATK, even if "Skill Drain" is later removed.

For "Chimeratech Fortress Dragon", "This card cannot be used as a Fusion Material Monster." is not an effect, so it will not be negated by "Skill Drain". You cannot use "Chimeratech Fortress Dragon" as a Fusion Material Monster under any circumstance.

Monster Tokens cannot be sent to the Graveyard, since they disappear when they are removed from the field. Thus, they cannot be sent to the Graveyard as a Fusion Material Monster to Special Summon "Chimeratech Fortress Dragon".
You can Special Summon "Chimeratech Fortress Dragon" by sending to the Graveyard monsters which are being treated as Machines by "DNA Surgery".

You can send to the Graveyard a face-down "Cyber Dragon" or face-down Machine-Type Monsters from your side to Special Summon "Chimeratech Fortress Dragon". You cannot send face-down monsters on your opponent's field, since you do not know that they are of the proper Type.

When the effect of "Macro Cosmos" etc is applied, cards are not sent to the Graveyard, and directly removed from play. "Chimeratech Fortress Dragon" cannot be Special Summoned if "Macro Cosmos" is active, since you cannot send cards to the Graveyard.
When Special Summoning "Chimeratech Fortress Dragon"/"XYZ-Dragon Cannon"/etc, you cannot use "Goddess with the Third Eye" etc as a Fusion Substitute Monster.

You can send "Cyber Dragon" and/or Machine-Type Monsters on your opponent's field the Graveyard to Special Summon "Chimeratech Fortress Dragon". You can Special Summon "Chimeratech Fortress Dragon" by sending only your opponent's monsters to the Graveyard.

The ATK gained by "Turret Warrior" is based on the monster's ATK after it is Tributed. If a "Evil HERO Dark Gaia" or "Chimeratech Fortress Dragon" under the effect of "DNA Surgery" is Tributed, ? ATK is treated as 0 ATK, so "Turret Warrior" will have 1200 ATK.

When a Pendulum Monster would be sent from the field to the Graveyard, it is placed face-up in the Extra Deck instead. It is not possible to send a Pendulum Monster to the Graveyard to Special Summon "Chimeratech Fortress Dragon"; therefore, you cannot use "Timegazer Magician" being treated as a Machine-Type monster and "Cyber Dragon" to Special Summon it.

name: Chimeratech Overdragon
desc:
"Cyber Dragon" + 1+ Machine monsters
Must be Fusion Summoned. If this card is Fusion Summoned: Send all other cards you control to the GY. The original ATK/DEF of this card each become equal to the number of Fusion Materials used for its Fusion Summon x 800. Each turn, this card can attack your opponent's monsters a number of times equal to the number of Fusion Materials used for its Fusion Summon.
rulings: "Chimeratech Overdragon" cannot be Special Summoned, except by Fusion Summon. After it is Fusion Summoned, if it is sent to the Graveyard, it cannot be Special Sumoned with "Monster Reborn".

Discarding 1 card is a cost to activate this effect.
This effect targets 1 card your opponent controls. (When resolving this effect, if control of the targeted card was switched to you, the targeted card is not destroyed.)
The Special Summon of cards that do not use "Polymerization" like "XYZ-Dragon Cannon" or "Gladiator Beast Gyzarus" can be negated by "Solemn Warning".

name: Acrobat Monkey
desc: An autonomous monkey type robot which was developed with cutting-edge technology. It moves very acrobatically.

name: Archfiend Soldier
desc: An expert at battle who belongs to a crack diabolical unit. He's famous because he always gets the job done.

name: Beast of Talwar
desc:
Only the master of the sword among Fiend-Type monsters is permitted to hold the Talwar.


(This card is always treated as an "Archfiend" card.)

name: Big Koala
desc: A species of huge Des Koala. He's meek, but people are afraid of him because he's very powerful.

name: Blade Skater
desc: An image of beauty on the ice, this gorgeous warrior rips her opponents into pieces with her stylish Accel Slicer attack.

name: Charcoal Inpachi
desc: A wicked wooden spirit that has burned out. The barbecue grilled with this charcoal is so awesome that everybody thinks it's priceless.

name: Cycroid
desc: The most lovable and friendly of all the Vehicroids. It can arm itself with training wheels!

name: Dark Blade
desc: They say he is a dragon-manipulating warrior from the dark world. His attack is tremendous, using his great swords with vicious power.
rulings: The effect of a "Kiryu" which equips it to "Dark Blade" starts a Chain.
The effect of "Pitch-Dark Dragon" which equips it to "Dark Blade" starts a Chain.

name: Divine Dragon Ragnarok
desc: A legendary dragon sent by the gods as their instrument. Legends say that if provoked, the whole world will sink beneath the sea.

name: Elemental HERO Avian
desc: A winged Elemental HERO who wheels through the sky and manipulates the wind. His signature move, Featherbreak, gives villainy a blow from sky-high.

name: Elemental HERO Burstinatrix
desc: A flame manipulator who was the first Elemental HERO woman. Her Burstfire burns away villainy.

name: Elemental HERO Clayman
desc: An Elemental HERO with a clay body built-to-last. He'll preserve his Elemental HERO colleagues at any cost.

name: Elemental HERO Neos
desc: ''A new Elemental HERO has arrived from Neo-Space! When he initiates a Contact Fusion with a Neo-Spacian his unknown powers are unleashed.''
rulings: Example: Player A is attacking Player B's with his "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" while Player B controls a face-up "Skyscraper". Player B responds to "Blue-Eyes White Dragon"'s attack with "Mirror Gate". When "Mirror Gate" resolves, both monsters switch control and the battle is taken to the "calculate damage" portion of the Damage Step. Since "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" is still the attacking monster, the effect of "Skyscraper" will not be applied as "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" is not an monster.

name: Elemental HERO Sparkman
desc: ''An Elemental HERO and a warrior of light who proficiently wields many kinds of armaments. His Static Shockwave cuts off the path of villainy.''

name: Fiend Scorpion
desc: A huge scorpion inhabited by the soul of a fiend. Usually it holds back, but has untapped potential.

name: Gagagigo
desc: This young evildoer used to have an evil heart, but by meeting a special person, he discovered justice.

name: Gene-Warped Warwolf
desc: This warwolf was given incalculable strength through horrific genetic manipulation. Its gentle nature was completely wiped out, and it now lives only to unleash destruction.

name: Giga Gagagigo
desc: In order to fight tremendous evil, he gained formidable power through body reconstruction, but lost his heart and his redemption.

name: Gigobyte
desc: He has a tranquil soul, but carries a destiny that one day his heart shall be tainted by evil....

name: Gil Garth
desc: This steel-armored terror machine ruthlessly strikes down enemies with its giant katana.

name: Goblin Calligrapher
desc: A Goblin who devotes himself to mastering perfect calligraphy of the word "False". He gives his all to each stroke.

name: Gogiga Gagagigo
desc: His soul long-since collapsed, his body recklessly continues onward, driven by a lust for more power. He no longer resembles his former self....

name: Hunter Dragon
desc: This dragon has taken down countless prey with its sharp fangs. It strikes very quickly, because if it does not strike first it is vulnerable to a counter-attack.

name: Inpachi
desc: A log that attacks lost travelers in the forest. Originally a big tree, it was cut down and possessed by a wicked spirit.

name: Jack's Knight
desc: A strong master swordsman. His loyalty is to justice, his duty to protect the weak.

name: Jerry Beans Man
desc: Jerry, a bean soldier, believes he is the strongest warrior in the world, but his true abilities are still untested.

name: Lizard Soldier
desc: A beast soldier derived from dragons, it is small for a Dragon-Type. Moving very quickly, this monster is an excellent strategist.

name: Luster Dragon
desc: A very beautiful dragon covered with sapphire. It does not like fights, but has incredibly high attack power.

name: Luster Dragon
desc: A very beautiful dragon covered with sapphire. It does not like fights, but has incredibly high attack power.

name: Mad Dog of Darkness
desc: He used to be a normal dog who played around in a park, but was corrupted by the powers of darkness.

name: Master Kyonshee
desc: A wandering Kyonshee searching for a strong rival to defeat. They say he was known as the master of all martial arts.

name: Metal Armored Bug
desc: A gigantic insect-like creature covered by thick armor. Everything in his path is destroyed.

name: Mokey Mokey
desc: An outcast angel. Nobody knows what he is thinking at all. Sometimes he gets mad and that is dreadful.

name: Mystical Shine Ball
desc: A soul of light covered by mystical shine. When you see its beautiful shape, your dream will come true.

name: Ojama Black
desc: He's one of the Ojama Trio. It's said that he butts in by any means necessary. It's also said that when the three are together, something happens.

name: Ojama Green
desc: He's one of the Ojama Trio. It's said that he butts in by any means necessary. It's also said that when the three are together, something happens.

name: Ojama Yellow
desc: He's one of the Ojama Trio. It's said that he butts in by any means necessary. It's also said that when the three are together, something happens.

name: Oppressed People
desc: They are oppressed, but believe they will have their freedom someday.

name: Opticlops
desc: A one-eyed giant that serves the "Dark Ruler Ha Des", it skewers its enemies with its sharp horn, shattering them to pieces.

name: People Running About
desc: Although they always suffer in silence, they swear an oath to inevitably revolt.

name: Pharaoh's Servant
desc: An apparition of those said to formerly serve the Pharaoh. It has tremendous loyalty that does not waiver.

name: Pharaonic Protector
desc: The mummy of a soldier that has been guarding the royal family for thousands of years. Even now, its spirit does not allow anybody to trespass.

name: Queen's Knight
desc: This knight catches her opponents off guard, dominating them with swift yet graceful attacks.

name: Robotic Knight
desc: The Commander of Machine-Types, he serves the Machine King. He is famous for the way he controls his troops.

name: Sabersaurus
desc: This normally gentle dinosaur enjoys relaxing in its nest in the prairies. If it becomes angered, it turns terribly ferocious.

name: Sealmaster Meisei
desc: One of the few people who has a good command of Talismans. His history is a mystery.
rulings: If "Imperial Custom" is active, then when "Sealmaster Meisei" is no longer face-up on the field, "Talisman of Spell Sealing" will not be destroyed. Also, the effect of "Talisman of Spell Sealing" will still be applied.

If a "Sealmaster Meisei" on the field is used as a Xyz Material, since it stops being on the field, your face-up copies of "Talisman of Spell Sealing" and "Talisman of Trap Sealing" are destroyed. Also, if you control "Talisman of Trap Sealing" and "Sealmaster Meisei" is used as aXyz Material for a Xyz Summon, at the time it becomes a Xyz Material, "Talisman of Trap Sealing" is destroyed, and the opponent can activate "Solemn Warning".[http://yugioh.faq.konami.jp/EokpControl?&lang=en&tid=65433&event=FE0006 Konami FAQ]: If a "Sealmaster Meisei" on the field is used as a Xyz Material, are the copies of "Talisman of Spell Sealing" and "Talisman of Trap Sealing" you control destroyed?

name: Soul Tiger
desc: The soul of a tiger that is said to devour human souls. He is a famous soul that you wouldn't want to run into in a dark alley.

name: Spiral Serpent
desc: When huge whirlpools lay cities asunder, it is the hunger of this sea serpent at work. No one has ever escaped its dreaded Spiral Wave to accurately describe the terror they experienced.

name: The Dragon Dwelling in the Cave
desc: A huge dragon dwelling in a cave. It is horrible when it gets angry, although it is usually quiet. It is said to preserve certain treasures.

name: United Resistance
desc: The people that gather to swear to fight their oppressors. A revolution is coming.

name: V-Tiger Jet
desc: This ace fighter is unbeatable in a dogfight. It combines with other monsters to launch an array of encircling attacks.

name: Volcanic Rat
desc: This mutated mouse dwells in the core of active volcanoes. No amount of heat is too much for it to bear.

name: Warrior Dai Grepher
desc: The warrior who can manipulate dragons. Nobody knows his mysterious past.

name: Warrior of Zera
desc: A wandering warrior who seeks the sanctuary where he can gain the power of the Archlords. To escape the temptation of evil fiends, he fights solo day by day.

name: X-Head Cannon
desc: A monster with a mighty cannon barrel, it is able to integrate its attacks. It attacks in many ways by combining and separating with other monsters.
rulings: The effect of a "Y-Dragon Head" which equips it to "X-Head Cannon" starts a Chain.
The effect of "Z-Metal Tank" which equips it to "X-Head Cannon" or "Y-Dragon Head" starts a Chain.

name: Zure, Knight of Dark World
desc: The name of this illustrious knight is known by all residents of Dark World. He never oppresses the commoners.

name: Cyber Angel Benten
desc: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Machine Angel Ritual". If this card destroys a monster by battle and sends it to the GY: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to that monster's original DEF in the GY. If this card is Tributed: You can add 1 LIGHT Fairy monster from your Deck to your hand.

name: Cyber Angel Dakini
desc: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Machine Angel Ritual". If this card is Ritual Summoned: You can make your opponent send 1 monster they control to the GY (their choice). If a Ritual Monster you control attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent. Once per turn, during your End Phase: You can target 1 Ritual Monster or 1 "Machine Angel Ritual" in your GY; add it to your hand.

name: Cyber Angel Idaten
desc: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Machine Angel Ritual". If this card is Ritual Summoned: You can add 1 Ritual Spell from your Deck or GY to your hand. If this card is Tributed: You can make all Ritual Monsters you control gain 1000 ATK/DEF.

name: Demise, King of Armageddon
desc: You can Ritual Summon this card with "End of the World". You can pay 2000 LP; destroy all other cards on the field.
rulings: If "Demise, King of Armageddon" would destroy "Ancient City - Rainbow Ruins" and at least 1 "Crystal Beast" card in your opponent's Spell/Trap Zone, then "Ancient City - Rainbow Ruins" is not destroyed because of the "Crystal Beast" card.

You can activate the effect of "Demise, King of Armageddon" when your opponent controls "Field Barrier" and a Field Spell Card. However, the Field Spell Card would not be destroyed by "Demise, King of Armageddon"'s effect.

When "Final Destiny"/"Demise, King of Armageddon"/etc would destroy "Power Tool Dragon" and an Equip Spell Card simultaneously, you cannot apply the effect of "Power Tool Dragon" and send the Equip Spell Card to the Graveyard instead.

If "Mermaid Archer" and the equipped monster would be destroyed simultaneously by "Demise, King of Armageddon"/"Judgment Dragon"/"Final Destiny"/etc, then you cannot apply the effect of "Mermaid Archer" and destroy the equipped monster instead.
