If "Imperial Custom" is active and an effect like "Heavy Storm" or "Demise, King of Armageddon" or "Malevolent Catastrophe" would destroy all Spell and Trap Cards on the field, then "Imperial Custom" is destroyed, but all other face-up Continuous Trap Cards are not destroyed and remain on the field.

If "Divine Grace - Northwemko" and the targeted cards would be destroyed simultaneously - such as by the effect of "Demise, King of Armageddon" - then "Divine Grace - Northwemko" is not destroyed and remain on the field.

Suppose you control "Malefic Stardust Dragon" and a Field Spell Card. If your opponent activates an effect like that of "Demise, King of Armageddon" or "Final Destiny" or "Judgment Dragon" which would destroy "Malefic Stardust Dragon" and the Field Spell Card simultaneously, then the Field Spell Card is not destroyed since it cannot be destroyed by card effects.

name: Litmus Doom Swordsman
desc: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Litmus Doom Ritual". It is unaffected by Trap effects and cannot be destroyed by battle. Gains 3000 ATK/DEF while a Trap is on the field. If this Ritual Summoned card in its owner's control is destroyed by your opponent's card: You can target 1 Trap in either GY; Set it to your Spell & Trap Zone.

name: Lord of the Red
desc: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Red-Eyes Transmigration". Once per turn, during either player's turn, when a card or effect is activated, except "Lord of the Red": You can target 1 monster on the field; destroy it. Once per turn, during either player's turn, when a card or effect is activated, except "Lord of the Red": You can target 1 Spell/Trap Card on the field; destroy it.

name: Lycanthrope
desc: This card can only be Ritual Summoned with the Ritual Spell Card, "Synthesis Spell". When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, inflict 200 damage to your opponent for each Normal Monster in your Graveyard.

name: Paladin of White Dragon
desc: You can Ritual Summon this card with "White Dragon Ritual". At the start of the Damage Step, if this card attacks a face-down Defense Position monster: Destroy that face-down monster. You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" from your hand or Deck, but "Blue-Eyes White Dragons" cannot attack for the rest of this turn.

name: Shinato, King of a Higher Plane
desc: This card can only be Ritual Summoned with the Ritual Spell Card, "Shinato's Ark". You must also Tribute monsters whose total Levels equal 8 or more from the field or your hand. When this card destroys a Defense Position monster and sends it to the Graveyard as a result of battle, inflict damage to your opponent's Life Points equal to the original ATK of the destroyed monster.
rulings: The effect that inflicts damage to your opponent equal to the destroyed monster's original ATK is a Trigger Effect that activates on the field. (It does not target. It activates mandatorily at the end of the Damage Step in which "Shinato, King of a Higher Plane" destroyed a Defense Position monster in your opponent's Monster Zone by battle and sent it to the Graveyard.)

This effect activates when the Defense Position monster destroyed by battle with "Shinato, King of a Higher Plane" is sent to either player's Graveyard, and it inflicts damage to your opponent equal to the original ATK of the monster that was sent to the Graveyard.

name: A Deal with Dark Ruler
desc:
(This card is always treated as an "Archfiend" card.)
If a Level 8 or higher monster under your control was sent to the Graveyard this turn: Special Summon 1 "Berserk Dragon" from your hand or Deck.
rulings: This card is considered an "Archfiend" card. "Archfiend" cards are:
Anything with "Archfiend" in the name.
A Deal with Dark Ruler
Axe of Despair
B. Skull Dragon
Beast of Talwar
Fiend Skull Dragon
Lesser Fiend
Shadow Tamer
Summoned Skull
Toon Summoned Skull

If a Level 8 or higher monster equipped to "Relinquished" is sent from the field to the Graveyard (by "Relinquished" being destroyed, or the Equip Spell Card being destroyed by "Mystical Space Typhoon"), "A Deal with Dark Ruler" cannot be activated.

name: A Feather of the Phoenix
desc: Discard 1 card, then target 1 card in your GY; return that target to the top of your Deck.

name: A Legendary Ocean
desc:
(This card's name is always treated as "Umi".)
All WATER monsters on the field gain 200 ATK/DEF. Reduce the Level of all WATER monsters in both players' hands and on the field by 1.
rulings: Ritual Spell Cards: When using Ritual Spell Cards, "A Legendary Ocean" will not reduce the number of Levels that you need to Tribute. However, "A Legendary Ocean" will reduce the Level of the monsters being Tributed (so that you will have to Tribute more monsters to complete the Ritual Summon).

Example: "A Legendary Ocean" turns "Mother Grizzly" into a Level 3 monster. When it is sent to the Graveyard, the effect of "Sea Dragon Lord Gishilnodon" will not activate and its ATK will not become 3000 because "Mother Grizzly" is Level 4 while in the Graveyard.

name: A Wingbeat of Giant Dragon
desc: Return 1 Level 5 or higher Dragon-Type monster you control to the hand, and if you do, destroy all Spell and Trap Cards on the field.
rulings: The effect of "A Wingbeat of Giant Dragon" doesn't target.
The effect of "A Wingbeat of Giant Dragon" cannot return a face-down Dragon-Type monster to the hand.

An "Archlord Kristya" treated as a Dragon-Type monster by the effect of "DNA Surgery" can be chosen to be returned to the hand by the effect of "A Wingbeat of Giant Dragon", but since it returns to the top of the Deck instead of the hand, the "destroy all Spell and Trap Cards on the field." effect is not applied.

Even if you only control a Level 5 or higher "Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV6", you can activate "A Wingbeat of Giant Dragon". Also, you can choose to return "Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV6" to the hand by the effect of "A Wingbeat of Giant Dragon", but since it's unaffected by Spell Cards, it does not return to the hand, and the "destroy all Spell and Trap Cards on the field." effect is not applied.

A Fusion or Synchro can be chosen by the effect of "A Wingbeat of Giant Dragon". Also, the chosen monster isn't returned to the hand and is returned to the Extra Deck instead. Furthermore, if a Fusion Monster is chosen by the effect of "A Wingbeat of Giant Dragon" and the chosen monster isn't returned to the hand, the "destroy all Spell and Trap Cards on the field." effect is not applied.

If A Wingbeat of Giant Dragon is activated and Book of Moon is chained, flipping the only Level 5 or higher Dragon-Type monster on the controller's side of the field face-down, then A Wingbeat of Giant Dragon resolves without effect.

Since the entire effect of A Wingbeat of Giant Dragon happens during resolution, the controller of the effect must be able to return a Level 5 or higher Dragon-Type monster from the field to the hand during resolution of the effect. A face-down monster's Level and Type cannot be determined, so it cannot be returned for the effect. Without returning an appropriate monster, the effect of A Wingbeat of Giant Dragon cannot continue to resolve as the conjunction "and if you do" is used, so the effect of A Wingbeat of Giant Dragon resolves without effect.

name: Abyssal Designator
desc: Pay 1000 Life Points. Declare a Type and an Attribute. Your opponent must send 1 monster with both the declared Type and Attribute from their hand or Deck to the Graveyard.
rulings: The Attribute of "Obelisk the Tormentor" is DIVINE. The Type of "Obelisk the Tormentor" is Divine-Beast.
"Abyssal Designator" can declare "DIVINE-Attribute" and "Divine-Beast-Type".

name: Advanced Dark
desc: All "Crystal Beast" monsters on the field and in the GY become DARK. If an "Ultimate Crystal" monster attacks, negate the effects of the attack target during that Battle Phase. During damage calculation, if a "Crystal Beast" monster you control battles and you would take damage: You can send 1 "Crystal Beast" monster from your Deck to the GY; you take no battle damage from that battle.
rulings: The effect that treats all "Crystal Beast" monsters on the field and in both GYs as DARK monsters does not start a Chain.
The effect that negates the effects of a monster attacked by an "Ultimate Crystal" monster doesn't start a Chain.
The effect that reduces the battle damage to 0 starts a Chain. Furthermore, sending 1 "Crystal Beast" monster from the Deck to the GY is a cost.

name: ALERT!
desc:
(This card is always treated as a "Rescue-ACE" card.)
Add 1 "Rescue-ACE" monster from your GY to your hand, or if you control "Rescue-ACE Hydrant", you can add 1 "Rescue-ACE" monster from your Deck to your hand instead. You can only activate 1 "ALERT!" per turn.

name: Amazoness Call
desc: Take 1 "Amazoness" card from your Deck, except "Amazoness Call", and either add it to your hand or send it to the GY. During your Main Phase: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 "Amazoness" monster you control; this turn, that monster can attack all monsters your opponent controls, once each, also other monsters you control cannot attack. You can only activate 1 "Amazoness Call" per turn.

name: Amazoness Spellcaster
desc: Target 1 "Amazoness" monster you control and 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; switch the original ATK of those targets until the end of this turn.

name: Amplifier
desc: Equip only to "Jinzo". While this card is equipped, the equipped monster's effect does not negate the effects of its controller's Trap Cards. When this card is removed from the field, destroy the equipped monster. This card's activation and effect cannot be negated.

name: Ancient City - Rainbow Ruins
desc: You must have this many "Crystal Beast" cards in your Spell & Trap Card Zone to activate and to resolve these effects. ● 1+: This card cannot be destroyed by card effects. ● 2+: Once per turn (including the opponent's) you can halve the Battle Damage you take. ● 3+: During either player's turn, when a Spell/Trap Card is activated: You can send 1 "Crystal Beast" monster you control to the Graveyard; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it. ● 4+: Once per turn, during your Main Phase: You can draw 1 card. ● 5: Once per turn, during your Main Phase: You can target 1 "Crystal Beast" card in your Spell & Trap Card Zone; Special Summon that target.
rulings: It is not treated as an effect.
It does not start a Chain Link and is applied in the Field Zone.
It does not start a Chain Link and is applied in the Field Zone.
It can be applied during damage calculation when you would take battle damage.
It starts a Chain Link and can be activated in the Field Zone.
It can be activated directly in Chain to the activation of a Spell/Trap Card. (It is a Spell Speed 2 effect.)
It cannot be activated during the Damage Step.
It starts a Chain Link and can be activated in the Field Zone.
It can be activated during your Main Phase.
It starts a Chain Link and can be activated in the Field Zone.
It can be activated during your Main Phase.

name: Ancient Gear Castle
desc: All "Ancient Gear" monsters gain 300 ATK. Each time a monster is Normal Summoned/Set, place 1 counter on this card. If you Tribute Summon an "Ancient Gear" monster face-up, you can Tribute this card instead, if the number of its counters is equal to or greater than the number of required Tribute(s).
rulings: Since Ancient Gear Golem requires 2 Tributes to Tribute Summon, when using the effect of Ancient Gear Castle to substitute itself for the Tributes, there must be 2 or more counters on it. Therefore, you cannot use 2 copies of Ancient Gear Castle that each only have 1 counter on them.

name: Ancient Gear Drill
desc: If you control an "Ancient Gear" monster: Discard 1 card; Set 1 Spell Card directly from your Deck. This turn, that Spell Card cannot be activated.

name: Ancient Gear Explosive
desc: Target 1 "Ancient Gear" monster you control; destroy it, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to half its original ATK.

name: Ancient Gear Factory
desc: Reveal 1 Level 5 or higher "Ancient Gear" monster from your hand, then banish a number of "Ancient Gear" monsters from your Graveyard, whose combined Levels are double the revealed monster's, and if you do, if you Normal Summon the revealed monster this turn, you must Normal Smmon it without Tributing.

name: Ancient Gear Fist
desc: Equip only to an "Ancient Gear" monster. At the end of the Damage Step, if the equipped monster battled a monster and is still on the field: Destroy the monster it battled.

name: Ancient Gear Tank
desc: Equip only to an "Ancient Gear" monster. It gains 600 ATK. When this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: Inflict 600 damage to your opponent.

name: Ancient Gear Workshop
desc: Target 1 "Ancient Gear" monster in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand.
rulings: This card targets 1 "Ancient Gear" monster in your Graveyard.
This card can also target "Ultimate Ancient Gear Golem". (In this case, it is returned to the Extra Deck.)
When resolving this card, if the targeted monster is no longer in the Graveyard, the effect is not applied.

name: Anti-Magic Arrows
desc: At the start of the Battle Phase: For the rest of this turn after this card resolves, Spell/Trap Cards, and their effects, cannot be activated. Cards and effects cannot be activated in response to this card's activation.

name: Archfiend's Oath
desc: Once per turn: You can pay 500 Life Points, then declare 1 card name; excavate the top card of your Deck, and if it is the declared card, add it to your hand. Otherwise, send it to the Graveyard.
rulings: In place of declaring a FULL card name, a precise description of a card's stats, appearance, and/or effects, is considered acceptable so long as both players are in clear agreement over which card is being described. }}

name: Armed Changer
desc: Send 1 Equip Spell Card from your hand to the Graveyard to activate this card. If the equipped monster destroys a monster by battle, the controller of this Equip Card can add 1 monster with ATK equal to or less than the equipped monster from their Graveyard to their hand.

name: Assault Armor
desc: Equip only to a Warrior-Type monster that is the only monster you control. It gains 300 ATK. During your Main Phase 1, you can send this equipped card to the Graveyard to allow the equipped monster to attack twice during each Battle Phase this turn.
rulings: Sending this card to the Graveyard is a cost to activate the effect to attack twice. Activating this effect starts a chain. This effect does not target.

If “Assault Armor” is equipped to your monster, then after that you Summon another monster, “Assault Armor” remains on the field. The requirement that you control no other monsters only applies to equipping “Assault Armor”.
If an effect is chained to “Assault Armor” that makes the target no longer a Warrior, then “Assault Armor” cannot be equipped to it, and is destroyed.
If the equipped monster’s type changes after “Assault Armor” is already equipped to it, “Assault Armor” remains equipped to that monster.
You can only send “Assault Armor” to the Graveyard to activate its effect during Main Phase 1.

name: Ayers Rock Sunrise
desc: Target 1 Beast-Type monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target, and if you do, all face-up monsters your opponent currently controls lose 200 ATK for each Beast, Plant, and Winged Beast-Type monster currently in your Graveyard, until the end of this turn. You can only activate 1 "Ayers Rock Sunrise" per turn.

name: Battle Fusion
desc: When an attack is declared involving a Fusion Monster you control and an opponent's monster: That monster you control gains ATK equal to the ATK of the opponent's monster, until the end of the Damage Step. You can only activate 1 "Battle Fusion" per turn.

name: Battle of Sleeping Spirits
desc: Each player can Special Summon 1 monster from their GY that was destroyed by battle this turn, in Attack Position, and if you Special Summoned "Elemental HERO Neos" by this effect, if it battles your opponent's monster this turn, its ATK becomes doubled during the Damage Step only. You can only activate 1 "Battle of Sleeping Spirits" per turn.

name: Berserker Soul
desc: When a monster you control inflicts 1500 or less damage to your opponent by a direct attack: Discard your entire hand (min. 1); excavate the top card of your Deck, and if it is a Monster Card, send it to the Graveyard, and if you do that, inflict 500 damage to your opponent, then repeat this effect up to 7 more times or until you excavate a non-Monster Card. If a non-Monster Card is excavated, place it on the top of your Deck. You can only activate 1 "Berserker Soul" per turn.

name: Big Bang Shot
desc: The equipped monster gains 400 ATK. If the equipped monster attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent. When this card leaves the field, banish the equipped monster.
rulings: If control a "Beast Machine King Barbaros Ür" equipped with your "Fairy Meteor Crush" or "Big Bang Shot", then when it battles, its effect will make the Battle Damage it inflicts to the opponent become 0, so it will not inflict Battle Damage to your opponent. Also, if you control a "Beast Machine King Barbaros Ür" equipped with an opponent's "Fairy Meteor Crush", then when it battles, the Battle Damage will be inflicted to you.

name: Big Evolution Pill
desc: After this card's activation, it remains on the field, but destroy it during your opponent's 3rd End Phase. Tribute 1 Dinosaur-Type monster to activate this card; while this card is face-up on the field, you can Normal Summon Level 5 or higher Dinosaur-Type monsters without Tributing.

name: Big Wave Small Wave
desc: Destroy all face-up WATER monsters you control, then you can Special Summon WATER monsters from your hand, up to the number of monsters destroyed by this effect.

name: Blaze Accelerator
desc: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; send 1 Pyro-Type monster with 500 or less ATK from your hand to the Graveyard, and if you do, destroy that target. You cannot declare an attack during the turn you activate this effect.
rulings: "Tytannial, Princess of Camellias"'s effect can be used against Continuous Spell Cards and Continuous Trap Cards which are already face-up. The effect must be chainable, and must target a card on the field.
Example: "Tytannial, Princess of Camellias" can be used against "Blaze Accelerator" and "Pitch-Black Power Stone".
"Prime Material Dragon"'s effect can be to negate the activation of a Continuous Spell/Trap Card's effect which destroys a monster on the field, such as "Blaze Accelerator".

The effect "●WIND: You must pay 500 Life Points to activate a Spell Card." of "Clear World" only applies to when a Spell Card is activated from the hand, or when a face-down Spell Card is activated. You do not pay 500 Life Points to activate the effect of a Spell Card which is already face-up on the field, like "Miracle Fertilizer" or "Blaze Accelerator".

name: Bonding - H2O
desc: Tribute 2 "Hydrogeddon" and 1 "Oxygeddon"; Special Summon 1 "Water Dragon" from your hand, Deck, or GY.

name: Bonfire
desc: Add 1 Level 4 or lower Pyro monster from your Deck to your hand. You can only activate 1 "Bonfire" per turn.

name: Book of Life
desc: Target 1 Zombie monster in your GY and 1 monster in your opponent's GY; Special Summon the first target, also banish the second target.
rulings: You cannot activate "Book of Life" if there are (1) no monsters in your opponent's Graveyard and/or (2) no Zombie-Type monster in your Graveyard.
The effects targets the two Monsters.

If "Imperial Iron Wall" is active, "Book of Life" cannot be activated. If "Imperial Iron Wall" is chained to "Book of Life", then the Zombie-Type monster will still be Special Summoned, but the other monster will remain in the Graveyard.

If the Zombie-Type monster targeted by an effect like "Book of Life" or "Mezuki" or "Zombie Master" is not a Zombie-Type monster at resolution - for example, "Mystical Space Typhoon" was chained and destroyed "Zombie World" - then the effect which Special Summons the monster from the Graveyard is not applied. Also, for "Book of Life", its effect which removes from play one card in your opponent's Graveyard is still applied.

name: Book of Moon
desc: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; change that target to face-down Defense Position.
rulings: You cannot activate this card during the Damage Step.

Example: "Trishula, Dragon of the Ice Barrier" activates its effect, and "Effect Veiler" is Chained and targets "Trishula, Dragon of the Ice Barrier", and then "Book of Moon" is Chained also targeting "Trishula, Dragon of the Ice Barrier". Resolving backwards, "Trishula, Dragon of the Ice Barrier" is flipped face-down, so that "Effect Veiler" cannot negate its effect.

"Book of Moon": Resolving backwards, since "Book of Moon" changes "Judgment Dragon" to face-down Defense Position, the effect of "Forbidden Chalice" is no longer applied, the effect of "Judgment Dragon" is not negated and the cards on the field are destroyed.
You cannot activate "Book of Moon" and target a Token.

There can be multiple chains in the Battle Step before entering the Damage Step. Only the initial chain can directly respond to the attack, and only in this Chain can you activate cards such as "Mirror Force", "Sakuretsu Armor", and "Magic Cylinder" (Cards that can only be activated when your opponent's Monster declares an attack). Cards that do not have this restriction ("Book of Moon", "Compulsory Evacuation Device", "Waboku", etc) can still be activated in another Chain before entering the Damage Step.

Since the entire effect of A Wingbeat of Giant Dragon happens during resolution, the controller of the effect must be able to return a Level 5 or higher Dragon-Type monster from the field to the hand during resolution of the effect. A face-down monster's Level and Type cannot be determined, so it cannot be returned for the effect. Without returning an appropriate monster, the effect of A Wingbeat of Giant Dragon cannot continue to resolve as the conjunction "and if you do" is used, so the effect of A Wingbeat of Giant Dragon resolves without effect.

name: Book of Taiyou
desc: Flip 1 face-down monster on the field into face-up Attack Position.

name: Boss Rush
desc: You cannot Normal Summon or Set. During the End Phase of the turn that a "B.E.S." monster or a "Big Core" is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard, you can Special Summon 1 "B.E.S." monster or 1 "Big Core" from your Deck.
rulings: During the End Phase, the Special Summoning effect starts a chain.

name: Brain Control
desc: Pay 800 LP, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls that can be Normal Summoned/Set; take control of that target until the End Phase.
rulings: This card targets 1 face-up monster in your opponent's Monster Zone that can be Normal Summoned/Set.
Even if a monster was Special Summoned by the effect of "Monster Reborn", that monster can be targeted by "Brain Control" as long as that monster can be Normal Summoned/Set.
Since Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, Token Monsters, etc. are not Normal Summon Monsters, they cannot be targeted by "Brain Control".
Paying 800 Life Points is a cost to activate this card.
Returning the control of the monster affected by "Brain Control" during the End Phase does not start a Chain Link.

If you gain control of an opponent's monster with a card like "Brain Control" or "Enemy Controller" and then the monster is flipped face-down by an effect like "Book of Moon", then the effect of "Enemy Controller" is still applied, and control of the monster still returns back to your opponent during the End Phase.

If you gain control of an opponent's monster with an effect like "Brain Control" or "Enemy Controller" and then the monster is banished by "Interdimensional Matter Transporter", then after the monster returns to the field during the End Phase, your opponent still regains control of the monster. Also, if the monster is banished by "Dimensionhole", then during the Standby Phase the monster returns to the opponent's side of the field.

"Brain Control" is a card that is activated by targeting 1 face-up monster in your opponent's Monster Zone that can be Normal Summoned/Set. Since an "Embodiment of Apophis" that is treated as a Normal Monster Card is not a Normal Summon Monster, it cannot be targeted by "Brain Control".

name: Bubble Blaster
desc: You can only equip this card to "Elemental Hero Bubbleman". Increase the ATK of the equipped monster by 800 points. If the equipped monster would be destroyed as a result of battle, destroy this card instead, and make the Battle Damage to the controller of the equipped monster 0.

name: Bubble Illusion
desc: You can only activate this card while there is a face-up "Elemental Hero Bubbleman" on your side of the field. During this turn, you can activate 1 Trap Card from your hand.

name: Bubble Shuffle
desc: Target 1 face-up Attack Position "Elemental HERO Bubbleman" you control and 1 face-up Attack Position monster your opponent controls; change both those targets to Defense Position, then Tribute that "Elemental HERO Bubbleman", then Special Summon 1 "Elemental HERO" monster from your hand.

name: Burden of the Mighty
desc: Each face-up monster your opponent controls loses 100 ATK x its own Level.
rulings: If you have multiple copies of this card face-up on the field, their effects will accumulate.
This effect is applied continuously and does not use the Chain.

"Ritual Buster" only prevents the activation of Spell and Trap Cards, and the activation of the effect of Spell and Trap Cards which are already face-up on the field. It does not prevent Spell and Trap Cards like "Burden of the Mighty" and "Gravity Bind" with Continuous Effects from applying their effects.

name: Burial from a Different Dimension
desc: Target up to 3 banished monsters; return them to the GY.
rulings: When "Miracle Dig" or "Burial from a Different Dimension" return removed from play cards to the Graveyard, the cards are not treated as being sent to the Graveyard. Thus, you can activate "Burial from a Different Dimension" and its effect will be applied and return cards to the Graveyard even when the effects of "Macro Cosmos" or "Banisher of the Light" are active.

"Burial from a Different Dimension" and "Miracle Dig" can only be activated by selecting monsters which are removed from play face-up. If a monster is removed from play face-down - such as by the effect of "Destiny Hero - Doom Lord" - then it cannot be returned to the Graveyard by effects like that of "Miracle Dig".

name: Burst Return
desc: If you control a face-up "Elemental HERO Burstinatrix": Return all face-up "Elemental HERO" monsters on the field to the hand, except "Elemental HERO Burstinatrix".

name: Burst Stream of Destruction
desc: If you control "Blue-Eyes White Dragon": Destroy all monsters your opponent controls. "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" you control cannot attack the turn you activate this card.

name: Butterfly Dagger - Elma
desc: The equipped monster gains 300 ATK. When this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard while equipped: You can return this card to the hand.
rulings: The effect that makes the equipped monster gain 300 ATK does not start a Chain Link. (It is applied to the equipped monster.)

The effect that returns this card to the hand can be activated in the Graveyard. (It does not target. It can be activated if "Butterfly Dagger - Elma" is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard while equipped to a monster. It can be activated even during the Damage Step.)

name: Card of Demise
desc: Draw until you have 3 cards in your hand, also for the rest of this turn after this card resolves, your opponent takes no damage. During the End Phase of this turn, send your entire hand to the GY. You can only activate 1 "Card of Demise" per turn. You cannot Special Summon during the turn you activate this card.

name: Card of Sanctity
desc: Banish all other cards you control and in your hand (min. 1 from each); draw until you have 2 cards in your hand.
rulings: While the effect of "Imperial Iron Wall" is being applied, since cards cannot be banished, you cannot activate "Card of Sanctity". (You cannot activate "Card of Sanctity" to banish "Imperial Iron Wall".)
This card can be activated if you don't have cards in either your side of the field or your hand.
If you have 2 or more cards in your hand, including "Card of Sanctity", and you have no cards on your side of the field, "Card of Sanctity" can be activated from your hand.
If you control 2 or more cards, including a Set "Card of Sanctity", and you have no cards in your hand, that Set "Card of Sanctity" can be activated.
If you only have "Card of Sanctity" in your hand and you have no cards on your side of the field, "Card of Sanctity" cannot be activated.
When this card is activated, this card itself is not banished. When this card is activated, all other cards you control and in your hand are banished.

name: Celestial Sword - Eatos
desc:
(This card is always treated as a "Noble Arms" card.)
The equipped monster gains 500 ATK. When this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard: You can target 1 "Guardian Eatos" you control; it gains 500 ATK for each banished monster.

name: Chaos Distill
desc:
While this card is face-up on the field, any card sent to your GY is banished instead. You can activate 1 of these effects;
● Add 1 "Macro Cosmos", or 1 card that mentions it, from your Deck to your hand, except "Chaos Distill".
● If "Macro Cosmos" is on the field: Banish this face-up card from the Spell & Trap Zone; add 1 LIGHT monster with ? ATK from your Deck to your hand.
You can only use this effect of "Chaos Distill" once per turn.
rulings: [Regarding the effect "Any card sent to your GY is banished instead."]
It does not start a Chain and applies in the Spell & Trap Zone.

[Regarding the effect "You can activate 1 of these effects; ● Add 1 "Macro Cosmos", or 1 card that mentions it, from your Deck to your hand, except ""Chaos Distill"". ● If "Macro Cosmos" is on the field: Banish this face-up card from the Spell & Trap Zone; add 1 LIGHT monster with ? ATK from your Deck to your hand."]
It starts a Chain and can be activated in the Spell & Trap Zone.
It can only be activated during your Main Phase.
When activating this effect, choose 1 "●" effect and activate it as that effect.
[Regarding the first "●" effect.]
A 'card that mentions "Macro Cosmos"' refers to a card that has the specific card name "Macro Cosmos" written in its text.

name: Chaos End
desc: You can only activate this card if 7 or more of your cards are currently removed from play. Destroy all Monster Cards on the field.

name: Chaos Form
desc: This card can be used to Ritual Summon any "Chaos" or "Black Luster Soldier" Ritual Monster. You must also Tribute monsters from your hand or field and/or banish "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" or "Dark Magician" from your GY, whose total Levels exactly equal the Level of the "Chaos" or "Black Luster Soldier" Ritual Monster you Ritual Summon.

name: Chaos Greed
desc: You can only activate this card if 4 or more of your cards are currently removed from play and there are no cards in your Graveyard. Draw 2 cards from your Deck.
rulings: This card does not target.
To activate this card, you must have 4 or more banished cards and no cards in your Graveyard.
To activate this card, you must have 4 or more banished. This can include face-down banished cards, such as by the effect of "Lightforce Sword".
Even if you have 3 or less banished cards and/or a card(s) in your Graveyard, after this card was activated, the effect resolves normally.

name: Chthonian Alliance
desc: The equipped monster gains 800 ATK for each other face-up monster on the field that has the same name it does.

name: Clear Wall
desc: If "Clear World" is on the field: You can add 1 monster that mentions "Clear World" from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Clear Wall" once per turn. Monsters that mention "Clear World" cannot be destroyed by battle, also you take no battle damage from that battle. While you control a Level 7 or higher monster that mentions "Clear World", your opponent receives all effects of "Clear World", regardless of the monster Attributes they control.
rulings: It starts a Chain Link and can be activated by this face-up card in the Spell & Trap Zone.
It can be activated during your Main Phase.
A monster that mentions "Clear World" refers to a monster that specifically lists the card name "Clear World" in its text.
It does not start a Chain Link and is applied by this face-up card in the Spell & Trap Zone.
A monster that mentions "Clear World" refers to a monster that specifically lists the card name "Clear World" in its text.
It does not start a Chain Link and is applied by this face-up card in the Spell & Trap Zone.

It is applied if "Clear World" is in either player's Field Zone and a Level 7 or higher monster that mentions "Clear World" is in your Monster Zone. (It is applied even if your opponent has no face-up monsters on their field.)
A monster that mentions "Clear World" refers to a monster that specifically lists the card name "Clear World" in its text.

name: Clear World
desc: During each of your End Phases, pay 500 Life Points or destroy this card. Each player receives effects, depending on the monster Attributes they control. ● LIGHT: Play with your hand revealed at all times. ● DARK: If you control 2 or more monsters, you cannot declare an attack. ● EARTH: During your Standby Phase: Target 1 face-up Defense Position monster you control; destroy that target. ● WATER: During your End Phase: Discard 1 card. ● FIRE: During your End Phase: Take 1000 damage. ● WIND: You must pay 500 Life Points to activate a Spell Card.
rulings: It is not treated as an effect. It is a cost to keep this card on the field. (It does not start a Chain Link.)
It is not treated as an effect.
It does not start a Chain Link and is applied by this face-up card in the Field Zone.
It does not start a Chain Link and is applied by this face-up card in the Field Zone.
It is applied to both players. (Monsters that are unaffected by Spell Card effects cannot declare an attack.)
It does not start a Chain Link and is applied by this face-up card in the Field Zone.
It is applied once if the turn player enters their Standby Phase while they have have a face-up EARTH monster in their Monster Zone.
It does not start a Chain Link and is applied by this face-up card in the Field Zone.
It is applied once if the turn player enters their End Phase while they have have a face-up WATER monster in their Monster Zone.
It does not start a Chain Link and is applied by this face-up card in the Field Zone.
It is applied once if the turn player enters their End Phase while they have have a face-up FIRE monster in their Monster Zone.
It does not start a Chain Link and is applied by this face-up card in the Field Zone.
It is applied even during the Damage Step.
If you control a monster with an effect that treats it as having multiple Attributes, all the relevant effects of "Clear World" will apply to you.
Even if "Field Barrier" is active, if you don't pay the cost of "Clear World" during the End Phase it will be destroyed.
You still have to pay 500 Life Points to activate Spell Cards if you control a WIND monster, even if you also control "Spell Economics."
The WIND effect of "Clear World" only applies to activating Spell Cards. You do not have to pay Life Points when you activate the effect of a Spell Card that is already face-up on the field.
If you control "Clear Vice Dragon" and any EARTH, FIRE, or WATER monsters, the effect of "Clear World" will start a Chain but it will resolve without effect.
The EARTH, FIRE, and WATER effects of "Clear World" each start their own Chain. You do not form a single Chain with all 3 effects.
The LIGHT, DARK, and WIND effects of "Clear World" do not start a Chain.

name: Clock Tower Prison
desc: Once per turn, during your opponent's Standby Phase: Place 1 Clock Counter on this card. While there are 4 or more Clock Counters on this card, you do not take any battle damage. If this card with 4 or more Clock Counters is destroyed and sent to the GY: Special Summon 1 "Destiny HERO - Dreadmaster" from your hand or Deck.

name: Clockwork Night
desc: All face-up monsters on the field become Machine monsters. Machine monsters you control gain 500 ATK/DEF, also Machine monsters your opponent controls lose 500 ATK/DEF. You can banish this card from your GY, then discard 1 card; add 1 EARTH Machine monster from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Clockwork Night" once per turn. You can only activate 1 "Clockwork Night" per turn.

name: Cocoon Party
desc: Special Summon 1 "Chrysalis" monster from your Deck for each "Neo-Spacian" monster with a different name in your Graveyard.

name: Comic Hand
desc: If you control "Toon World", equip to an opponent's monster. Take control of it. It is treated as a Toon monster. If your opponent controls no Toon monsters, it can attack your opponent directly. If "Toon World" is not on the field, destroy this card.

name: Common Soul
desc: Select 1 face-up monster on the field. Special Summon 1 "Neo-Spacian" monster from your hand to the same side of the field as the selected monster. The selected monster gains ATK equal to the ATK of the monster that was Special Summoned by this effect. When this card is removed from the field, return the Special Summoned monster to its owner's hand.

name: Contact
desc: Send all "Chrysalis" monsters you control to the Graveyard, and Special Summon 1 monster from your hand or Deck that is written in the card text of those cards.

name: Contact Out
desc: Return 1 "Neos" Fusion Monster you control to the Extra Deck. If all the Fusion Material Monsters listed on that Fusion Monster are in your Deck, you can Special Summon them.
rulings: The effect targets 1 face-up "Neos" Fusion Monster in your Monster Zone.
It cannot be activated during the Damage Step.

Resolving "Return 1 "Neos" Fusion Monster you control to the Extra Deck" and "If all the Fusion Material Monsters listed on that Fusion Monster are in your Deck, you can Special Summon them" are treated as being done at the same time.
If "Contact Out" is activated, the targeted monster is always returned to the Extra Deck, but you can decided not to apply the effect to Special Summon all of the Fusion Materials from the Deck.
The effect to Special Summon all of the Fusion Materials from the Deck Special Summons all of the Fusion Materials listed on the Fusion Monster that was returned to the Extra Deck as one set.

If "Contact Out" is activated by targeting an "Elemental HERO Aqua Neos" etc. that was Special Summoned by "Miracle Contact", that "Elemental HERO Aqua Neos" is returned to the Extra Deck, but regarding being able to apply "If all the Fusion Material Monsters listed on that Fusion Monster are in your Deck, you can Special Summon them", you can Special Summon to the field the set of monsters listed on that "Elemental HERO Aqua Neos" etc. that was returned to the Extra Deck.

name: Contract with Exodia
desc: If you have all 5 of "Exodia the Forbidden One", "Right Arm of the Forbidden One", "Left Arm of the Forbidden One", "Right Leg of the Forbidden One", and "Left Leg of the Forbidden One" in your Graveyard: Special Summon 1 "Exodia Necross" from your hand.
rulings: This card does not target.

If you do not have "Exodia the Forbidden One", "Right Arm of the Forbidden One", "Left Arm of the Forbidden One", "Right Leg of the Forbidden One", and "Left Leg of the Forbidden One" in your Graveyard, "Contract with Exodia" cannot be activated.
If you do not have "Exodia Necross" in your hand, "Contract with Exodia" cannot be activated.

name: Convert Contact
desc: If you control no monsters: Send 2 "Neo-Spacian" monsters (1 from your hand and 1 from your Deck) to the GY, then draw 2 cards.
rulings: It does not target.
If you do not have at least 1 "Neo-Spacian" card in both your hand and your Deck, you cannot activate "Convert Contact".
You cannot send "NEX" to the Graveyard with the effect of "Convert Contact".
Resolving "Send 1 "Neo-Spacian" monster from your hand and 1 from your Deck to the Graveyard" and "Then draw 2 cards" are not treated as being done at the same time.

name: Cost Down
desc: Discard 1 card; for the rest of this turn, reduce the Levels of all monsters in your hand by 2 (even after they are Summoned).
rulings: When Summoning "Montage Dragon", "Cost Down" has no effect when determining its Original ATK.

If you use "Eccentric Boy" and a monster in your hand as Synchro Material Monsters and the monster in your hand's Level has been changed by an effect like "Cost Down", then you use the monster's current, altered Level when performing the Synchro Summon.

name: Creature Swap
desc: Each player chooses 1 monster they control and switches control of those monsters with each other. Those monsters cannot change their battle positions for the rest of this turn.
rulings: The effect does not target. The monster whose control will be switched are chosen at resolution.
Each player selects which of his monsters will switch control.

At the time of a monster changing control due to a card effect like "Brain Control" or "Creature Swap, the Turn Player may use Priority to activate a Spell Speed 2+ effect. Also, Trigger Effects that activate upon a monster changing control will activate. The Turn Player cannot use Priority to Tribute that monster for a Tribute Summon or Tribute Set, nor to activate an Ignition Effect, nor to activate a Normal Spell Card.

While "Rivalry of Warlords" is active, when "Creature Swap" is activated, players may exchange monsters of different Types. After a monster switches control, if its new controller also controls a monster of a different Type, then the monster which switched control is sent to the Graveyard. However, if you only control one monster after the monsters switch control, then you only control one Type of monster, so the monster whose control you gained is not sent to the Graveyard.

The effect of "Creature Swap" does not target the monsters that change control. If "Creature Swap" is activated and you select to change control of a face-up "Spirit Reaper", then "Spirit Reaper" is not destroyed.

name: Crystal Beacon
desc: Special Summon 1 "Crystal Beast" monster from your Deck. You must have 2 or more "Crystal Beast" cards in your Spell & Trap Card Zone to activate and to resolve this effect.

name: Crystal Release
desc: Equip only to a "Crystal Beast" monster. It gains 800 ATK. When this card is sent from the field to the GY: You can place 1 "Crystal Beast" monster from your Deck face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell.
rulings: The effect of "Crystal Release" will activate even if it is sent to the Graveyard while Set in the Spell & Trap Card Zone.

name: Crystal Tree
desc: Each time a "Crystal Beast" monster(s) is placed in either player's Spell & Trap Zone, place 1 Crystal Counter on this card. You can send this card to the GY; take a number of "Crystal Beast" monsters from your Deck equal to the number of Crystal Counters that were on this card, and place them face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone as Continuous Spells.

name: Cup of Ace
desc: Toss a coin: ● Heads: Draw 2 cards. ● Tails: Your opponent draws 2 cards.
rulings: This card can be activated when at least 1 player is able to draw 2 cards (when there are 2 or more cards in the Deck and there are no effects or conditions that prevent drawing). It cannot be activated if neither player is able to draw 2 cards.
When resolving this effect, toss a coin once. The player who draws is determined by the result.

name: Cyberdark Impact!
desc: Fusion Summon 1 "Cyberdark Dragon" from your Extra Deck, by returning 1 each of "Cyberdark Horn", "Cyberdark Edge", and "Cyberdark Keel" from your hand, GY, and/or anywhere on your field, to the Deck, as Fusion Material.
rulings: It does not target.
Returning "Cyberdark Horn", "Cyberdark Edge" and "Cyberdark Keel" to the Deck and Special Summoning from the Extra Deck are not treated as being performed at the same time.

You can choose to return a face-down Defense Position "Cyberdark Horn" etc. on your field to your Deck. (In that case, your opponent can confirm that the card returned to the Deck is the appropriate card.)
You can choose to return a "Cyberdark Edge" etc. that is in your Spell & Trap Zone due to the effect of "Relinquished" etc. to your Deck.

When "Cyberdark Impact!" resolves, you must return 1 each of "Cyberdark Horn", "Cyberdark Edge", and "Cyberdark Keel" to the Deck. Therefore, "King of the Swamp" cannot be returned to the Deck by the effect of "Cyberdark Impact!".

If any of the chosen "Cyberdark Horn", "Cyberdark Keel", or "Cyberdark Edge" to be returned to the Deck are owned by the opponent, that monster is returned to your opponent's Deck. ("Cyberdark Dragon" is Special Summoned normally.)

If any of the chosen "Cyberdark Horn", "Cyberdark Keel", or "Cyberdark Edge" to be returned to the Deck are owned by the opponent, that monster is returned to your opponent's Deck. ("Cyberdark Dragon" is Special Summoned normally.)

The resolution of "Cyberdark Impact!" returns 1 each of "Cyberdark Horn", "Cyberdark Edge" and "Cyberdark Keel" from the player's hand, field, and/or Deck to the owner's Deck as Fusion Material and performs a Fusion Summon. Therefore, while the effect of "Prohibition" activated by declaring "Cyberdark Edge" is applying, if "Cyberdark Edge" was not on the field before the effect of "Prohibition" was applied, because "Cyberdark Edge" cannot be used as Fusion Material, "Cyberdark Impact!" cannot be activated.

name: Cybernetic Fusion Support
desc: Pay half your LP; once, if you Fusion Summon a Machine Fusion Monster this turn, you can banish monsters from your hand, field, and/or GY as the Fusion Materials. You can only activate 1 "Cybernetic Fusion Support" per turn.
rulings: This effect does not perform a Fusion Summon. You must activate Spell Cards like "Polymerization" to apply this effect.
Paying half of your Life Points is a cost to activate this card.
This card cannot be activated during the Damage Step.

If the only Fusion Material Monsters available for a Fusion Summon are in the Graveyard and the effect "Cybernetic Fusion Support" has not resolved yet, the monsters required for the Fusion Summon need to be on the field or in the hand. Therefore, "Polymerization" cannot be activated. But if "Cybernetic Fusion Support" has already resolved, then "Polymerization" can be activated even if the only Fusion Material Monsters available are not on the field or in the hand.

When "Super Polymerization" resolves, you cannot apply the effect of "Cybernetic Fusion Support" if you use monsters your opponent controls as Fusion Material Monsters. The effect of "Cybernetic Fusion Support" can only be applied if you use Fusion Material Monsters from your hand, field, or Graveyard. (You cannot use monsters your opponent controls.)

During a turn in which "Cybernetic Fusion Support" has been activated, if "Polymerization" is activated, a Fusion Summon can be performed without applying the effect of "Cybernetic Fusion Support". (The effect of "Cybernetic Fusion Support" does not need to be applied for the first Fusion Summon performed during that turn. You decide at the time of performing the Fusion Summon whether or not to apply it.)
Special Summoning "Chimeratech Fortress Dragon" or "VWXYZ-Dragon Catapult Cannon" from the Extra Deck is not a Fusion Summon. Therefore, the effect of "Cybernetic Fusion Support" cannot be applied.

name: Cybernetic Zone
desc: Select 1 face-up Machine-Type Fusion Monster you control and remove it from play until the End Phase of this turn. When that monster is returned to the field, double its ATK. During your next Standby Phase, destroy it.

name: Cyclone Boomerang
desc: Equip only to "Elemental HERO Wildheart". It gains 500 ATK. When the equipped monster is destroyed by a card effect and sent to the Graveyard: Destroy all Spell and Trap Cards on the field, then inflict 100 damage to your opponent for each Spell/Trap Card destroyed by this effect.

name: D - Burst
desc: Target 1 face-up Spell you control; destroy it, and if you do, draw 1 card, then if you control a "Destiny HERO" monster, you can Special Summon 1 "Destiny HERO" monster from your hand, GY, or banishment. At the end of the Damage Step, if a monster equipped with an Equip Card, or "Destiny HERO - Dogma", attacked: You can banish this card from your GY; that monster can make a second attack in a row. You can only activate 1 "D - Burst" per turn.

name: D - Force
desc:
When this card is activated: You can add 1 "Destiny HERO - Plasma" from your Deck or GY to your hand. While you control "Destiny HERO - Plasma", apply the following effects.
● You cannot draw during the Draw Phase.
● Your opponent cannot target cards you control with card effects.
● Each "Destiny HERO - Plasma" you control gains 100 ATK for each monster in the GYs, cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects, also can make a second attack during each Battle Phase.

name: D - Formation
desc: Each time a face-up "Destiny HERO" monster(s) you control is destroyed, place 1 D Counter on this card for each of those monsters. When you Normal or Special Summon a monster during your Main Phase: You can send this card with 2 or more D Counters to the Graveyard; add up to 2 cards from your Deck and/or Graveyard to your hand, with the same name as that monster.

name: D - Spirit
desc: Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower "Destiny HERO" monster from your hand. You must not control any face-up "Destiny HERO" monsters to activate and to resolve this effect.

name: D.D. Designator
desc: Declare 1 card name. Look at your opponent's hand, and if they have the declared card in their hand, remove that 1 card from play. If they do not have the declared card in their hand, remove 1 random card in your hand from play.
rulings: In place of declaring a FULL card name, a precise description of a card's stats, appearance, and/or effects, is considered acceptable so long as both players are in clear agreement over which card is being described. }}

name: Dangerous Machine Type-6
desc:
During each of your Standby Phases: Roll a six-sided die and apply the result.
● 1: Discard 1 card.
● 2: Your opponent discards 1 card.
● 3: Draw 1 card.
● 4: Your opponent draws 1 card.
● 5: Destroy 1 monster your opponent controls.
● 6: Destroy this card.

name: Dark Calling
desc: Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, that must be Special Summoned with "Dark Fusion", by banishing the Fusion Materials listed on it from your hand and/or GY. (This is treated as a Fusion Summon with "Dark Fusion".)
rulings: This card does not target.
When resolving this card, Fusion Materials are banished.

"Banish, from your hand or your Graveyard, the Fusion Material Monsters listed on a Fusion Monster Card that can only be Special Summoned with "Dark Fusion"" and "Special Summon that monster from your Extra Deck." are not considered to happen simultaneously.

You can Special Summon a monster that can only be Special Summoned with "Dark Fusion", but the "The Special Summoned monster cannot be targeted by the opponent's Spells, Traps, or card effects this turn." effect is not applied.

When Fusion Summoning with "Dark Calling", you can banish 2 Fusion Materials from only your hand, or from only your Graveyard, or you can banish 1 from the hand and 1 from the Graveyard. It isn't mandatory to banish 1 from each.

When resolving "Dark Fusion", you can use a card like "King of the Swamp" as a substitute Fusion Material. However, if you are Fusion Summoning a Fusion Monster like "Evil Hero Dark Gaia" which does not specifically name cards ("1 Fiend-Type monster + 1 Rock-Type monster"), or a monster like "Dark Balter the Terrible" with the text "A Fusion Summon of this monster can only be conducted with the above Fusion Material Monsters", then you cannot use a monster like "King of the Swamp".

name: Dark City
desc: When a "Destiny HERO" monster attacks, if its ATK is lower than the ATK of the attack target, the attacking monster gains 1000 ATK during damage calculation only.

name: Dark Corridor
desc: Add 1 "Dark World" monster from your Deck to your hand, then discard 1 card. You can only activate 1 "Dark Corridor" per turn.
rulings: [Regarding the effect "Add 1 "Dark World" monster from your Deck to your hand, then discard 1 card."]
It can be activated even if you do not have any cards in your hand (or if activating this card from your hand results in having no cards left in your hand).
When resolving this effect, add 1 "Dark World" monster from your Deck to your hand. Then, if you successfully added one to your hand, discard 1 card from your hand.

name: Dark Designator
desc: Declare 1 Monster Card name. If the declared card is in your opponent's Deck, add 1 of that card to your opponent's hand.
rulings: In place of declaring a FULL card name, a precise description of a card's stats, appearance, and/or effects, is considered acceptable so long as both players are in clear agreement over which card is being described. }}

name: Dark Dragon Ritual
desc: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Paladin of Dark Dragon". You must also Tribute monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels equal 4 or more. During your Main Phase, except the turn this card was sent to the Graveyard: You can banish this card from your Graveyard; add 1 "Red-Eyes" Spell/Trap Card from your Deck to your hand.

name: Dark Element
desc: If you have a "Gate Guardian" monster in your GY: Pay half your LP; Special Summon 1 Level 11 or higher "Gate Guardian" monster from your hand, Deck, or Extra Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions. You can banish this card from your GY; add 1 of your "Sanga of the Thunder", "Kazejin", or "Suijin" from your Deck or banishment to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Dark Element" once per turn.

name: Dark Factory of Mass Production
desc: Target 2 Normal Monsters in your GY; add them to your hand.
rulings: The effect of "Dark Factory of Mass Production" targets two Normal Monsters in your Graveyard.

name: Dark Fusion
desc: Fusion Summon 1 Fiend Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field as Fusion Material. Your opponent cannot target it with card effects this turn.
rulings: This card does not target.
When resolving this card, Fusion Materials are sent to the Graveyard.

"Send, from your hand or your side of the field to the Graveyard, the Fusion Material Monsters that are listed on a Fiend-Type Fusion Monster Card" and " Special Summon that Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck." are not considered to happen simultaneously.
When this card resolves, the last thing to happen is considered to be the Special Summon of a monster.

If the monster that was Special Summoned using "Dark Fusion" is changed to face-down Defense Position, the "The Special Summoned monster cannot be targeted by the opponent's Spells, Traps, or card effects this turn." effect is no longer applied.

name: Dark Sanctuary
desc: If a "Spirit Message" card would be placed on your field with "Destiny Board", you can Special Summon it as a Normal Monster (Fiend/DARK/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) instead, and if you do, it is unaffected by card effects, except "Destiny Board", and cannot be targeted for attacks, but does not prevent your opponent from attacking you directly. When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Toss a coin and if the result is heads, negate the attack, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to half the current ATK of that opponent's monster.

name: Dark World Dealings
desc: Each player draws 1 card, then each player discards 1 card.
rulings: Drawing a card and discarding a card are not treated as occurring at the same time.
Each player chooses the card that is discarded from their own hand.
If there are 0 cards in either player's Deck, "Dark World Dealings" cannot be activated.

name: Dark World Lightning
desc: Target 1 Set card on the field; destroy that target, then discard 1 card.
rulings: This card targets 1 Set card on the field.
This card cannot be activated if you have no cards in your hand.
Destroying the targeted card and discarding 1 card are not resolved simultaneously.
When resolving this card's effect, if the targeted card is face-up, it is not destroyed, and you do not discard any card.

If "Dark World Lightning" targets a face-down Defense Position monster on the field, "Judgment of Anubis" cannot be activated in a Chain. If "Dark World Lightning" targets a face-down card in the Field Zone or Spell & Trap Zone, "Judgment of Anubis" can be activated in a Chain.

name: Dedication through Light and Darkness
desc: Tribute 1 "Dark Magician"; Special Summon 1 "Dark Magician of Chaos" from your hand, Deck, or Graveyard.

name: Demise of the Land
desc: Activate only when your opponent Special Summons a monster. Select 1 Field Spell Card from your Deck and activate it.
rulings: This card does not target a Field Spell Card card in the Deck.
This card cannot be activated during the Damage Step.
If there is not Field Spell Card in your Deck, you cannot activate "Demise of the Land".

You can activate a card effect by chaining to the activation of "Demise of the Land", but you cannot activate a card effect by chaining to the activation of the Field Spell Card activated by "Demise of the Land".
You cannot activate "Demise of the Land" while the effect Neither player can activate a new Field Spell Card, of "Field Barrier" is being applied.

When "Oracle of the Zefra" is activated by the effect of "Demise of the Land" or "Pop-Up" the effect, When this card is activated: Add 1 "Zefra" monster from your Deck to your hand. , is not applied. Additionally, you can activate "Oracle of the Zefra" from your Deck with the effect of "Demise of the Land" or "Pop-Up" even if you have no "Zefra" monsters in your Deck.

You can activate "Toon Kingdom" with the effect of "Demise of the Land" or "Pop-Up" even if you have 2 or fewer cards remaining in your Deck. The effect, When this card is activated: Banish 3 cards from the top of your Deck, face-down., is not applied.

name: Des Croaking
desc: Activate only while you control 3 face-up "Des Frogs". Destroy all cards your opponent controls.

name: Destiny Draw
desc: Discard 1 "Destiny HERO" card; draw 2 cards.

name: Diamond-Dust Cyclone
desc: Select 1 monster with 4 or more Fog Counters. Destroy it and then draw 1 card for every 4 Fog Counters that were on it.

name: Dice Dungeon
desc:
When this card is activated: You can add 1 "Dimension Dice" from your Deck to your hand. At the start of the Battle Phase: You can activate this effect; each player rolls a six-sided die and applies the result to all monsters they control, until the end of this turn.
● 1: Lose 1000 ATK.
● 2: Gain 1000 ATK.
● 3: Lose 500 ATK.
● 4: Gain 500 ATK.
● 5: Halve their ATK.
● 6: Double their ATK.

name: Different Dimension Capsule
desc: Select 1 card from your Deck and remove it from play face-down. During your 2nd Standby Phase after activation, destroy this card and add the removed card to your hand.
rulings: After activation, this card remains on the field until your second Standby Phase.
If your second Standby Phase is skipped by a card effect, then "Different Dimension Capsule" remains on the field meaninglessly, and the removed card remains removed from play face-down.
The card which is removed from play is removed from play face-down.
"Pyro Clock of Destiny" will only affect cards that count turns.
It will affect "Swords of Revealing Light", "Nightmare's Steelcage", "Crush Card Virus", "Lightforce Sword", etc.
It will not affect "Goblin Attack Force", "Cocoon of Evolution", "Great Moth", "Change of Heart", "Dimensionhole", "Destiny Board", "Different Dimension Capsule", "Ekibyo Drakmord", etc.
If "Different Dimension Capsule" is not destroyed by its own effect, then the card which was removed from play remains removed from play face-down.
"Gold Sarcophagus" and "Different Dimension Capsule" do not count turns. You cannot activate "Pyro Clock of Destiny" in chain, to advance their turn count by 1.

While "Thunder King Rai-Oh" is on the field, you can still remove from play cards from your deck and you can still add cards to your hand which have been removed from play, so you can still activate "Gold Sarcophagus"/"Different Dimension Capsule"/etc, and afterwards the card will be added to your hand.

If "Imperial Iron Wall" is active, then "Different Dimension Capsule" cannot be activated. If "Imperial Iron Wall" is chained to "Different Dimension Capsule", then no card is removed from play and "Different Dimension Capsule" is sent to the Graveyard.

If a monster is removed from play face-down - such as by the effect of "Different Dimension Capsule" - then it is unknown what type of card it is (Monster/Spell/Trap), so when resolving "Parallel World Fusion" you cannot return it to the Deck as a Fusion Material Monster.

name: Diffusion Wave-Motion
desc:
(This card is not treated as a "Fusion" card.)
If your opponent controls a monster: Pay 1000 LP, then target 1 Level 7 or higher Spellcaster monster you control; this turn, it must attack all monsters your opponent controls once each, also other monsters you control cannot attack. The effects of monsters destroyed by these attacks cannot activate and are negated.

name: Dimension Dice
desc: If you control a card with an effect that requires a die roll: You can Tribute 1 monster; Special Summon 1 monster with an effect that requires a die roll from your hand or Deck.
rulings: This card can be activated if you have a face-up monster in your Monster Zone with a monster effect that requires a die roll, a face-up Spell/Trap Card in your Spell & Trap Zone with an effect that requires a die roll (or a Pendulum Monster Card in your Pendulum Zone with a Pendulum Effect that requires a die roll), or a Field Spell Card in your Field Zone with an effect that requires a die roll.

name: Dimension Distortion
desc: You can only activate this card if there are no cards in your Graveyard. Select 1 removed from play monster and Special Summon it on your side of the field.

name: Dimension Explosion
desc: Return 1 face-up Fusion Monster you control to the Extra Deck. Both players select up to 2 of their monsters that are removed from play, and Special Summon them.
rulings: Returning one Fusion Monster to the Extra Deck is a cost to activate this card.

"Dimension Explosion" targets the removed monsters to be Special Summoned. You choose which of your removed monsters to Special Summon, and your opponent chooses which of his monsters to Special Summon.
"Dimension Explosion" cannot be activated if either player has no removed from play monsters that he can Special Summon.

"Dimension Explosion" cannot be activated if a player has no open Monster Card Zones. However, if a player only has one open Monster Card Zone, then "Dimension Explosion" can be activated, but the player can only target one monster to be Special Summoned.

name: Dimension Fusion
desc: Pay 2000 Life Points. Both players Special Summon as many of their removed from play monsters as possible.
rulings: If "Automatic Laser" is activated when multiple monsters are Special Summoned simultaneously by an effect like "Dimension Fusion", then all Special Summoned monsters with 1000+ ATK are destroyed. Special Summoned monsters with less than 1000 ATK are not destroyed.
If "Bottomless Trap Hole" is activated when multiple monsters are Special Summoned simultaneously, then all Summoned monsters with 1500+ ATK are destroyed.
Example: Two copies of "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" are Special Summoned by "Dimension Fusion". If "Bottomless Trap Hole" is activated, then both copies of "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" are destroyed.

name: Dimension Fusion Destruction
desc: Banish from your hand, field, and/or GY, the Fusion Materials that are listed on a "Phantasm" Fusion Monster, then Special Summon that Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions. You take no battle damage from attacks involving the monster Special Summoned by this effect. If you control "Uria, Lord of Searing Flames", "Hamon, Lord of Striking Thunder", or "Raviel, Lord of Phantasms", your opponent cannot activate cards or effects in response to this card's activation.

name: Dimensional Fissure
desc: Any monster sent to the Graveyard is banished instead.
rulings: If "Crystal Beast Ruby Carbuncle" is destroyed while "Banisher of the Light"/"Banisher of the Radiance"/"Macro Cosmos"/etc is on the field, you can still place it in your Spell/Trap Zone and treat it as a Continuous Spell Card. If you choose not to use the effect, then "Crystal Beast Ruby Carbuncle" is banished.

If "Arcana Force VII - The Chariot" battles with a monster with the same ATK, so that both are destroyed, the effect cannot be activated. If "Arcana Force VII - The Chariot" destroys a monster while "Macro Cosmos" or "Dimensional Fissure" is active, then the banished monster can be Special Summoned.
If "Dimensional Fissure" is active when "Celestia, Lightsworn Angel" is Tribute Summoned, then you cannot activate her effect.

While "Imperial Iron Wall" is active, you can still activate "Macro Cosmos"/"Dimensional Fissure"/etc, but "Macro Cosmos"' effect which banishes cards is not applied, and cards are sent to the Graveyard normally.
While the effect of "Gravekeeper's Servant" is active, your opponent cannot attack without sending a card from the top of his Deck to the Graveyard.
If the effect of "Macro Cosmos" or "Banisher of the Light" is active, then your opponent cannot send a card from the Deck to the Graveyard, so he cannot declare an attack.
If the effect of "Dimensional Fissure" is active, then it is unknown whether or not the top card of the opponent's Deck is a Monster Card, so your opponent cannot declare an attack.

If the effects of both "Dimensional Fissure" and "Convulsion of Nature" are active, then it is known whether or not the top card of the opponent's Deck is a Monster Card, so your opponent can attack only if the top card of his Deck is a Spell or Trap Card.

If "Dimensional Fissure" is active, then you may still activate the effect of "Guardian Eatos" by sending to the Graveyard a Monster Card that is being treated as an Equip Spell Card, such as a Union monster.

While the effect of "Dimensional Fissure" or "Macro Cosmos" is active, you cannot activate effects which have "discard to the Graveyard" or "send to the Graveyard" as costs. Thus, you cannot activate the effect of "Honest" which increases ATK, since you cannot send it to the Graveyard as a cost.

You can activate the effect of "Brionac, Dragon of the Ice Barrier" by discarding Spell and Trap Cards even if the effect of "Dimensional Fissure" is active. However, if the effect of "Dimensional Fissure" is active, then you cannot discard monsters to the Graveyard since they would be banished instead of being sent to the Graveyard, so you cannot activate the effect of "Brionac, Dragon of the Ice Barrier" by discarding Monster Cards.

If "Dimensional Fissure" is active, then you cannot send cards from the top of your Deck to the Graveyard as a cost, since you might send a Monster Card to the Graveyard. Thus, you cannot activate effects like those of "Charge of the Light Brigade", "Card Trooper", or "Celestia, Lightsworn Angel".

You can send an "Inzektor Hornet" that is equipped to an "Inzektor" monster to the Graveyard while "Dimensional Fissure" is applied to activate its effect, because it is treated to be sent to the Graveyard as an Equip Spell Card. However, if "Macro Cosmos" is active, cards cannot be sent to the Graveyard, so the effect of "Inzektor Hornet", when it is treated as an Equip Spell Card, cannot be activated.

While the effect of "Dimensional Fissure" is being applied, if a Pendulum Monster in a Pendulum Zone is destroyed, it will not be banished and will be returned to the Extra Deck, since it is treated as a Spell Card while in a Pendulum Zone.
While the effect of "Dimensional Fissure" is being applied, if a Pendulum Monster in a Monster Zone is destroyed, it will be banished instead of returning to the Extra Deck.

When the effect of "Macro Cosmos" etc is applied, cards are not sent to the Graveyard, and directly removed from play. "Chimeratech Fortress Dragon" cannot be Special Summoned if "Macro Cosmos" is active, since you cannot send cards to the Graveyard.
If "Macro Cosmos" is being negated by "Jinzo", when "Jinzo" is destroyed, it is removed from play.
If "Macro Cosmos" and "Jinzo" are face-up on the field, you cannot send "Jinzo" to the Graveyard to Special Summon "Chimeratech Fortress Dragon".
If "Evil HERO Infernal Prodigy" is Tributed for a "HERO" monster while "Macro Cosmos" is active, then its effect to draw still activates during the End Phase.
If "Samsara Kaiser" is Tributed while "Macro Cosmos" is active, then its effect to return it to your hand activates.

If the monster discarded by "D.D.R. - Different Dimension Reincarnation" is removed from play by "Macro Cosmos", then you can select the monster as a target of "D.D.R. - Different Dimension Reincarnation". However, you must already have at least one monster removed from play to activate "D.D.R. - Different Dimension Reincarnation".

If "Grandmaster of the Six Samurai" is destroyed and removed from play, such as by "Macro Cosmos" or "Banisher of the Light", the effect which adds 1 "Six Samurai" monster from your Graveyard to your hand still activates. The effect activates in the Graveyard if it is sent to the Graveyard, and activates in the banished pile if the monster is removed from play.
You can Synchro Summon while "Macro Cosmos"/"Banisher of the Light"/etc is in play. In this case, the Synchro Material Monsters are removed from play.

Synchro Materials are considered Synchro Materials as long as they remain in the Graveyard (or banished pile if "Macro Cosmos" is active), or if it is removed from play from the Graveyard with "D.D. Crow" etc. It is no longer considered a Synchro Material if it returns to the Graveyard from the Removed Zone, if it is Special Summoned to the field, or if it returns to the Hand/Deck from the Graveyard/Removed Zone.

You can treat "Dragunity Javelin" as an Equip Spell Card and equip it to a Winged Beast-Type "Dragunity" monster even the effect of a card like "Banisher of the Radiance" or "Banisher of the Light" or "Macro Cosmos" or "Dimensional Fissure" is active when "Dragunity Javelin" would be destroyed while it is face-up in the Monster Zone. If the effect is not applied, then "Dragunity Javelin" is removed from play by the effect of the card like "Banisher of the Light".

name: Divine Sword - Phoenix Blade
desc: Equip only to a Warrior monster. It gains 300 ATK. During your Main Phase, if this card is in your GY: You can banish 2 Warrior monsters from your GY; add this card to your hand.

name: Doctor D
desc: Banish 1 "Destiny HERO" monster from your GY; add to your hand or Special Summon 1 "Destiny HERO" monster from your GY. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 2 "Destiny HERO" monsters you control; choose 1 of those monsters, its ATK becomes the other monster's ATK, until the end of this turn.

name: Doll Hammer
desc: Target 1 monster you control; destroy it, and if you do, draw 2 cards, then you can change the battle position of 1 monster your opponent controls. If a monster(s) is Special Summoned from your GY while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Doll Hammer" once per turn.

name: Double Fusion
desc: Pay 500 LP; Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field, then you can Fusion Summon 1 more Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field.

name: Double Snare
desc: Destroy 1 face-up card on the field that has an effect that negates Trap Cards' effects.
rulings: A face-up "The Dragon's Bead", "Tyrant Dragon", "Fiend Skull Dragon", "Jinzo", "Royal Decree", "Sorcerer of Dark Magic", etc. can be destroyed by the effect of "Double Snare". Also, "Ryu Senshi" can be targeted by the effect of "Double Snare". However, "Double Snare" will be negated by the effect of "Ryu Senshi" that negates the effects of Spell Cards. Furthermore, "Double Snare" can only destroy face-up cards.[http://www.db.yugioh-card.com/yugiohdb/faq_search.action?ope=5&fid=6096&request_locale=ja Konami OCG Card Database]: What kind of card can be destroyed by the effect of "Double Snare"?

name: Double Spell
desc: Discard 1 Spell Card, then target 1 Spell Card in your opponent's Graveyard; place that target in the appropriate Zone on your side of the field, and as this card's effect resolution, follow its card text as if you had used it yourself.

name: Double Summon
desc: You can conduct 2 Normal Summons/Sets this turn, not just 1.

name: Dragon Nails
desc: Equip only to a DARK monster. It gains 600 ATK, also it cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects. If this card is sent to the GY because the equipped monster was destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can Special Summon that monster, and if you do, equip this card to it, but banish this card when it leaves the field. You can only use this effect of "Dragon Nails" once per turn.

name: Dragon's Gunfire
Dragon's Mirror
desc: Fusion Summon 1 Dragon Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by banishing Fusion Materials listed on it from your field or GY.

name: E - Emergency Call
desc: Add 1 "Elemental HERO" monster from your Deck to your hand.
rulings: This card does not target.
This card cannot be activated if you don't have any "Elemental HERO" monster in your Deck.

name: EN Shuffle
desc: Shuffle 1 "Elemental HERO" or "Neo-Spacian" monster you control into the Deck, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "Elemental HERO" or "Neo-Spacian" monster with a different name from your Deck. You can banish this card from your GY; shuffle from your GY into the Deck, either 1 "Elemental HERO" monster and 1 "Neo-Spacian" monster, OR 1 "Elemental HERO Neos", then draw 1 card. You can only use each effect of "EN Shuffle" once per turn.

name: Earthquake
desc: Change all face-up monsters on the field to Defense Position.

name: Ectoplasmer
desc: Once per turn, during each player's End Phase: The turn player must Tribute 1 face-up monster, and if they do, inflict damage to their opponent equal to half the original ATK of the Tributed monster.
rulings: The effect is not optional, and MUST be activated during every End Phase.
The effect does not target.
The Tributing is done at resolution. It is not a cost.
Damage dealt is equal to half the Tributed monster's Original ATK.
"Spell of Pain" activates in chain to an opponent's card effect which inflicts damage.
Example: "Spell of Pain" can be activated in chain to "Ectoplasmer", "Ring of Destruction", and "Cannon Soldier".

name: Emblem of Dragon Destroyer
desc: Add 1 "Buster Blader" from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand.
rulings: You can activate "Emblem of Dragon Destroyer", etc, while "Thunder King Rai-Oh" is face-up on the field. When resolving the effect, if "Thunder King Rai-Oh" is on the field, then you can only add a "Buster Blader" from your Graveyard to your hand.

name: Emergency Provisions
desc: Send any number of other Spell/Trap Cards you control to the Graveyard; gain 1000 LP for each card sent to the Graveyard this way.
rulings: Sending a Spell/Trap Card(s) to the Graveyard is a cost to activate this effect.
You can send a Monster Card equipped to "Relinquished" or an "Embodiment of Apophis" being treated as a Monster Card to the Graveyard to activate "Emergency Provisions".
You can send multiple Spell/Trap Cards to the Graveyard.
You cannot activate "Emergency Provisions" if you already have 5 cards in your Spell & Trap Card Zone.

name: Enchanting Fitting Room
desc: Pay 800 LP; excavate the top 4 cards of your Deck and Special Summon all excavated Level 3 or lower Normal Monsters, also, after that, shuffle the rest back into your Deck.

name: End of the World
desc: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Ruin, Queen of Oblivion" or "Demise, King of Armageddon". You must also Tribute monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels exactly equal the Level of the Ritual Monster you Ritual Summon.

name: Enemy Controller
desc:
Activate 1 of these effects.
● Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; change that target's battle position.
● Tribute 1 monster, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; take control of that target until the End Phase.
rulings: For "Kuraz the Light Monarch", the player who controls the card at the time it is destroyed draws 1 card. So if you target your own monster and your opponent takes control of it with "Enemy Controller", your opponent will draw 1 card.
If you activate "Dark End Dragon"'s effect and chain "Enemy Controller" so that you gain control of the target, then the target is not sent to the Graveyard.

If "Enemy Controller" is chained to the activation of the effect of "Black Whirlwind" so that the opponent controls the "Blackwing" monster when resolving the effect of "Black Whirlwind", then the effect of "Black Whirlwind" still resolves and you can still add a "Blackwing" monster from your Deck to your hand.

The effect of "Turbo Cannon" inflicts damage to the current controller of the monster when resolving the effect. If you chain an effect like "Enemy Controller" to "Turbo Warrior" to take control of the opponent's targeted monster, then the damage is inflicted to you.

If you gain control of an opponent's monster with a card like "Brain Control" or "Enemy Controller" and then the monster is flipped face-down by an effect like "Book of Moon", then the effect of "Enemy Controller" is still applied, and control of the monster still returns back to your opponent during the End Phase.

If you gain control of an opponent's monster with an effect like "Brain Control" or "Enemy Controller" and then the monster is removed from play by "Interdimensional Matter Transporter", then after the monster returns to the field during the End Phase, your opponent still regains control of the monster. Also, if the monster is removed from play by "Dimensionhole", then during the Standby Phase the monster returns to the opponent's side of the field.

If you activate "Raigeki Break" and target your own "Clear Vice Dragon" and then the opponent Chains "Enemy Controller" to take control of your "Clear Vice Dragon", then your opponent chooses whether to discard one card from his hand or to have "Clear Vice Dragon" destroyed.

Suppose "Machina Fortress" is targeted by an opponent's Effect Monster's effect and then "Enemy Controller" is Chained. After resolving the effect of "Enemy Controller", "Machina Fortress" is under your opponent's control, so when resolving the opponent's Effect Monster's effect "Machina Fortress" is no longer treated as "being targeted by an opponent's Effect Monster's effect". Thus, you do not apply the effect of "Machina Fortress" which discards one card from the opponent's hand.

name: Eye of Illusion
desc:
If you control an Illusion or Spellcaster monster: Activate 1 of these effects;
● Your Illusion and Spellcaster monsters cannot be destroyed by battle this turn.
