● During your opponent's turn: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; take control of it until the End Phase.
● When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls, except the attacking monster; change the attack target to it and perform damage calculation.
rulings: [Regarding the effect "If you control an Illusion or Spellcaster monster: Activate 1 of these effects; ● Your Illusion and Spellcaster monsters cannot be destroyed by battle this turn. ● During your opponent's turn: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; take control of it until the End Phase. ● When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls, except the attacking monster; change the attack target to it and perform damage calculation."]
When activating this effect, select 1 "●" effect and activate it as this effect.
It cannot be activated during the Damage Step.
The first "●" effect will also apply to Illusion or Spellcaster monsters that come to be in your Monster Zone after it resolves.

name: Fairy of the Spring
desc: Target 1 Equip Spell Card in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand. That Equip Spell Card cannot be activated this turn.

name: Fake Hero
desc: Special Summon 1 "Elemental HERO" monster from your hand. That monster cannot attack, and returns to the hand during the End Phase.

name: Fallen Paradise
desc: Your opponent cannot target "Uria, Lord of Searing Flames", "Hamon, Lord of Striking Thunder", "Raviel, Lord of Phantasms", or "Armityle the Chaos Phantom" in your Monster Zones with card effects, also those monsters cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects while you control them. If you control "Uria, Lord of Searing Flames", "Hamon, Lord of Striking Thunder", "Raviel, Lord of Phantasms" or "Armityle the Chaos Phantom" in your Monster Zone: You can draw 2 cards. You can only use this effect of "Fallen Paradise" once per turn.

name: Feather Shot
desc: Target 1 face-up "Elemental HERO Avian" you control; during this turn, that target can attack a number of times equal to the number of monsters you control when this card resolves, but cannot attack directly, and other monsters you control cannot attack this turn.

name: Fiend's Sanctuary
desc: Special Summon 1 "Metal Fiend Token" (Fiend/DARK/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0). It cannot attack. Your opponent takes any battle damage you would have taken from battles involving it. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase, pay 1000 LP or destroy this Token.
rulings: The Token Monster is treated as a Normal Monster.
Paying Life Points during your Standby Phase is a Maintenance Cost for the "Metal Fiend Token".
This card's effect makes makes the opponent take the Battle Damage that the controller of "Metal Fiend Token" would have taken during the damage calculation of "Metal Fiend Token"'s battle.
The damage that the opponent receives by the battle of "Metal Fiend Token" becomes Battle Damage.
After the opponent receives the Battle Damage, the "Metal Fiend Token" is destroyed by battle.
If there is no open space in you Monster Card Zone, it is not possible to activate this card.

name: Fifth Hope
desc: Target 5 "Elemental HERO" cards in your Graveyard; shuffle them into the Deck, then draw 2 cards (draw 3 cards instead, if you had no other cards on your side of the field and in your hand when you activated this card).

name: Final Light
desc: Pay LP in multiples of 1000, then target 1 "Valkyrie" monster in your GY with a different name for every 1000 LP paid; Special Summon them, then your opponent can Special Summon monsters with 2000 or less ATK from their GY, up to the number of monsters you Special Summoned by this effect. You can only activate 1 "Final Light" per turn.
rulings: Paying Life Points in multiples of 1000 is the cost to activate this card.
This card targets 1 "Valkyrie" monster in your GY for every 1000 Life Points paid. (If you target 2 or more monsters, they must have different names.)
Special Summoning the targeted monsters from your GY and your opponent Special Summoning monsters from their GY do not happen simultaneously.

Your opponent chooses whether or not to apply the part of the effect that Special Summons monsters from their GY. (If your opponent does not Special Summon any monsters, the effect finishes resolving with you Special Summoning monsters from your GY as the last thing to happen.)

name: Fire Recovery
desc: Target 1 FIRE monster in your GY; send 1 card from your hand to the GY, and if you do, Special Summon the targeted monster. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 3 of your FIRE monsters that are banished and/or in your GY; shuffle them into the Deck, then draw 1 card. You can only use this effect of "Fire Recovery" once per turn.
rulings: [Regarding the effect "Target 1 FIRE monster in your GY; send 1 card from your hand to the GY, and if you do, Special Summon the targeted monster."
It is the effect applied when this card's activation resolves.
When resolving this effect, send 1 card from your hand to the GY, and if it is successfully sent to the GY, Special Summon the targeted monster.
Sending a card from your hand to the GY and Special Summoning the targeted monster occur simultaneously.
[Regarding the effect "You can banish this card from your GY, then target 3 of your FIRE monsters that are banished and/or in your GY; shuffle them into the Deck, then draw 1 card."
It starts a Chain and can be activated in the GY.
It can only be activated during your Main Phase, if you have at least 1 card in your Deck.
When resolving this effect, even if some of the targeted monsters are no longer present, the effect is applied to the remaining targeted monsters.
When resolving this effect, shuffle the targeted monsters into the Deck. Then, if you successfully returned at least 1 of them to the Deck (or Extra Deck), draw 1 card.
Returning monsters to the Deck and drawing a card do not occur simultaneously.

name: Five Star Twilight
desc: If the only monster you control is 1 Level 5 monster: Tribute that monster; Special Summon 5 monsters (1 "Kuribah", 1 "Kuribee", 1 "Kuriboo", 1 "Kuribeh", and 1 "Kuriboh") from your hand, Deck, and/or GY, but they cannot be Tributed for a Tribute Summon. You can only activate 1 "Five Star Twilight" per turn.

name: Flint
desc: The equipped monster loses 300 ATK and cannot change its battle position or declare an attack. If this card is destroyed because the equipped monster is destroyed: Target 1 monster on the field; equip this card to that monster.
rulings: If "Venom Swamp" is on the field and "Flint" is equipped to a monster with 300 or less ATK and a Venom Counter, then the monster is considered to have its ATK decreased to 0 by "Flint", so it is not destroyed by "Venom Swamp".

If "Flint" is equipped to a monster, and then it gains a Venom Counter because of "Venom Swamp" and has its ATK decreased to 0, then the monster is considered to have its ATK decreased to 0 by "Venom Swamp", so it is destroyed.

name: Foolish Burial
desc: Send 1 monster from your Deck to the GY.
rulings: A single "Exodius the Ultimate Forbidden Lord" must send all five "Forbidden One" cards to the Graveyard for you to win the Duel. If "Foolish Burial" sends one piece to the Graveyard, you do not win the Duel.

After you send the card to the Graveyard, you shuffle the Deck. However, this is not treated as the effect of a card, so the last thing to resolve is sending the card from the Deck to the Graveyard. Because of this, you can activate the effect of "Jinzo - Returner" or "Peten the Dark Clown" if it is sent from the Deck to the Graveyard by "Foolish Burial".

At the time of "Destiny Hero - Malicious" being sent to the Graveyard by the effect of "Foolish Burial"/"Armageddon Knight"/etc, the Turn Player cannot use Priority to activate the Ignition Effect of "Destiny Hero - Malicious". If the Turn Player passes Priority and does not activate a Spell Speed 2+ effect, then the opponent can activate the effect of "D.D. Crow" before the Turn Player can activate the effect of "Destiny Hero - Malicious".

name: Fossil Fusion
desc: Fusion Summon 1 "Fossil" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by banishing Fusion Materials listed on it from any GYs (except for materials with a specific GY requirement listed). If you banished monsters from both GYs, neither player can target that Special Summoned monster with monster effects. If a face-up "Fossil" Fusion Monster(s) you control is destroyed by battle or card effect, while this card is in your GY: You can add this card from the GY to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Fossil Fusion" once per turn.

name: Frontline Base
desc: Once per turn: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Union monster from your hand.

name: Fulfillment of the Contract
desc: Activate this card by paying 800 LP, then target 1 Ritual Monster in your GY; Special Summon it and equip it with this card. When this card is destroyed, banish the equipped monster.

name: Full Moon Mirror
desc:
Each time a monster(s) is destroyed by battle or effect, place 1 Full Moon Counter on this card for each. You can remove Full Moon Counters from this card, then activate 1 of these effects;
● 1: Special Summon 1 Level 6 or lower monster (Fiend or Fairy) from your hand or GY.
● 3: Add 1 Level 10 DARK monster from your Deck to your hand.
● 5: Special Summon 1 Level 10 monster from your hand or GY.
You can only use this effect of "Full Moon Mirror" once per turn.

name: Fusion Recovery
desc: Target 1 "Polymerization" in your GY, and 1 monster in your GY that was used as material for a Fusion Summon; add them to your hand.
rulings: The effect of "Fusion Recovery" targets a total of two cards: 1 "Polymerization" and 1 monster that was used as a Fusion Material.
The 2 targeted cards are treated as being added to the hand at the same time.
Even if either of the 2 targeted cards in no longer in the Graveyard when the effect resolves, the remaining card is returned to the hand.

You can target a Fusion, Synchro or Xyz Monster that was used for a Fusion Summon as the "1 Fusion Material Monster that was used for a Fusion Summon". (In that case, it returns to the Extra Deck instead of being added to the hand.)
Because "Fusion Substitute" is a card that "is always treated as "Polymerization"", a "Fusion Substitute" in the Graveyard can be targeted by "Fusion Recovery".

Even if "Elemental HERO Prisma", "Phantom of Chaos" etc. that has changed its name with its own effect is used as a Fusion Material, that "Elemental HERO Prisma" etc. can be returned to the hand by the effect of "Fusion Recovery". Also, that "Elemental HERO Prisma" can also be Special Summoned by the effect of "Branch!".

"If a Fusion Material used for a regular Fusion Summon is returned to the Graveyard by "Burial from a Different Dimension" etc. after being banished, that monster is not treated as a ""Fusion Material"". Therefore, a monster that has been returned to the Graveyard after being banished cannot be returned to the hand by the effect of "Fusion Recovery" or "Supply" as a ""Fusion Material Monster""."

If "Proto-Cyber Dragon" on the field was used as a Fusion Material while its name was treated as "Cyber Dragon", that "Proto-Cyber Dragon" can be returned to the hand by the effect of "Fusion Recovery". Also, that "Proto-Cyber Dragon" can be Special Summoned by the effect of "Branch!".

name: Fusion Weapon
desc: Equip only to a Level 6 or lower Fusion Monster. The equipped monster gains 1500 ATK and DEF.

name: Future Fusion
desc: During your 1st Standby Phase after this card's activation: Show 1 Fusion Monster in your Extra Deck and send the Fusion Materials listed on it from your Main Deck to the GY. During your 2nd Standby Phase after this card's activation: Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck with the same name as the monster you showed, and target it with this card. When this card leaves the field, destroy that target. When that target is destroyed, destroy this card.
rulings: The monsters are sent to the GY when resolving the effect.
This effect does not target.
You choose which Fusion Monster when resolving this card's effect.
This effect continuously targets the Fusion Summoned Fusion Monster.

name: Gift of the Martyr
desc: Send 1 monster on your side of the field to the Graveyard. Select 1 monster on your side of the field. The selected monster gains ATK equal to the ATK of the sent monster until the end of this turn.

name: Gingerbread House
desc: During your opponent's Standby Phase: You can have as many monsters they control as possible gain 600 ATK, then destroy as many monsters they control as possible with 2500 or more ATK, and if you do, gain LP equal to the number of monsters destroyed x 500. (The ATK gain remains even if this card leaves the field.) You can only use this effect of "Gingerbread House" once per turn.
rulings: This card's effect that activates during your opponent's Standby Phase starts a Chain. (It does not target.)

Increasing the ATK of all monsters on your opponent's field by 600 and destroying any that have 2500 or more ATK do not happen simultaneously. (If there are no monsters with 2500 or more ATK on your opponent's field, the effect finishes resolving after increasing your opponent's monsters' ATK.)
Destroying monsters with 2500 or more ATK on your opponent's field and gaining 500 Life Points for each monster destroyed happen simultaneously.

The monsters destroyed by this effect will include monsters that had 2500 or more ATK before the 600 ATK increase was applied, as well as monsters that have 2500 or more ATK as a result of the 600 ATK increase being applied.

name: Glass Slippers
desc: If this card is equipped to a Fairy monster, it gains 1000 ATK. If this card is equipped to a non-Fairy monster, it cannot attack, also it loses 1000 ATK. If this card is sent to the GY because the equipped monster is destroyed: You can target 1 "Prinzessin" you control; equip this card to that target. You can only use this effect of "Glass Slippers" once per turn.

name: Goddess Skuld's Oracle
desc: When this card is activated: If all monsters you control are "Valkyrie" monsters (min. 1), you can add 1 "Goddess Verdande's Guidance" from your Deck to your hand. Once per turn, during your Main Phase: You can look at the top 3 cards of your opponent's Deck, and if you do, place them on top of their Deck in any order, but you cannot Normal or Special Summon monsters for the rest of this turn, except Fairy monsters. You can only activate 1 "Goddess Skuld's Oracle" per turn.
rulings: This card's effect that adds a "Goddess Verdande's Guidance" from your Deck to your hand is the effect applied by activating this card. (It does not target.)

When this card resolves, if all monsters in your Monster Zone are face-up "Valkyrie" monsters, you can add a "Goddess Verdande's Guidance" from your Deck to your hand. (You can also choose not to apply this effect.)

This card's effect that allows you to look at the top 3 cards of your opponent's Deck and replace them in any order starts a Chain. (It does not target. Only the player who activated this effect can look at the cards from your opponent's Deck and decides the order they are replaced in.)
You cannot activate this effect if your opponent has less than 3 cards in their Deck.

name: Goddess Urd's Verdict
desc: Your opponent cannot target "Valkyrie" monsters you control with card effects, also they cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects. Once per turn: You can declare 1 card name, then target 1 Set card your opponent controls; reveal the Set card, and if it was the declared card, banish it. Otherwise, banish 1 card you control.
rulings: This card's effect that prevents your opponent from targeting "Valkyrie" monsters on your field with card effects and prevents those monsters from being destroyed by your opponent's card effects does not start a Chain.

This card's effect that reveals a Set card on your opponent's field and banishes a card starts a Chain. (It targets 1 face-down card on your opponent's field. Declare 1 card name when activating this effect.)
If you target a Set Spell/Trap Card, and that card is chained to this effect, you cannot apply the effect of revealing it, so no cards are banished.

name: Goddess Verdande's Guidance
desc: When this card is activated: If all monsters you control are "Valkyrie" monsters (min. 1), you can add 1 "Goddess Urd's Verdict" from your Deck to your hand. Once per turn: You can declare 1 type of card (Monster, Spell, or Trap); reveal the top card of your opponent's Deck and if it was the declared type, they Set it to their field. Otherwise, they add it to their hand. You can only activate 1 "Goddess Verdande's Guidance" per turn.
rulings: This card's effect that adds a "Goddess Urd's Verdict" from your Deck to your hand is the effect applied by activating this card. (It does not target.)

When this card resolves, if all monsters in your Monster Zone are face-up "Valkyrie" monsters, you can add a "Goddess Urd's Verdict" from your Deck to your hand. (You can also choose not to apply this effect.)
This card's effect that reveals the top card of your opponent's Deck and either Sets it or adds it to their hand starts a Chain. (It does not target. Declare 1 card type when activating this effect.)

Even if you reveal a card of the declared card type, if there are no zones it can be Set to, the card is added to your opponent's hand. Furthermore, if Monster was declared and a monster that cannot be Special Summoned is revealed, the card is added to your opponent's hand.

name: Gold Moon Coin
desc: Add 2 cards from your hand to your opponent's hand, then draw 2 cards. You can only activate 1 "Gold Moon Coin" per turn.
rulings: This card does not target.
Adding 2 cards from your hand to your opponent's and drawing 2 cards do not happen simultaneously.
You cannot activate "Gold Moon Coin" unless you have 2 or more cards in your hand. (However, if "Gold Moon Coin" is activated from your hand, you must have at least 2 other cards in your hand.)
You cannot activate "Gold Moon Coin" if you have 1 card or less in your Deck.

name: Gold Sarcophagus
desc: Banish 1 card from your Deck, face-up. During your second Standby Phase after this card's activation, add that card to the hand.
rulings: While "Thunder King Rai-Oh" is on the field, you can still remove from play cards from your deck and you can still add cards to your hand which have been removed from play, so you can still activate "Gold Sarcophagus", etc, and afterwards the card will be added to your hand.

name: Golden Castle of Stromberg
desc: Once per turn, during your Standby Phase, you must banish 10 cards from the top of your Deck face-down (this is not optional), or this card is destroyed. During your Main Phase: You can Special Summon 1 monster from your Deck that specifically lists the card "Golden Castle of Stromberg" in its text. You cannot Normal Summon/Set the turn you activate this effect (even if this card leaves the field). You can only use this effect of "Golden Castle of Stromberg" once per turn. When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Destroy the attacking monster, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to half the ATK that monster had on the field.

name: Golden Rule
desc:
(This card is always treated as a "Crystal" card.)
Place 2 "Crystal Beast" monsters from your Deck face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone as Continuous Spells, then Special Summon 1 "Crystal Beast" monster from your hand or GY with a different name than those cards, and if you do, equip it with this card. When this card leaves the field, destroy that monster. You can only activate 1 "Golden Rule" per turn.

name: Grand Convergence
desc: If you control "Macro Cosmos": Inflict 300 damage to your opponent and destroy all monsters on the field.
rulings: This card cannot be activated during the Damage Step.
This card can only be activated while "Macro Cosmos" is face-up on your field.
Applying "Inflict 300 damage to your opponent" and "destroy all monsters on the field" are treated as being done at the same time.
"Grand Convergence" can be activated even if there are no face-up monsters on the field. (In that case, only apply "Inflict 300 damage to your opponent".)

name: Gravity Axe - Grarl
desc: The equipped monster gains 500 ATK. Monsters your opponent controls cannot change their battle positions.

name: Grief Tablet
desc:
(This card is always treated as a "Wedju" card.)
The equipped monster cannot attack or be Tributed, also its effects are negated. Once per turn, if you control the equipped monster: You can add 1 "Wedju" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Grief Tablet". If this card is sent to the GY because the equipped monster is destroyed: You can inflict 500 damage to your opponent. You can only activate 1 "Grief Tablet" per turn.
rulings: [Regarding the effect "The equipped monster cannot attack or be Tributed, also its effects are negated."
This effect does not start a Chain and is applied while this card is face-up in the Spell & Trap Zone.
[Regarding the effect "Once per turn, if you control the equipped monster: You can add 1 "Wedju" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Grief Tablet"."
This effect starts a Chain and can be activated while this card is face-up in the Spell & Trap Zone.
It can only be activated during your Main Phase.
[Regarding the effect "If this card is sent to the GY because the equipped monster is destroyed: You can inflict 500 damage to your opponent."
This effect starts a Chain and can be activated in the GY.
It can also be activated during the Damage Step.

name: Gryphon's Feather Duster
desc: Destroy all Spell and Trap Cards on your side of the field. Increase your Life Points by the number of destroyed cards x 500 points.

name: Guard Penalty
desc: Select 1 monster on the field. If it is changed to Defense Position this turn, draw 1 card.
rulings: When you draw by this card's effect, it does not start a Chain.

name: H - Heated Heart
desc: Target 1 face-up monster you control; until the end of this turn, it gains 500 ATK, and if it attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.
rulings: This card targets 1 face-up monster you control.
Applying the "if it attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing Battle Damage to your opponent." efect does not start a Chain Link.

name: Hammer Shot
desc: Destroy 1 face-up Attack Position monster with the highest ATK. (If it is a tie, you get to choose.)
rulings: This card will destroy a monster you control if it has the highest ATK.
This effect does not target.
If two monsters are tied for the highest ATK, then the player who activated "Hammer Shot" chooses which is destroyed.
"Remote Revenge" cannot be used against "Hammer Shot", since "Hammer Shot" does not target.

name: Harpie Lady Phoenix Formation
desc: If you control 3 or more "Harpie Lady" and/or "Harpie Lady Sisters": Target as many monsters your opponent controls as possible, but not more than the total number of "Harpie Lady" and "Harpie Lady Sisters" you control; destroy those targets, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to the highest original ATK among those destroyed monsters (your choice, if tied). You cannot Special Summon monsters from the Main Deck or Extra Deck, nor conduct your Battle Phase, the turn you activate this card.

name: Heart of the Underdog
desc: During your Draw Phase, when you draw a Normal Monster(s): You can reveal it; draw 1 more card.

name: Hero Flash!!
desc: Banish "H - Heated Heart", "E - Emergency Call", "R - Righteous Justice" and "O - Oversoul" from your Graveyard; Special Summon 1 "Elemental HERO" Normal Monster from your Deck. All "Elemental HERO" Normal Monsters you currently control can attack your opponent directly this turn.
rulings: Banishing 1 "H - Heated Heart", "E - Emergency Call", "R - Righteous Justice" and "O - Oversoul" from your Graveyard is a cost to activate this card.
This card does not target.

If this card is activated and "Vanity's Emptiness" is activated in a chain, even if you cannot Special Summon 1 "Elemental HERO" Normal Monster from your Deck, the "All "Elemental HERO" Normal Monsters you currently control can attack your opponent directly this turn." effect is still applied.
After this card resolves, if a new "Elemental HERO" monster is Summoned, that monster cannot attack directly using the effect of "Hero Flash!!".

name: Hero Heart
desc: Target 1 face-up "Elemental HERO" monster you control; halve its ATK until the end of this turn, but it can attack twice during this turn's Battle Phase.

name: Hero Mask
desc: Target 1 face-up monster you control; send 1 "Elemental HERO" monster from your Deck to the Graveyard, and if you do, that target's name becomes the sent monster's name, until the End Phase.
rulings: If a monster whose original name does not include "HERO" is being treated as an "Elemental HERO" monster by the effect of "Hero Mask", "Mask Change" can be activated targeting that monster.

If "Hero Mask" is activated targeting a face-up "Elemental HERO Avian" you control, an "Elemental HERO Avian" cannot be chosen during the resolution of the effect. Therefore, if there are no "Elemental HERO" monsters in your Deck except "Elemental HERO Avian", "Hero Mask" cannot be activated targeting "Elemental HERO Avian".

If a Token Monster or "Embodiment of Apophis" is being treated as "Elemental Hero Neos" because of "Hero Mask", then you may select it as a target of "Wrath of Neos". If "Wrath of Neos" attempts to return the Token Monster to the Deck, then the Token Monster disappears instead, so "Wrath of Neos" does not destroy the cards on the field because you did not return the Token Monster to the Deck. If "Wrath of Neos" targets "Embodiment of Apophis", then "Embodiment of Apophis" is returned to the Deck, so all cards on the field are destroyed.

name: Hieroglyph Lithograph
desc: Pay 1000 Life Points. During the current Duel, your hand size limit becomes 7.

name: Illusion Gate
desc: Pay half your LP; destroy as many monsters your opponent controls as possible, then you can Special Summon 1 monster from your opponent's GY to your field, ignoring its Summoning conditions. You can only apply this effect of "Illusion Gate" once per Duel.
rulings: At resolution, apply "destroy as many monsters your opponent controls as possible". Then, if at least 1 monster was destroyed, you can apply "Special Summon 1 monster from your opponent's GY to your field, ignoring its Summoning conditions".
Destroying monsters and Special Summoning a monster do not happen at the same time.

name: Inferno Fire Blast
desc: Target 1 "Red-Eyes B. Dragon" in your Monster Zone; inflict damage to your opponent equal to its original ATK. "Red-Eyes B. Dragon" cannot attack the turn you activate this card.

name: Inferno Reckless Summon
desc: When exactly 1 monster with 1500 or less ATK is Special Summoned to your field while your opponent controls a face-up monster: Special Summon as many monsters as possible with the same name as the Summoned monster, from your hand, Deck, and Graveyard, in Attack Position, also your opponent Special Summons as many monsters as possible with the same name as 1 of their face-up monsters, from their hand, Deck, and Graveyard.
rulings: This effect does not target.
This card cannot be activated during the Damage Step.

It can only be activated when exactly 1 monster with 1500 or less ATK is Special Summoned to your Monster Zone face-up. (It cannot be activated when 2 or more monsters are Special Summoned at the same time.)

You Special Summon as many monsters as possible with the same name as the Summoned monster from your hand, Deck, and Graveyard. (If you have no monsters with the same name in your hand, Deck, or Graveyard, "Inferno Reckless Summon" cannot be activated.)

"Special Summon as many monsters as possible with the same name as the Summoned monster, from your hand, Deck, and Graveyard, in Attack Position" and "your opponent Special Summons as many monsters as possible with the same name as 1 of their face-up monsters, from their hand, Deck, and Graveyard." are considered to happen at the same time.

If a card like "Rush Recklessly" is Chained to "Inferno Reckless Summon" so that the Special Summoned monster has 1501 or more ATK at resolution, then "Inferno Reckless Summon" still resolves properly and Special Summons monsters with the same name.
If your opponent only controls Token Monsters, then you can still activate "Inferno Reckless Summon". In this case, only you will Special Summon monsters from the effect of "Inferno Reckless Summon".

If cards like "Book of Moon" or "Raigeki Break" is Chained to "Inferno Reckless Summon" so that neither player has any face-up monsters at resolution, then neither player Special Summons monsters with the same name. If only your opponent has face-up monsters, then your opponent still Special Summons monsters with the same name, even though you do not have any face-up monsters. If only you have face-up monsters, then only you Special Summon monsters with the same name.

If a Special Summon monster with 1500 ATK or less like "Kagetokage" is Special Summoned and there are copies of that monster that have been properly Special Summoned in the Graveyard, "Inferno Reckless Summon" can be activated. However, if there are not properly Special Summoned copies, since the remaining copies in the hand or Deck of "Kagetokage" cannot be Special Summoned with the effect of "Inferno Reckless Summon", "Inferno Reckless Summon" cannot be activated.

"Inferno Reckless Summon" can be activated even if the opponent cannot Special Summon because you control "Vanity's Ruler". In that case, monsters from your hand, Deck or Graveyard with the same name as the monster with 1500 ATK or less that was Special Summoned are Special Summoned to your side of the field. The opponent still chooses a monster, but since they cannot Special Summon monsters, no monsters are Special Summoned. (Monsters are only Special Summoned to your side of the field.)

"Inferno Reckless Summon" can be activated even if the opponent does not have any available Monster Zone. In that case, monsters from your hand, Deck or Graveyard with the same name as the monster with 1500 ATK or less that was Special Summoned are Special Summoned to your side of the field. The opponent still chooses a monster, but since all their Monster Zones are occupied, no monsters are Special Summoned. (Monsters are only Special Summoned to your side of the field. If there are monsters in the opponent's hand or Deck with the same name as the choosed monster, these are not sent to the Graveyard.)
Suppose your opponent activates "Inferno Reckless Summon" when they Special Summon "Card Trooper" while you control "Bujin Mikazuchi" and "Bujingi Wolf".
Your opponent Special Summons as many copies of "Card Trooper" as possible from their hand, Deck, and Graveyard.
You must choose either "Bujin Mikazuchi" or "Bujingi Wolf".
If you choose "Bujin Mikazuchi", since you can only control 1 "Bujin Mikazuchi", you cannot perform the Special Summon and only your opponent performs the Special Summon.
If you choose "Bujingi Wolf", you Special Summon as many monsters with the same name as possible from your hand, Deck, and Graveyard.
Suppose your opponent activates "Inferno Reckless Summon" when they Special Summon "Geargiauger" while you control a "Panther Warrior" and 3 copies of "Sheep Token".
Your opponent Special Summons as many copies of "Geargiauger" as possible from their hand, Deck, and Graveyard.
You must choose either "Panther Warrior" or "Sheep Token".

If you choose "Sheep Token", since you do not have any monster with the same name in your hand, Deck, or Graveyard, you cannot perform the Special Summon and only your opponent performs the Special Summon.

If you choose "Panther Warrior", since you only have 1 available Monster Zone, you Special Summon 1 "Panther Warrior" from your hand, Deck, or Graveyard. (Even if you have a third copy of "Panther Warrior" in your hand or Deck, since you cannot Special Summon 2 or more monsters, the third copy of "Panther Warrior" remains in the hand or Deck. It is not sent to the Graveyard.)
Suppose you activate "Inferno Reckless Summon" when you Special Summon "Hardened Armed Dragon" while your opponent controls "Gravekeeper's Spear Soldier" and "Necrovalley".

The player who activated "Inferno Reckless Summon" Special Summons as many copies of "Hardened Armed Dragon" as possible from their hand and Deck, but not from the Graveyard. (Even if the player who activated "Inferno Reckless Summon" cannot Special Summon because it only has copies of "Hardened Armed Dragon" in the Graveyard, their opponent still performs the Special Summon.)

Your opponent Special Summons as many copies of "Gravekeeper's Spear Soldier" as possible from their hand and Deck, but not from the Graveyard. (Even if your opponent cannot Special Summon because it only has copies of "Gravekeeper's Spear Soldier" in the Graveyard, the player who activated "Inferno Reckless Summon" still performs the Special Summon.)

name: Inferno Tempest
desc: When you take 3000 or more Battle Damage from 1 attack, you can activate this card. Remove all monsters in each player's Deck and Graveyard from play.
rulings: This card activates during the Damage Step.
You and your opponent can check each other's Decks at resolution.
If you take 3000+ Battle Damage when a monster is destroyed by battle, then the destroyed monster is not removed from play.

name: Instant Fusion
desc: Pay 1000 LP; Special Summon 1 Level 5 or lower Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, but it cannot attack, also it is destroyed during the End Phase. (This is treated as a Fusion Summon.) You can only activate 1 "Instant Fusion" per turn.
rulings: This card is a "Fusion" card.
Paying 1000 Life Points is the cost to activate this card.
This card cannot Special Summon a Fusion Monster such as "Chimeratech Rampage Dragon" that mentions "A Fusion Summon of this card can only be done with the above Fusion Materials".
The monster Special Summoned by this effect is treated as being Special Summoned by a Fusion Summon.

This card finishes resolving by performing the Special Summon. (Immediately after the Special Summon, the effect "it cannot attack, also it is destroyed during the End Phase" is applied to the Special Summoned monster.)
If the monster Special Summoned by this effect stops being face-up in the Monster Zone, the effect "it cannot attack, also it is destroyed during the End Phase" stops applying.
Destroying the monster Special Summoned by this effect during the End Phase does not start a Chain Link.
Even if control of the monster Special Summoned by this effect is changed to your opponent's Monster Zone during the same turn, it is still destroyed during the End Phase of that turn.
If the monster Special Summoned by this effect is not destroyed during the End Phase, the destruction effect is applied again during the End Phase of the next turn.

name: Instant Neo Space
desc: Equip only to a Fusion Monster that lists "Elemental HERO Neos" as material. It does not have to activate its effect during the End Phase to shuffle itself into the Extra Deck. If the equipped monster leaves the field: You can Special Summon 1 "Elemental HERO Neos" from your hand, Deck, or GY.

name: Iron Cage
desc: When this card is activated: Send 1 monster you control to the GY, or if "Golden Castle of Stromberg" is in a Field Zone, you can send 1 monster your opponent controls to the GY, instead. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: You can target the monster that was sent to the GY by this card's effect; destroy this card, and if you do, Special Summon that monster to your field. You can only activate 1 "Iron Cage" per turn.

name: Jurassic World
desc: All Dinosaur-Type monsters gain 300 ATK and DEF.

name: Kishido Spirit
desc: Monsters on your side of the field cannot be destroyed in a battle if the monsters' ATK are equal.

name: Knight's Title
desc: Tribute 1 face-up "Dark Magician"; Special Summon 1 "Dark Magician Knight" from your hand, Deck or Graveyard.

name: Left Arm Offering
desc: If you have 2 or more other cards in your hand: Banish your entire hand; add 1 Spell from your Deck to your hand. You cannot Set Spells/Traps during the turn you activate this card.

name: Legend of Heart
desc: Pay 2000 LP and Tribute 1 Warrior monster; banish up to 3 "Legendary Dragon" Spells with different names from your hand and/or GY, and if you do, Special Summon that many "Legendary Knight" monsters with different names from your hand, Deck, and/or GY. You can only activate 1 "Legend of Heart" per turn.
rulings: This card does not target.
Paying 2000 Life Points and Tributing 1 Warrior-Type monster is a cost to activate this card.
Banishing "Legendary Dragon" Spell Cards with different names from your hand and/or Graveyard is part of the effect. It is not a cost.
Banishing "Legendary Dragon" Spell Cards with different names and Special Summoning "Legendary Knight" monsters are considered to happen simultaneously.

If "Vanity's Emptiness" is activated in a chain to "Legend of Heart", you cannot Special Summon any monster. If you cannot Special Summon, you do not banish any "Legendary Dragon" Spell Card from your hand and/or Graveyard.

name: Level Down!?
desc: Select 1 face-up "LV" on the field to activate this card. Return the selected card to its owner's Deck and Special Summon 1 monster from the owner's Graveyard to their side of the field with the same name but lower "LV" (ignoring the Summoning conditions).
rulings: The effect targets 1 face-up "LV" monster in either player's Monster Zone.
It cannot be activated during the Damage Step.
Returning the targeted monster to the Deck and Special Summoning 1 monster happen at the same time.

When resolving the effect of "Level Down!?", if the targeted monster is in face-down Defense Position, the effect of "Level Down!?" is not applied. (The targeted monster is not returned to the Deck, and the Special Summon is not performed.)

name: Level Modulation
desc: Your opponent draws 2 cards. Special Summon 1 "LV" monster from your Graveyard, ignoring the Summoning conditions. The monster that was Special Summoned by this effect cannot attack, nor activate or apply its effect this turn.

name: Level Up!
desc: Send 1 face-up "LV" monster you control to the GY; Special Summon 1 monster from your hand or Deck that is listed in the sent monster's text, ignoring its Summoning conditions.
rulings: Sending 1 face-up "LV" monster from your Monster Zone to the Graveyard is the cost to activate this card.

At resolution, Special Summon a "LV" monster whose name is specifically listed in the card text of the monster that was sent to the Graveyard as a cost. (You cannot Special Summon a monster that is not a "LV" monster.)

If there is not a corresponding "LV" monster in your hand or Deck, this card cannot be activated. (There must be a "LV" monster in your hand or Deck corresponding to the monster sent to the Graveyard.)
You cannot activate this card by sending a "LV" monster to the Graveyard that does not list any monster in its card text, such as "Mystic Swordsman LV6".

name: Light Barrier
desc:
During your Standby Phase, toss a coin. If the result is Tails, the following effects are negated until your next Standby Phase:
● When you Summon an "Arcana Force" monster, choose which effect to apply without tossing a coin. If an "Arcana Force" monster destroys an opponent's monster by battle, you gain Life Points equal to the destroyed monster's original ATK.
rulings: It starts a Chain Link and is activated by this face-up card in the Field Zone.
It activates mandatorily once during each Standby Phase of this card's controller.
It does not start a Chain Link and is applied by this face-up card in the Field Zone.
It is applied mandatorily when this card's controller resolves an "Arcana Force" monster's effect that activates when it is Summoned.
It is applied even during the Damage Step.
It starts a Chain Link and can be activated by this face-up card in the Field Zone.
It activates mandatorily at the end of the Damage Step in which an "Arcana Force" monster of this card's controller destroyed an opponent's monster by battle.
It activates even if the "Arcana Force" monster battles a monster with the same ATK and both monsters are destroyed.

When gaining Life Points by this effect, refer to the ATK listed on the card that was destroyed by battle with your "Arcana Force" monster. If you destroyed a monster with ? ATK, "You gain LP equal to the destroyed monster's original ATK" is not applied.

name: Light Laser
desc: Equip only to a LIGHT Warrior-Type monster. Remove from play any monsters that battle with it at the end of Damage Step.

name: Lightning Crash
desc: Add 1 Thunder monster from your Deck to your hand, but you cannot Normal Summon/Set monsters with its name until the end of the next turn after this card resolves. You can only activate 1 "Lightning Crash" per turn.

name: Litmus Doom Ritual
desc: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Litmus Doom Swordsman". You must also Tribute monsters from your hand or field, whose total Levels equal 8 or more. If this card is in the GY: You can target 1 "Litmus Doom Swordsman" in your GY; shuffle both it and this card from the GY into the Deck, then draw 1 card. You can only use this effect of "Litmus Doom Ritual" once per turn.

name: Living Fossil
desc: Activate this card by targeting 1 Level 4 or lower monster in your GY; Special Summon it and equip it with this card, but banish it when it leaves the field (even if this card has left the field). When this card leaves the field, banish the equipped monster. The equipped monster loses 1000 ATK/DEF, also its effects are negated. You can only activate 1 "Living Fossil" per turn.

name: Lucky Cloud
desc: During the End Phase, if you Summoned 2 or more "Cloudian" monsters with the same name this turn, draw 2 cards.

name: Lullaby of Obedience
desc:
Pay 2000 LP and declare 1 Monster Card name; your opponent looks at their Deck, reveals 1 of the declared monsters if there is any, and chooses 1 of these effects to be applied.
● The declared monster is added to the hand of the player who activated this card.
● The player who activated this card Special Summons the declared monster to their field in Attack Position, ignoring its Summoning conditions.

name: Machine Angel Ritual
desc: This card can be used to Ritual Summon any "Cyber Angel" Ritual Monster. You must also Tribute monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels equal or exceed the Level of the Ritual Monster you Ritual Summon. If a LIGHT monster(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect while this card is in your GY, you can banish this card instead.

name: Machine Duplication
desc: Target 1 Machine monster you control with 500 or less ATK; Special Summon up to 2 monsters from your Deck with the same name as that face-up monster.
rulings: This card targets 1 Machine-Type monster you control with 500 or less ATK.

A Token Monster like "Sheep Token" is treated as a Monster Card on the field, but they do not exist on the Deck. Therefore, since you cannot Special Summon any monster with the same name from your Deck, "Machine Duplication" cannot be activated by targeting a Token Monster.

When "Genex Recycled" uses its effect and changes its name to "Genex Neutron", if you activate "Machine Duplication" and target "Genex Recycled", then you will Special Summon up to two "Genex Neutron" from your Deck.

If the targeted monster is no longer face-up on the field when resolving "Machine Duplication" - such as if "Book of Moon" or "Compulsory Evacuation Device" is chained - then you cannot Special Summon any monsters of the same name from your Deck.

Even if "Stronghold the Moving Fortress" or "Metal Reflect Slime" that is being treated as a Machine-Type by "DNA Surgery" are treated as Monster Cards by their own effects, they are still treated as Trap Cards on the Deck. Therefore, since you cannot Special Summon any monster with the same name from your Deck, "Machine Duplication" cannot be activated by targeting "Stronghold the Moving Fortress" or "Metal Reflect Slime".
If "Rush Recklessly" is chained to "Machine Duplication" so that the targeted monster has 501 or more ATK at resolution, then you still Special Summon monsters with the same name.

If "Machine Duplication" targets a Machine-Type monster with 500 or less ATK that has been affected by "Forbidden Lance", then you can still Special Summon monsters with the same name as the Machine-Type monster.

"Jinzo - Jector" is treated as "Jinzo" while it is face-up on the field or in the Graveyard. Therefore, if a "Jinzo - Jector" whose ATK was halved by "Shrink" is targeted by "Machine Duplication", you can only Special Summon "Jinzo" from your Deck. (You cannot Special Summon "Jinzo - Jector".)

name: Magic Formula
desc: Equip only to "Dark Magician" or "Dark Magician Girl". It gains 700 ATK. If this card is sent from the field to the GY: Gain 1000 LP.

name: Magic Reflector
desc: Target 1 face-up Spell Card you control; place 1 counter on it. If it would ever be destroyed, remove the counter instead.

name: Magical Blast
desc: Inflict 200 damage to your opponent for each Spellcaster monster you control. During your Draw Phase, if this card is in your GY, before you draw: You can give up your normal draw this turn, and if you do, add this card to your hand.
rulings: If you activate an effect like that of "Iron Core of Koa'ki Meiru" or "Magical Blast" or "Spirit Burner" instead of drawing, then if an effect like that of "D.D. Crow" or "Disappear" is chained so that "Iron Core of Koa'ki Meiru" is no longer in the Graveyard when resolving its effect, then you do not add "Iron Core of Koa'ki Meiru" to your hand. However, you still cannot draw, since you already chose to activate the effect of "Iron Core of Koa'ki Meiru" instead of draw.

name: Magical Dimension
desc: If you control a Spellcaster monster: Target 1 monster you control; Tribute that target, then Special Summon 1 Spellcaster monster from your hand, then you can destroy 1 monster on the field.
rulings: The effect targets 1 face-up Spellcaster-Type monster in your Monster Zone.
It cannot be activated during the Damage Step.

"Tribute that target, then Special Summon 1 Spellcaster-Type monster from your hand" must be applied, but you can choose not to apply "then you can destroy 1 monster on the field". (If "then you can destroy 1 monster on the field" is applied, the monster to be destroyed is chosen when that effect is applied.)

The application of "Tribute that target, then Special Summon 1 Spellcaster-Type monster from your hand" and the application of "then you can destroy 1 monster on the field" are not treated as being done at the same time.

Even if the only monsters on your field and unaffected by Spell effects, if there is a Spellcaster-Type monster on your field, you can activate "Magical Dimension". Furthermore, if the monster targeted by the effect of "Magicial Dimension" is unaffected by Spell effects due to the effect of "Forbidden Lance" etc., the monster cannot be Tributed by the effect of "Magicial Dimension" and the effect is not applied. (Special Summon 1 Spellcaster-Type monster from your hand" and "then you can destroy 1 monster on the field" are also not applied.)

If "Vanity's Emptiness" is activated in Chain to the activation of "Magical Dimension", only "Tribute that target" is performed. (Special Summoning a Spellcaster-Type monster from the hand and destroying a monster on the field cannot be performed.)

name: Magical Mallet
desc: Shuffle any number of cards from your hand into the Deck, then draw that same number of cards.

name: Magical Stone Excavation
desc: Discard 2 cards, then target 1 Spell in your GY; add it to your hand.
rulings: This card targets the Spell Card which is to be returned to the hand.

name: Magicians Unite
desc: If you control 2 or more Attack Position Spellcaster monsters: Target 1 of them; its ATK becomes 3000 until the end of this turn, also for the rest of this turn after this card resolves, other Spellcaster monsters you control cannot attack.
rulings: If you do not control 2 or more face-up Attack Position Spellcaster-Type monsters in your Monster Zone, "Magicians Unite" cannot be activated.
It targets 1 face-up Attack Position Spellcaster-Type monster in your Monster Zone.
"Magicians Unite" can be activated during the Main Phase 2. (Even if you have already attacked with other Spellcaster-Type monsters, "Magicians Unite" can be activated.)
After "Magicians Unite" resolves, Spellcaster-Type monsters Summoned afterwards are also unable to atttack that turn.

When resolving the effect of "Magicians Unite", if the targeted monster is unaffected by the effects of Spell Cards because the effect of "Forbidden Lance", the targeted monster is unaffected by the effect "its ATK becomes 3000 until the end of this turn", but "other Spellcaster-Type monsters you control cannot attack this turn." is still applied. Therefore, other Spellcaster-Type monsters you control cannot attack this turn.

When resolving the effect of "Magicians Unite", if the targeted monster is no longer on the field because it was destroyed by the effect of "Raigeki Break", the effect "its ATK becomes 3000 until the end of this turn" is not applied, but "other Spellcaster-Type monsters you control cannot attack this turn." is still applied. Therefore, Spellcaster-Type monsters you control cannot attack this turn.

name: Magnet Circle LV2
desc: Special Summon 1 Level 2 or lower Machine-Type monster from your hand.

name: Magnet Reverse
desc: Target 1 of your Machine or Rock monsters, that is banished or is in your GY, that cannot be Normal Summoned/Set; Special Summon it.
rulings: This card targets 1 of the following monsters:
Machine-Type Special Summon Monsters in your Graveyard.
Rock-Type Special Summon Monsters in your Graveyard.
Your banished Machine-Type Special Summon Monsters.
Your banished Rock-Type Special Summon Monsters.
This card cannot be activated during the Damage Step.
This card can target a Machine-Type or Rock-Type Fusion, Synchro, or Xyz Monster.
This card cannot target a monster that was sent to the Graveyard or banished without being Special Summoned using the procedure written in its text.

"Malefic Cyber End Dragon" is a monster that must be Special Summoned using the procedure written in its text and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. Even if it is sent to the Graveyard (or banished) after being Special Summoned using the procedure written in its text, it cannot be Special Summoned by "Magnet Reverse".

"Valkyrion the Magna Warrior" is a monster that cannot be Special Summoned by other card effects unless it was first be Special Summoned using the procedure written in its text. Therefore, a "Valkyrion the Magna Warrior" that was sent from the hand to the Graveyard cannot be Special Summoned by "Magnet Reverse".

"XYZ-Dragon Cannon" is a monster that cannot be Special Summoned by other card effects unless it was first be Special Summoned using the procedure written in its text. Also, "XYZ-Dragon Cannon" cannot be Special Summoned from the Graveyard even if it was Special Summoned using the procedure written in its text. If "XYZ-Dragon Cannon" is banished after being Special Summoned using the procedure written in its text, it can be Special Summoned by "Magnet Reverse".

name: Marshmallon Glasses
desc: While "Marshmallon" is in your Monster Zone, your opponent cannot target monsters other than "Marshmallon" for attacks.

name: Mausoleum of the Emperor
desc: During any Main Phase: The turn player can pay 1000 LP x the number of monsters normally needed for the Tribute Summon of a monster (max. 2000); that player Normal Summons/Sets that monster without Tributing. (This is their one Normal Summon/Set for that turn. This is not a Tribute Summon.)
rulings: "The Wicked Avatar" and "The Wicked Dreadroot" cannot be Normal Summoned or Set, except with a Tribute Summon with 3 monsters. "Mausoleum of the Emperor" cannot be used to Normal Summon these cards.

You can only use the effect of "Spell Economics" to activate a Spell Card without paying Life Points - that is, you can only not pay Life Points to play a Spell Card from your hand or to flip face-up a Spell Card which is face-down on the field. Thus, if you control a face-up "Spell Economics" and a face-up "Mausoleum of the Emperor", then you cannot use the effect of "Spell Economics" to activate the effect of "Mausoleum of the Emperor" without paying Life Points.
You can use the effect of "Mausoleum of the Emperor" to Normal Summon or Set monsters like "Simorgh, Bird of Divinity" or "Diabolos, King of the Abyss" from your hand, without Tributing monsters.

name: Metamorphosis
desc: Tribute 1 monster. Special Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck with the same Level as the Tributed monster.
rulings: Tributing 1 monster from your Monster Zone is the cost to activate this card.
It can be activated even if you have 6 monsters in your Monster Zone.
It can also Tribute a face-down Defense Position monster.
It cannot Tribute an Xyz or Link Monster.
The effect resolves based on the Level the Tributed monster had in the Monster Zone.
At resolution, even if the Tributed monster is no longer in the Graveyard, you still Special Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck with the same Level as the Tributed monster.

The Special Summon performed by this effect is not treated as a Fusion Summon. (If a monster Special Summoned by this effect is sent to the Graveyard or banished, it cannot be Special Summoned by other card effects.)

name: Meteor of Destruction
desc: If your opponent's Life Points are higher than 3000: Inflict 1000 damage to your opponent.

name: Mind Control
desc: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; until the End Phase, take control of that target, but it cannot declare an attack or be Tributed.
rulings: This effect targets 1 face-up monster in your opponent's Monster Zone.
It can also target a monster in face-down Defense Position in your opponent's Monster Zone.
Returning control of the monster affected by "Mind Control" during the End Phase does not make a Chain Link.
The effect "it cannot declare an attack or be Tributed" is an effect that is applied until the End Phase of the turn "Mind Control" is applied.

Sending monsters to the Graveyard for a Synchro Summon is not treated as "Tributing". Therefore, a monster which the player gained control of by the effect of "Mind Control" can be sent to the Graveyard as a Synchro Material, even it cannot be Tributed.

A card with an effect of "Control of this face-up card on the field cannot switch" cannot switch control while face-up under any circumstances. So, if a face-down Botanical Lion changes control due to Mind Control and is then flipped face-up, the lingering part of the effect of Mind Control will not apply during the End Phase and control of Botanical Lion will not return to the opponent.

name: Miracle Contact
desc: Shuffle into the Deck, from your hand, field, or GY, the Fusion Materials that are listed on an "Elemental HERO" Fusion Monster that lists "Elemental HERO Neos" as Fusion Material, then Special Summon that Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions.
rulings: The effect does not target.

The resolution of "Shuffle into the Deck, from your hand, field, or GY, the Fusion Materials that are listed on an "Elemental HERO" Fusion Monster that lists "Elemental HERO Neos" as Fusion Material" and the resolution of "Special Summon that Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions" are considered to happen at the same time.
The monster Special Summoned by the effect of "Miracle Contact" is not treated as a monster that was Special Summoned by a Fusion Summon.

name: Miracle Fusion
desc: Fusion Summon 1 "Elemental HERO" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by banishing Fusion Materials listed on it from your field or your GY.

name: Miracle Rupture
desc: Send 1 Level 4 or lower Rock monster from your Deck to the GY, then, if "Fossil Fusion" is in your GY, draw 1 card. You can only activate 1 "Miracle Rupture" per turn.

name: Mirage Tube
desc: This card cannot be activated from your hand. Activate only when a face-up monster you control is selected as an attack target. Inflict 1000 damage to your opponent.

name: Mirage of Nightmare
desc: Once per turn, during your opponent's Standby Phase: Draw cards until you have 4 cards in your hand. If you do, during your next Standby Phase after that: Randomly discard the same number of cards you drew (or your entire hand, if you do not have enough cards).
rulings: It starts a Chain Link and activates in the Spell & Trap Zone.
It activates mandatorily once during each of your opponent's Standby Phases.
It starts a Chain Link and activates in the Spell & Trap Zone.
It activates mandatorily once during your next Standby Phase after drawing by this card's 1st effect.
After drawing by this card's 1st effect, this effect is not activated if this card leaves the Spell & Trap Zone before this effect is activated.

name: Mischief of the Time Goddess
desc: Neither player can activate cards or effects in response to this card's activation. Cannot be activated as Chain Link 2 or higher. At the end of your Battle Phase, if all monsters you control are "Valkyrie" monsters (min. 1): Send this card to the GY, also, immediately after this effect resolves, skip to the start of the Battle Phase of your next turn. If you do, you cannot activate "Mischief of the Time Goddess" until the end of that turn.
rulings: "Neither player can activate cards or effects in response to this card's activation. Cannot be activated as Chain Link 2 or higher" is not treated as an effect.
This card's effect does not target.
This card can be activated at the end of your Battle Phase (= End Step) if the only monsters in your Monster Zone are face-up "Valkyrie" monsters.

If this effect is applied, the Main Phase 2 and End Phase of that turn, the opponent's next turn, and the Draw Phase, Standby Phase, and Main Phase 1 of your next turn are skipped. (As a result, you resume the Duel from the Start Step of the Battle Phase of your next turn.)
You cannot activate "Mischief of the Time Goddess" at the end of the Battle Phase (= End Step) of the turn you resumed the Duel.

name: Misfortune
desc: Select 1 face-up monster your opponent controls. Inflict damage to your opponent equal to half that monster's original ATK. Your monsters cannot attack this turn.

name: Mist Body
desc: The equipped monster cannot be destroyed by battle.

name: Mokey Mokey Smackdown
desc: While a face-up "Mokey Mokey" is on your side of the field, if a Fairy-Type monster on your side of the field is destroyed, the ATK of each "Mokey Mokey" on your side of the field becomes 3000 until the end of this turn.

name: Monster Gate
desc: Tribute 1 monster; excavate cards from the top of your Deck until you excavate a monster that can be Normal Summoned/Set. Special Summon it, also send the other excavated cards to the GY.
rulings: This card does not target.
Tributing 1 monster in your Monster Zone is a cost to activate this card. (You can Tribute a face-down Defense Position monster.)
Special Summoning and sending the excavated cards to the Graveyard are considered to happen simultaneously.
If you have no monsters that can be Normal Summoned/Set in your Deck, "Monster Gate" cannot be activated.

If "Metaion, the Timelord" is excavated by "Monster Gate", it is not Special Summoned. After "Metaion, the Timelord" is excavated, "Monster Gate" stops resolving, and all excavated cards are sent to the Graveyard, including "Metaion, the Timelord".

Because "Darklord Ixchel" is a monster that can be Normal Summoned/Set, if it is excavated by the effect of "Reasoning" and its Level differs from the declared Level, it can be Special Summoned. Likewise, if "Darklord Ixchel" is excavated by the effect of "Monster Gate", it can be Special Summoned. However, if a "Darklord Ixchel" has already been Special Summoned by the effect of "Darklord Contact" that turn, if "Darklord Ixchel" is excavated by "Reasoning" or "Monster Gate", it is sent to the Graveyard without being Special Summoned, and the effect finishes resolving. (No further cards are excavated from the Deck.)

"Wulf, Lightsworn Beast" is a Special Summon Monster. It cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Therefore, even if "Wulf, Lightsworn Beast" is excavated by "Reasoning" or "Monster Gate", it is not Special Summoned and you will continue excavating cards. After that, it will be sent to the Graveyard with the other excavated cards.

"Mare Mare" is a monster that can be Normal Summoned/Set, but it is a monster that "Cannot be Special Summoned, except by the effect of a Wyrm-Type monster". Therefore, if "Mare Mare" is excavated by the effect of "Reasoning" or "Monster Gate", without excavating any more cards, all of the excavated cards are sent to the Graveyard including "Mare Mare", and the effect finishes resolving.

When resolving "Monster Gate", if the effect of "Vanity's Emptiness" is being applied, since you cannot Special Summon any monster, no card is excavated from the Deck. (Cards are not sent to the Graveyard and no monster is Special Summoned.) When resolving "Reasoning", if the effect of "Vanity's Emptiness" is being applied, since you cannot Special Summon any monster, no card is excavated from the Deck. (Cards are not sent to the Graveyard and no monster is Special Summoned.)
While the effect of "Vanity's Fiend" or "Fossil Dyna Pachycephalo" is being applied, "Reasoning" and "Monster Gate" cannot be activated.

While the effect of "Evilswarm Ophion" is being applied, if you have a monster that can be Normal Summoned/Set in your Deck, "Reasoning" and "Monster Gate" can be activated. When resolving "Monster Gate", if a Level 4 or lower monster is excavated, it is Special Summoned normally, but if a Level 5 or higher monster is excavated, it is sent to the Graveyard with the other excavated cards. When resolving "Reasoning", "If that monster is the same Level as the one declared by your opponent, send all excavated cards to the Graveyard." is applied normally, but when resolving "If not, Special Summon the excavated monster, also send the remaining cards to the Graveyard.", if a Level 4 or lower monster is excavated, it is Special Summoned normally, but if a Level 5 or higher monster is excavated, it is sent to the Graveyard with the other excavated cards.

While the effect of "Stellarknight Constellar Diamond" or "Dimension Fortress Weapon" is being applied, "Reasoning" and "Monster Gate" cannot be activated. When resolving "Reasoning" or "Monster Gate", if the effect of "Stellarknight Constellar Diamond" or "Dimension Fortress Weapon" is being applied, the effect of "Reasoning" or "Monster Gate" is not applied.

Even if the effect of "Power Filter" is being applied, "Monster Gate" can be activated. If a monster with 1000 or less ATK is excavated, because that monster cannot be Special Summoned, all of the excavated cards are sent to the Graveyard.

name: Monster Reincarnation
desc: Discard 1 card, then target 1 monster in your GY; add it to your hand.

name: Morale Boost
desc: Each time a player equips an Equip Spell Card, increase the Life Points of the controller of that Equip Spell Card by 1000 points. Each time an Equip Spell Card is removed from the field, the controller of that Equip Spell Card takes 1000 points of damage.

name: Mound of the Bound Creator
desc: Level 10 or higher monsters on the field cannot be targeted or destroyed by card effects. If a Level 10 or higher monster on the field destroys a monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: The player who controlled the destroyed monster takes 1000 damage. When this card on the field is destroyed by a card effect and sent to the Graveyard: You can add 1 DIVINE monster from your Deck to your hand.

name: Multiplication of Ants
desc: Tribute 1 Insect-Type Monster on your side of the field. Special Summon 2 "Army Ant Tokens" (Insect-Type/EARTH/Level 4/ATK 500/DEF 1200) on your side of the field. The tokens cannot be used as a Tribute for a Tribute Summon.

name: Mustering of the Dark Scorpions
desc: If you control a face-up "Don Zaloog": You can Special Summon any number of "Dark Scorpion" monsters from your hand, but only 1 copy of each.

name: My Body as a Shield
desc: When your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card or monster effect that would destroy a monster(s) on the field: Pay 1500 LP; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.
rulings: Paying 1500 Life Points is an activation cost.
The effect does not target.

It is activated directly in Chain to the activation of an opponent's monster effect or Spell/Trap Card that would destroy a monster(s) in the Monster Zone. (It cannot be activated in Chain to the activation of a Spell/Trap Card's effect.)

Even if a card effect that destroys a monster(s) on the field is activated, you cannot activate "My Body as a Shield" if no monster would be destroyed by that effect, for example, if there are no monsters on the field.
It can be activated during the Damage Step.

name: Mystik Wok
desc: Tribute 1 monster. Select either its ATK or DEF and gain that many Life Points.

name: NEX
desc: Send 1 face-up "Neo-Spacian" monster you control to the Graveyard. Special Summon 1 Level 4 monster with the same name from your Extra Deck.
rulings: The effect targets 1 face-up "Neo-Spacian" monster on your field.
The "Neo-Spacian" monster is sent to the Graveyard when this card resolves.

name: Necklace of Command
desc:
When a monster you control that's equipped with this card is destroyed by battle, and this card is sent to the Graveyard, you can either:
● Draw 1 card. OR
● Discard 1 random card from your opponent's hand.

name: Necrovalley
desc: All "Gravekeeper's" monsters gain 500 ATK and DEF. Cards in the Graveyard cannot be banished. Negate any card effect that would move a card in the Graveyard to a different place. Negate any card effect that changes Types or Attributes in the Graveyard.
rulings: The effect "All "Gravekeeper's" monsters gain 500 ATK and DEF." does not start Chain Link.

The effect "All "Gravekeeper's" monsters gain 500 ATK and DEF." is not only applied to face-up "Gravekeeper's" monsters in your Monster Zone, but also to face-up "Gravekeeper's" in your opponent's Monster Zone.
If each player controls a face-up "Necrovalley" in their Field Zone, the effect of each copy is applied. (All face-up "Gravekeeper's" monsters in the Monster Zone gain 1000 ATK and DEF.)
The effect "Negate any card effect that would move a card in the Graveyard to a different place. Negate any card effect that changes Types or Attributes in the Graveyard." does not start Chain Link.

ABC-Dragon Buster: While the effect of "Necrovalley" is applying, cards cannot be banished from the Graveyard. If you control "A-Assault Core", "B-Buster Drake", and "C-Crush Wyvern", you can Special Summon "ABC-Dragon Buster" by banishing those 3 cards you control.

Chosen of Zefra: While the effect of "Necrovalley" is applying, during the resolution of the effect "● 10" of "Chosen of Zefra", if your opponent has 1 or more cards in their Graveyard, since the effect would affect cards in the Graveyard, the effect is negated by "Necrovalley". Also, during the resolution of the effect "● 10" of "Chosen of Zefra", if your opponent has no cards in their Graveyard, since the effect would not affect cards in the Graveyard, the effect is applied normally. (All cards on the opponent's hand and field are shuffled into the Deck.)

Crystron Entry: The effect "Special Summon 2 "Crystron" Tuners (1 from your hand and 1 from your Graveyard)." is treated as an effect that affects cards in the Graveyard. Even if the effect of "Necrovalley" is applying, "Crystron Entry" can be activated, but its effect is negated by "Necrovalley". (No monsters are Special Summoned from your hand or Graveyard.)

Crystron Phoenix: While the effect of "Necrovalley" is applying, if "Crystron Phoenix" is Synchro Summoned while your opponent has a Spell/Trap Card in their Graveyard, the effect of "Crystron Phoenix" cannot be activated. If "Crystron Phoenix" is Synchro Summoned while your opponent has no Spell/Trap Cards in their Graveyard, the effect of "Crystron Phoenix" can be activated, and all Spell/Trap Cards your opponent controls are banished. ("Necrovalley" is also banished.)

Cyber Angel Vrash: Shuffling 1 Ritual Monster from your Graveyard into the Deck is a cost to activate the effect "negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card.". Since it is not an effect that affects cards in the Graveyard, the effect is not negated by "Necrovalley", and it is resolved normally.

Darklord: Even if the effect of "Necrovalley" is applying, the effect of "Darklord Ixchel" etc. can be activated. However, since the effect of "Darklord Ixchel" etc. is treated as an effect that affects cards in the Graveyard, it is negated by "Necrovalley". (The resolution of "apply that target's effect" and the resolution of "then shuffle that target into the Deck" are not applied.)

Debunk: If "Debunk" is activated in a Chain to the activation of the effect of a "Gravekeeper's Nobleman" in the Graveyard, "Debunk" is treated as an effect that banishes cards from the Graveyard. While the effect of "Necrovalley" is applying, since cards cannot be banished from your opponent's Graveyard, "Debunk" cannot be activated.

Drill Warrior: Even if the effect of "Necrovalley" is applying, the effect that banishes "Drill Warrior" and the effect that Special Summons "Drill Warrior" can be activated. Since the effect "During your next Standby Phase: Special Summon this card banished by this effect, then add 1 monster from your Graveyard to your hand." is treated as an effect that affects cards in the Graveyard, the effect is negated by "Necrovalley". ("Drill Warrior" remains banished, and is not Special Summoned.) However, if during the resolution of that effect, you have no monsters in your Graveyard, since is not treated as an effect that affects cards in the Graveyard, only the resolution of "Special Summon this card banished by this effect" is applied.

Fairy Tail - Snow: While the effect of "Necrovalley" is applying, cards cannot be banished from the Graveyard. The effect of "Fairy Tail - Snow" cannot be activated from the Graveyard unless you can banish 7 cards from your hand and/or field as a cost. (Even if 1 of the 7 banished cards is "Necrovalley", you cannot banish cards from the Graveyard when the effect is activated from the Graveyard.) Since the effect of "Fairy Tail - Snow" is an effect that affects cards in the Graveyard, if you do not banish "Necrovalley" as a cost to activate its effect, the effect of "Fairy Tail - Snow" is negated.

Silent Graveyard: The effect of "Silent Graveyard" is not treated as an effect that affects cards in the Graveyard. While the effect of "Necrovalley" is applying, "Silent Graveyard" can be activated and it is resolved normally. (It is not negated by "Necrovalley".)

Gemini monster: The effect "This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the Graveyard." of "Ancient Gear Knight" is not treated as an effect that affects cards in the Graveyard. Therefore, even if the effect of "Necrovalley" is applying, "Ancient Gear Knight" is treated as a Normal Monster while it is in the Graveyard.

Grapha, Dragon Lord of Dark World: While the effect of "Necrovalley" is applying, since the effect that Special Summons "Grapha, Dragon Lord of Dark World" is treated as an effect that affects cards in the Graveyard, the effect cannot be applied. (You cannot return 1 "Dark World" monster you control to the hand.)

Green Baboon, Defender of the Forest: While the effect of "Necrovalley" is applying, if the effect of "Green Baboon, Defender of the Forest" is activated from the hand, since it will be Special Summoned from the hand, it is not affected by "Necrovalley", and it is Special Summoned normally. If the effect of "Green Baboon, Defender of the Forest" is activated from the Graveyard, since it will be Special Summoned from the Graveyard, it is treated as an effect that affects the Graveyard, and the effect is negated by "Necrovalley".

Hieratic: Even if "Hieratic Dragon of Gebeb" etc. is Tributed while the effect of "Necrovalley" is applying, its effect is still activated. During the resolution, Special Summon 1 "Hieratic" Normal Monster from your hand or Deck. (If you only have "Hieratic" Normal Monsters in your Graveyard, the effect of "Hieratic Dragon of Gebeb" etc. is not applied.)

Igknight: Even if the effect of "Necrovalley" is applying, the Pendulum Effect of "Igknight Squire" etc. can be activated. During the resolution, add 1 FIRE Warrior-Type monster from your Deck to your hand. (If you only have FIRE Warrior-Type monsters in your Graveyard, the effect of "Igknight Squire" etc. is not applied.)

Illusion Magic: Even if the effect of "Necrovalley" is applying, "Illusion Magic" can be activated. During the resolution, add up to 2 copies of "Dark Magician" from your Deck to your hand. (If you only have copies of "Dark Magician" in your Graveyard, the effect of "Illusion Magic" is not applied.)
Inferno Reckless Summon: Suppose you activate "Inferno Reckless Summon" when you Special Summon "Hardened Armed Dragon" while your opponent controls "Gravekeeper's Spear Soldier" and "Necrovalley".

The player who activated "Inferno Reckless Summon" Special Summons as many copies of "Hardened Armed Dragon" as possible from their hand and Deck, but not from the Graveyard. (Even if the player who activated "Inferno Reckless Summon" cannot Special Summon because it only has copies of "Hardened Armed Dragon" in the Graveyard, their opponent still performs the Special Summon.)

Your opponent Special Summons as many copies of "Gravekeeper's Spear Soldier" as possible from their hand and Deck, but not from the Graveyard. (Even if your opponent cannot Special Summon because it only has copies of "Gravekeeper's Spear Soldier" in the Graveyard, the player who activated "Inferno Reckless Summon" still performs the Special Summon.)

Infernoid Onuncu: "Must be Special Summoned (from your hand or Graveyard) by banishing 3 "Infernoid" monsters from your hand or Graveyard while the total Levels and Ranks of all Effect Monsters you control are 8 or lower, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways." is not treated as an effect. Since it is a procedure to Special Summon a Special Summon Monster, even if the effect of "Necrovalley" is applying, "Infernoid Onuncu" can be Special Summoned from the hand or Graveyard. However, while the effect of "Necrovalley" is applying, since cards cannot be banished from the Graveyard, "Infernoid Onuncu" cannot be Special Summoned unless you banish 3 "Infernoid" monsters from your hand.

Kozmojo: Even if the effect of "Necrovalley" is applying, "Kozmojo" can be activated. The resolution of "destroy it" is applied normally, but during the resolution of "banish 1 card your opponent controls or in their Graveyard.", you cannot banish a card from your opponent's Graveyard, and you must banish 1 card your opponent controls.

Lunalight Black Sheep: Even if the effect of "Necrovalley" is applying, the effect of "Lunalight Black Sheep" can be activated when it is sent to the Graveyard as a Fusion Material for a Fusion Summon. During the resolution, add 1 face-up "Lunalight" Pendulum Monster from your Extra Deck to your hand. (If you only have "Lunalight" monsters in your Graveyard, the effect of "Lunalight Black Sheep" is not applied.)

Madolche Chateau: Since the effect "When this card is activated: Shuffle all "Madolche" monsters in your Graveyard into the Deck." of "Madolche Chateau" is treated as an effect that affects cards in the Graveyard, the effect is negated by "Necrovalley", but "Madolche Chateau" remains in the Field Zone and the effect "All "Madolche" monsters on the field gain 500 ATK and DEF. " is applied normally. Also, since the effect "Shuffle this card into your Deck." of "Madolche Mewfeuille" is treated as an effect that affects cards in the Graveyard, that effect is negated by "Necrovalley", and the effect "If a monster(s) in your Graveyard would be returned to the Deck by the effect of a "Madolche" monster, you can add it to your hand instead." of "Madolche Chateau" cannot be applied.

Madolche Mewfeuille: The effect "Shuffle this card into your Deck." of "Madolche Mewfeuille" is treated as an effect that affects cards in the Graveyard. Even if the effect of "Necrovalley" is applying, the effect of "Madolche Mewfeuille" is still activated when it is destroyed by your opponent and sent to your Graveyard, but the effect is negated by "Necrovalley". ("Madolche Mewfeuille" remains in the Graveyard.)

Marshmacaron: Even if the effect of "Necrovalley" is applying, the effect of "Marshmacaron" can be activated when it is destroyed by battle or card effect and sent to the Graveyard. During the resolution, if you Special Summon copies of "Marshmacaron" from your hand and/or Deck, the effect is applied normally. If you only have copies of "Marshmacaron" in your Graveyard, the effect of "Marshmacaron" is not applied, and no copies of "Marshmacaron" are Special Summoned.

Miracle Contact: Even if the effect of "Necrovalley" is applying, "Miracle Contact" can be activated. During the resolution, shuffle the Fusion Materials from your hand or Monster Zone into the Deck and Special Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck. If you cannot resolve this card's effect unless you include Fusion Materials in your Graveyard, then the effect of "Miracle Contact" is not applied.

Nekroz of Sophia: While the effect of "Kycoo the Ghost Destroyer" (or "Necrovalley") is applying, cards cannot be banished from the Graveyard. If either player has 1 or more cards in their Graveyard, the effect of "Nekroz of Sophia" is treated as an effect that banishes cards from the Graveyard, and it cannot be activated. If neither player has cards in their Graveyard, the effect of "Nekroz of Sophia" can be activated. (All other cards on the field are banished normally.)

Nekroz of Trishula: While the effect of "Necrovalley" is applying, cards cannot be banished from the Graveyard. Therefore, the effect of "Nekroz of Trishula" cannot be activated when it is Ritual Summoned.

Performapal Trump Witch: Even if the effect of "Necrovalley" is applying, the monster effect of "Performapal Trump Witch" can be activated. During the resolution, add 1 "Polymerization" from your Deck to your hand. (If you only have copies of "Polymerization" in your Graveyard, the effect of "Performapal Trump Witch" is not applied.)
Preparation of Rites: Even if the effect of "Necrovalley" is applying, "Preparation of Rites" can be activated. In that case, you only add 1 Ritual monster from your Deck to your hand.

Red-Eyes Darkness Metal Dragon: Even if the effect of "Necrovalley" is applying, the effect of "Red-Eyes Darkness Metal Dragon" can be activated. During the resolution, Special Summon 1 Dragon-Type monster from your hand. (If you only have Dragon-Type monsters in your Graveyard, the effect of "Red-Eyes Darkness Metal Dragon" is not applied.)
