Red-Eyes Retro Dragon: Even if the effect of "Necrovalley" is applying, the effect of "Red-Eyes Retro Dragon" can be activated from the hand. However, since it is treated as an effect that affects cards in the Graveyard, it is negated by "Necrovalley". ("Red-Eyes Retro Dragon" is not Special Summoned and remains in the hand, also the monsters destroyed and sent to the Graveyard are not Special Summoned and remain in the Graveyard.)

Scramble Egg: Even if the effect of "Necrovalley" is applying, "Scramble Egg" can be activated. During the resolution, Special Summon 1 "Sonic Chick" from your hand or Deck. (If you only have copies of "Sonic Chick" in your Graveyard, the effect of "Scramble Egg" is not applied.)

Senior Silver Ninja: Even if the effect of "Necrovalley" is applying, the effect of "Senior Silver Ninja" can be activated. During the resolution, Special Summon any number of "Ninja" monsters from your hand in face-down Defense Position. (If you only have "Ninja" monsters in your Graveyard, the effect of "Senior Silver Ninja" is not applied.)

Shadow-Imprisoning Mirror: While the effect of "Necrovalley" is applying, since the effect of "Shadow-Imprisoning Mirror" is not treated as an effect that affects cards in the Graveyard, the effect is applied normally. (It is not negated by "Necrovalley".) The effect of "Sangan" is not an effect that affects cards in the Graveyard, but it is the effect of a DARK monster that is activated from the Graveyard. The effect of "Black Dragon's Chick" is not an effect that affects cards in the Graveyard, but it is the effect of a DARK monster that is activated from the field. Therefore, in both cases, the effects are negated by "Shadow-Imprisoning Mirror".

Sinister Serpent: Even if the effect of "Necrovalley" is applying, the effect of "Sinister Serpent" can be activated from the Graveyard. However, since it is treated as an effect that affects cards in the Graveyard, it is negated by "Necrovalley". (It is not returned to your hand.) Also, if the effect of "Sinister Serpent" is activated, and during your opponent's next End Phase the effect of "Necrovalley" is applying, since cards cannot be banished from the Graveyard, the effect "also banish 1 "Sinister Serpent" from your Graveyard during your opponent's next End Phase" is not applied.

Stardust Re-Spark: Even if the effect of "Necrovalley" is applying, "Stardust Re-Spark" can be activated. The resolution of "Negate the attack, and if you do, draw 1 card" is applied normally, and you can Special Summon 1 "Stardust" monster from your Extra Deck. (You cannot Special Summon 1 "Stardust" monster from your Graveyard.)

Sylvan Princessprout: The effect "Special Summon this card from the Graveyard, and if you do, it becomes that Level." of "Sylvan Princessprout" is treated as an effect that affects cards in the Graveyard. Even if the effect of "Necrovalley" is applying, the effect of "Sylvan Princessprout" can be activated when it is excavated from the Deck and sent to the Graveyard, but the effect is negated by "Necrovalley". ("Sylvan Princessprout" remains in the Graveyard.)

Tamtam the Melodious Diva: Even if the effect of "Necrovalley" is applying, the effect of "Tamtam the Melodious Diva" can be activated when it is Special Summoned. During the resolution, add 1 "Polymerization" from your Deck to your hand. (If you only have copies of "Polymerization" in your Graveyard, the effect of "Tamtam the Melodious Diva" is not applied.)

The End of Anubis: While the effect of "Necrovalley" is applying, since the effect of "The End of Anubis" is not treated as an effect that affects cards in the Graveyard, the effect is applied normally. (It is not negated by "Necrovalley".)

The Supremacy Sun: The effect that Special Summons "The Supremacy Sun" from the Graveyard is treated as an effect that affects cards in the Graveyard. If the effect of "The Supremacy Sun" is activated while the effect of "Necrovalley" is applying, the effect is negated by "Necrovalley" and "The Supremacy Sun" is not Special Summoned. ("The Supremacy Sun" remains in the Graveyard.)

Tragoedia: The effect "this card's Level becomes the same as that target's, until the end of this turn." targets a monster in the Graveyard, but it is not treated as an effect that affects cards in the Graveyard. Therefore, even if the effect of "Necrovalley" is applying, the effect of "Tragoedia" is applied normally and its Level is changed. (If this effect is activated by targeting "Glow-Up Bulb", the Level of Tragoedia becomes 1.)

Trick Box: Even if the effect of "Necrovalley" is applying, "Trick Box" can be activated. However, since it is an effect that affects cards in the Graveyard, it is negated by "Necrovalley". (The resolution of "take control of it until the End Phase" and the resolution of "Special Summon 1 "Performage" monster from your Graveyard to your opponent's field." are not applied.)

Trishula, Dragon of the Ice Barrier: While the effect of "Kycoo the Ghost Destroyer" (or "Necrovalley") is applying, cards cannot be banished from the Graveyard. Even in this case, the effect of "Trishula, Dragon of the Ice Barrier" can be activated, but you can only banish up to 2 cards (up to 1 from your opponent's hand and up to 1 from your opponent's field.) Even if you banish "Kycoo the Ghost Destroyer" or "Necrovalley" during the resolution of the effect of "Trishula, Dragon of the Ice Barrier", you still cannot banish a card from the Graveyard.

True King Bahrastos, the Fathomer: Even if the effect of "Necrovalley" is applying, the effect of "True King Bahrastos, the Fathomer" can be activated. (The effect of "True King Bahrastos, the Fathomer" is not negated by "Necrovalley".) During the resolution of the effect "you can banish up to 2 Spell/Trap Cards from your opponent's field and/or Graveyard, if both the destroyed monsters were WATER.", you cannot banish Spell/Trap Cards from your opponent's Graveyard. (You must banish up to 2 Spell/Trap Cards your opponent controls.)

Wightprincess: The effect "This card's name becomes "Skull Servant" while it is in the Graveyard." is not treated as an effect that affects cards in the Graveyard. Therefore, even if the effect of "Necrovalley" is applying, the name of "Wightprincess" is treated as "Skull Servant" while it is in the Graveyard.

Windwitch - Crystal Bell: The effect "until the End Phase, this card's name becomes that monster's, and replace this effect with that monster's original effects." targets a monster in the Graveyard, but it is not treated as an effect that affects cards in the Graveyard. Therefore, even if the effect of "Necrovalley" is applying, the effect of "Windwitch - Crystal Bell" is applied normally, its name becomes the same as the targeted monster and it gains the effect of the targeted monster. (If this effect is activated by targeting "Windwitch - Winter Bell", the name of Windwitch - Crystal Bell becomes "Windwitch - Winter Bell" and it gains the effect of "Windwitch - Winter Bell".)

Xyz Encore: Even if the effect of "Necrovalley" is applying, "Xyz Encore" can be activated. The resolution of "detach all Xyz Materials from it, and if you do, return it to the Extra Deck" is applied normally, but even if there is a Monster Card in the Graveyard among those detached Xyz Materials, the resolution of "Special Summon as many of those monsters as possible from the Graveyard to your opponent's side of the field in face-up Defense Position." cannot be applied.

Yosen Training Grounds: Even if the effect of "Necrovalley" is applying, the effect "● 3 Counters" of "Yosen Training Grounds" can be activated. During the resolution, add 1 "Yosenju" monster from your Deck to your hand. (If you only have "Yosenju" monsters in your Graveyard, the effect of "Yosen Training Grounds" is not applied.)
While "Necrovalley" is active on the field the following rules apply:
No effect can take a card in the Graveyard and remove it from play. No exceptions!
If a card in the Graveyard can add itself back to the hand or Deck, it DOES work.
If a card's effect tries to take another card in the Graveyard and put it back in the hand or Deck, it won't work.
If a monster in the Graveyard can Summon itself back to the field, it DOES work.
If a card's effect tries to Summon a different monster from the Graveyard, it won't work.

If a card targets something in the Graveyard, or looks at cards in the Graveyard, but doesn't disturb their rest, it DOES work. (For example, a card that counts the number of monsters in the Graveyard.)

name: Neo Space
desc: "Elemental HERO Neos" and all Fusion Monsters that specifically list "Elemental HERO Neos" as a Fusion Material gain 500 ATK. Fusion Monsters that specifically list "Elemental HERO Neos" as a Fusion Material do not have to activate their effects during the End Phase that shuffle them into the Extra Deck.

name: Neos Force
desc: Equip only to "Elemental HERO Neos". It gains 800 ATK. When it destroys a monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to the original ATK of the destroyed monster in the Graveyard. During the End Phase: Shuffle this card into the Deck.

name: O - Oversoul
desc: Target 1 "Elemental HERO" Normal Monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target.
rulings: This card targets 1 "Elemental HERO" Normal Monster in your Graveyard.
This card can also target an "Elemental HERO Neos Alius" in the Graveyard that is treated as a Normal Monster.

name: Ocean of Regeneration
desc: You can target 1 WATER monster with 1000 or less ATK in your GY; Special Summon it, but destroy it during the End Phase. You can only use this effect of "Ocean of Regeneration" once per turn.
rulings: [Regarding the effect "You can target 1 WATER monster with 1000 or less ATK in your GY; Special Summon it, but destroy it during the End Phase."
This effect starts a Chain and can be activated while this card is face-up in the Spell & Trap Zone.
It can only be activated during your Main Phase.
If the monster Special Summoned by this effect is no longer face-up in the Monster Zone, the effect "destroy it during the End Phase" is no longer applied to it.

name: Ojama Delta Hurricane!!
desc: You can only activate this card while "Ojama Green", "Ojama Yellow" and "Ojama Black" are face-up on your side of the field. Destroy all cards on your opponent's side of the field.

name: Ojamagic
desc: If this card is sent from the hand or field to the GY: Add 1 each of "Ojama Green", "Ojama Yellow" and "Ojama Black" from your Deck to your hand.

name: Ojamandala
desc: Pay 1000 Life Points. Special Summon 1 "Ojama Green", "Ojama Yellow" and "Ojama Black" from your Graveyard.

name: Ojamuscle
desc:
(This card is always treated as a "Ojama" card.)
Select 1 face-up "Ojama King". Destroy all "Ojama" monsters on the field, except the selected "Ojama King". It gains 1000 ATK for each monster destroyed this way.

name: Opti-Camouflage Armor
desc: You can only equip this card to a Level 1 monster. A monster equipped with this card can attack your opponent's Life Points directly.

name: Orichalcos Sword of Sealing
desc:
The equipped monster's effects are negated. You can only use the following effect of "Orichalcos Sword of Sealing" once per turn. If you control a card in your Field Zone: You can target 1 Effect Monster you control; that Effect Monster gains this effect until the end of your opponent's turn.
● Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can send 1 card from your hand to the GY, then target 1 face-up card on the field; destroy that target.

name: Over Destiny
desc: Target 1 "Destiny HERO" monster in your GY; Special Summon 1 "Destiny HERO" monster from your Deck whose Level is less than or equal to half of that target's Level, but destroy it during the End Phase of this turn.
rulings: This card targets 1 "Destiny HERO" monster in your Graveyard.
Destroying the Special Summoned monster during the End Phase does not start a Chain Link.
This card cannot be activated if all of your Monster Zones are occupied.
If the monster Special Summoned by this card is changed to face-down Defense Position or it leaves the field, it is not destroyed during the End Phase.

name: Overload Fusion
desc: Fusion Summon 1 DARK Machine Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by banishing Fusion Materials listed on it from your field or GY.

name: Owner's Seal
desc: Return control of all monsters on the field to their original owners.
rulings: This effect does not target.
The effect of "Owner's Seal" also applies to face-down Defense Position monsters.
Your "Lava Golem" etc. that was Special Summoned to the opponent's field is returned to the control of its owner.

"Owner's Seal" is not an effect that only applies during the turn it was activated. After the effect has been applied, as long as control isn't changed again by activating "Mind Control", etc., the monsters remain under the control of their respective owners.

name: Pandemonium
desc: Neither player has to pay Life Points during the Standby Phase for "Archfiend" monsters. Each time a player's "Archfiend" monster(s) is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard, except by battle, that player can add 1 "Archfiend" monster from their Deck to their hand that is a lower Level than the destroyed card.
rulings: The effect "Neither player has to pay Life Points during the Standby Phase for "Archfiend" monsters" does not make a Chain Link.
You do not have to pay LP for the maintenance cost of "Archfiend" monsters during the Standby Phase. (You can also pay LP as normal.)

The effect "Each time a player's "Archfiend" monster(s) is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard, except by battle, that player can add 1 "Archfiend" monster from their Deck to their hand that is a lower Level than the destroyed card" makes a Chain Link. (It does not target. It cannot be activated during the Damage Step.)

When an "Archfiend" monster is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard, except by battle, that monster's owner can activate the effect "that player can add 1 "Archfiend" monster from their Deck to their hand that is a lower Level than the destroyed card." (If your opponent's "Archfiend" monster is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard, except by battle, your opponent can apply the effect of your "Pandemonium".)

While you control "Archfiend of Gilfer" and "Pandemonium", if "Archfiend of Gilfer" is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard by the effect of "Snipe Hunter", since the timing for "Archfiend of Gilfer" and "Pandemonium" effects occurs simultaneously, they can be activated in a Chain in any order.

The effect of "Pandemonium" cannot be activated when an "Archfiend" monster equipped to "Relinquished" is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard by "Mystical Space Typhoon". (You can only activate the effect of "Pandemonium" if the "Archfiend" monster is destroyed while being treated as a monster.)
If "Mist Archfiend" is Normal Summoned without Tribute by its own effect, and during the End Phase it is destroyed, you can activate the effect of "Pandemonium".
Even if the "Archfiend" monster was destroyed while in the hand or Deck, you can activate the effect of "Pandemonium".

name: Pegasus Wing
desc: If you have a Union monster in your GY: Target any number of "Valkyrie" monsters you control; those monsters can attack directly this turn, but if they do so using this effect, their battle damage inflicted to your opponent is halved.
rulings: This card targets any number of "Valkyrie" monsters that are face-up in your Monster Zone.
This card can only be activated if you have 1 or more Union monsters in your GY. (Even if you only have 1 Union monster in your GY, you can target 2 or more "Valkyrie" monsters with this card.)
You cannot activate this card during your Main Phase 2 or during a turn you cannot conduct a Battle Phase, such as the first turn of the Duel.

name: Penguin Sword
desc: Equip only to a "Penguin" monster. It gains 800 ATK. When the equipped monster inflicts battle damage to your opponent: You can return 1 card your opponent controls to the hand. If a face-up card your opponent controls leaves the field by a "Penguin" card's effect and returns to the hand or is banished: Negate the activated effects and effects on the field of cards with that original name, until the end of the next turn. You can only use this effect of "Penguin Sword" once per turn.

name: Phantasmal Martyrs
desc: Activate only while you have 2 or more cards in your hand, and control a face-up "Uria, Lord of Searing Flames" or "Hamon, Lord of Striking Thunder". Send your entire hand to the Graveyard to Special Summon 3 "Phantasmal Martyr Tokens" (Fiend-Type/DARK/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) in Attack Position.

name: Photon Generator Unit
desc: Tribute 2 "Cyber Dragons". Special Summon 1 "Cyber Laser Dragon" from your hand, Deck, or Graveyard.

name: Pot of Avarice
desc: Target 5 monsters in your GY; shuffle all 5 into the Deck, then draw 2 cards.
rulings: The effect targets 5 monsters in your Graveyard.
It can also target Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, and Link Monsters in your Graveyard. (If you do, those Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, and Link Monsters are returned to the Extra Deck.)
Returning 5 monsters to the Deck and drawing 2 cards are not considered to happen at the same time.
"Pot of Avarice" cannot be activated if you have 1 or 0 cards in your Deck.

name: Power Bond
desc: Fusion Summon 1 Machine Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field as Fusion Material, and it gains ATK equal to its original ATK. During the End Phase of the turn this card is activated, you take damage equal to the amount of ATK gained from this effect at the time of the Summon.
rulings: You can still activate cards like "Polymerization" or "Power Bond" and Fusion Summon while the effect of "Macro Cosmos" is active and removing from play the Fusion Material Monsters instead of having them sent to the Graveyard. If "Polymerization" is activated while "Macro Cosmos" is active, then the Fusion Material Monsters to be sent to the Graveyard will be removed from play instead, and the Fusion Monster will still be Fusion Summoned from the Extra Deck.

name: Prima Light
desc:
Activate 1 of these effects;
● Tribute 1 EARTH Warrior monster, and if you do, Special Summon 1 LIGHT Warrior monster from your hand or Deck.
● During the Main Phase: Immediately after this effect resolves, Normal Summon 1 Warrior monster from your hand.
During your Main Phase: You can banish this card from your GY; add 1 Warrior or Fairy "Cyber" monster from your Deck to your hand. You can only use 1 "Prima Light" effect per turn, and only once that turn.
rulings: [Regarding the effect "Activate 1 of these effects; ● Tribute 1 EARTH Warrior monster, and if you do, Special Summon 1 LIGHT Warrior monster from your hand or Deck. ● During the Main Phase: Immediately after this effect resolves, Normal Summon 1 Warrior monster from your hand."]
It is the effect that applies when this card's activation resolves.
When activating this effect, choose 1 "●" effect and activate it as that effect.
Regardless of which "●" effect you activate, it cannot be activated during the Damage Step.
[Regarding the first "●" effect.]
When resolving this effect, Tribute 1 EARTH Warrior monster you control, and if it is successfully Tributed, Special Summon 1 LIGHT Warrior monster from your hand or Deck.
Tributing and Special Summoning occur simultaneously.
You can also Tribute a face-down Defense Position EARTH Warrior monster in your Monster Zone.
[Regarding the second "●" effect.]
Immediately after resolving the Chain Link made by activating this effect, Normal Summon 1 Warrior monster from your hand.
[Regarding the effect "During your Main Phase: You can banish this card from your GY; add 1 Warrior or Fairy "Cyber" monster from your Deck to your hand."]
It starts a Chain and can be activated in the GY.
It is Spell Speed 1.

name: Psychic Wave
desc: If you control a Machine monster: Send 1 "Jinzo" from your hand or Deck to the GY; inflict 600 damage to your opponent. During your Main Phase, except the turn this card was sent to the GY: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Machine monster in your GY; send 1 "Jinzo" monster from your Deck to the GY, and if you do, add that targeted monster to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Psychic Wave" once per turn.

name: Question
desc: When activating this card, your opponent cannot check cards in the Graveyard. Your opponent calls the name of the first monster found at the bottom of your Graveyard. If he/she calls it right, the monster is removed from play. If he/she calls it wrong, the monster is Special Summoned to your side of the field.
rulings: In place of declaring a FULL card name, a precise description of a card's stats, appearance, and/or effects, is considered acceptable so long as both players are in clear agreement over which card is being described.
Saying "Dekoichi" instead of "Dekoichi the Battlechanted Locomotive" is acceptable as long as there isn't another card with the name "Dekoichi".

In the case of a card like "Luster Dragon", since the original printing of "Luster Dragon #2" did not have the #2 by its card name, you should ask the player for additional information. If they say "The Level 6 one" is then enough information provided so that both players know which card it is.

name: Quick Summon
desc: Immediately after this effect resolves, Normal Summon/Set 1 monster. When you do, if your opponent controls a monster, you can Normal Summon a Level 5 or higher monster without Tributing. During your Main Phase, if this card is in your GY, except the turn it was sent there: You can banish it; add 1 Level 5 or higher monster that can be Normal Summoned/Set from your Deck or GY to your hand, then immediately after this effect resolves, Tribute Summon it. You can only use this effect of "Quick Summon" once per turn.

name: R - Righteous Justice
desc: Destroy Spell/Trap Cards equal to the number of "Elemental HERO" cards you control.
rulings: "R - Righteous Justice" does not target.

Suppose your opponent controls 3 "Elemental HERO" monsters and 1 Spell/Trap Card, and you control 2 Spell/Trap Cards. If your opponent activates "R - Righteous Justice", since 2 Spell/Trap Cards you control will be destroyed by "R - Righteous Justice", you can chain "Starlight Road".

Suppose your opponent controls 3 "Elemental HERO" monsters and 2 Spell/Trap Cards, and you control 2 Spell/Trap Cards. If your opponent activates "R - Righteous Justice", since it does not target and is unknown whether or not your opponent will destroy 2 Spell/Trap Cards you control, you cannot chain "Starlight Road"

"R - Righteous Justice" does not target, so the number of Spell or Trap Cards to destroy is not decided at the time the card is activated and no targets are selected. When resolving "R - Righteous Justice", a number of Spell or Trap Cards on the field equal to the number of face-up "Elemental HERO" monsters you control are destroyed.

name: Rainbow Bridge Bifrost
desc:
(This card is not treated as a "Rainbow Bridge" card.)
Banish 3 Level 10 or higher monsters from your Extra Deck, including a LIGHT Synchro Monster; add 1 Field Spell from your Deck to your hand. You can only activate 1 "Rainbow Bridge Bifrost" per turn.

name: Rainbow Veil
desc: If the equipped monster battles an opponent's monster, while that monster is on the field its effect(s) is negated during the Battle Phase only.

name: Rare Value
desc: If you control 2 or more "Crystal Beast" cards in your Spell & Trap Zone: Your opponent chooses 1 "Crystal Beast" card in your Spell & Trap Zone, you send it to the GY, and if you do, you draw 2 cards.
rulings: It does not target.
It can only be activated if there are 2 or more face-up "Crystal Beast" cards in the player's Spell & Trap Zone.

The application of "Your opponent chooses 1 "Crystal Beast" card in your Spell & Trap Zone, you send it to the GY" and the application of "and if you do, you draw 2 cards" are treated as being done at the same time.

name: Raregold Armor
desc: As long as you control the monster equipped with this card, your opponent cannot attack other monsters other than the equipped monster.
rulings: The effect "As long as you control the monster equipped with this card, your opponent cannot attack other monsters other than the equipped monster" does not make a Chain Link.
"Raregold Armor" can be equipped to a monster in the opponent's Monster Zone, but because the player does not control the equipped monster, the effect of "Raregold Armor" is not applied.

If there are 2 monsters in your Monster Zones equipped with your "Raregold Armor", the opponent's monsters cannot attack. (Monsters that can attack directly due to being equipped with "Shooting Star Bow - Ceal" etc. can attack directly.)

name: Re-Fusion
desc: Activate this card by paying 800 LP, then target 1 Fusion Monster in your GY; Special Summon it and equip it with this card. When this card is destroyed, banish the equipped monster.
rulings: Paying 800 Life Points is a cost to activate "Re-Fusion".
This card targets 1 Fusion Monster in your Graveyard. (You cannot target a Fusion Monster that was sent from the Extra Deck to the Graveyard.)
Applying "When this card is destroyed, remove the equipped monster from play." does not start a Chain Link.
When the equipped monster is changed to face-down Defense Position and "Re-Fusion" is destroyed, "When this card is destroyed, remove the equipped monster from play." is not applied.

name: Reaper Scythe - Dreadscythe
desc: Equip only to "Guardian Dreadscythe". It gains 500 ATK for each monster in the Graveyards.

name: Rebellion
desc: During either player's Battle Phase: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; take control of it until the end of the Battle Phase, also other monsters you control cannot attack for the rest of this turn. You can only activate 1 "Rebellion" per turn.

name: Recycle
desc: During your Standby Phase, by paying 300 Life Points, select 1 non-Monster Card in your Graveyard and return it to the bottom of your Deck.
rulings: The effect "During your Standby Phase, by paying 300 Life Points, select 1 non-Monster Card in your Graveyard and return it to the bottom of your Deck." starts a Chain Link. (It is an optional effect that can be activated during your Standby Phase.)
The effect "select 1 non-Monster Card in your Graveyard and return it to the bottom of your Deck." can be activated once during each of your Standby Phases.
Paying 300 Life Points is a cost to activate the effect "select 1 non-Monster Card in your Graveyard and return it to the bottom of your Deck.".
The effect "select 1 non-Monster Card in your Graveyard and return it to the bottom of your Deck." targets 1 Spell/Trap Card in your Graveyard.
When the targeted card is placed on the bottom of the Deck by the effect of "Recycle", the Deck is not shuffled.

name: Red-Eyes Transmigration
desc: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Lord of the Red". You must also Tribute monsters from your hand or field, and/or banish "Red-Eyes" monsters from your Graveyard, except "Red-Eyes B. Chick", whose total Levels equal 8 or more.

name: Reinforcement of the Army
desc: Add 1 Level 4 or lower Warrior monster from your Deck to your hand.
rulings: When "Reinforcement of the Army" resolves, turn player may start a Chain with a Spell Speed 2+ card or effect or pass Priority. This means that the opponent will have the opportunity to activate a Spell Speed 2+ card ("Mind Crush", etc) before the turn player will have the opportunity to Normal Summon a Monster.
When "Thunder King Rai-Oh" is face-up on the field, you cannot activate "Terraforming", "Reinforcement of the Army", etc.
"Reinforcement of the Army" cannot be activated when there is no Level 4 or lower Warrior-Type monster in your Deck.

At the time of a card being added to the hand by "Magician of Faith" or "Reinforcement of the Army", the Turn Player cannot immediately activate a Normal Spell Card or Normal Summon a monster. If the Turn Player passes Priority and does not activate a Spell Speed 2+ effect, then the Turn Player can activate the Normal Spell Card/Normal Summom only after the opponent passes Priority.

name: Release Restraint
desc: Tribute 1 "Gearfried the Iron Knight"; Special Summon 1 "Gearfried the Swordmaster" from your hand or Deck.
rulings: Tributing "Gearfried the Iron Knight" is a cost.
This effect does not target.

name: Reload
desc: Add all cards in your hand to your Deck and shuffle it. Then draw the same number of cards that you added to your Deck.
rulings: If, during your Draw Phase, you draw a DARK monster because of "Reload", you can activate "Veil of Darkness".

If multiple cards including "Infernity Archfiend" were drawn by an effect like "Card Destruction" or "Reload", then "Infernity Archfiend" was still drawn while you have 0 cards in your hand, so you can activate the effect of and Special Summon "Infernity Archfiend".

name: Reversal Quiz
desc: Send all cards in your hand and on your side of the field to the Graveyard. Call the type of card (Spell, Trap, or Monster) on top of your Deck. If you call it right, exchange your current Life Points with your opponent's current ones.
rulings: Sending all cards in the hand and on the field to the Graveyard is a cost to activate "Reversal Quiz". If there are no cards in your hand or on your field other than "Reversal Quiz", you cannot pay the cost, so you cannot activate "Reversal Quiz".

name: Reverse of Neos
desc: Activate only when a face-up "Neos" Fusion Monster you control is destroyed. Special Summon 1 "Elemental Hero Neos" from your Deck in Attack Position. It gains 1000 ATK and is destroyed during the End Phase of this turn.
rulings: It does not target.
It cannot be activated during the Damage Step.
Resolving "It [...] is destroyed during the End Phase of this turn" does not make a Chain Link.
It can be activated when a face-up "Neos" Fusion Monster in your Monster Zone is destroyed. (It cannot be activated when a face-down Defense Position "Neos" Fusion Monster is destroyed.)
The ATK increase that "Elemental HERO Neos" gains by the effect of "Reverse of Neos" is only applied during the turn "Reverse of Neos" is activated.

If "Elemental HERO Neos" that was Special Summoned by "Reverse of Neos" is face-down during the End Phase due to "Book of Moon" etc., the effect "It [...] is destroyed during the End Phase of this turn" is not applied. Also, even if "Elemental HERO Neos" that was flipped face-down during the turn it was Special Summoned is face-up during that same turn's End Phase, the effect "It [...] is destroyed during the End Phase of this turn" is not applied.

name: Revoke Fusion
desc: Discard 1 "Polymerization" to the Graveyard. Send 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck to your Graveyard and Special Summon 1 monster from your hand that is listed as a Fusion Material Monster on that card. The Special Summoned monster is sent to the Graveyard during the End Phase of this turn.

name: Ride of the Valkyries
desc: Special Summon any number of "Valkyrie" monsters with different names from your hand. If you Special Summoned 3 or more monsters with this effect, you take no battle damage until the end of the next turn. During the End Phase of the turn you activated this card, shuffle all monsters you control into the Deck. You can banish this card from your GY; add 1 "Mischief of the Time Goddess" from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Ride of the Valkyries" once per turn.
rulings: This card's effect that Special Summons "Valkyrie" monsters from your hand is the effect that applies by activating this card. (It does not target. If you Special Summon 3 or more monsters with this effect, the part of the effect that prevents you from taking battle damage until the end of the next turn is also applied immediately.)
Returning all monsters on your field to the Deck during the End Phase does not start a Chain.

This card's effect that adds a "Mischief of the Time Goddess" from your Deck to your hand starts a Chain and activates in the GY. (It does not target, and can only be activated during your Main Phase.)

name: Ring of Defense
desc: When a Trap effect that inflicts damage is activated: Make that effect damage 0.
rulings: This card is activated in chain to a Trap Card with the effect of inflicting damage.
All damage inflicted by the Trap Card to which "Ring of Defense" is chained becomes 0.
When "Ring of Defense" is chained to "Ring of Destruction", both players take 0 damage.

name: Ritual Sanctuary
desc: You can discard 1 Spell; add 1 LIGHT Ritual Monster or 1 Ritual Spell from your Deck to your hand. You can shuffle any number of Spells from your GY into the Deck, then target 1 LIGHT Fairy monster in your GY whose Level equals the number of cards you shuffled into the Deck; Special Summon it. You can only use each effect of "Ritual Sanctuary" once per turn.

name: Ritual Weapon
desc: Equip only to a Level 6 or lower Ritual Monster. It gains 1500 ATK and DEF.

name: Ritual of the Matador
desc: This card can be used to Ritual Summon "Matador Archfiend". You must also Tribute monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels equal 6 or more. You can banish this card from your GY; Special Summon 1 non-Ritual "Archfiend" monster from your hand. You can only use this effect of "Ritual of the Matador" once per turn.
rulings: [Regarding the effect "This card is used to Ritual Summon "Matador Archfiend". You must also Tribute monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels equal 6 or more."]
It is the effect that applies when this card's activation resolves.
When resolving this effect, Tribute monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels equal 6 or more. Then, Ritual Summon "Matador Archfiend" from your hand.
Tributing and Special Summoning do not occur simultaneously.
[Regarding the effect "You can banish this card from your GY; Special Summon 1 non-Ritual "Archfiend" monster from your hand."]
It starts a Chain and can be activated in the GY.
It can only be activated during your Main Phase.

name: Rod of Silence - Kay'est
desc: The equipped monster gains 500 DEF. Negate other Spell effects that target the equipped monster, and if you do, destroy that Spell Card.

name: Rod of the Mind's Eye
desc: If a monster equipped with this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, the damage becomes 1000 points.
rulings: During Damage Calculation in which the equipped monster inflicts Battle Damage to the opponent, the Battle Damage becomes 1000, regardless of whether it is originally greater or less than 1000.

name: Roulette Spider
desc:
When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Roll a six-sided die and apply the result.
1: Halve your LP.
2: Make that attack a direct attack.
3: Choose 1 monster you control, change the attack target to it, and perform damage calculation.
4: Choose 1 other monster your opponent controls, change the attack target to it, and perform damage calculation.
5: Negate the attack, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to that monster's ATK.
6: Destroy that opponent's monster.

name: Royal Straight
desc: Send 1 "Queen's Knight", "King's Knight", and "Jack's Knight" from your hand and/or face-up Monster Zone to the GY, then Special Summon 1 monster from your hand, Deck, Extra Deck, or GY that mentions all of "Queen's Knight", "King's Knight", and "Jack's Knight".

name: Royal Tribute
desc: If you control "Necrovalley": Both players discard any monsters in their hands.
rulings: You can activate this card even if you don't have any monsters in your hand.
The effect of this card is still applied normally even if during its resolution "Necrovalley" does not exist on the field.

name: Ruthless Denial
desc: Select 1 monster you control and send it to the Graveyard, and send 1 random card in your opponent's hand to the Graveyard.
rulings: This effect targets the monster. The monster that is sent to the Graveyard is part of the effect of "Ruthless Denial". It is not a cost.

name: Sabatiel - The Philosopher's Stone
desc: If you have a "Winged Kuriboh" monster in your GY: Pay half your LP; add 1 "Polymerization" Spell or "Fusion" Spell from your Deck to your hand. If this card is in your GY: You can banish 3 copies of "Sabatiel - The Philosopher's Stone" from your GY, then target 1 monster on the field; it gains ATK equal to the ATK of the monster on the field with the highest ATK (your choice, if tied), until the end of this turn.

name: Sage's Stone
desc: If you control a face-up "Dark Magician Girl": Special Summon 1 "Dark Magician" from your hand or Deck.
rulings: The effect does not target.
This card can be activated if you control a face-up "Dark Magician Girl"
"Sage's Stone" cannot be activated if you do not have any "Dark Magician" in your hand or Deck.
When resolving the effect of "Sage's Stone", even if you no longer control "Dark Magician Girl", the effect that Special Summons "Dark Magician" is applied as usual.

name: Salvage
desc: Target 2 WATER monsters with 1500 or less ATK in your Graveyard; add those targets to your hand.

name: Second Coin Toss
desc: When a coin toss is performed, you can choose to redo the coin toss. (If the toss involved multiple coin flips, redo all of them.) You can only use the effect of "Second Coin Toss" once per turn.
rulings: The effect "When a coin toss is performed, you can choose to redo the coin toss." does not start a Chain Link.

During the effect resolution of a card, if the controller of "Second Coin Toss" performed a coin toss, before continuing with the effect resolution based on the result, you can choose whether or not to apply the effect of "Second Coin Toss".
If only your opponent performed a coin toss during the resolution of a card, you cannot apply the effect of "Second Coin Toss".
Even if you control multiple copies of "Second Coin Toss" in your Spell & Trap Zone, the effect "you can choose to redo the coin toss." can only be applied once per turn.

name: Shadow Toon
desc: If you control "Toon World": Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; inflict damage to your opponent equal to the ATK of that face-up monster. You can only activate 1 "Shadow Toon" per turn.

name: Shield Crush
desc: Target 1 Defense Position monster on the field; destroy that target.

name: Shinato's Ark
desc: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Shinato, King of a Higher Plane". You must also Tribute monsters whose total Levels equal 8 or more from the field or your hand.

name: Short Circuit
desc: Activate only if you control 3 or more "Batteryman" monsters. Destroy all cards your opponent controls.

name: Shrink
desc: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; its original ATK becomes halved until the end of this turn.
rulings: This card targets 1 face-up monster on the field.
The halved ATK by "Shrink" is treated as the monster's original ATK.

The halved ATK by "Shrink" is treated as the monster's original ATK. Thus, when your opponent Normal Summons or Flip Summons a monster, if you activate "Cloning" and then "Shrink" is Chained and targets the Summoned monster, then the ATK of the "Clone Token" is equal to the ATK of the opponent's monster halved by "Shrink".

If "Emissary from Pandemonium" has its ATK/DEF halved by its effect and then it is affected by "Shrink" or "Megamorph", then "Shrink" and "Megamorph" use 1300 to determine the new ATK. "Shrink" will make its ATK 650, etc. If "Skill Drain" is later activated, then the effect of "Emissary from Pandemonium" will be negated, but it will still have 650 ATK.

Example: "Earthbound Immortal Wiraqocha Rasca" has 3100 ATK because of its own effect. When it is affected by "Shrink", its Original ATK of 100 is halved to 50, and then you re-apply the +3000 from the effect of "Earthbound Immortal Wiraqocha Rasca", for a total of 3050 ATK.

Example: When "Jester Lord" has 2000 ATK by its own effect and "Shrink" is activated, "Shrink" will make "Jester Lord" have 0 ATK. Afterwards, you apply the effect of "Jester Lord", so that "Jester Lord" has 2000 ATK.

Example: "The Winged Dragon of Ra" has 6000 ATK by its own effect. If "Shrink" targets "The Winged Dragon of Ra", then its Original ATK of 0 is halved, and then you re-apply its ATK-increasing effect, so that its ATK becomes 6000.
Example: "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" (ATK 3000) is Summoned, and its ATK is halved to 1500. "Shrink" will make its ATK 1500. During the End Phase, "Blue-Eyes White Dragon"'s ATK returns to 3000.
Example: If "Reptilianne Gorgon" battles "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" and makes its ATK 0, then the ATK of "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" will be 1500 (half its Original ATK) when it is affected by "Shrink".
Example: "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" (3000 ATK) has its ATK decreased by 2300 by "Rocket Pilder", to 700 ATK. If "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" is affected by "Shrink", then its ATK becomes 1500.

name: Silent Doom
desc: Target 1 Normal Monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon it in face-up Defense Position, but it cannot attack.
rulings: The effect of "Silent Doom" targets one Normal Monster in your Graveyard.

name: Skyscraper
desc: If an "Elemental HERO" monster attacks a monster that has a higher ATK, the attacking monster gains 1000 ATK during damage calculation only.
rulings: Example: Player A is attacking Player B's with his "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" while Player B controls a face-up "Skyscraper". Player B responds to "Blue-Eyes White Dragon"'s attack with "Mirror Gate". When "Mirror Gate" resolves, both monsters switch control and the battle is taken to the "calculate damage" portion of the Damage Step. Since "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" is still the attacking monster, the effect of "Skyscraper" will not be applied as "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" is not an monster.
Discarding "Elemental HERO Captain Gold" to the Graveyard is a cost to activate its effect which adds "Skyscraper" to your hand.

name: Skyscraper 2 - Hero City
desc: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, if you control this card: You can target 1 "Elemental HERO" monster in your Graveyard that was destroyed by battle; Special Summon that target.
rulings: An "Elemental HERO" monster that was destroyed by battle before the activation of "Skyscraper 2 - Hero City" can be targeted for its effect that Special Summons an "Elemental HERO" monster that was destroyed in battle.

name: Slash Draw
desc: Discard 1 card; send cards from the top of your Deck to the GY, equal to the number of cards your opponent controls, then draw 1 card and show it. Then, if it was "Slash Draw", send it to the GY, and if you do, destroy as many cards on the field as possible, then inflict 2000 damage to your opponent for each card destroyed and sent to the GY by this effect. If the card you drew was not "Slash Draw", shuffle cards from your GY into your Deck, equal to the number of cards sent from your Deck to the GY by this effect. You can only activate 1 "Slash Draw" per turn.

name: Snake Rain
desc: Discard 1 card. Select 4 Reptile-Type monsters from your Deck and send them to the Graveyard.

name: Soul Absorption
desc: If a card(s) is banished: Gain 500 LP for each.
rulings: After the card "Soul Absorption" has been activated, the effect activates each time a card is banished and makes a Chain Link.
The effect activates even if a card is banished during the Damage Step.
The effect activates regardless of whether the player's card(s) or the opponent's card(s) are banished. (The player you gains LP is the player who activated "Soul Absorption".)
If a card(s) is banished during the resolution of a Chain or as a cost to activate an effect, the effect of "Soul Absorption" is activated after the whole Chain has resolved.

If multiple cards are banished at once by "Soul Release", after "Soul Release" resolves, the effect of "Soul Absorption" activates only once and makes a Chain Link. Consequently, with that one effect resolution, the player gain LP equal to the number of banished cards ×500. (If 5 cards were banished, the controller of "Soul Absorption" gains 2500 LP.)

If a Token Monster (such as a Sheep Token) is targeted by the effect of "Caius the Shadow Monarch", it leaves the field and disappears, and as a result it is not banished. Therefore, in this case, the effect of "Soul Absorption" is not activated.

name: Soul Charge
desc: Target any number of monsters in your GY; Special Summon them, and if you do, you lose 1000 LP for each monster Special Summoned by this effect. You cannot conduct your Battle Phase the turn you activate this card. You can only activate 1 "Soul Charge" per turn.
rulings: If Solemn Warning is used to negate the activation of Soul Charge, a second Soul Charge may be activated the same turn.
This card targets 1 or more monsters in your Graveyard.
Special Summoning the targeted monsters and losing Life Points are considered to happen simultaneously.
This card cannot be activated during the Main Phase 2.
If 2 or more monsters are targeted, then those monsters are considered to be Special Summoned simultaneously.

You cannot conduct your Battle Phase the turn you activate "Soul Charge". If you cannot conduct your Battle Phase, then the Battle Phase of that turn is not skipped by the effect of your opponent's "Artifact Ignition". Therefore, your next Battle Phase is skipped by the effect of your opponent's Artifact Ignition.

If "Soul Charge" is activated targeting 3 monsters in your Graveyard and the opponent activates the effect of "D.D. Crow" in a Chain targeting 1 of those monsters, then even if 1 of the 3 targeted monsters is banished by the effect of "D.D. Crow", the remaining 2 monsters are still Special Summoned. Furthermore, since you only Special Summoned 2 monsters, you lose 2000 Life Points for the "you lose 1000 Life Points for each monster Special Summoned by this effect." effect.
This card can be activated during the first turn of the Duel if you have 1 or more monsters that can be Special Summoned in your Graveyard.

name: Soul Taker
desc: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; destroy that target, then your opponent gains 1000 LP.
rulings: This card targets 1 face-up monster your opponent controls.
Destroying the targeted monster and gaining Life Points are not considered to happen simultaneously.
If the targeted monster is not destroyed, your opponent does not gain Life Points.
This card can also target a Token Monster or an "Embodiment of Apophis" treated as a monster. (The targeted monster is destroyed and your opponent gains 1000 Life Points.)

name: Soul of Fire
desc: Your opponent draws 1 card. Select 1 Pyro-Type monster from your Deck and remove it from play. Inflict damage to your opponent equal to half the ATK of the removed monster. If you activate this card, you cannot declare an attack this turn.

name: Space Gift
desc: Draw 1 card for each different "Neo-Spacian" name on the monsters you control.

name: Spacetime Transcendence
desc: Banish 2 or more Dinosaur monsters from your GY; Special Summon 1 Dinosaur monster from your hand or GY whose Level equals the total Levels of those banished monsters, but it cannot attack this turn.

name: Spark Blaster
desc: Equip only to "Elemental HERO Sparkman". During your Main Phase: You can target 1 face-up monster; change the battle position of that target. After you use this effect 3 times, destroy this card.

name: Special Hurricane
desc: Discard 1 card from your hand. Destroy all Special Summoned monsters on the field.

name: Specimen Inspection
desc: Reveal 1 "Fossil Fusion" in your hand; send 1 monster from your hand to the GY, and if you do, declare a Type and a Level, then your opponent looks at their hand and Deck, and sends 1 monster with the declared Type and Level from one of them to the GY (if possible). You can only activate 1 "Specimen Inspection" per turn.

name: Spell Calling
desc: When this face-down card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard by the effect of a Spell or Trap Card controlled by your opponent, select 1 Quick-Play Spell Card from your Deck and Set it after showing it to your opponent.

name: Spell Chronicle
desc: Activate this card by sending your entire hand to the GY; banish 5 Spells/Traps from your Deck. Each time your opponent activates a Spell Card, place 1 Chronicle Counter on this card when that Spell Card resolves. You can remove 2 Chronicle Counters from this card; your opponent chooses 1 card banished by this card's effect for you to add to your hand. If this face-up card in the Spell & Trap Zone leaves the field: You take 500 damage for each card currently banished by this card's effect.
rulings: "Barrel Behind the Door", "Trap of Board Eraser", and similar Counter Trap cards must be activated in Chain to an effect which inflicts damage. If the effect of a Spell, Trap, or Effect Monster Card like "Spell Chronicle", "Curse of Darkness", or "Fire Princess" would inflict damage but does not start a Chain, then you cannot activate a card like "Barrel Behind the Door".

name: Spell Economics
desc: You do not pay Life Points to activate Spell Cards.
rulings: If "Spell Economics" is active, "Star Blast" cannot be activated without paying Life Points, since the effect depends on the Life Points paid.
The effect of "Spell Economics" only applies to the player who controls "Spell Economics". The opponent cannot also activate Spell Cards without paying Life Points.

You can only use the effect of "Spell Economics" to activate a Spell Card without paying Life Points - that is, you can only not pay Life Points to play a Spell Card from your hand or to flip face-up a Spell Card which is face-down on the field. Thus, if you control a face-up "Spell Economics" and a face-up "Mausoleum of the Emperor", then you cannot use the effect of "Spell Economics" to activate the effect of "Mausoleum of the Emperor" without paying Life Points.

For the effect "●WIND: A player cannot activate a Spell Card unless he pays 500 Life Points." of "Clear World", the 500 Life Points paid are not considered to be an activation cost for a Spell Card. Thus, even if the effect "You do not have to pay any Life Points to activate a Spell Card." of "Spell Economics" is active, then you still must pay the 500 Life Points to activate a Spell Card.

name: Spell Gear
desc: Send 3 "Ancient Gear" cards you control to the Graveyard. You can Special Summon up to 1 "Ancient Gear Golem" from your hand and 1 from your Deck, ignoring the Summoning conditions. Then, destroy all monsters you control except "Ancient Gear Golems". You cannot Normal Summon or Set until the end of your next turn.
rulings: You cannot activate "Spell Gear" if you have no "Ancient Gear Golem"s in both your hand and your deck. You can activate "Spell Gear" if you have no "Ancient Gear Golem"s in your hand, but you have one in your deck. You can activate it if you have no "Ancient Gear Golem"s in your deck, but you have one in your hand.

name: Spell Reproduction
desc: Send 2 Spells from your hand to the GY, then target 1 Spell in your GY; add it to your hand.

name: Spell of Pain
desc: When your opponent activates a card or effect that would inflict effect damage to you: Your opponent takes the effect damage from that card or effect, instead.
rulings: “Spell of Pain” ‘switches’ damage, like “Barrel Behind the Door.” It does not actually have an effect itself that ‘inflicts’ damage.
“Spell of Pain” is chained to an effect that would inflict damage to you.
You cannot activate “Spell of Pain” during the Damage Step.
"Spell of Pain" activates in chain to an opponent's card effect which inflicts damage.
Example: "Spell of Pain" can be activated in chain to "Ectoplasmer", "Ring of Destruction", and "Cannon Soldier".
"Spell of Pain" does not inflict damage. It makes the damage be inflicted to the opponent instead of you.
You cannot activate this card during the Damage Step.

name: Spider Web
desc: If a monster declares an attack, it is changed to Defense Position at the end of the Damage Step. It cannot change its battle position until the End Phase of its controller's next turn, while this card remains on the field.
rulings: The effects of this card do not start a Chain. They apply to both players.
If "Total Defense Shogun" attacks while in Defense Position, the effects of "Spider Web" do not apply.
If a monster affected by "Spider Web" is flipped face-down, the effect of "Spider Web" is no longer applied to it.
If "Spider Web" is negated by "Seal of Wickedness", monsters affected by "Spider Web" can change their Battle Positions.
If "Seal of Wickedness" is destroyed, monsters affected by "Spider Web" cannot change their Battle Positions.
If "Spider Web" is removed from the field, monsters affected by "Spider Web" can change their Battle Positions.
The effect of "Spider Web" which changes the monster to Defense Position at the end of the Damage Step does not start a Chain Link.
The effect of "Spider Web" which prevents the monster's Battle Position from being changed is applied to both players.

All effects of "Spider Web" are only applied as long as "Spider Web" remains face-up on the field. If "Spider Web" is removed from the field, then a monster who attacked can change its Battle Position, even if it is before the next turn's End Phase.

name: Spirit Illusion
desc:
Equip only to a Level 5 or higher Fiend or Zombie monster. When an attack is declared involving the equipped monster and an opponent's monster: You can make that opponent's monster lose ATK equal to the equipped monster's ATK. You can activate 1 of these effects;
● Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field.
● Special Summon 1 "Doppelganger Token" (Level 5/ATK ?/DEF 0) with the equipped monster's Type, Attribute, and ATK.
You can only use this effect of "Spirit Illusion" once per turn.
rulings: [Regarding the effect "You can activate 1 of these effects; ● Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field as material. ● Special Summon 1 "Doppelganger Token" (Level 5/ATK ?/DEF 0) with the same Type, Attribute, and ATK as the equipped monster."
This effect starts a Chain and can be activated while this card is face-up in the Spell & Trap Zone.
It can only be activated during your Main Phase.
When activating this effect, select 1 "●" effect activate activate it as that effect.
[Regarding the second "●" effect.
When resolving this effect, use monsters from your hand or field as materials for the Fusion Summon. Then, Fusion Summon the Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck.
Using materials from your hand or field and Special Summoning do not occur simultaneously.

Fusion Material monsters are sent to the GY unless another effect is applied, but even if these effects are applied that may cause the Fusion Material monsters to be sent somewhere other than the GY, the Fusion Monster is Special Summoned as long as the materials left the hand or field.
[Regarding the effect "When an attack is declared involving the equipped monster and an opponent's monster: You can make that opponent's monster lose ATK equal to the equipped monster's."
This effect starts a Chain and can be activated while this card is face-up in the Spell & Trap Zone.

name: Spiritual Energy Settle Machine
desc: As long as this card remains face-up on the field, all Spirit monsters remain face-up on the field and do not return to their owners' hands during the End Phase even if they are Normal Summoned or flipped face-up. Discard 1 card from your hand during each of your End Phases. If you do not, destroy this card. When this card is removed from the field, all face-up Spirit monsters return to the owners' hands.

name: Spring of Rebirth
desc: Increase your Life Points by 500 points every time monsters return from the field to the owner's hand.

name: Stamping Destruction
desc: If you control a Dragon monster: Target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; destroy that target, and if you do, inflict 500 damage to its controller.

name: Stray Lambs
desc: Special Summon 2 "Lamb Tokens" (Beast/EARTH/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) in Defense Position. You cannot Summon other monsters the turn you activate this card (but you can Set).

name: Subspace Battle
desc:
Apply the following effect, 3 times, in sequence.
● Each player reveals 1 monster from their Deck that does not have ? ATK. Add the monster with the higher ATK to the hand of the player that revealed it, also destroy the monster with the lower ATK and inflict 500 damage to the player that revealed it. If tied, shuffle those monsters into the Decks.
For the rest of this turn, neither player can activate the effects of monsters with any of their revealed monsters' names. You can only activate 1 "Subspace Battle" per turn.
rulings: It can be activated if you have at least 1 monster in your Deck that does not have ? ATK and your opponent has at least 1 card in their Deck.
At resolution, the "●" effect is applied 3 times. The resolution of each "●" effect does not happen at the same time.
Adding a monster to the hand, destroying a monster, and inflicting damage happen at the same time.

After this effect resolves, "For the rest of this turn, neither player can activate the effects of monsters with any of their revealed monsters' names". (Players can also reveal by this effect a monster with the same name as a monster that has already activated its effect.)

Regardless of whether a monster is added to the hand, a monster is destroyed, or damage is inflicted successfully, "For the rest of this turn, neither player can activate the effects of monsters with any of their revealed monsters' names".
If a player reveals a Pendulum Monster by this effect, they can still activate that Pendulum Monster Card in the Pendulum Zone or activate its Pendulum Effects.
At resolution, if a player cannot reveal a monster in their Deck that does not have ? ATK, the effect is not applied.

name: Summon Cloud
desc: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, if you don't control any monsters, you can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower "Cloudian" monster from your hand or from either player's Graveyard. If you Special Summon a monster from the Graveyard with this effect, destroy this card.

name: Summon Dice
desc:
Pay 1000 LP; roll a six-sided die and apply the result.
● 1 or 2: Immediately after this effect resolves, you can Normal Summon 1 monster.
● 3 or 4: You can Special Summon 1 monster from your GY.
● 5 or 6: You can Special Summon 1 Level 5 or higher monster from your hand.
You can only activate 1 "Summon Dice" per turn.
rulings: This effect does not target.
Paying 1000 LP is a cost to activate the card "Summon Dice".
You roll the die at the time the effect resolves, and perform the corresponding effect.

If resolving "1 or 2: Immediately after this effect resolves, you can Normal Summon 1 monster", Normal Summon 1 monster from your hand face-up. (If the monster is Level 5 or higher, it is still necessary to Tribute monsters as usual for a Tribute Summon.)
If resolving "3 or 4: You can Special Summon 1 monster from your GY", choose and Special Summon 1 monster which can be Special Summoned from your Graveyard.
If resolving "5 or 6: You can Special Summon 1 Level 5 or higher monster from your hand", choose and Special Summon 1 Level 5 or higher monster from your hand.

name: Summon Storm
desc: Pay 800 LP; Special Summon 1 Level 6 or lower WIND monster from your hand. During your Main Phase, except the turn this card was sent to the GY: You can banish this card from your GY; Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower WIND monster from your hand. You can only use this effect of "Summon Storm" once per turn.

name: Super Polymerization
desc: Discard 1 card; Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from either field as Fusion Material. Neither player can activate cards or effects in response to this card's activation.
rulings: If "Evilswarm Ophion" is applying its effect that prevents Level 5 or higher monsters from being Special Summoned and you only have "Elemental HERO Escuridao" in your Extra Deck, you cannot activate "Super Polymerization". Also, when you control "Petit Dragon" and the opponent controls "Firegrass", "Evilswarm Ophion" and 3 Dragon-Type monsters, if you activate "Super Polymerization", the only monster you can Special Summon is "Darkfire Dragon" using "Petit Dragon" and "Firegrass" as Fusion Materials, and since "Five-Headed Dragon" is higher than Level 5, it cannot be Special Summoned.[http://yugioh.faq.konami.jp/EokpControl?&lang=en&tid=66837&event=FE0006 Konami OCG FAQ]: If you only have "Elemental HERO Escuridao" in your Extra Deck and the opponent controls "Evilswarm Ophion", can you activate "Super Polymerization" using the opponent's "Evilswarm Ophion" to Special Summon the level 8 "Elemental HERO Escuridao"?

The prevention of "Super Polymerization" means that no card or effect can be chained to its activation. Therefore, when "Super Polymerization" resolves and the Fusion Monster is Special Summoned, "Torrential Tribute" or "Bottomless Trap Hole" can be activated.

"Solemn Judgment" or "Solemn Warning" cannot be activated in the middle of the resolution of the effect of "Super Polymerization". In addition, because cards or effects cannot be chained to the activation of "Super Polymerization", you cannot chain "Solemn Judgment" or "Solemn Warning to the activation of "Super Polymerization"

name: Super Rejuvenation
desc: During the End Phase of the turn this card was activated, draw a number of cards equal to the combined number of Dragon monsters you discarded or Tributed from your hand or field this turn.
rulings: During the End Phase, you draw cards for each Dragon-Type monster this card's controller Tributed or discarded.
If "Droll & Lock Bird" has been activated this turn, you can activate "Super Rejuvenation", "Maxx "C"", etc. However, "Droll & Lock Bird" still prevents you from drawing cards with their effects.

Suppose that you already drew cards for the effect of "Super Rejuvenation", and afterwards you discard or Tribute more Dragon-Type monsters. You already drew cards for the effect of "Super Rejuvenation" during the End Phase, so you cannot apply the effect a second time to draw more cards during the same End Phase.
If you draw multiple cards by the effect of "Super Rejuvenation", then you only gain 500 Life Points by the effect of "Solemn Wishes".
If you Tribute an opponent's Dragon-Type monster due to "Soul Exchange", it is included in the number of cards you draw with the effect of "Super Rejuvenation" during the End Phase.

You can activate "Super Rejuvenation" even while your opponent controls "Protector of the Sanctuary". However, if your opponent controls "Protector of the Sanctuary" during the End Phase, you cannot draw (even if "Protector of the Sanctuary" was not on the field when you activated "Super Rejuvenation").
If you draw multiple cards by the effect of "Super Rejuvenation", then all cards are drawn by the same effect resolution. You cannot split up the effect and draw multiple times.
Drawing a card(s) by the effect of "Super Rejuvenation" does not start a Chain Link.

name: Swing of Memories
desc: Target 1 Normal Monster in your GY; Special Summon it, but destroy it during the End Phase of this turn.
rulings: If a "Dark Magician" that was Special Summoned by "Swing of Memories" is equipped with "Gagagashield", when the effect of "Swing of Memories" is applied during the End Phase, since the effect of "Gagagashield" is applied, "Dark Magician" is not destroyed and remains on the field. Also, if a "Time Wizard" that was Special Summoned by the effect of "Limit Reverse" is equipped with "Gagagashield" and later switched to Defense Position, the effect of "Limit Reverse" is applied and it destroys itself, but since the effect of "Gagagashield" is applied, "Time Wizard" is not destroyed and remains on the field.

Normal Monsters Special Summoned by "Swing of Memories" are destroyed during the End Phase even if "Non-Spellcasting Area" is active. It makes no difference in which order the two cards were activated.

name: Synthesis Spell
desc: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Lycanthrope". You must also Tribute monsters whose total Levels equal 6 or more from the field or your hand.

name: System Down
desc: Pay 1000 LP; banish all Machine-Type monsters your opponent controls and in their Graveyard.
rulings: The effect does not target.
The effect banishes all face-up Machine monsters in your opponent's Monster Zone and all Machine monsters in your opponent's Graveyard.
Paying 1000 Life Points is the cost to activate this card.
If your opponent has no Machine monsters in their Monster Zone and no Machine monsters in their Graveyard, "System Down" cannot be activated.

name: Tail Swipe
desc: Target 1 Level 5 or higher Dinosaur monster you control; if that Dinosaur monster is still face-up on the field, choose up to 2 monsters your opponent controls that have a lower Level than it, or are face-down, and return the chosen monsters to the hand.

name: Temple of the Kings
desc: You can activate 1 Trap Card the turn it was Set. You can send 1 "Mystical Beast of Serket" in your Monster Zone and this card you control to the Graveyard; Special Summon 1 monster from your hand or Deck, or 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck. You can only use each effect of "Temple of the Kings" once per turn.
rulings: The "You can activate 1 Trap Card the turn it was Set." effect does not start a Chain Link. (It starts applying after "Temple of the Kings" resolves.)
You cannot activate Trap Cards from your hand with this effect. You need Set them in your Spell & Trap Zone.

The "You can send 1 "Mystical Beast of Serket" in your Monster Zone and this card you control to the Graveyard; Special Summon 1 monster from your hand or Deck, or 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck." effect starts a Chain Link. (It does not target. It can only be activated during your Main Phase. Sending 1 "Mystical Beast of Serket" and this card you control to the Graveyard is a cost to activate this effect.)

This effect cannot Special Summon Special Summon Monsters from your hand or Deck. Also, it can only Special Summon Fusion Monsters from your Extra Deck. (You cannot Special Summon Synchro, Xyz or Pendulum Monsters from your Extra Deck.)
Since monsters Special Summoned by this effect are not treated as being properly Summoned, you cannot Special Summon monsters that can only be Fusion Summoned like "Dark Paladin".
You can only use each effect of "Temple of the Kings" once per turn, but you can activate more than 1 "Temple of the Kings" per turn.
After you Xyz Summon a monster, if you activate a "Dimension Slice" that was Set this turn, it can be activated using either the effect of "Dimension Slice" or the effect of "Temple of the Kings".

If it is activated using the "If the Summon is an Xyz Summon, you can activate this card the turn it was Set." effect of "Dimension Slice", then the effect of "Temple of the Kings" can be used to activate another Trap Card that was Set this turn.

If it is activated using the "You can activate 1 Trap Card the turn it was Set." effect of "Temple of the Kings", then the effect of "Temple of the Kings" cannot be used to activate another Trap Card that was Set this turn.

If the activation of a Trap Card that was activated by applying the effect of "Temple of the Kings" is negated, since the "You can activate 1 Trap Card the turn it was Set." effect was already applied, you cannot activate a second Trap Card that was Set this turn.

You can activate 1 Trap Card during the turn it was Set using the effect of "Temple of the Kings". If a "Breakthrough Skill" that was Set this turn is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard by an opponent's "Mystical Space Typhoon", you cannot activate its effect from the Graveyard this turn using the effect of "Temple of the Kings".
If a "Blaze Accelerator Reload" that was Set this turn is activated using the effect of "Temple of the Kings", you can activate the card and its effect in the same Chain Link.

You cannot activate "Ring of Destruction" during your turn using the effect of "Temple of the Kings". If you cannot activate "The Transmigration Prophecy" because the effect of "Xing Zhen Hu", then it cannot be activated using the effect of "Temple of the Kings".

"Limiter Overload" and "Statue of the Wicked" cannot be activated while they are Set in the Spell & Trap Zone. (Their effects can be activated from the Graveyard when they are destroyed.) You cannot activate these effects using the effect of "Temple of the Kings".
Counter Trap Cards like "Solemn Judgment" can be activated during the turn they were Set.
Cards that are activated during the Damage Step like "Hero Signal" can be activated during the turn they were Set.

If "Raigeki Break" is activated during the turn it was Set using the effect of "Temple of the Kings" and "Mystical Space Typhoon" is activated in a chain, destroying "Temple of the Kings", the effect of "Raigeki Break" is applied normally.
If "Mystical Space Typhoon" is activated by targeting a "Raigeki Break" that was Set this turn, that "Raigeki Break" can be activated in a chain using the effect of "Temple of the Kings".
If the effect of "Temple of the Kings" is negated by "Silent Swordsman LV7", you cannot activate a Trap Card during the turn it was Set.
Even if a Trap Card like "Jar of Greed" was Set this turn before the activation of "Temple of the Kings", since it was Set this turn, it can be activated using the effect of "Temple of the Kings".
Even if a Trap Card is Set by the effect of "Dust Tornado", since it was Set this turn, it can be activated using the effect of "Temple of the Kings".

If a "Scrap-Iron Scarecrow" that was Set during the previous turn is activated, and then Set by its own effect, since it is a Trap Card that was Set during this turn, it can be activated again using the effect of "Temple of the Kings". (After "Scrap-Iron Scarecrow" is Set again, it cannot be activated again during this turn.)

name: Terraforming
desc: Add 1 Field Spell from your Deck to your hand.
rulings: When "Thunder King Rai-Oh" is face-up on the field, you cannot activate "Terraforming", "Reinforcement of the Army", etc.

name: The A. Forces
desc: All Warrior-Type monsters you control gain 200 ATK for each Warrior or Spellcaster-Type monster you control.

name: The Big March of Animals
desc: Until the end of this turn, all face-up Beast-Type monsters on your side of the field gain 200 ATK for each Beast-Type monster on your side of the field.

name: The Eye of Timaeus
desc:
(This card is also always treated as "Legendary Dragon Timaeus".)
Target 1 "Dark Magician" monster you control; Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck that lists that monster on the field as Fusion Material, using it as the Fusion Material. You can only activate 1 "The Eye of Timaeus" per turn.
rulings: This card does not mention "Dark Magician".
It is not treated as an effect.
At resolution, apply "using it as the Fusion Material". Then, apply "Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck that mentions that monster on the field as material".
"Fusion Monster ... that mentions that monster on the field as material" refers to a Fusion Monster that lists in its text as Fusion Material the name of the monster that was sent to the Graveyard.
Using a monster as Fusion Material and Special Summoning a Fusion Monster do not happen at the same time.

As long as no other card effects are applied, the Fusion Material Monster is sent to the Graveyard, but it can be sent to somewhere else instead of the Graveyard due to other card effects. Even in that case, as long as the Fusion Material Monster leaves the hand or field, the Fusion Monster is still Special Summoned.

name: The Flute of Summoning Kuriboh
desc: Take 1 "Kuriboh" or 1 "Winged Kuriboh" from your Deck, and either add it to your hand or Special Summon it.

name: The Graveyard in the Fourth Dimension
desc: Add 2 "LV" monsters from your Graveyard to your Deck and shuffle it.

name: The Mask of Remnants
desc: Shuffle this card into its owner's Deck, OR if this card was put into play by the effect of "Masked Beast Des Gardius", this card is treated as an Equip Card. Control of the equipped monster is switched.

name: The Sanctuary in the Sky
desc: Battle damage to the controller of a Fairy monster from a battle involving that monster becomes 0.

name: The Seal of Orichalcos
desc: All monsters you control gain 500 ATK. Once per turn, this card cannot be destroyed by card effects. While you control 2 or more face-up Attack Position monsters, your opponent cannot target your monster(s) with the lowest ATK for an attack. If this card is activated: Destroy all Special Summoned monsters you control. You cannot Special Summon monsters from the Extra Deck. You can only activate "The Seal of Orichalcos" once per Duel.
rulings: For effects that read "you can only ACTIVATE this card/effect once per turn/Duel" if the activation of the card or effect is negated, you can activate the card/effect again in the same turn/Duel. So if the activation of "The Seal of Orichalcos" is negated by a card's effect you can activate another "The Seal of Orichalcos" in that Duel. For effects that read "you can only USE this card/effect once per turn/Duel" if the activation of the card or effect is negated, you cannot activate the card/effect again in the same turn/Duel.
Even if during the Duel the opponent activates "The Seal of Orichalcos", you can activate "The Seal of Orichalcos".

If "Forbidden Dress" or "Forbidden Lance" are activated in a chain to "The Seal of Orichalcos" targeting a monster that was Special Summoned, the Special Summoned monster is not destroyed once the effects of "Forbidden Dress" or "Forbidden Lance" have stopped applying. Therefore, the monster affected by the effect of "Forbidden Dress" or "Forbidden Lance" remains on the field.

If there's one or more monsters with the same ATK as the monster with the lowest ATK under the control of the controller of "The Seal of Orichalcos", the opponent cannot target any of those monsters for an attack. Furthermore, if the controller of "The Seal of Orichalcos" only controls face-up monsters and they all have the same ATK, the opponent cannot target any monsters for an attack.

name: The Second Sarcophagus
desc: This card can only be placed on the field by the effect of "The First Sarcophagus".
rulings: "The Second Sarcophagus" is a Spell Card that cannot be activated.
"The Second Sarcophagus" cannot be Set from the hand to the Spell & Trap Zone during your Main Phase.
"The Second Sarcophagus" cannot be Set in the Spell & Trap Zone by the effect of "Dust Tornado".
"The Second Sarcophagus" cannot be placed on the field as a Monster Card by the effect of "Magical Hats".

name: The Third Sarcophagus
desc: This card can only be placed on the field by the effect of "The First Sarcophagus".
rulings: "The Third Sarcophagus" is a Spell Card that cannot be activated.
"The Third Sarcophagus" cannot be Set from the hand to the Spell & Trap Zone during your Main Phase.
"The Third Sarcophagus" cannot be Set in the Spell & Trap Zone by the effect of "Dust Tornado".
"The Third Sarcophagus" cannot be placed on the field as a Monster Card by the effect of "Magical Hats".

name: The Warrior Returning Alive
desc: Target 1 Warrior-Type monster in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand.

name: Thousand Energy
desc: Increase the original ATK and DEF of all face-up Level 2 Normal Monsters (except Tokens) on your side of the field by 1000 points until the End Phase. Destroy all Level 2 Normal Monsters on your side of the field during the End Phase.
rulings: The effect does not target.
The effect is applied to all Level 2 Normal Monsters, except Tokens, that are face-up in your Monster Zone when the effect resolves.
Destroying all Level 2 Normal Monsters you control during the End Phase does not start a Chain Link.
You cannot activate "Thousand Energy" if you control no face-up Level 2 Normal Monsters in your Monster Zone other than Tokens.

name: Thunder Crash
desc: Destroy all monsters you control, and if you do, inflict 300 damage to your opponent for each monster destroyed.

name: Ties of the Brethren
desc: Pay 2000 LP, then target 1 Level 4 or lower monster you control; for the rest of this turn after this card resolves, you cannot Special Summon monsters, also Special Summon 2 monsters from your Deck, with the same Type, Attribute, and Level as that monster, but with different names from each other and that monster. You cannot conduct your Battle Phase the turn you activate this card.

name: Time Stream
desc: Target 1 "Fossil" Fusion Monster you control; Tribute it, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "Fossil" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, whose original Level is 2 higher than that monster's. (This is treated as a Fusion Summon with "Fossil Fusion".) During your Main Phase, except the turn this card was sent to the GY: You can banish this card and 1 "Fossil" Fusion Monster from your GY, then target 1 "Fossil" Fusion Monster in your GY; Special Summon it.

name: Token Thanksgiving
desc: Destroy all tokens on the field. Increase your Life Points by the number of tokens destroyed x 800 points.
rulings: This card does not target.
All Token Monsters on the field are destroyed.
Destroying all Token Monsters and gaining Life Points are considered to happen simultaneously.
If there are no Token Monsters on the field, "Token Thanksgiving" cannot be activated.

name: Toon Kingdom
desc: When this card is activated: Banish 3 cards from the top of your Deck, face-down. This card's name becomes "Toon World" while in the Field Zone. Your opponent cannot target Toon monsters you control with card effects. If a Toon monster(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can banish 1 card from the top of your Deck, face-down, for each of those monster(s) instead.

name: Toon Rollback
desc: Target 1 Toon monster you control; it can make a second attack during each Battle Phase this turn.

name: Toon Table of Contents
desc: Add 1 "Toon" card from your Deck to your hand.
rulings: You can add a card other than a Toon Monster to the hand that has "Toon" in its name, like "Toon Alligator".

name: Transcendent Wings
desc: Send 1 face-up or face-down "Winged Kuriboh" you control and 2 cards from your hand to the GY; Special Summon 1 "Winged Kuriboh LV10" from your hand or Deck.

name: Tri-Blaze Accelerator
desc: Activate only by sending 1 face-up "Blaze Accelerator" on your side of the field to the Graveyard. You can send 1 Pyro-Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard to destroy 1 monster your opponent controls and inflict 500 damage to your opponent, but you cannot declare an attack during this turn if you do.

name: Tribute Burial
desc: You cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn. Once during this turn, you can conduct a Tribute Summon that requires 2 Tributes by banishing 1 monster from each Graveyard instead of Tributing (it is still treated as a Tribute Summon).

name: Tribute Doll
desc: Tribute 1 monster; Special Summon 1 Level 7 monster from your hand that can be Normal Summoned/Set. It cannot attack this turn.
rulings: Tributing 1 monster is a cost to activate this card.
You cannot Special Summon a Special Summon Monster from your hand with this effect.

name: Tricky Spell 4
desc: Send 1 face-up "The Tricky" you control to the Graveyard; Special Summon "Tricky Tokens" (Spellcaster-Type/WIND/Level 5/ATK 2000/DEF 1200) in Defense Position, equal to the number of monsters your opponent controls. "Tricky Tokens" cannot declare an attack.
rulings: Sending 1 face-up "The Tricky" in your Monster Zone to the Graveyard is a cost to activate this card.
