When resolving "Tricky Spell 4", Special Summon "Tricky Tokens" equal to the number of monsters your opponent controls. ("Tricky Tokens" are Normal Monsters.)
This card does not target.
This card cannot be activated during the Damage Step.
If your opponent controls no monsters, "Tricky Spell 4" cannot be activated.

name: Ultra Evolution Pill
desc: Tribute 1 Reptile monster; Special Summon 1 Dinosaur monster from your hand.

name: Underworld Circle
desc: Activate this card if both players have 5 or more monsters in their GYs; destroy as many monsters on the field as possible, then each player banishes (face-down) as many monsters from their Deck as possible, then you can Special Summon 1 Normal Monster from your GY. Once per turn, during the Standby Phase: Activate this effect; each player can Special Summon 1 monster from their GY, ignoring its Summoning conditions, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only activate 1 "Underworld Circle" per Duel.

name: Union Attack
desc: Target 1 face-up monster you control; add up the total ATK of all other face-up Attack Position monsters you currently control, then during the Battle Phase of this turn only, the monster gains that much ATK, but cannot inflict battle damage to your opponent, also other face-up Attack Position monsters cannot attack.
rulings: This effect targets 1 face-up monster on your field.
It cannot be activated in Main Phase 2.

Applying the effect "add up the total ATK of all other face-up Attack Position monsters you currently control, then during the Battle Phase of this turn only, the monster gains that much ATK" at the start of the Battle Phase does not make a Chain Link.

name: Valkyrie's Embrace
desc: If all monsters you control are "Valkyrie" monsters: Target 1 Attack Position "Valkyrie" monster you control and 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; change your monster to Defense Position, and if you do, banish that opponent's monster. You cannot Special Summon monsters the turn you activate this card, except "Valkyrie" monsters. You can only activate 1 "Valkyrie's Embrace" per turn.
rulings: This card targets 2 monsters; 1 face-up Attack Position "Valkyrie" monster in your Monster Zone, and 1 face-up monster in your opponent's Monster Zone.
This card can only be activated if all monsters in your Monster Zone are face-up "Valkyrie" monsters.
Changing your monster to Defense Position and banishing the opponent's monster happen simultaneously.

You cannot activate this card during a turn you already Special Summoned a non-"Valkyrie" monster. If you activate this card, you cannot Special Summon a non-"Valkyrie" monster for the rest of that turn.

name: Vehicroid Connection Zone
desc: Fusion Summon 1 "Vehicroid" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field as Fusion Materials, and if you do, it cannot be destroyed by card effects, and its effects cannot be negated.
rulings: You can use the effect of "Chain Material" when resolving "Vehicroid Connection Zone".

name: Venom Shot
desc: Activate only while you control a face-up "Venom" monster, "Vennominaga the Deity of Poisonous Snakes", or "Vennominon the King of Poisonous Snakes". Send 1 Reptile-Type monster from your Deck to the Graveyard and place 2 Venom Counters on 1 face-up monster your opponent controls.
rulings: This effect targets one face-up monster on your opponent's field.
The Reptile-Type monster is sent to the Graveyard at resolution. It is not a cost.

name: Venom Swamp
desc: During each player's End Phase: Place 1 Venom Counter on each face-up monster, except "Venom" monsters. Monsters lose 500 ATK for each Venom Counter on them. Destroy a monster if its ATK becomes 0 by this effect.
rulings: Even if the effect of "Venom Swamp" is being applied, if the monster's ATK is not reduced to 0 by placing a Venom Counter on it, it is not destroyed by the effect of "Venom Swamp".

While the effect of "Imperial Order" is being applied, "Venom Swamp" is on the field and a monster with 500 or less ATK that has been equipped with "Ring of Magnetism" had a Venom Counter placed on itself, if the effects of "Ring of Magnetism" and "Venom Swamp" start applying as a result of "Imperial Order" leaving the field, since the ATK became 0 as a result of the effect of "Ring of Magnetism" being reapplied, the monster is not destroyed by the effect of "Venom Swamp".

The effect of "Venom Swamp" that places 1 Venom Counter during the End Phase starts a Chain Link. The effect that destroys monsters whose ATK became 0 also starts a Chain Link. This effect activates when the ATK of a monster becomes 0 after placing a Venom Counter on it.
If a Venom Counter is placed on a monster with 0 ATK, since the ATK of that monster is not reduced to 0 by the effect of "Venom Swamp", that monster is not destroyed.

name: Vicious Claw
desc: The equipped monster gains 300 ATK. If the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle, return this card to its owner's hand instead. Then, destroy 1 monster, except the one that battled the equipped monster, and inflict 600 damage to your opponent. After that, Special Summon 1 "Evil Token" (Fiend-Type/DARK/Level 7/ATK 2500/DEF 2500) on your opponent's side of the field. During the turn this card is returned to your hand, you cannot use "Vicious Claw" from your hand.
rulings: The effect "The equipped monster gains 300 ATK." does not start a Chain Link.

The effect "If the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle, return this card to its owner's hand instead." does not start a Chain Link. (The "Vicious Claw" that applied this effect is returned to the hand after damage calculation.)

The effect "Then, destroy 1 monster, except the one that battled the equipped monster, and inflict 600 damage to your opponent." does not start a Chain Link. (It does not target. It is applied as part of the resolution of the effect "return this card to its owner's hand instead.".)

The effect "After that, Special Summon 1 "Evil Token" (Fiend-Type/DARK/Level 7/ATK 2500/DEF 2500) on your opponent's side of the field." does not start a Chain Link. (It does not target. It is applied as part of the resolution of the effect "return this card to its owner's hand instead.".)

Special Summoning an "Evil Token" is considered the last thing to happen when the effect "return this card to its owner's hand instead." resolves. None of the effects are considered to happen at the same time.

name: Water of Life
desc: If you control no monsters: Target 1 monster in your GY; Special Summon that target in Attack Position, also, for the rest of this turn after this card resolves, you cannot activate monster effects, except the effects of that Special Summoned monster on the field. You can only activate 1 "Water of Life" per turn.
rulings: You can only activate this card if you have no monsters in your Monster Zone.
This card targets 1 monster in your Graveyard.

The effect of "Water of Life" finishes resolving by Special Summoning the targeted monster from the Graveyard. (The part of the effect that prevents you from activating other monsters' effects this turn is also applied immediately at this time.)
After Special Summoning a monster with this card's effect, you cannot activate other monsters' effects for the rest of this turn, including effects in the hand, Graveyard, etc.

name: Weapon Change
desc: Once during each of your Standby Phases: You can pay 700 Life Points, then target 1 Warrior or Machine-Type monster you control; switch the current ATK and DEF of that target until the end of your opponent's next turn.
rulings: This card's effect is no longer applied if it leaves the Field. At this time, recalculate the ATK/DEF.
Paying 700 LP is a cost to activate the effect of this card.

name: White Dragon Ritual
desc: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Paladin of White Dragon". You must also Tribute monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels equal 4 or more.

name: White Veil
desc: While the equipped monster battles, your opponent cannot activate any Spell/Trap Cards until the end of the Damage Step. When an attack is declared involving the equipped monster: Face-up Spell/Trap Cards your opponent controls have their effects negated until the end of the Damage Step (even if this card leaves the field). When the equipped monster destroys an opponent's monster by battle: You can destroy all Spell and Trap Cards your opponent controls. When this face-up card in a player's Spell & Trap Zone leaves the field, that player takes 3000 damage.

name: Wicked Canon
desc: Each time an opponent's monster declares an attack, place 1 Sinister Doctrine Counter on this card. You can only use each of the following effects of "Wicked Canon" once per turn. During your Main Phase, if this card was activated this turn: You can add 1 DARK Fiend monster from your Deck to your hand, then discard 1 Fiend monster. You can send this card with 4 or more Sinister Doctrine Counters to the GY; Special Summon 1 Fiend monster from your Deck, then you can add 1 "Super Polymerization" from your Deck to your hand.

name: Wicked-Breaking Flamberge - Baou
desc: Send 1 card from your hand to the GY, then target 1 monster on the field; equip this card to that target. It gains 500 ATK. Negate the effects of opponent's monsters destroyed by battle with the equipped monster.

name: Wild Fire
desc: Pay 500 Life Points. Destroy a face-up "Blaze Accelerator" card you control and destroy all monsters on the field. Then, Special Summon 1 "Wild Fire Token" (Pyro-Type/FIRE/Level 3/ATK 1000/DEF 1000) in Attack Position. Also, you cannot declare an attack this turn.

name: Wild Nature's Release
desc: Target 1 Beast or Beast-Warrior-Type monster; it gains ATK equal to its current DEF until the End Phase. During the End Phase, destroy it.

name: Wing Requital
desc: If all monsters you control are Winged Beast monsters and you control at least 2 monsters with different original names: Pay 600 LP; draw 2 cards. You can only activate 1 "Wing Requital" per turn.

name: A Hero Emerges
desc: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Your opponent chooses 1 random card from your hand, then if it is a monster that can be Special Summoned, Special Summon it. Otherwise, send it to the Graveyard.
rulings: The effect does not target.
If you have no cards in your hand, or if you have no Monster Cards in your hand, "A Hero Emerges" cannot be activated.

If the opponent's randomly chosen monster is "Tsukuyomi", a Special Summon Monster, etc., if it was a monster that cannot be Special Summoned by the effect of "A Hero Emerges", that monster is sent to the Graveyard without being Special Summoned.

If you only have LIGHT monsters in your Monster Zones while the effect of "Gozen Match" is applying, providing you have a LIGHT monster in your hand that can be Special Summoned by the effect of "A Hero Emerges", you can activate "A Hero Emerges". (For example, in this case, if you only have DARK monsters in your hand, you cannot activate "A Hero Emerges".) Furthermore, while "Each player can only control 1 Attribute of monster. Send all other face-up monsters they control to the Graveyard" is applying, if the opponent chose a LIGHT monster it is Special Summoned normally, but if the opponent chose a non-LIGHT monster or a Spell/Trap Card, the chosen card is sent to the Graveyard.

If "Vanity's Emptiness" is activated in Chain to the activation of "A Hero Emerges", since the effect of "Vanity's Emptiness" prevents monsters from being Special Summoned, the effect of "A Hero Emerges" does not apply. (Your opponent does not randomly select a card in your hand.)

name: A Rival Appears!
desc: Select 1 face-up monster your opponent controls. Special Summon 1 monster from your hand that has the same Level as the selected monster.

name: Alchemy Cycle
desc: The original ATK of all face-up monsters you control becomes 0, until the End Phase. Each time a monster that had its original ATK reduced to 0 by this effect is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, draw 1 card.

name: Amazoness Archers
desc: When an opponent's monster declares an attack, while you control an "Amazoness" monster: Change all monsters your opponent currently controls to face-up Attack Position (Flip Effects are not activated), they lose 500 ATK, also they must attack this turn, if able.
rulings: If a monster is forced to attack by "Amazoness Archers", and a replay occurs, then you cannot choose to attack with a different monster. You can choose to attack a different monster.

name: Apple of Enlightenment
desc: Target cards in your opponent's GY, up to the number of "Valkyrie" monsters you control; banish them. If this Set card in its owner's control has left the field because of an opponent's effect, and is now in the GY or banished: You can draw cards equal to the number of "Valkyrie" monsters you control +1.
rulings: This card's effect that banishes cards from your opponent's GY is the effect applied by activating this card. (It targets cards in your opponent's GY, up to the number of face-up "Valkyrie" monsters in your Monster Zone.)
This card can only be activated if you have at least 1 face-up "Valkyrie" monster in your Monster Zone.
This card cannot be activated during the Damage Step.
This card's effect that draws cards starts a Chain and activates either in the GY or if this card is banished. (It does not target, and can be activated during the Damage Step.)

name: Arcana Call
desc: Select 1 "Arcana Force" monster you control. Remove from play 1 "Arcana Force" monster from either player's Graveyard. Until the End Phase, the selected monster's effect becomes the removed monster's effect for the same coin toss result.
rulings: The effect targets 1 face-up "Arcana Force" monster on the field and 1 "Arcana Force" monster in the Graveyard.

name: Attack Guidance Armor
desc:
When a monster declares an attack: Activate 1 of these effects;
● Destroy the attacking monster.
● Target 1 monster on either field, except the attacking monster; change the attack target to it and perform damage calculation.
You can only activate 1 "Attack Guidance Armor" per turn.

name: Attack Reflector Unit
desc: Tribute 1 "Cyber Dragon". Special Summon 1 "Cyber Barrier Dragon" from your hand or Deck.

name: Backfire
desc: If a face-up FIRE monster(s) you control is destroyed and sent to the GY: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent.
rulings: You can activate the card "Backfire" at any time except during the Damage Step.
The effect to inflict damage to your opponent uses a Chain Link.

This effect will activate when a face-up FIRE-Attribute monster you control is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard. (This effect will not activate when a face-down Defense Position FIRE-Attribute monster you control is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard.)

While "Backfire" is face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone, its effect will activate even when a FIRE-Attribute monster is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard during the Damage Step. (It will only activate when a face-up FIRE-Attribute monster on the field is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard. Even if a face-down Defense Position monster is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard after being flipped face-up by battle, this effect will activate.)

name: Bad Reaction to Simochi
desc: As long as this card remains face-up on the field, any effect of increasing your opponent's Life Points is changed to inflict the same amount of points in damage to your opponent's Life Points.
rulings: If "Dian Keto the Cure Master" is activated while both "Prime Material Dragon" and "Bad Reaction to Simochi" are on the field, "Bad Reaction to Simochi" turns the effect into an effect which inflicts damage, but then "Prime Material Dragon" turns the effect into an effect which recovers Life Points. "Dian Keto the Cure Master" will recover 1000 LP.

If "Ookazi" is activated while both "Prime Material Dragon" and "Bad Reaction to Simochi" are on the field, "Prime Material Dragon" turns the effect into an effect which recovers Life Points, but then "Bad Reaction to Simochi" turns the effect into an effect which deals damage. "Ookazi" will deal 800 damage.

name: Battle-Scarred
desc: Select 1 Archfiend monster on your side of the field to activate this card. Your opponent also pays the same Life Points that you pay for the selected monster during the Standby Phase. If this card is removed from the field, destroy the selected monster. When the selected monster is removed from the field, destroy this card.
rulings: The activation of the card "Battle-Scarred" can be performed at any time, except during the Damage Step.
When "Battle-Scarred" is activated it targets 1 face-up "Archfiend" monster in your Monster Zone.

The effect "Your opponent also pays the same Life Points that you pay for the selected monster during the Standby Phase" does not make a Chain Link. (If you pay LP during the Standby Phase for its maintenance cost, the opponent also pays those LP.)
The effect "If this card is removed from the field, destroy the selected monster" does not make a Chain Link. (It applies even during the Damage Step.)
The effect "When the selected monster is removed from the field, destroy this card" does not make a Chain Link. (It applies even during the Damage Step.)

name: Beast Soul Swap
desc: Target 1 Beast-Type monster you control; return it to the hand, and if you do, Special Summon 1 Beast-Type monster from your hand with the same Level as the monster that was returned to the hand.
rulings: This card cannot be activated during the Damage Step.
This card targets 1 face-up Beast-Type monster you control.
Returning the targeted monster to the hand and Special Summoning 1 monster from your hand are not considered to happen simultaneously.
"Beast Soul Swap" can be activated even if you have no cards in your hand. (In this case, you will Special Summon the same monster that was returned to the hand.)

name: Beckoning Light
desc: Discard your entire hand, then for each card you discarded to the GY by this effect, add 1 LIGHT monster from your GY to your hand.
rulings: You discard all cards from your hand to the Graveyard when resolving the effect. It is not a cost.
The effect does not target.

name: Big Burn
desc: You can only activate this card when your opponent activates a card that targets a monster in the Graveyard. Remove from play all monsters in both players' Graveyards.

name: Bottomless Trap Hole
desc: When your opponent Summons a monster(s) with 1500 or more ATK: Destroy that monster(s) with 1500 or more ATK, and if you do, banish it.
rulings: "Bottomless Trap Hole" does not negate a Summon. It destroys and the monsters after it has already been successfully Summoned.
As long as you are properly chaining cards with appropriate Spell Speeds, you can activate as many cards that respond to the Summon/Attack in the chain responding to those actions.

Cards like "Bottomless Trap Hole" or "Sakuretsu Armor" do not have to be Chain Link 1 in order for them to be activated. You can technically activate 3 copies of "Bottomless Trap Hole" during the same Chain, even as Chain links 5, 6, and 9.
Chain link 1: "Breaker the Magical Warrior" (Mandatory Trigger effect that will place the counter on itself)
Chain link 2: "Genex Ally Crusher" (Optional Trigger effect)
Chain link 3: "Bottomless Trap Hole"

Example: If Starlight Road is Chained to the activation of Heavy Storm, then Heavy Storm is Chain Link 1 and Starlight Road is Chain Link 2. When Starlight Road resolves, it will negate the activation of Heavy Storm and destroy it (at the same time, due to the “and if you do” conjunction), then it will Summon Stardust Dragon. At this time, the activation of Heavy Storm has been negated, so the chain ends. The last thing to happen is the Summon of Stardust Dragon, so players may respond to that summon with any legal card, including Bottomless Trap Hole.
"Bottomless Trap Hole" only destroys and banishes the monster(s) whose Summon(s) provided the correct timing for "Bottomless Trap Hole" to be activated.

Example: "Monster Reborn" is activated and targets "Dark Magician" (2500 ATK). "Birthright" is chained and targets "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" (3000 ATK). "Birthright" resolves first and Special Summons "Blue-Eyes White Dragon", and then "Dark Magician" is Special Summoned as Chain Link 1. If "Bottomless Trap Hole" is activated, then only "Dark Magician" is destroyed and banished because its Summon allowed "Bottomless Trap Hole to be activated.
If "Bottomless Trap Hole" is activated when multiple monsters are Special Summoned simultaneously, then all Summoned monsters with 1500+ ATK are destroyed.
Example: Two copies of "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" are Special Summoned by "Dimension Fusion". If "Bottomless Trap Hole" is activated, then both copies of "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" are destroyed.

The effect of "Bottomless Trap Hole" does not target. Thus, if "Lord of D." is on the field, then you can still activate "Bottomless Trap Hole" when a Dragon-Type monster with 1500+ ATK is Normal Summoned/Flip Summoned/Special Summoned, and the Dragon-Type monster will be banished normally.

name: Break the Seal
desc:
You can activate 1 of these effects;
● Place 1 "Break the Seal" from your Deck or GY, face-up on your field.
● Send 2 face-up "Break the Seal" you control to the GY, including this card; add 1 "Forbidden One" monster from your Deck to your hand.
If this card on the field is destroyed: You can reveal up to 5 "Forbidden One" monsters in your hand; return that many cards your opponent controls to the hand. You can only use each effect of "Break the Seal" once per turn.
rulings: This card can be activated either by performing only the card activation or by activating the 1st "●" effect in the same Chain Link as the card activation.

If only the card activation is performed, it has no activation condition. However, it cannot be activated during the Damage Step. Also, if only the card activation is performed, the 1st "●" effect cannot be activated in the same Chain (as Chain 2 or higher).
If the activation condition of the 1st "●" effect is met, the 1st "●" effect can be activated in the same Chain Link as the card activation.
It starts a Chain Link and can be activated in the Spell & Trap Zone.
When this effect is activated, choose 1 "●" and activate this effect as that "●" effect.
Neither "●" effect can be activated during the Damage Step.

If the activation condition of this effect is met, the 1st "●" effect can be activated in the same Chain Link as this card's activation. However, the 2nd "●" effect cannot be activated in the same Chain Link as this card's activation.
It can be activated even during the Damage Step.

If this card is destroyed, this effect can be activated in the Graveyard if this card is sent to the Graveyard, or while banished if this card is banished face-up. (It can be activated where this card is first sent after being destroyed.)

name: Brutal Potion
desc: This card becomes an Equip Card, and equips to 1 monster you control. Once per turn, when you inflict damage to your opponent with a card effect, the equipped monster gains 1000 ATK until the End Phase.
rulings: The effect of "Brutal Potion" activates and starts a Chain when an effect inflicts damage.
The effect of "Brutal Potion" which activates when an effect inflicts damage can only give +1000 ATK. The +1000 ATK does not accumulate every time damage is inflicted.

name: Burst Breath
desc: Tribute 1 Dragon-Type monster; destroy all face-up monsters on the field whose DEF is less than or equal to the ATK the Tributed monster had on the field.

name: Byroad Sacrifice
desc: Activate only if a monster on your side of the field is destroyed by battle. Special Summon 1 "Cyber Ogre" from your hand.

name: Call of the Earthbound
desc: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: You choose the target of the attack.

name: Cemetary Bomb
desc: Inflict 100 damage to your opponent for each card in their Graveyard.

name: Chain Burst
desc: Each time a player activates a Trap Card, they take 1000 damage immediately after it resolves.

name: Chain Disappearance
desc: When a monster(s) with 1000 or less ATK is Summoned: Banish that monster(s) with 1000 or less ATK, then your opponent banishes all cards with the same name as that card(s) from their hand and Deck.
rulings: Suppose that a monster with 1000 or less ATK is Summoned. "Forbidden Lance" is activated in respond to the Summon targeting that monster and "Chain Disappearance" is chained to it. Chain resolves backwards. First, "Chain Disappearance" resolves and . Then, "Forbidden Lance" attempts to resolves, but its target is no longer on the field so it will resolve without effect.

When "Chain Disappearance" resolves, if the monster that was Summoned is no longer face-up on the field because a card like "Book of Moon" was activated in a Chain, then the Summoned monster is not banished. Therefore, monsters with the same name in the hand or Deck are not banished.

If you Normal Summon "Elemental HERO Wildheart" while your opponent controls "Ultimate Insect LV7" and your opponent activates "Chain Disappearance", then the "Elemental HERO Wildheart" on the field is not banished, so the copies of "Elemental HERO Wildheart" in the hand and Deck are not banished.

Suppose that a monster with 1000 ATK or less is Normal Summoned and "Chain Disappearance" is activated. If a card like "TG1-EM1" is Chained to "Chain Disappearance" so that control of the monster changes, then when "Chain Disappearance" resolves the opponent of the player who activated "Chain Disappearance" still banishes all copies of the monster from their hand and Deck.

"Chain Disappearance" can be activated even if a monster with 1000 ATK or less and a monster with more than 1000 ATK are Pendulum Summoned simultaneously. (In that case, only the monster with 1000 or less ATK is banished by the effect of "Chain Disappearance", and the "your opponent banishes all cards with the same name as that card(s) from their hand and Deck." is also applied.)

You can activate "Chain Disappearance" when a Fusion or Synchro Monster is Special Summoned. The Summoned monster will be banished, but cards with the same name from the Extra Deck are not banished. Therefore, "your opponent banishes all cards with the same name as that card(s) from their hand and Deck." is not applied. However, if the Special Summoned monster is "Neo-Spacian Marine Dolphin", since its name is also treated as "Neo-Spacian Aqua Dolphin", when "Chain Disappearance" resolves, "your opponent banishes all cards with the same name as that card(s) from their hand and Deck." is applied.

name: Chain Material
desc: Any time you Fusion Summon a monster this turn, you can remove from play, from your side of the field, Deck, hand or Graveyard, Fusion Material Monsters that are listed on the Fusion Monster Card, and use them as Fusion Material Monsters. You cannot attack during the turn this card is activated. If you used this effect for a Fusion Summon, the Summoned Fusion Monster(s) is destroyed during the End Phase.
rulings: This card does not target.
It cannot be activated during the Damage Step.

The card "Chain Material" itself does not have an effect that Fusion Summons. The turn that "Chain Material" is activated, when "Polymerization" etc. is activated and performs a Fusion Summon, you can apply the effect "you can remove from play, from your side of the field, Deck, hand or Graveyard, Fusion Material Monsters that are listed on the Fusion Monster Card, and use them as Fusion Material Monsters". (You can also Fusion Summon normally, without applying it.)

If you apply the effect "you can remove from play, from your side of the field, Deck, hand or Graveyard, Fusion Material Monsters that are listed on the Fusion Monster Card, and use them as Fusion Material Monsters", you choose and banish the whole chosen set of Fusion Materials using this effect. (You cannot apply the effect to only 1 of the Fusion Materials in the set.)
Applying "If you used this effect for a Fusion Summon, the Summoned Fusion Monster is destroyed during the End Phase" does not make a Chain Link.

If you activated "Chain Material", even when Fusion Summoning with the effect of "Super Polymerization" or "Fusion Gate" you can apply the effect of "Chain Material" to banish Fusion Materials from your hand, Deck, field, and/or Graveyard. Also, when Fusion Summoning with the effect of "Super Polymerization" by applying "Chain Material", you cannot banish a monster on your opponents field as a Fusion Material.

Unlike a normal Fusion Summon, using "The Eye of Timaeus" does not require you to use all of the listed Fusion Materials, and only the targeted monster is used as Fusion Material. Therefore, you cannot apply the effect of "Chain Material".

Since the Special Summon of the monster using the effect of "The Fang of Critias" or "The Claw of Hermos" is not treated as a Fusion Summon, you cannot apply the effect of "Chain Material" when resolving these effects.

The Fusion Materials required to Fusion Summon "Starving Venom Fusion Dragon" are 2 DARK monsters on the field, except Tokens. Therefore, even if you apply the effect of "Chain Material" when Fusion Summoning "Starving Venom Fusion Dragon", you must use Fusion Materials on your side of the field. (You cannot use monsters in your hand, Deck, or Graveyard for the Fusion Summon.)

If you are Fusion Summoning using the Pendulum Effect of "Performapal Trump Witch", you can apply the effect of "Chain Material". In this case, "you can remove from play, from your side of the field, Deck, hand or Graveyard, Fusion Material Monsters that are listed on the Fusion Monster Card, and use them as Fusion Material Monsters", but "the Summoned Fusion Monster is destroyed during the End Phase". Furthermore, because in the case in this question "Chain Material" has been activated, "You cannot attack during the turn this card is activated." is being applied.

When resolving the effect of "D/D Swirl Slime" in the hand, you can apply the effect "you can remove from play, from your side of the field, Deck, hand or Graveyard, Fusion Material Monsters that are listed on the Fusion Monster Card, and use them as Fusion Material Monsters" of "Chain Material". Even in this case, you must use the activated "D/D Swirl Slime" as one of the Fusion Materials. (All Fusion Materials are banished, also the effect "You cannot attack during the turn this card is activated. If you used this effect for a Fusion Summon, the Summoned Fusion Monster is destroyed during the End Phase" is applied.)

If you perform a Fusion Summon using the effect of "Soprano the Melodious Songstress", you can apply the effect of "Chain Material" and banish the appropriate Fusion Materials from your hand, Deck, field or Graveyard to perform the Fusion Summon. In that case, the Fusion Summoned "Melodious" Fusion Monster is destroyed during the End Phase. (Also, you cannot attack during the turn in which you activate "Chain Material".)

When resolving "Destruction Swordsman Fusion", you can apply the effect of "Chain Material". In that case, you choose and banish the Fusion Materials from your hand, your Deck, your field, and your Graveyard. You cannot use monsters on your opponents field as Fusion Materials.

When resolving "Particle Fusion", even if the Fusion Materials are banished, when the monster is Fusion Summoned you can target a banished Fusion Material. Additionally, when resolving "Particle Fusion", you can also apply the effect of "Chain Material".

When resolving the effect of "D/D Necro Slime" in the Graveyard, you can apply the effect "you can remove from play, from your side of the field, Deck, hand or Graveyard, Fusion Material Monsters that are listed on the Fusion Monster Card, and use them as Fusion Material Monsters" of "Chain Material". Even in this case, you must use the activated "D/D Necro Slime" as one of the Fusion Materials. (All Fusion Materials are banished, also the effect "You cannot attack during the turn this card is activated. If you used this effect for a Fusion Summon, the Summoned Fusion Monster is destroyed during the End Phase." is applied.)

You can apply the effect of "Chain Material" when resolving "D-Fusion". Even if this case, because you are Fusion Summoning using "D-Fusion", the Fusion Materials you choose and banish from your hand, Deck, field, and Graveyard must be "Destiny HERO" monsters.

The effect of "Chain Material" can be applied when resolving the effect of "Parallel World Fusion". Furthermore, you do apply the effect, you banish Fusion Materials from your hand, field, Deck, and Graveyard. (In that case, you may not Fusion Summon the Fusion Monster using the method "by shuffling your banished Fusion Materials listed on it into your Deck".)

If the effect of "Chain Material" is applying, when resolving the effect of "Metalfoes Fusion", rather than choosing and sending to the Graveyard monsters from your hand or field, you can Fusion Summon using "remove from play, from your side of the field, Deck, hand or Graveyard". In that case, you cannot apply the effect "You can use monsters you control equipped to this card you control as Fusion Materials for the Fusion Summon of a "Metalfoes" Fusion Monster that lists them as Materials." of "Fullmetalfoes Alkahest" and include equipped monsters as Fusion Materials.

If you resolve the effect of "Odd-Eyes Fusion" without applying the effect of "Chain Material", you can use Fusion Materials from your field or hand for the Fusion Summon. At this time, in the case that "your opponent controls 2 or more monsters and you control no monsters", you can also choose monsters in your Extra Deck. (Even in this case, because you activated Chain Material this turn, you cannot attack.) Furthermore, if you apply the effect of Chain Material, because you choose Fusion Materials by applying "remove from play, from your side of the field, Deck, hand or Graveyard", this time even if "your opponent controls 2 or more monsters and you control no monsters", you cannot use monsters from your Extra Deck. (In this case, since you Fusion Summoned by applying the effect of "Chain Material", the Fusion Monster is destroyed during the End Phase of this turn.)

name: Change of Hero - Reflector Ray
desc: When an "Elemental HERO" Fusion Monster you control is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to its original Level x 300.

name: Chaos Burst
desc: When your opponent's monster declares an attack: Tribute 1 monster, then target the attacking monster; destroy that target, then inflict 1000 damage to your opponent.
rulings: This card targets the attacking monster.
Tributing 1 monster you control is a cost to activate this card.
Destroying the attacking monster and inflicting damage are not considered to happen simultaneously.
If the targeted monster is in face-down Defense Position by the effect of "Book of Moon", the targeted monster is not destroyed. (No damage is inflicted.)

name: Chthonian Blast
desc: When a face-up monster you control is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: Destroy the 1 face-up monster on the field that has the lowest ATK (your choice, if tied), and if you do, inflict damage to both players equal to half of that monster's ATK.
rulings: It does not target.
It can also be activated if a monster is destroyed by battle or card effect and sent to the Graveyard during the Damage Step.
If a monster is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard by the effect of a card activated as Chain Link 2 or higher, "Chthonian Blast" cannot be activated.

The application of "Destroy the 1 face-up monster on the field that has the lowest ATK (your choice, if tied)" and the application of "inflict damage to both players equal to half of that monster's ATK" are considered to be performed at the same time.

The damage inflicted by the effect of "Chthonian Blast" is equal to half the destroyed monster's ATK on the field. Therefore, if the targeted monster is a "Beast King Barbaros" that was Normal Summoned without Tributing, since the targeted "Beast King Barbaros" has 1900 ATK on the field, each player takes 950 damage.

name: Chthonian Polymer
desc: Activate only when your opponent Fusion Summons a Fusion Monster. Tribute 1 monster to take control of that Fusion Monster.
rulings: Tributing one monster is a cost to activate this card.
The effect targets the opponent's Fusion Summoned Fusion Monster.

name: Clay Charge
desc: When an "Elemental HERO Clayman" you control is targeted for an attack (even if it is face-down, but reveal it to your opponent in that case): Destroy the attacking monster and that "Elemental HERO Clayman", and inflict 800 damage to your opponent.
rulings: It can be activated when an "Elemental HERO Clayman" in your Monster Zone is targeted for an attack. (It can be activated regardless of whether "Elemental HERO Clayman" is face-up or in face-down Defense Position.)
It does not target.

Not only can it be activated when an opponent's monster declares an attack targeting "Elemental HERO Clayman", but it can also be activated when an "Elemental HERO Clayman" is targeted for an attack due to a replay.
Destroying the attacking monster and attack target "Elemental HERO Clayman", and inflicting damage to your opponent are treated as being done at the same time.

name: Cloning
desc: When your opponent Normal or Flip Summons a monster that has a Level: Target that face-up monster; Special Summon 1 "Clone Token", with the same original Type, Attribute, Level, ATK, and DEF as that target. When that target is destroyed and sent to the GY, destroy this Token.
rulings: This card targets the monster that was Normal/Flip Summoned.
Token Monsters are treated as Normal Monsters.

The halved ATK by "Shrink" is treated as the monster's original ATK. Thus, when your opponent Normal Summons or Flip Summons a monster, if you activate "Cloning" and then "Shrink" is Chained and targets the Summoned monster, then the ATK of the "Clone Token" is equal to the ATK of the opponent's monster halved by "Shrink".
Since Xyz Monsters don't have any Level, you cannot target an Xyz Monster with "Cloning" or the effect of "Scanner".

name: Cocoon Veil
desc: Activate by Tributing 1 face-up "Chrysalis" monster. This turn, any damage to a player caused by an effect becomes 0. Special Summon 1 "Neo-Spacian" monster written on the "Chrysalis" monster you Tributed from your hand, Deck or from either player's Graveyard.
rulings: The effect does not target.
Tributing 1 face-up "Chrysalis" monster in your Monster Zone is a cost to activate this card.
This card cannot be activated during the Damage Step.

"Cocoon Veil" cannot be activated if you cannot perform the resolution of "Special Summon 1 "Neo-Spacian" monster written on the "Chrysalis" monster you Tributed, from your hand, Deck or from either player's Graveyard.".

name: Coffin Seller
desc: Each time a monster(s) is sent to your opponent's GY: Inflict 300 damage to your opponent.
rulings: The activation of the card "Coffin Seller" can be performed at any time, except during the Damage Step.
The effect "Each time a monster(s) is sent to your opponent's Graveyard: Inflict 300 damage to your opponent" makes a Chain Link. (It does not target.)
The effect of "Coffin Seller" cannot be activated in the same Chain Link as the activation of the card.

While "Coffin Seller" is face-up in the Spell & Trap Zone, each time a monster is sent to the opponent's Graveyard, the effect activates and makes a Chain Link. (It activates even during the Damage Step.)
If an Xyz Material of an Xyz Monster is detached and sent to the Graveyard as a cost, the effects of "Skull Invitation" and "Coffin Seller" will inflict damage.

name: Compulsory Evacuation Device
desc: Target 1 monster on the field; return that target to the hand.
rulings: There can be multiple chains in the Battle Step before entering the Damage Step. Only the initial chain can directly respond to the attack, and only in this Chain can you activate cards such as "Mirror Force", "Sakuretsu Armor", and "Magic Cylinder" (Cards that can only be activated when your opponent's Monster declares an attack). Cards that do not have this restriction ("Book of Moon", "Compulsory Evacuation Device", "Waboku", etc) can still be activated in another Chain before entering the Damage Step.
This card targets 1 monster on the Field.
It is possible to select a face-down monster as a target for this card.
When a Synchro Monster would be returned to the hand by "Compulsory Evacuation Device"/"The Warrior Returning Alive"/etc, it is instead returned to the Extra Deck.
If a Fusion Monster would be returned to the Hand by "Penguin Soldier"/"Compulsory Evacuation Device"/etc, then it is instead returned directly to the Extra Deck.
"Compulsory Evacuation Device": Resolving backwards, if "Compulsory Evacuation Device" returns "Judgment Dragon" to the hand, its effect is negated.

name: Counter Gem
desc: Send all cards in your Spell & Trap Card Zone to the Graveyard. Place as many "Crystal Beast" monsters as possible from your Graveyard in your Spell & Trap Card Zone, face-up, as Continuous Spell Cards. During the End Phase, destroy all face-up "Crystal Beast" cards you control.

name: Cross Counter
desc: If the DEF of an attacked Defense Position monster is higher than the ATK of your opponent's attacking monster, the Battle Damage inflicted to your opponent is doubled. Destroy the attacking monster after damage calculation.

name: Crystal Pair
desc: When a "Crystal Beast" monster you control is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: Place 1 "Crystal Beast" monster from your Deck face-up in your Spell & Trap Card Zone as a Continuous Spell Card, then you take no Battle Damage for the rest of this turn.

name: Curse of Anubis
desc: Change all Effect Monsters on the field to Defense Position. Until the end of this turn, the original DEF of those monsters becomes 0, also their battle positions cannot be changed.
rulings: This card cannot be activated during the Damage Step.
This card does not target.
This effect is not applied to monsters Summoned after this card's resolution.

name: Cursed Seal of the Forbidden Spell
desc: When a Spell Card is activated: Discard 1 Spell; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it, and if you do that, your opponent cannot activate Spell Cards with that name for the rest of this Duel.
rulings: Discarding 1 Spell Card is a cost to activate this card.
If the activation of a Pendulum Monster as a Spell Card is negated by "Cursed Seal of the Forbidden Spell", the use of cards with the same name as that Pendulum Monster become as follows.
It can be Normal Summoned.
It cannot be activated as a Spell Card in the Pendulum Zone.
The effects of that monster can be activated.
The Pendulum Effect of cards with the same name that are already in the Pendulum Zone can be activated.

name: Cyber Shadow Gardna
desc: During your opponent's Main Phase: Special Summon this card as an Effect Monster (Machine/EARTH/Level 4/ATK ?/DEF ?). (This card is also still a Trap.) When an opponent's monster declares an attack that targets this card: The ATK/DEF of this card become the ATK/DEF of the attacking monster. Once per turn, during your opponent's End Phase: Set this card in its Spell & Trap Zone.
rulings: If "Cyber Shadow Gardna" battles with "The Wicked Avatar", "Cyber Shadow Gardna"'s ATK becomes the same as "The Wicked Avatar", then "The Wicked Avatar"'s effect is applied and its ATK becomes "Cyber Shadow Gardna"'s +100. "Cyber Shadow Gardna"'s ATK does not change again.

name: Cyber Summon Blaster
desc: Each time a Machine monster(s) is Special Summoned, while this card is already face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone: Inflict 300 damage to your opponent.
rulings: The activation of only the card "Cyber Summon Blaster" can be performed at any time, except during the Damage Step.

The effect "Each time a Machine-Type monster(s) is Special Summoned: Inflict 300 damage to your opponent" makes a Chain Link. (It does not target. The effect activates each time a Machine-Type monster is successfully Special Summoned in either player's turn.)
If "Cyber Summon Blaster" is already face-up, the effect "Each time a Machine-Type monster(s) is Special Summoned: Inflict 300 damage to your opponent" will activate even during the Damage Step.
The effect "Each time a Machine-Type monster(s) is Special Summoned: Inflict 300 damage to your opponent" cannot be activated in the same Chain Link as the card "Cyber Summon Blaster".

name: Cybernetic Hidden Technology
desc: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: You can send to the Graveyard 1 "Cyber Dragon" you control, or 1 Fusion Monster you control that lists "Cyber Dragon" as a Fusion Material Monster, then target the attacking monster; destroy that target.
rulings: The activation of only the card "Prepare to Strike Back" can be performed at any time, except during the Damage Step.

The effect "When an opponent's monster declares an attack: You can send to the Graveyard 1 "Cyber Dragon" you control, or 1 Fusion Monster you control that lists "Cyber Dragon" as a Fusion Material Monster, then target the attacking monster; destroy that target" makes a Chain Link. (It targets the 1 opponent's monster that declared the attack.)

Sending a face-up "Cyber Dragon" or a Fusion Monster that lists "Cyber Dragon" as a Fusion Material to the Graveyard is a cost to activate the effect "destroy that target". (A face-down Defense Position monster cannot be sent to the Graveyard.)

If the card "Cybernetic Hidden Technology" is activated when an opponent's monster declares an attack, the effect "destroy that target" can be activated in the same Chain Link as the activation of the card.

name: D - Chain
desc: Target a "Destiny HERO" monster you control; equip this card to that target. It gains 500 ATK. When it destroys a monster your opponent controls by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

name: D - Counter
desc: When a "Destiny HERO" monster you control is targeted for an attack: Destroy the attacking monster.

name: D - Fortune
desc: When your opponent declares a direct attack: Banish 1 "Destiny HERO" monster from your Graveyard; end the Battle Phase.

name: D - Shield
desc: When an Attack Position "Destiny HERO" monster you control is targeted for an attack: Target it; change it to Defense Position and equip it with this card. The equipped monster cannot be destroyed by battle.
rulings: This card targets 1 Attack Position "Destiny HERO" monster you control.

This card can be activated when an Attack Position "Destiny HERO" monster you control is targeted for an attack, or when a Replay occurs and an Attack Position "Destiny HERO" monster you control is targeted for an attack.

If "D - Shield" is destroyed by a "Mystical Space Typhoon" activated in a chain, the targeted monster is still changed to Defense Position. (Since "D - Shield" is not treated as an Equip Card because it was destroyed by "Mystical Space Typhoon", the "The equipped monster cannot be destroyed by battle." effect is not applied.)

name: D - Time
desc: When a face-up "Elemental HERO" monster you control leaves the field: Add 1 "Destiny HERO" monster from your Deck to your hand whose Level is less than or equal to that "Elemental HERO" monster's original Level.
rulings: This card cannot be activated during the Damage Step.
This card does not target.
This card cannot be activated when a face-down Defense Position "Elemental HERO" monster you control leaves the field.

name: Damage = Reptile
desc: Once per turn, when you take Battle Damage from a battle involving a Reptile-Type monster, you can Special Summon 1 Reptile-Type monster from your Deck with ATK less than or equal to the Battle Damage you took.
rulings: The activation of only the card "Damage = Reptile" can be performed at any time, except during the Damage Step.
If you also activate its effect in the same Chain Link, you can activate the card "Damage = Reptile" after damage calculation.
The effect of "Damage = Reptile" activates after damage calculation and makes a Chain Link. (It does not target.)

This effect can not only be activated when a Reptile-Type monster you control battles and you take battle damage, but also when an opponent's Reptile-Type monster declares a direct attack and you take battle damage.

name: Damage Condenser
desc: When you take battle damage: Discard 1 card; Special Summon 1 monster from your Deck with ATK less than or equal to the battle damage you took, in face-up Attack Position.

name: Damage Polarizer
desc: Activate only when an effect that inflicts damage is activated. Negate its activation and effect, and each player draws 1 card.

name: Dark Cure
desc: When your opponent Summons a monster(s), they gain Life Points equal to half the ATK of 1 of the Summoned monsters of your choice.
rulings: The activation of only the card "Dark Cure" can be performed at any time, except during the Damage Step.
The effect "When your opponent Summons a monster(s), they gain Life Points equal to half the ATK of 1 of the Summoned monsters of your choice" makes a Chain Link. (It does not target.)

If "Dark Cure" is already face-up in the Spell & Trap Zone, the effect "they gain Life Points equal to half the ATK of 1 of the Summoned monsters of your choice" activates even during the Damage Step; however, a "Dark Cure" Set in the Spell & Trap Zone cannot be activated during the Damage Step.

The effect "they gain Life Points equal to half the ATK of 1 of the Summoned monsters of your choice" can be activated in the same Chain Link as the card; however, because the card "Dark Cure" cannot be activated during the Damage Step, the card and its effect cannot be activated in the same Chain Link during the Damage Step.

name: Dark Illusion
desc: When a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, is activated that targets a DARK monster on the field: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card.

name: Dark Mirror Force
desc: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Banish all Defense Position monsters your opponent controls.
rulings: Monsters are removed from play face-up (not face-down like "Different Dimension Capsule"), regardless of whether the monsters were face-up or face-down on the field.

name: Dark Renewal
desc: When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster(s): Target 1 of those monsters and 1 Spellcaster monster you control; send both monsters to the GY, then you can Special Summon 1 DARK Spellcaster monster from your Deck or GY.
rulings: This card target 1 monster that your opponent Normal or Special Summoned and 1 face-up Spellcaster-Type monster you control.
This card cannot be activated during the Damage Step.
This card cannot be activated when your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster by a card effect activated as Chain Link 2 or higher.

You choose whether to apply or not the "you can Special Summon 1 DARK Spellcaster-Type monster from your Deck or Graveyard." when the card resolves. (You can choose not perform the Special Summon. In that case, when the card resolves, only the 2 targeted monsters are sent to the Graveyard.)

name: Dark Scorpion Combination
desc: You can only activate this card when there are "Don Zaloog", "Cliff the Trap Remover", "Dark Scorpion - Chick the Yellow", "Dark Scorpion - Gorg the Strong", and "Dark Scorpion - Meanae the Thorn" face-up on your side of the field. During this turn, any of these 5 cards can attack your opponent's Life Points directly. In that case, the Battle Damage inflicted to your opponent by each of those cards becomes 400 points.
rulings: This card can only be activated if all of "Don Zaloog", "Dark Scorpion - Cliff the Trap Remover", "Dark Scorpion - Chick the Yellow", "Dark Scorpion - Gorg the Strong", and "Dark Scorpion - Meanae the Thorn" are on your field.
It cannot be activated during the Damage Step.
This effect does not target.
If a "Don Zaloog" etc. affected by the effect of "Dark Scorpion Combination" battles a monster or attacks directly, in either case the battle damage inflicted to the opponent becomes 400.

name: Dark Spell Regeneration
desc: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Target 1 Spell in your opponent's GY; Set it to your field. You can banish this card from your GY and send 1 "Monster Reborn" from your hand or Set on your field to the GY; Special Summon 1 "The Winged Dragon of Ra" from your GY ignoring its Summoning conditions, then you can send 1 monster your opponent controls to the GY, also send that Special Summoned monster to the GY during the End Phase.

name: Des Counterblow
desc: Destroy any monster that inflicts Battle Damage to a player's Life Points by attacking directly.
rulings: The activation of only the card "Des Counterblow" can be performed at any time, except during the Damage Step.
The effect "Destroy any monster that inflicts Battle Damage to a player's Life Points by attacking directly" makes a Chain Link. (It does not target.)

The effect "Destroy any monster that inflicts Battle Damage to a player's Life Points by attacking directly" always activates after damage calculation in which a monster inflicts battle damage to a player by a direct attack, and destroys that monster that inflicted the battle damage.

The card "Des Counterblow" cannot be activated in the same Chain Link as the effect "Destroy any monster that inflicts Battle Damage to a player's Life Points by attacking directly." (Unless "Des Counterblow" is already face-up in the Spell & Trap Zone, its effect cannot be activated.)

name: Destiny Mirage
desc: When a "Destiny HERO" monster you control is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard by an opponent's card effect: Special Summon, to your side of the field, all "Destiny HERO" monsters that were destroyed and sent to either Graveyard this turn.

name: Destiny Signal
desc: When a monster you control is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower "Destiny HERO" monster from your hand or Deck.
rulings: This card does not target.
This card can be activated when a monster you control is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard (at the end of the Damage Step).

name: Destruction of Destiny
desc: Send 3 cards from the top of your Deck to the Graveyard, and take 1000 damage for each Spell or Trap Card sent to the Graveyard this way.
rulings: This card cannot be activated during the Damage Step.
This card does not target.
This cannot be activated if you have 2 or less cards in your Deck.
"Send 3 cards from the top of your Deck to the Graveyard" is applied when the effect resolves. It is not a cost.
If 3 Spell/Trap Cards are sent to the Graveyard, you take 3000 damage.

name: Dimensional Prison
desc: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Target that attacking monster; banish that target.
rulings: This card targets 1 attacking monster.

You cannot choose to activate cards/effects like "Dimensional Prison" while "Imperial Iron Wall" is active. If "Imperial Iron Wall" is chained to such a card/effect, then no card is removed from play.

If "Book of Moon" is used on an attacking monster, then that monster is no longer considered to be an attacking monster. Thus, if "Book of Moon" is Chained to an effect like "Dimensional Prison" or "Sakuretsu Armor" and changes the monster to face-down Defense Position, then the effect of "Sakuretsu Armor" does not resolves, so the attacking monster is not destroyed (or removed from play, and so on).

If something like "Enemy Controller" or "TG1-EM1" is Chained to something like "Sakuretsu Armor" or "Dimensional Prison" so that control of the attacking monster changes, then the effect of "Sakuretsu Armor" does not destroy the attacking monster.

name: Divine Wrath
desc: When a monster effect is activated: Discard 1 card; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that monster.
rulings: Discarding 1 card is a cost to activate this card.
This card does not target.
This card cannot be chained to effects that activate in the Main Deck.

You can activate "Divine Wrath" and "Gladiator Beast War Chariot" during the Damage Step in Chain to an Effect Monster's effect. You can also activate these cards during Damage Calculation, for example, in Chain to the effect of "Honest".

Example: If a Flip Effect activates after "Ehren, Lightsworn Monk" returns the Flip Effect monster to the Deck, then "Divine Wrath" may be Chained to the Flip Effect. The Flip Effect will be negated, but the Flip Effect monster will not be destroyed and will remain in the Deck.

Example: If your Warrior-Type monster attacks an opponent's "Marshmallon", and "Divine Wrath" negates the activation of the damage-inflicting effect of "Marshmallon" and destroys "Marshmallon", then you can still Special Summon "Sword Master".

If you have five cards in your hand and the opponent has six cards in his hand, and afterwards the opponent activates "Divine Wrath" or the effect of "Honest", then when resolving the effect of "Divine Wrath" or "Honest" both players have five cards in their hands, so the effect of "The Fabled Unicore" is applied and the effect of "Divine Wrath" or "Honest" is negated.

name: Doble Passe
desc: When an opponent's monster declares an attack on a face-up Attack Position monster you control: Make your opponent's attack a direct attack instead and inflict damage to your opponent equal to the ATK of the attack target you control. Also, that monster you control can attack your opponent directly during your next turn.

name: Double Magical Arm Bind
desc: Tribute 2 monsters, then target 2 face-up monsters your opponent controls; take control of both targets until your End Phase.

name: Dragon's Rage
desc: Dragon-Type monsters you control inflict piercing Battle Damage when they attack a Defense Position monster.

name: Draining Shield
desc: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Target the attacking monster; negate that attack, and if you do, gain LP equal to that target's ATK.

name: Dramatic Rescue
desc: Activate only when a card is activated that targets an "Amazoness" monster. Return the targeted monster to its owner's hand and Special Summon 1 other monster from your hand.
rulings: It is possible to Special Summon a Level 5 or more Normal Summon monster.
You cannot Special Summon a Special Summon monster.

name: Drop Off
desc: When your opponent draws for their normal draw in their Draw Phase: Your opponent discards 1 card they just drew.

name: Edge Hammer
desc: Tribute 1 "Elemental HERO Bladedge" to target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy that target and inflict damage to your opponent equal to that target's original ATK.
rulings: Tributing 1 "Elemental HERO Bladedge" is a cost to activate this card.
You can Tribute 1 face-down "Elemental HERO Bladedge" to activate this card.
This card targets 1 monster your opponent controls.
You can target face-down monsters your opponent controls.
The damage inflicted is equal to the ATK written on the destroyed monster.

name: Elemental Absorber
desc: Remove from play 1 Monster Card in your hand to activate this card. Your opponent's monsters that have the same Attribute as the monster removed by this effect cannot declare an attack.
rulings: This effect cannot be activated during the Damage Step.
Banishing 1 monster from your hand is part of the effect. It is not a cost.
This effect cannot be activated more than once. (You can only banish 1 monster with this effect.)

name: Elemental Burst
desc: Tribute 1 each of WIND, WATER, FIRE, and EARTH monsters to activate this card. Destroy all cards on your opponent's side of the field.
rulings: This card cannot be activated during the Damage Step.
This card does not target.
Tributing 1 WIND, 1 WATER, 1 FIRE and 1 EARTH monster is a cost to activate "Elemental Burst". (You can Tribute face-down Defense Position monsters.)
"Elemental Burst" cannot be activated if your opponent controls no cards.

name: Elemental Recharge
desc: Gain 1000 Life Points for each face-up "Elemental HERO" monster you control.
rulings: This card does not target.
This card cannot be activated during the Damage Step.
When resolving this card, you gain 1000 Life Points for each face-up "Elemental HERO" monster you control.

name: Embodiment of Apophis
desc: During either player's Main Phase: Special Summon this card as a Normal Monster (Reptile-Type/EARTH/Level 4/ATK 1600/DEF 1800). (This card is also still a Trap Card.)
rulings: After the effect of "Calming Magic" has resolved, players cannot Special Summon monsters and cannot choose to activate effects which Special Summon monsters.
Neither player can activate effects like those of "Gorz the Emissary of Darkness", "Monster Reborn", "Embodiment of Apophis", etc.

name: Energy Drain
desc: Target 1 face-up monster you control; it gains 200 ATK/DEF for each card your opponent currently has in their hand, until the end of this turn.

name: Enervating Mist
desc: Your opponent's hand size limit becomes 5.

name: Eternal Dread
desc: Place 2 Clock Counters on each "Clock Tower Prison".
rulings: This card does not target.
This card cannot be chained to the activation of "Clock Tower Prison".

If this card is activated while both players control a "Clock Tower Prison" on their Field Zone, 2 Clock Counter are placed on each "Clock Tower Prison". (You cannot place Clock Counters on only 1 "Clock Tower Prison". You must place Clock Counters on both "Clock Tower Prison".)

name: Evil Blast
desc: Activate only when a monster is Special Summoned to your opponent's side of the field. Equip this card to that monster. It gains 500 ATK. During each of your opponent's Standby Phases, inflict 500 damage to your opponent.
rulings: "Evil Blast" targets the monster that you equip it to.
You cannot activate "Evil Blast" during the Damage Step.
When "Evil Blast" is equipped to a monster, you can switch it to a different monster with "Tailor of the Fickle."
The effect that deals damage starts a Chain.
You can activate "Evil Blast" even if multiple monsters are Special Summoned at the same time.

The effect "Activate only when a monster is Special Summoned to your opponent's side of the field. Equip this card to that monster. It gains 500 ATK. During each of your opponent's Standby Phases, inflict 500 damage to your opponent" resolves as the resolution of the activation of the card "Evil Blast". (It cannot be activated during the Damage Step.)
When "Evil Blast" is activated, it targets 1 face-up monster in the opponent's Monster Zone (the monster whose Special Summon allowed this card to meet its activation timing).
When a monster is Special Summoned in the opponent's Monster Zone by a card effect activated as Chain Link 2 or higher, "Evil Blast" cannot be activated.

At a point after "Evil Blast" has been treated as an Equip Card, the effect "During each of your opponent's Standby Phases, inflict 500 damage to your opponent" activates and makes a Chain Link. (It only activates once during each Standby Phase of the opponent of this card's controller. It does not target.)

If "Evil Blast" is already equipped to a monster by its effect, it cannot be equipped to a different monster using "Tailor of the Fickle". Only the monster targeted by the effect of "Evil Blast" is a correct target to be equipped with it.

name: Exchange of the Spirit
desc: If both players have 15 or more cards in their Graveyards: Pay 1000 LP; each player swaps the cards in their Graveyard with the cards in their Deck, then shuffles their Deck. You can only activate 1 "Exchange of the Spirit" per Duel.
rulings: This card cannot be activated during the Damage Step.
Paying 1000 Life Points is a cost to activate this card.
This card cannot be activated unless both players have 15 or more cards in their Graveyard. (It can be activated even if there are Fusion, Synchro or Xyz Monsters in the Graveyard.)
This card does not target.
"each player swaps the cards in their Graveyard with the cards in their Deck" and "shuffles their Deck" are considered to happen simultaneously.

This card can be activated even if 1 player has no cards in their Deck, as long as both players have 15 or more cards in their Graveyard. In this case, no cards are placed in the Graveyard and all cards from the Graveyard are shuffled into the Deck.
"each player swaps the cards in their Graveyard with the cards in their Deck" is not treated as sending cards to the Graveyard.
If the effect of "Macro Cosmos" or "Dimension Fortress Weapon" is being applied, this effect is applied normally.
If "Dandylion" is placed in the Graveyard, the effect of "Dandylion" is not activated.
When swapping the Decks and Graveyards, you cannot change the order of cards in the Graveyard.

If you have 5 cards in the Deck, ABCDE, from top to bottom, then after "Exchange of the Spirit" resolves, the card A will be placed in the bottom of the Graveyard, followed by the cards BCDE. (Card E that was at the bottom of the Deck is now at the top of the Graveyard.)

When resolving "Exchange of the Spirit", Fusion, Synchro and Xyz Monsters in the Graveyard are returned to the Extra Deck. (Extra Deck is not shuffled.) The other cards are placed into the Deck and shuffled normally.
When resolving "Exchange of the Spirit", even if either player has 14 or less cards in their Graveyard, the effect is applied normally.

name: Fatal Abacus
desc: Each time 1 monster is sent from the field to the Graveyard, inflict 500 points of damage per card to the respective card owner's Life Points.
rulings: In order to inflict damage, the card must be sent to the Graveyard, and it must be a Monster Card both on the field and in the Graveyard.

name: Feather Wind
desc: When a Spell/Trap Card is activated while you control a face-up "Elemental HERO Avian": Negate the activation and destroy it.
rulings: This card can be activated even during the Damage Step.
It does not target.
"Feather Wind" itself cannot be activated unless there is a face-up "Elemental HERO Avian" on your field.
It is activated directly in Chain to card activation of the Spell/Trap Card. (It cannot be activated in Chain to the activation of the effect of a Continuous Spell/Trap Card etc.)

name: Final Attack Orders
desc: All face-up monsters on the field are changed to Attack Position and their battle positions cannot be changed.
rulings: The "cannot change their Battle Position" by this card's effect refers to the player manually changing the monster's Battle Position.
If the monster targeted by "Black Rose Dragon"'s effect is changed to Attack Position by "Final Attack Orders", then you do not reduce the monster's ATK to 0.
"Great Poseidon Beetle" can attack once more only if it selected a monster in Attack Position as an attack target, and that monster was not destroyed by battle.

Example: "Final Attack Orders" is active and the opponent has a "Spirit Reaper" in face-down Defense Position. If "Great Poseidon Beetle" attacks that "Spirit Reaper", then "Great Poseidon Beetle" cannot attack once more, even though "Spirit Reaper" was changed to face-up Attack Position.

name: Final Fusion
desc: During either player's Battle Step, when a Fusion Monster you control battles an opponent's Fusion Monster: Target both those Fusion Monsters; negate the attack, and if you do, each player takes damage equal to the combined ATK of both those Fusion Monsters.

name: Firewall
desc: When your opponent declares a direct attack, you can negate that monster's attack by removing from play 1 Pyro-Type monster in your Graveyard. Pay 500 Life Points during each of your Standby Phases. If you do not, destroy this card.
rulings: It does not target.
This effect activates and creates a Chain Link when your opponent declares a direct attack.

name: Fossil Excavation
desc: Activate this card by discarding 1 card, then target 1 Dinosaur-Type monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target. Negate the effects of that monster on the field. When this card leaves the field, destroy that monster. When that monster is destroyed, destroy this card.

name: Fuh-Rin-Ka-Zan
desc:
When there are face-up WIND, WATER, FIRE and EARTH monster(s) on the field: Apply 1 of these effects.
● Destroy all monsters your opponent controls.
● Destroy all Spell and Trap Cards your opponent controls.
● Discard 2 random cards from your opponent's hand.
● Draw 2 cards.

name: Fusion Guard
desc: Activate only when an effect that inflicts damage is activated. Negate its activation and effect, and randomly send 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck to the Graveyard.
rulings: If you do not have cards in your Extra Deck, this card cannot be activated.

name: Gorgon's Eye
desc: Until the end of this turn, all effects of Defense Position monsters are negated.

name: Hallowed Life Barrier
desc: Discard 1 card from your hand. This turn, any damage you take from your opponent's cards and effects becomes 0.
rulings: This card cannot be activated during the Damage Step.
This card does not target.
Discarding 1 card is a cost to activate this card.
If the effect of "Hallowed Life Barrier" is being applied, monsters you control cannot be destroyed by battle.

name: Harpie's Feather Storm
desc: If you control a WIND Winged Beast monster: Until the end of this turn, negate any monster effects your opponent activates. If you control a "Harpie" monster, you can activate this card from your hand. If this card in its owner's Spell & Trap Zone is destroyed by an opponent's card effect: You can add 1 "Harpie's Feather Duster" from your Deck or GY to your hand.

name: Hate Buster
desc: When a Fiend-Type monster you control is targeted for an attack: Target the opponent's attacking monster and that monster you control; destroy both targets, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to the original ATK of the opponent's destroyed monster.

name: Hero Barrier
desc: Negate 1 attack from an opponent's monster. You must control a face-up "Elemental HERO" monster to resolve this effect.
rulings: The effects of "Hero Barrier" and "Necro Gardna" negate the first attack declared after the effect resolves. If multiple copies of "Hero Barrier" are activated, then the effects will all negate the next attack declared.

name: Hero Blast
desc: Target 1 "Elemental HERO" Normal Monster in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand, then if your opponent controls any monsters with ATK less than or equal to that target's ATK, destroy 1 of them.

name: Hero Counterattack
desc: When an "Elemental HERO" monster you control is destroyed by battle: Your opponent chooses and reveals 1 random card from your hand, then, if it is an "Elemental HERO" monster, you destroy 1 monster your opponent controls and Special Summon the chosen monster.
rulings: You can activate this card at the end of the Damage Step in which an "Elemental HERO" monster in your Monster Zone was destroyed by battle.
It does not target.
If you do not have an "Elemental HERO" monster in your hand, "Hero Counterattack" cannot be activated.
Applying "destroy 1 monster your opponent controls" and "Special Summon the chosen monster" are treated as being done at the same time.

name: Hero Medal
desc: When this Set card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard by an opponent's card effect, shuffle this card into its owner's Deck. Then draw 1 card.

name: Hero Ring
desc: Target 1 Warrior-Type monster with 1500 or less ATK; equip this card to that target. Monsters your opponent controls with 1900 or more ATK cannot attack that target.
rulings: The effect targets 1 face-up Warrior monster with 1500 or less ATK in the Monster Zone. (It can target not only a monster in your Monster Zone, but also a monster in your opponent's Monster Zone.)
It cannot be activated during the Damage Step.
During the Battle Step, if an opponent's monster with 1900 or more ATK attacks and you equip this card to your monster that was targeted for an attack, a replay occurs.

name: Hero Signal
desc: When a monster you control is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower "Elemental HERO" monster from your hand or Deck.
rulings: When "Torapart" is used for the Synchro Summon of a a Synchro Monster and that Synchro Monster attacks, Trap Cards cannot be activated even at the end of the Damage Step. The opponent cannot activate cards like "Hero Signal" which are activated at the end of the Damage Step.

If you control a monster that your opponent owns due to the effect of "Enemy Controller", if that monster is destroyed by battle on your side of the field and sent to the opponent's Graveyard, you can activate "Hero Signal".

name: Hero Spirit
desc: During the Battle Phase, if an "Elemental HERO" monster you controlled was destroyed by battle this turn: Make the Battle Damage from 1 of your opponent's monsters 0.
rulings: The effect does not target.
It cannot be activated during the Damage Step.

After "Hero Spirit" is activated, if the Battle Phase ends without an opponent's monster battling, the effect "Make the Battle Damage from 1 of your opponent's monsters 0" stops applying. (The effect only applies during the turn "Hero Spirit" was activated. The effect is not applied from the next turn onward.)
After "Hero Spirit" is activated, the first battle damage received from an opponent's monster becomes 0.

If the effect "Make the Battle Damage from 1 of your opponent's monsters 0" is applied, players take no battle damage from that battle. Also, in that case, if your monster would be destroyed by battle, that monster you control cannot be destroyed by that battle.

name: Hero's Rule 1: Five Freedoms
desc: Target up to 5 cards in any GY(s); banish them. If this card is in your GY, except the turn it was sent there: You can banish it, then target 1 of your banished "Elemental HERO" monsters; Special Summon it, ignoring its Summoning conditions. You can only use this effect of "Hero's Rule 1: Five Freedoms" once per turn.
rulings: [Regarding the effect "Target up to 5 cards in any GY(s); banish them."]
It is the effect that applies when this card's activation resolves.
It cannot be activated during the Damage Step.
Even if some of the targeted cards are no longer in the GY when the effect resolves, the effect is still applied to the remaining targeted cards.

[Regarding the effect "If this card is in your GY, except the turn it was sent there: You can banish it, then target 1 of your banished "Elemental HERO" monsters; Special Summon it, ignoring its Summoning conditions."]
It starts a Chain and can be activated in the GY.
It cannot be activated during the Damage Step.

name: Hero's Rule 2
desc: Negate the activation of a Spell, Trap, or Effect Monster's effect that targets a card(s) in the Graveyard, and destroy it.

name: Hidden Soldiers
desc: When your opponent Normal or Flip Summons a monster: Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower DARK monster from your hand.

name: Hope for the Future
desc: If you control a "Neos" Fusion Monster or "Elemental HERO Neos": Discard 1 card; Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck that mentions a "HERO" monster as material, using monsters from your hand, Deck, or field. If you control a "Neos" Fusion Monster: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 face-up card your opponent controls; negate its effects until the end of this turn. You can only use each effect of "Hope for the Future" once per turn.

name: Huge Revolution
desc: This card can only be activated during your Main Phase when "People Running About", "Oppressed People", and "United Resistance" are face-up on your side of the field. Send all cards in your opponent's hand to the Graveyard and destroy all cards your opponent controls on the field.

name: Human-Wave Tactics
desc: During the End Phase of each turn, select a number of Level 2 or lower Normal Monsters from your Deck equal to the number of your Level 2 or lower Normal Monsters destroyed as a result of battle during that turn, and Special Summon them to your side of the field. The Deck is then shuffled.
rulings: The activation of only the card "Human-Wave Tactics" can be performed at any time, except during the Damage Step.

The effect "During the End Phase of each turn, select a number of Level 2 or lower Normal Monsters from your Deck equal to the number of your Level 2 or lower Normal Monsters destroyed as a result of battle during that turn, and Special Summon them to your side of the field. The Deck is then shuffled" is an effect that makes a Chain Link. (The effect does not target. The effect activates only once per End Phase, during either player's turn.)

The effect "select a number of Level 2 or lower Normal Monsters from your Deck equal to the number of your Level 2 or lower Normal Monsters destroyed as a result of battle during that turn, and Special Summon them to your side of the field" always activates during the End Phase of either player's turn if at least 1 of your Level 2 or lower Normal Monsters was destroyed by battle that turn. (It will not activate during a turn that none of your Level 2 or lower Normal Monsters were destroyed by battle.)

The effect "select a number of Level 2 or lower Normal Monsters from your Deck equal to the number of your Level 2 or lower Normal Monsters destroyed as a result of battle during that turn, and Special Summon them to your side of the field" can only Special Summon a number of Level 2 or lower Normal Monsters equal to the number of your Level 2 or lower Normal Monsters destroyed by battle that turn. (If you cannot Special Summon the same number of monsters, the effect is not applied and you do not Special Summon any monsters.)

name: Hunting Instinct
desc: When a monster(s) is Special Summoned to your opponent's field (except during the Damage Step): Special Summon 1 Dinosaur monster from your hand.

name: Icarus Attack
desc: Tribute 1 Winged Beast-Type monster, then target 2 cards on the field; destroy them.
rulings: If "Icarus Attack" targets 1 Spell/Trap Card and 1 Monster Card, you can use "Carrierroid"'s effect to negate it.
When activating "Icarus Attack", you cannot target the same activated "Icarus Attack" as one of the cards to be destroyed.
You can Tribute a face-down Winged Beast-Type monster as an activation cost for "Icarus Attack".
When resolving the effect of "Icarus Attack", if one of the targeted cards is no longer on the field, then the card that is still on the field will still be destroyed.
If the effect of "Junk Collector" is activated by removing from play a Trap Card like "Icarus Attack" which targets, then you select the effect's target when the effect activates.

"Guard Mines" can only be activated directly in Chain to an effect which targets one monster. Thus, you cannot Chain "Guard Mines" to an effect like "Icarus Attack" or "Gladiator Beast Gyzarus" that targets multiple cards.

name: Interdimensional Matter Transporter
desc: Target 1 face-up monster you control; banish that target until the End Phase.
rulings: If "Light End Dragon"/"Dark End Dragon" activates its effect, and is then banished by "Interdimensional Matter Transporter", then the ATK/DEF decrease will disappear when "Light End Dragon"/"Dark End Dragon" return to the field.

If your "Elemental HERO Absolute Zero" is under your opponent's control, then when it is banished by "Dark Core" etc, it activates as your effect, and you destroy all monsters on your opponent's field. If it is banished temporarily with "Interdimensional Matter Transporter"/"Dimensionhole"/etc, then it is considered to be under your opponent's control while banished, so it activates as your opponent's effect and destroys all monsters on your field.
