When an ":/Assault Mode" monster is Special Summoned by "Assault Revival" and then banished by "Interdimensional Matter Transporter", the monster is treated as being banished by "Assault Revival". The monster remains banished, and does not return during the End Phase.

For the "Attack Position:" effect of "Morphtronic Scopen", destroying the monster during the End Phase does not start a Chain. If the Special Summoned monster is flipped face-down with "Book of Moon" or banished temporarily with "Interdimensional Matter Transporter", then the monster is not destroyed during the End Phase.

The increase to ATK from "Overdoom Line" lasts as long as the monster remains face-up on the field. If the monster is flipped face-down by "Book of Moon" or leaves the field by "Interdimensional Matter Transporter", then the increase to ATK is not reapplied.

If a Level 6 or higher monster is flipped face-down and then Flip Summoned, or if a Level 6 or higher monster is banished temporarily by an effect like "Interdimensional Matter Transporter", then the monster is still considered to have been Special Summoned. Thus, it will be affected by "Grave of the Super Ancient Organism", so it can neither activate its effects nor attack.

If your "Fortune Lady Light" is banished from your opponent's field permanently by an effect like "Dark Core", then you can activate its effect and Special Summon a "Fortune Lady" card from your Deck. If your "Fortune Lady Light" is banished from your opponent's field temporarily by an effect like "Interdimensional Matter Transporter" or "Dimensionhole", then your opponent controls "Fortune Lady Light" so they can activate its effect.

If "Beast King Barbaros" or "Fusilier Dragon, the Dual-Mode Beast" is Normal Summoned without Tributes and has its ATK/DEF changed, then if it is flipped face-down by an effect like "Book of Moon", then the effect which changes its ATK/DEF is no longer applied, so "Fusilier Dragon, the Dual-Mode Beast" returns to 2800/2000. Also, if it is banished by "Interdimensional Matter Transporter", then the effect which changes its ATK/DEF is no longer applied as soon "Fusilier Dragon, the Dual-Mode Beast" leaves the field, so "Fusilier Dragon, the Dual-Mode Beast" returns to 2800/2000.

If you gain control of an opponent's monster with an effect like "Brain Control" or "Enemy Controller" and then the monster is banished by "Interdimensional Matter Transporter", then after the monster returns to the field during the End Phase, your opponent still regains control of the monster. Also, if the monster is banished by "Dimensionhole", then during the Standby Phase the monster returns to the opponent's side of the field.

For effects like "Future Visions" and "Interdimensional Matter Transporter", when the banished monster is returned to the field the monster is not treated as being Special Summoned, so effects like "Torrential Tribute" may not be activated.

If an effect like "Book of Moon" or "Interdimensional Matter Transporter" is Chained to the effect of "Worm Bait" so that you do not have face-up on your side of the field when resolving the effect of "Worm Bait", then the "Worm Tokens" are still Special Summoned.

If "Battle Fader" is Special Summoned by its effect and then banished by an effect like "Interdimensional Matter Transporter", then "Battle Fader" is treated as being banished by its effect "banish this card when it leaves the field.", so during the next End Phase "Battle Fader" is not returned to the field and remains banished.

Suppose you banish "Malefic Blue-Eyes White Dragon" with a card like "Interdimensional Matter Transporter", and then Summon another "Malefic Blue-Eyes White Dragon", all while "Skill Drain" is active. During the End Phase, even though the effect "There can only be 1 face-up "Malefic" monster on the field." of the "Malefic Blue-Eyes White Dragon" on the field is negated, that effect of the banished "Malefic Blue-Eyes White Dragon" is still active, so the banished "Malefic Blue-Eyes White Dragon" cannot return to the field. Thus, the banished "Malefic Blue-Eyes White Dragon" is sent to the Graveyard.

name: Judgment of Anubis
desc: When your opponent activates a Spell Card that would destroy a Spell/Trap Card(s) on the field: Discard 1 card; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it, then you can destroy 1 face-up monster your opponent controls, and if you do that, inflict damage to your opponent equal to the destroyed monster's ATK on the field.
rulings: The effect does not target. You can activate "Judgment of Anubis" when your opponent controls no monsters.

name: Jurassic Impact
desc: If you control 2 or more Dinosaur monsters and your LP is lower than your opponent's: Destroy as many monsters on the field as possible, and if you do, take 1000 damage for each monster destroyed, then inflict damage to your opponent, equal to the damage you took. Until the end of the next turn after this card is activated, neither player can Normal or Special Summon.

name: Justi-Break
desc: Activate only when your opponent declares an attack against a face-up Normal Monster you control. Destroy all monsters on the field, except face-up Attack Position Normal Monsters.

name: Kid Guard
desc: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Tribute 1 "Hero Kid"; negate the attack, then add 1 "Elemental HERO" monster from your Deck to your hand.

name: Last Resort
desc: Activate only when your opponent's monster declares an attack. You can select 1 "Ancient City - Rainbow Ruins" from your Deck and activate it. If your opponent had an active Field Spell Card when this card was activated, they can draw 1 card.

name: Last Turn
desc: This card can only be activated during your opponent's turn when your Life Points are 1000 or less. Select 1 monster on your side of the field and send all other cards on the field and in their respective owners' hands to their respective Graveyards. After that, your opponent selects and Special Summons 1 monster from their Deck in face-up Attack Position and attacks your selected monster. (Any Battle Damage from this battle is treated as 0.) The player whose monster remains alone on the field at the End Phase of this turn wins the Duel. Any other case results in a DRAW.
rulings: A high-Level monster can also be Special Summoned, as long as it is a monster that can be Normal Summoned/Set.
The Special Summon from the Deck is performed in face-up Attack Position.
This card can be activated during your opponent's turn if your Life Points are 1000 or less.

name: Life Absorbing Machine
desc: During your Standby Phase, gain Life Points equal to half of the total Life Points you paid during your last turn.

name: Life Shaver
desc: You can only control 1 "Life Shaver". Once per turn, during your opponent's End Phase: Place 1 counter on this card. During the Main or Battle Phase, if this card has a counter(s) on it: You can send this card to the GY, then make your opponent discard as many cards as possible, up to the number of counters that were on this card.

name: Limit Reverse
desc: Target 1 monster with 1000 or less ATK in your Graveyard; Special Summon it in Attack Position. If the target is changed to Defense Position, destroy it and this card. When this card leaves the field, destroy the target. When the target is destroyed, destroy this card.
rulings: Monsters like "Fortune Lady Earth" do not have a defined ATK, so cards like "Magician's Circle" and "Limit Reverse" may not Special Summon them from the Deck or Graveyard.

If "Shield Worm" is Special Summoned by "Limit Reverse", then first the effect of "Shield Worm" resolves, switches "Shield Worm" to Defense Position, and sends cards from the opponent's Deck to the Graveyard; and afterwards the effect of "Limit Reverse" destroys "Shield Worm" and "Limit Reverse".

name: Loge's Flame
desc: While you control a "Valkyrie" monster, monsters your opponent controls with 2000 or less ATK cannot attack. If this card in your possession is destroyed by an opponent's card effect: You can Special Summon 1 Level 5 or higher "Valkyrie" monster from your hand or Deck.
rulings: You can activate this card at any time except during the Damage Step.

This card's effect that prevents your opponent's monsters with 2000 or less ATK from attacking does not start a Chain. (This effect applies while you have a face-up "Valkyrie" monster in your Monster Zone.)
This card's effect that Special Summons a Level 5 or higher "Valkyrie" monster from your hand or Deck starts a Chain. (It does not target, and can be activated during the Damage Step.)

name: Macro Cosmos
desc: When this card resolves: You can Special Summon 1 "Helios - The Primordial Sun" from your hand or Deck. While this card is face-up on the field, any card sent to the Graveyard is banished instead.
rulings: The effect of "Royal Oppression" can negate the activation of and destroy "Macro Cosmos", even though it is not known whether or not "Macro Cosmos" will Special Summon a "Helios - The Primordial Sun".

While an effect like that of "Banisher of the Radiance" or "Macro Cosmos" is active, it is impossible to discard a card to the Graveyard. The activation costs of the effects of "Jowgen the Spiritualist", "Abyss Soldier" and "Return of the Doomed" require you to discard a card to the Graveyard, which is impossible, so you cannot activate their effects. However, the activation costs of effects like "Magic Jammer" only require you to discard a card, so you can activate their effects since the card does not need to be discarded to the Graveyard.

While the effect of "Dimensional Fissure" or "Macro Cosmos" is active, you cannot activate effects which have "discard to the Graveyard" or "send to the Graveyard" as costs. Thus, you cannot activate the effect of "Honest" which increases ATK, since you cannot send it to the Graveyard as a cost.

"At the end of the Damage Step", as mentioned in the text of cards like "Legendary Jujitsu Master", occurs at the same time as "when the monster which is destroyed by battle is sent to the Graveyard". Or, if "Macro Cosmos" or "Banisher of the Radiance" is active, then this occurs at the same time as "when the monster which is destroyed by battle is removed from play".
If the effect of "Macro Cosmos" or "Banisher of the Light" is active, then your opponent cannot send a card from the Deck to the Graveyard, so he cannot declare an attack.

name: Magical Trick Mirror
desc: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Target 1 Spell in your opponent's GY; Set it to your field. You can banish this card from your GY and send 1 "Monster Reborn" from your hand or face-down field to the GY; Special Summon 1 "Obelisk the Tormentor" from your GY in Defense Position, and if you activated this effect during your opponent's turn, all monsters your opponent controls that can attack must attack that face-up monster, this turn, while you control it.

name: Magician's Circle
desc: When a Spellcaster monster declares an attack: Each player Special Summons 1 Spellcaster monster with 2000 or less ATK from their Deck in Attack Position.
rulings: You cannot activate "Magician's Circle" if you do not have any Spellcaster-Type monsters in your Deck.
Monsters like "Fortune Lady Earth" do not have a defined ATK, so cards like "Magician's Circle" and "Limit Reverse" may not Special Summon them from the Deck or Graveyard.

name: Magnet Force
desc: This turn, all monsters on the field whose original Types are Machine or Rock, are unaffected by your opponent's monster effects (except their own).

name: Malevolent Catastrophe
desc: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Destroy all Spell and Trap Cards on the field.
rulings: If you control "Ancient City - Rainbow Ruins" and a "Crystal Beast" card in your Spell/Trap Zone, when "Heavy Storm"/"Demise, King of Armageddon"/"Malevolent Catastrophe" would destroy the "Crystal Beast" card and "Ancient City - Rainbow Ruins" simultaneously, then "Ancient City - Rainbow Ruins" is not destroyed.
"Heavy Storm"/"Malevolent Catastrophe"/etc can be activated while "Field Barrier" is active, but the Field Spell Card will still not be destroyed.

If "Imperial Custom" is active and an effect like "Heavy Storm" or "Demise, King of Armageddon" or "Malevolent Catastrophe" would destroy all Spell and Trap Cards on the field, then "Imperial Custom" is destroyed, but all other face-up Continuous Trap Cards are not destroyed and remain on the field.

name: Malfunction
desc: Pay 500 Life Points. Negate the activation of a Trap Card and return it to its original position.
rulings: This card is activated in a Chain, directly in response to the activation of a Trap Card. It cannot be activated in response to the activation of the effect of a Trap Card.
Paying 500 Life Points is a cost for the activation of this card.
This card's effect does not target.
This card can be activated during the Damage Step.

If the opponent activates a "Raigeki Break" that is Set in their Spell & Trap Zones, and "Malfunction" is chained to it, "Raigeki Break" is placed face-down again in the Spell & Trap Zone. Can it be activated again during the same turn?
In this scenario, the "Raigeki Break" that is placed face-down due to the effect of "Malfunction" to "negate the activation of a Trap Card and return it to its previous state" is not treated as a card that was just Set. Therefore, the opponent can activate this "Raigeki Break" again during the same turn, discarding 1 card from their hand for its activation cost as usual.

I activate "Hero Barrier" from my hand during a turn in which the effect of "Bubble Illusion" - "You can activate 1 Trap Card from your hand this turn" - is being applied. Can my opponent chain "Malfunction" in response to the activation of that "Hero Barrier"?
"Malfunction" can be activated in response to the activation of a Trap Card activated from the hand due to the effect of "Bubble Illusion". In this scenario, when resolving the effect of "Malfunction" to "negate the activation of a Trap Card and return it to its previous state", "Hero Barrier" is returned to your hand.

name: Metal Reflect Slime
desc: Special Summon this card in Defense Position as an Effect Monster (Aqua/WATER/Level 10/ATK 0/DEF 3000). (This card is also still a Trap.) This card cannot attack.

name: Meteorain
desc: During this turn, when your monsters attack with an ATK that is higher than the DEF of your opponent's Defense Position monster, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points.
rulings: This card does not target.
This card cannot be activated during the Damage Step.
The effect of "Meteorain" is applied to all monsters you control during the turn it is activated. It is also applied to monsters that are Summoned after this card's activation.

name: Micro Ray
desc: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; that target's DEF becomes 0 until the end of this turn.
rulings: You can activate "Micro Ray" in the Damage Step.

name: Minefield Eruption
desc: Inflict 1000 damage to your opponent for each face-up "Mine Golem" on your side of the field. After that, destroy all face-up "Mine Golem"(s) on your side of the field.
rulings: It is not an effect that targets.
It can only be activated if there is 1 or more face-up "Mine Golem" in your Monster Zones.
It cannot be activated during the Damage Step.

The number of face-up "Mine Golem" in your Monster Zones determines the damage inflicted. ("Mine Golem" in the Spell & Trap Zones are not counted.) If damage is successfully inflicted, all face-up "Mine Golem(s)" in your Monster Zones and your Spell & Trap Zones are destroyed.
Inflicting damage to your opponent and the destroying of "Mine Golem(s)" do not occur simultaneously.

name: Miracle Kids
desc: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; that target loses 400 ATK for each "Hero Kid" in your Graveyard, until the End Phase.

name: Mirror Gate
desc: When an opponent's monster declares an attack targeting a face-up "Elemental HERO" monster you control: Switch control of the opponent's attacking monster with the targeted monster you control, then calculate damage. Control of both monsters switches back during the End Phase.
rulings: This card's effect does not target.

name: Mispolymerization
desc: Activate only when a Fusion Monster is Special Summoned. Return all face-up Fusion Monsters to their respective Extra Decks.

name: Muko
desc: Activate only when an effect of drawing card(s) is activated. Both players see the cards drawn by the effect and discard them all to the Graveyard.
rulings: This card cannot be activated during the Damage Step.
This card does not target.
This card can be activated in a Chain to a card effect that draws cards like "Pot of Greed".
This card cannot be activated in a Chain to a card effect that draws cards and perform other effects like "Graceful Charity".

Providing the effect "● Draw 2 cards." of "Pot of The Forbidden" is chosen to be activated, "Null and Void" can be activated in a Chain. (If the other effects are chosen, "Null and Void" cannot be activated in a Chain.) However, since "Null and Void" cannot be activated during the Damage Step, if the effect of "Pot of The Forbidden" activates during the Damage Step, "Null and Void" cannot be activated in a Chain.

name: Multiple Destruction
desc: If both players have 3 or more cards in their hand: Each player places their entire hand on the bottom of the Deck in any order, also you lose LP equal to the total number of cards returned to the Deck by this effect x 300 (min. 1), then each player draws 5 cards. You can only activate 1 "Multiple Destruction" per turn.
rulings: This effect does not target.
This card cannot be activated during the Damage Step.

The resolution of "Each player places their entire hand on the bottom of the Deck in any order, also you lose LP equal to the total number of cards returned to the Deck by this effect x 300 (min. 1)" and the resolution of "then each player draws 5 cards" are not treated as occurring at the same time.
The last thing considered to resolve is both players drawing cards at the same time for the resolution of "each player draws 5 cards".

Only the player that activated "Multiple Destruction" loses Life Points when resolving "Each player places their entire hand on the bottom of the Deck in any order, also you lose LP equal to the total number of cards returned to the Deck by this effect x 300 (min. 1)".
If either player does not have 5 or more cards in their Deck, "Multiple Destruction" cannot be activated.

When resolving "Multiple Destruction", even if either player has 2 or fewer cards in their hand (due to "Raigeki Break", "Full Salvo", etc.), its effect is still applied. Also, when resolving "Multiple Destruction", even if a player has 0 cards in their hand, the entire effect of "Multiple Destruction" is still applied. But note that if both players have 0 cards in their hand when "Multiple Destruction" resolves, the effect that returns cards to the Deck cannot be applied, so neither player draws 5 cards.

While the effect of "Protector of the Sanctuary" is applying, neither player can activate "Multiple Destruction". Also, when resolving the effect of "Multiple Destruction", if "Protector of the Sanctuary" has been Special Summoned, the part of the effect that returns both players' cards in their hands to the Decks and makes you lose LP is applied normally. However, only the controller of "Protector of the Sanctuary" will draw 5 cards afterward, and their opponent will not be able to draw any cards.

Even if you have an opponent's card in your hand due to the effect of "Exchange", you can activate "Multiple Destruction". When resolving the part of the effect that returns cards to the Deck, they are returned to their owner's Deck. (Therefore, the opponent's card that is in your hand by the effect of "Exchange" is returned to the bottom of your opponent's Deck.)

When resolving "Multiple Destruction", even if either player has 4 or fewer cards in their Deck (such as due to "Needlebug Nest"), the entire effect of "Multiple Destruction" is applied normally. In addition, even if a player has 4 or fewer cards left in their Deck after the effect of "Multiple Destruction" returns cards to the bottom of the Deck, if they are unable to draw 5 cards, they lose the Duel.

Even if the effect of "Multiple Destruction" would make your Life Points become 0, you can still activate it. (If you have 3 cards in your hand and your opponent has 5 cards in theirs, and your Life Points are 2000, you will lose 2400 Life Points and lose the Duel.) In addition, if the effect of "Multiple Destruction" makes your Life Points 0, the Duel ends at that point, and both players do not draw 5 cards.

If you activate "Multiple Destruction" while there are 3 cards in my hand and 5 cards in your opponent's hand, firstly, each player returns their entire hand to the bottom of the Deck in any order. (In this scenario, if you are the turn player, you start by placing the 3 cards in your hand on the bottom of the Deck in the order you choose. Then, your opponent places the 5 cards in their hand on the bottom of the Deck in the order they choose.) Then, you lose Life Points equal to the total number of cards returned to the Deck this way × 300. (In this situation, since a total of 8 cards were returned to the Deck, you will lose 2400 Life Points.) Finally, each player draws 5 cards from their respective Decks.

name: Natural Disaster
desc: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent each time a card(s) they control is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard by the effect of a "Cloudian" monster.
rulings: The activation of only the card "Natural Disaster" can be done at any time except during the Damage Step.
This effect does not target.

The effect "Inflict 500 damage to your opponent each time a card(s) they control is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard by the effect of a "Cloudian" monster." uses a Chain Link. (It activates even during the Damage Step.)

The effect "Inflict 500 damage to your opponent each time a card(s) they control is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard by the effect of a "Cloudian" monster." cannot be activated at the same time as the card "Natural Disaster". If "Natural Disaster" is already face-up in the Spell & Trap Zone, when an opponent's card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard by the effect of a "Cloudian" monster, its effect will activate.

name: Nightmare Wheel
desc: Activate this card by targeting 1 monster your opponent controls; it cannot attack or change its battle position. When it leaves the field, destroy this card. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent. That monster must be on the field to activate and to resolve this effect.
rulings: The activation of the card "Nightmare Wheel" can be performed at any time, except during the Damage Step.
When the card "Nightmare Wheel" is activated, it targets 1 monster your opponent controls. (It can also target face-down Defense Position monsters.)

The effect "it cannot attack or change its battle position. When it leaves the field, destroy this card." does not start a Chain Link. ("When it leaves the field, destroy this card." is also applied during the Damage Step.)

The effect "During each of your Standby Phases: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent. That monster must be on the field to activate and to resolve this effect." starts a Chain Link. (It does not target. It is activated once during each of your Standby Phases.)

name: No Entry!!
desc: Change all Attack Position monsters to Defense Position.

name: Non Aggression Area
desc: You can only activate this card during your Standby Phase. Discard 1 card from your hand. Your opponent cannot Normal Summon, Set and/or Special Summon during his/her next turn.

name: Non-Fusion Area
desc: Neither player can Fusion Summon.
rulings: When "Non-Fusion Area" has been activated, the Spell Card "Polymerization" cannot be activated.

You can activate "Future Fusion" while the effect of "Non-Fusion Area" applies on the field. However if "Non-Fusion Area"'s effect is applied during the second Standby Phase after "Future Fusion"'s activation, you cannot Special Summon the Fusion Monster.

Furthermore, after "Future Fusion" has been activated and before the second Standby Phase the effect of "Non-Fusion Area" has stopped applying, it is possible to Special Summon the Fusion Monster during the second Standby Phase.
The Special Summons of "Ritual Beast Ulti-Apelio" or "Chimeratech Fortress Dragon" are not Fusion Summons; therefore, they can be Special Summoned while "Non-Fusion Area" is applying.

name: Nutrient Z
desc: During damage calculation, when you are about to take 2000 or more battle damage: Gain 4000 LP first.

name: Ojama Trio
desc: Special Summon 3 "Ojama Tokens" (Beast-Type/LIGHT/Level 2/ATK 0/DEF 1000) to your opponent's field in Defense Position. They cannot be Tributed for a Tribute Summon, and each time 1 is destroyed, its controller takes 300 damage.

name: Ordeal of a Traveler
desc: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Your opponent chooses 1 random card in your hand and calls the type of the card (Monster, Spell, or Trap), and if they call it wrong, return the attacking monster to the hand.
rulings: This effect does not target.
This card's effect cannot be activated if you have no hand.

name: Over Limit
desc: Pay 500 Life Points. Special Summon from both players' Graveyards as many Normal Monsters as possible with 1000 or less ATK that were destroyed by battle this turn.

name: Penalty Game!
desc:
When your opponent has 4 cards in their hand: Activate 1 of these effects.
● Your opponent cannot draw during their next Draw Phase.
● Your opponent cannot activate Spell/Trap Cards this turn.

name: Pikeru's Circle of Enchantment
desc: Damage to you from card effects becomes 0 until the end of this turn.

name: Power Wall
desc: During damage calculation, when you would take battle damage from an opponent's attacking monster: Send 1 card from the top of your Deck to the Graveyard for every 500 damage (round up) you are about to take, also you take no battle damage from that battle.
rulings: It does not target.

When the effect of "Power Wall" resolves, in order to make the battle damage the player takes 0, send 1 card from the top of the player's Deck for each 500 damage. (In the case of 2000 battle damage, 4 cards are sent from the Deck to the Graveyard.)

If the player cannot send cards from their Deck to the Graveyard in order to make the battle damage they are about to take 0, "Power Wall" cannot be activated. (In the case of 2000 battle damage, because it is necessary to send 4 cards from the Deck to the Graveyard, "Power Wall" cannot be activated if there are 3 or fewer cards in the player's Deck.)

Even when the player would take less than 500 battle damage, "Power Wall" can be activated. (1 card is sent from the top of the Deck to the Graveyard, and the battle damage becomes 0.) However, when the player would take 0 battle damage, "Power Wall" cannot be activated.

The opponent's "Ebon Illusion Magician" with 2500 ATK attacks the player's face-up Attack Position "Cyber Dragon Core" with 400 ATK. As Chain Link 1 during damage calculation, the opponent activates the monster effect "During damage calculation (in either player's turn), if your other DARK Spellcaster-Type monster battles an opponent's monster: You can send this card from your hand or face-up from your field to the Graveyard; that monster you control gains 2000 ATK and DEF during that damage calculation only" of "Apprentice Illusion Magician". Even in this case, the player can activate "Power Wall". In that case, when "Power Wall" resolves, the battle damage the player would take in the current state is 2100, so they send 5 cards from the top of their Deck to the Graveyard. Then, when the effect of "Apprentice Illusion Magician" is applied, the opponent's "Ebon Illusion Magician" gains 2000 ATK and DEF, but the battle damage the player would take has already been reduced to 0 so they take no damage. ("Cyber Dragon Core" is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard normally.)
When the effect of "Power Wall" is applied, the battle damage the player would take becomes 0, but the player's monster can still be destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard normally.

The opponent's "Ebon Illusion Magician" with 2500 ATK attacks the player's face-up Attack Position "Cyber Dragon Core" with 400 ATK. As Chain Link 1 during damage calculation, the player activates "Power Wall". The opponent chains the effect "During damage calculation (in either player's turn), if your other DARK Spellcaster-Type monster battles an opponent's monster: You can send this card from your hand or face-up from your field to the Graveyard; that monster you control gains 2000 ATK and DEF during that damage calculation only" of "Apprentice Illusion Magician". In this scenario, when the effect of "Apprentice Illusion Magician" is applied, the opponent's "Ebon Illusion Magician" gains 2000 ATK and DEF. Then, when "Power Wall" resolves, the battle damage the player would take in the current state is 4100, so they send 9 cards from the top of their Deck to the Graveyard. The player takes no battle damage from this battle, but "Cyber Dragon Core" is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard normally. Note that when resolving the effect of "Power Wall" in this scenario, if the player has fewer than 9 cards in their Deck, they cannot send any cards from the top of their Deck to the Graveyard, so they take 4100 damage normally.
While the effect of "Waboku" is applying, the player takes no battle damage from the opponent's monsters. Therefore, they cannot activate "Power Wall" during damage calculation that turn.

Even while "Macro Cosmos" is applying, "Power Wall" can be activated. In that case, the cards that would be sent to the Graveyard by "Send 1 card from the top of your Deck to the Graveyard for every 500 damage (round up) you are about to take, also you take no battle damage from that battle" are all banished, but the battle damage from that battle becomes 0 as normal.

If the opponent's face-up Attack Position "Reaper of the Cards" with 1380 ATK declares a direct attack and the player activates "Power Wall", since the battle damage they would take is 1380, they must send 3 cards from the top of their Deck to the Graveyard to reduce that damage to 0.

If the opponent's Attack Position "Amazoness Swords Woman" (1500 ATK) attacks the player's face-up Attack Position "Cyber End Dragon" (4000 ATK), since the monster effect "Your opponent takes all Battle Damage that you would have taken from a battle involving this card" of the opponent's "Amazoness Swords Woman" would make the player take the battle damage instead of the opponent, the player can activate "Power Wall". In that case, when resolving the effect of "Power Wall", since the battle damage they would take is 2500, they send 5 cards from the top of their Deck to the Graveyard. (Although the effect of "Power Wall" reduces the battle damage to 0, the opponent's "Amazoness Swords Woman" is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard.)

If "Performage Trapeze Magician" is in face-up Attack Position in the player's Monster Zone and is attacked by "Performapal Odd-Eyes Metal Claw", the effect of "Performage Trapeze Magician" makes any damage the player would take that is less than or equal to its current ATK of 2500 become 0. Since the battle damage they would take from the opponent’s attacking "Performapal Odd-Eyes Metal Claw" is 0 in this case, they cannot activate "Power Wall".

name: Pyro Clock of Destiny
desc: Move the turn count forward by 1 turn. The turn in which this card is activated continues as normal.
rulings: The effect does not target.
It cannot be activated during the Damage Step.
Cards that apply their effect for 3 turns after activation, like "Deck Devastation Virus", are cards that count turns.
Cards that resolve when the 2nd Standby Phase after activation is reached, like "Gold Sarcophagus", are not cards that count turns.
Based on the OCG text, "Pyro Clock of Destiny" only affects the turn count of one card.

name: Rain Storm
desc:
Select 1 "Cloudian" monster you control. Reduce that monster's ATK by 1000 or 2000 points, and apply the appropriate effect:
● 1000 points: Destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card your opponent controls.
● 2000 points: Destroy 2 cards your opponent controls.
rulings: The ATK decrease of "Rain Storm" lasts as long as the monster remains face-up on the field.

name: Rainbow Gravity
desc: If you have 7 "Crystal Beast" cards with different names on the field or in your Graveyard: Special Summon 1 "Ultimate Crystal" monster from your Deck or Graveyard, ignoring the Summoning conditions.
rulings: The effect of "Rainbow Gravity" does not target.

name: Rainbow Life
desc: Discard 1 card. Until the end of this turn, whenever you would take damage you gain that amount of Life Points instead.

name: Rainbow Path
desc: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Send 1 "Crystal Beast" card from your Spell & Trap Card Zone to the Graveyard to target the attacking monster; negate the attack, then you can add 1 "Rainbow Dragon" or "Rainbow Dark Dragon" from your Deck to your hand.

name: Rare Metalmorph
desc: Activate this card by targeting 1 Machine-Type monster on the field; it gains 500 ATK. Once, negate a Spell effect that targets that monster. When that monster leaves the field, destroy this card.
rulings: You can activate this card's effect during the Damage Step.

name: Rebirth Judgment
desc: Once per turn: You can declare 1 Monster Type; monsters in the GYs become that Type for the rest of this turn (even if this card leaves the field).

name: Red-Eyes Burn
desc: If a face-up "Red-Eyes" monster(s) you control, except "Red-Eyes B. Chick", is destroyed by battle or card effect: Target 1 of those monsters; both players take damage equal to its original ATK. You can only activate 1 "Red-Eyes Burn" per turn.

name: Red-Eyes Spirit
desc: Target 1 "Red-Eyes" monster in your GY; Special Summon it.

name: Relay Soul
desc: Special Summon 1 monster from your hand. While it is face-up on your side of the field, you take no damage. When it leaves the field, your opponent wins the Duel.
rulings: This effect does not target.
This card cannot be activated during the Damage Step.
The player who activated this card takes no damage, but their monsters are destroyed by battle normally.
Applying "When it leaves the field, your opponent wins the Duel." does not start a Chain Link.

name: Relieve Monster
desc: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Target 1 monster you control; return that target to the hand, then Special Summon 1 Level 4 monster from your hand.
rulings: This effect targets 1 monster in your monster zone. (It is possible to target a monster that is in face-down defence position.)
"Return that target to the hand" and "Special Summon 1 Level 4 monster from your hand" are considered to happen simultaneously.
If you target 1 Level 4 monster on your field and return it to your hand, you can choose to Special Summon that same Level 4 monster from your Hand.
You cannot activate this card if you do not have a Level 4 monster in your Hand.

name: Return Soul
desc: Activate only during the End Phase. You can return up to 3 monsters destroyed this turn from the Graveyard to their owners' Decks.

name: Return from the Different Dimension
desc: Pay half your Life Points; Special Summon as many of your banished monsters as possible. During the End Phase, banish all monsters that were Special Summoned by this effect.
rulings: "Return from the Different Dimension" can be activated while "Imperial Iron Wall" is active, and the monsters Special Summoned in this way stay on the field, instead of being removed from play again or sent to the Graveyard during the End Phase.

If "Return from the Different Dimension" etc is chained to "Scanner" so that the targeted monster is no longer removed from play when the effect of "Scanner" resolves, then "Scanner" resolves without effect. "Scanner" does not gain the ATK/DEF/Name/etc of the monster, and it is not removed from play when it leaves the field.
If the effect of "Junk Collector" is activated by removing from play a Trap Card like "Return from the Different Dimension" which has a cost, then you do not pay the removed card's cost.

You cannot Special Summon a Synchro Monster if it was not properly Synchro Summoned previously, such as if it was removed from play directly from the Extra Deck. Thus, you cannot use an effect like "D.D.R. - Different Dimension Reincarnation" or "Return from the Different Dimension" to Special Summon a "Stardust Dragon" which was removed from play to Special Summon "Malefic Stardust Dragon". Also, "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" and "Red-Eyes B. Dragon" are Normal Summon monsters, so they may be Special Summoned even if they are removed from play directly from the Deck.
Even if the effect of "Infestation Pandemic" is applied on monsters Special Summoned by the effect of "Return from the Different Dimension", they are still banished during the End Phase.

name: Reversal of Fate
desc: Select 1 "Arcana Force" monster you control. That monster's effect is now treated as the opposite coin toss result.
rulings: The effect targets 1 face-up "Arcana Force" monster on the field.

name: Rite of Spirit
desc: Target 1 "Gravekeeper's" monster in your GY; Special Summon that target. This card's activation and effect are unaffected by "Necrovalley".
rulings: This card targets 1 "Gravekeeper's" monster in your Graveyard.
This card cannot be activated during the Damage Step.

name: Rivalry of Warlords
desc: Each player can only control 1 Type of monster. Send all other face-up monsters they control to the GY.
rulings: “Rivalry of Warlords” and “Gozen Match” are Continuous Trap Cards that make it so you can only control face-up monsters of 1 Type (for Rivalry) or 1 Attribute (for Gozen).

When this Trap Card’s activation resolves, look at the face-up monsters you control. If they all have the same Type/Attribute, you don’t have to do anything else. If there are different Types/Attributes, you choose 1 Type/Attribute to keep, and send your face-up monsters that aren’t that Type/Attribute to the Graveyard.
While Rivalry/Gozen is active and you have a face-up monster, you cannot Summon monsters that are a different Type/Attribute from the monster(s) you already control.
So you can’t do any of the following to put a monster with the wrong Type/Attribute on your side of the field:
Normal Summon
Tribute Summon
Flip Summon
Xyz Summon
Synchro Summon
Fusion Summon
Special Summon with a monster’s own effect.

Activate a card or effect that can only Special Summon monsters of the wrong Type/Attribute (including effects that could theoretically Summon anything, but currently cannot, such as “Monster Reborn” when you control Spellcasters but the only monsters in the Graveyard are Zombies).

While Rivalry/Gozen is active, you can still Set monsters of any Type/Attribute, and you can Special Summon monsters of the wrong Type/Attribute face-down. But you can’t Flip Summon them afterwards, and they’re sent to the Graveyard after damage calculation if your opponent attacks them. (Also, in that case, you won’t get the effects of cards that need to be destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, because they’re sent to the Graveyard by the Trap Card’s effect instead. But Flip Effects will still activate.)
You can activate cards and effects that would Summon the same Type/Attribute monster as you have on the field.
You can also activate cards that would Summon more than one Type/Attribute of monster. The results depend on what you have on the field:

The same rule applies to the “Gladiator Beast” monsters. You can return a Gladiator Beast to your Deck and activate its effect as long as there is another Gladiator Beast in your Deck that you COULD Summon that is the same Type/Attribute as the one you returned. However, if you have no face-up monsters when the effect resolves, you can Summon any Type/Attribute of monster.
You can take control of an opponent’s monster that’s the wrong Type/Attribute with a card like “Mind Control.” If you do, it’s sent to the Graveyard immediately after you gain control of it.

If you control no face-up monsters, you can Summon a monster of any Type/Attribute. Also, if Rivalry/Gozen is being negated, you can Summon monsters of any Type/Attribute. If it stops being negated, you have to send monsters to the Graveyard until you control only 1 Type/Attribute again, just like if Rivalry/Gozen had just resolved.
The cards that are "sent to the Graveyard" are not treated as "destroyed".
Monsters with different Type than those that are face-up on the Field cannot be Special Summoned or Normal Summoned in a face-up position.
Even if this card's effect is applied, it is possible to Normal Set and to Special Summon monsters in face-down Defense Position.
If the monster that is flipped face-up has a different Type than the monster(s) that were face-up on the Field, the flipped face-up monster is sent to the Graveyard.
Sending the monster(s) with a different Type to the Graveyard does not start a Chain Link.
While your opponent controls an active "Rivalry of Warlords" and you control a non-Fiend-Type monster, you cannot send "Rivalry of Warlords" to the Graveyard to Special Summon "Trap Eater".

If "Rivalry of Warlords" is active and you only control Warrior-Type monsters, then you can neither Normal Summon nor Flip Summon any non-Warrior-Type monsters. Furthermore, you cannot activate any effect that would Special Summon any non-Warrior-Type monsters.

If "Rivalry of Warlords" is active and you only control Warrior-Type monsters, then when a Spellcaster-Type monster is flipped by battle or by an effect like "Swords of Revealing Light", the flipped monster is sent to the Graveyard.

If "Rivalry of Warlords" is active, then you can only activate the effect of "Gladiator Beast Laquari" to Special Summon a "Gladiator Beast" monster if you have another Beast-Warrior-Type "Gladiator Beast" monster in your Deck; you cannot activate the effect if you do not have any Beast-Warrior-Type "Gladiator Beast" monsters in your Deck. Also, if "Gladiator Beast Laquari" is returned to the Deck and you control no other face-up monsters, then you can Special Summon a Rock-Type monster like "Gladiator Beast Hoplomus.

While "Rivalry of Warlords" is active, when "Creature Swap" is activated, players may exchange monsters of different Types. After a monster switches control, if its new controller also controls a monster of a different Type, then the monster which switched control is sent to the Graveyard. However, if you only control one monster after the monsters switch control, then you only control one Type of monster, so the monster whose control you gained is not sent to the Graveyard.

Since "Ninjitsu Art of Super-Transformation" can only Special Summon Dragon, Dinosaur or Sea Serpent-Type monsters, if "Rivalry of Warlords" is active, you cannot activate "Ninjitsu Art of Super Transformation".

name: Rock Bombardment
desc: Send 1 Rock monster from your Deck to the GY; inflict 500 damage to your opponent.
rulings: Sending 1 Rock-Type monster from your Deck to the Graveyard is a cost to activate "Rock Bombardment".
"Rock Bombardment" cannot be activated during the Damage Step.
This card does not target.
When "Rock Bombardment" resolves, inflicting damage to your opponent is considered to be the last thing to happen.

name: Roll Out!
desc: Target 1 Union monster in your Graveyard; equip that target to a monster you control that would be an appropriate target for that Union monster's effect.
rulings: The effect targets 1 Union monster in your Graveyard.
It cannot be activated during the Damage Step.
If "Roll Out!" is activated, other than the targeted Union monster in the Graveyard, must also have an appropriate equip target for that Union monster face-up in your Monster Zone.
It does not target "a monster you control that would be an appropriate target for that Union monster's effect".

You activate the second effect of "Union Hangar" by targeting "Y-Dragon Head", then "Roll Out!" is chained, equipping another Union monster from the Graveyard to "Y-Dragon Head". If the Union monster targeted with "Roll Out!" is a monster such as "Buster Blaster" with the text "A monster can only be equipped with 1 Union monster at a time", so that the monster being equipped with it cannot be equipped with a second Union monster, the effect of "Union Hangar" is not applied. (No Union monster is chosen from your Deck.) Note that if the Union monster targeted with "Roll Out!" is a monster such as "Heavy Mech Support Platform", which does not have the same limitation, the effect of "Union Hangar" is applied normally.

Even if a Union monster was equipped by the effect of "Union Hangar", so that it cannot be Special Summoned this turn, if another Union monster was equipped by "Roll Out!", then "Combination Attack" can be activated. If "B-Buster Drake" is equipped to "A-Assault Core" by the effect of "Union Hangar", and in the same turn "C-Crush Wyvern" is also equipped to "A-Assault Core" by "Roll Out!", you can target "A-Assault Core" with "Combination Attack", and in that case, only "C-Crush Wyvern" will be Special Summoned and "A-Assault Core" is able to attack again ("B-Buster Drake" remains equipped to "A-Assault Core").

name: Rope of Life
desc: When a monster(s) is destroyed by battle and sent to your GY: Discard your entire hand (min.1), then target 1 of those monsters; Special Summon it, and if you do, it gains 800 ATK.
rulings: This card can be activated at the end of the Damage Step in which a monster was destroyed by battle and sent to your Graveyard.
Discarding your entire hand is an activation cost. (You cannot activate "Rope of Life" if you have no cards in your hand.)
The effect targets 1 monster that was destroyed by battle and sent to your Graveyard.
Even if a monster that you own is destroyed by battle in your opponent's Monster Zone and sent to your Graveyard, you can activate "Rope of Life" by targeting that monster.

name: Sakuretsu Armor
desc: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Target the attacking monster; destroy that target.
rulings: There can be multiple chains in the Battle Step before entering the Damage Step. Only the initial chain can directly respond to the attack, and only in this Chain can you activate cards such as "Mirror Force", "Sakuretsu Armor", and "Magic Cylinder" (Cards that can only be activated when your opponent's Monster declares an attack). Cards that do not have this restriction ("Book of Moon", "Compulsory Evacuation Device", "Waboku", etc) can still be activated in another Chain before entering the Damage Step.
As long as you are properly chaining cards with appropriate Spell Speeds, you can activate as many cards that respond to the Summon/Attack in the chain responding to those actions.

Cards like "Bottomless Trap Hole" or "Sakuretsu Armor" do not have to be Chain Link 1 in order for them to be activated. You can technically activate 3 copies of "Bottomless Trap Hole" during the same Chain, even as Chain links 5, 6, and 9.

"Battle Fader" has the same timing as cards like "Mirror Force", "Sakuretsu Armor", and "Magic Cylinder". This means you have one opportunity to activate it, the initial chain in direct response to the attack declaration. If you allow the current chain to resolve ("Battle Fader" > "Royal Oppression"), you will not be able to activate a 2nd copy of "Battle Fader".
Unlike the other cards listed above, "Battle Fader" has a Trigger Effect, so you would be unable to activate multiple copies of "Battle Fader" in response to the same attack declaration.

If "Book of Moon" is used on an attacking monster, then that monster is no longer considered to be an attacking monster. Thus, if "Book of Moon" is Chained to an effect like "Dimensional Prison" or "Sakuretsu Armor" and changes the monster to face-down Defense Position, then the effect of "Sakuretsu Armor" does not resolves, so the attacking monster is not destroyed (or removed from play, and so on).

If something like "Enemy Controller" or "TG1-EM1" is Chained to something like "Sakuretsu Armor" or "Dimensional Prison" so that control of the attacking monster changes, then the effect of "Sakuretsu Armor" does not destroy the attacking monster.

If the effect of "Scrubbed Raid" is activated in Chain to an effect like "Sakuretsu Armor" or "Dimensional Prison", then the effect of "Sakuretsu Armor" is not applied, and the attacking monster remains on the field.

If the effect of "Scrubbed Raid" is activated in Chain to "Magic Cylinder", then the Battle Phase ends, so "Magic Cylinder" cannot negate the attack so the effect of inflicting damage equal to the monster's ATK is not applied.
The effect of "Mirror Force" only destroys all monsters in Attack Position, so all Attack Position monsters will still be destroyed even if the effect of "Scrubbed Raid" ends the Battle Phase.

name: Seismic Shockwave
desc: Destroy this card during your 3rd Standby Phase after activation. Activate this card when a face-up Dinosaur-Type monster you control is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard (except during the Damage Step): Choose 3 of your opponent's unused Spell & Trap Zones. Those Zones cannot be used. If this card destroys itself: You can target 1 Dinosaur-Type monster in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand.

name: Sinister Seeds
desc: When a monster you control is destroyed by a battle in which you took damage, and it was in face-up Attack Position at the start of the Damage Step and when it was destroyed: Special Summon 1 "Sinister Seed Token" (Plant-Type/DARK/Level 1/ATK 100/DEF 100) for every 500 points of battle damage you took from that battle.

name: Skill Drain
desc: Activate by paying 1000 LP. Negate the effects of all face-up monsters while they are face-up on the field (but their effects can still be activated).
rulings: If "Skill Drain" is active, then you also negate the effects of Flip Effect Monsters which were flipped to being face-up on the field. Also, if a face-down Flip Effect Monster is attacked and flipped by battle, then even if it is destroyed by battle, then it is still face-up on the field when its Flip Effect activates after Damage Calculation, so the effect will be negated by "Skill Drain".

The effect of "Skill Drain" only negates the effects of face-up monsters. Thus, effects that activate in the Graveyard - like the effects of "Sangan" or "Pyramid Turtle" - are not negated by "Skill Drain".

The effect of "Skill Drain" negates the effects of Effect Monsters; it does NOT prevent Effect Monsters from activating their effects. Thus, "Skill Drain" will not prevent you from activating the effects of "Exiled Force" or "Rescue Cat".

The effect of "Skill Drain" negates the effects of Effect Monsters that are face-up on the field. Thus, it cannot negate the effect of a monster if the monster is in the Graveyard when the monster's activated effect is resolving. "Exiled Force" and "Rescue Cat" Tributes itself or sends itself to the Graveyard as activation costs for their effects, so the monsters are in the Graveyard when their effects resolve. Thus, "Skill Drain" cannot negate their effects, so you will destroy the monster or Special Summon the Beast-Type monsters from your Deck.

If "Skill Drain" affects "Elemental HERO Neos Knight" after "Elemental HERO Neos Knight" increases its ATK by its own effect, then the ATK of "Elemental HERO Neos Knight" becomes the printed ATK of 2500. Afterwards, the ATK of "Elemental HERO Neos Knight" will remain at 2500 even if "Skill Drain" is removed from the field or if its effect is no longer applied.

Example: There is one Spell Counter on "Breaker the Magical Warrior" (1900 ATK / 1000 DEF). After "Inverse Universe" resolves, "Breaker the Magical Warrior" will have 1000 ATK / 1900 DEF. Afterwards, the ATK of "Breaker the Magical Warrior" will remain at 1000 ATK / 1900 DEF, even if Spell Counters are removed from or added to "Breaker the Magical Warrior". If "Skill Drain" is later activated, then "Breaker the Magical Warrior" will still remain at 1000 ATK / 1900 DEF.

name: Snake Deity's Command
desc: Activate by showing your opponent 1 "Venom" monster in your hand. Negate the activation and effect of an opponent's Spell Card, and destroy it.

name: Snake Whistle
desc: Activate only when a Reptile-Type monster you control is destroyed. Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Reptile-Type monster from your Deck.
rulings: This card cannot be activated during the Damage Step.

"Chaos Burst" first destroys the monster, and then inflicts damage - they do not occur simultaneously. Because of this, you cannot activate a card that can only activate when a monster is destroyed, like "Snake Whistle", after a monster is destroyed by "Chaos Burst".

name: Soul Demolition
desc: You can only activate this card's effect when you have a Fiend-Type monster on your side of the field. Pay 500 Life Points to use this effect. Both players select 1 Monster Card from their opponent's Graveyard. Remove the selected cards from play.
rulings: "Soul Demolition" can be activated at any time, except during the Damage Step.
The effect of "Soul Demolition" can be activated at any time, except during the Damage Step. (It can be activated in the same Chain Link as the activation of the card.)
Paying 500 Life Points is a cost to activate the effect of "Soul Demolition".

The effect of "Soul Demolition" targets 1 monster in both Graveyards. (It targets 2 monsters in total. The player who activated the effect of "Soul Demolition" targets 1 monster first, then the opponent targets the other monster.)
The effect of "Soul Demolition" cannot be activated unless both players have a monster in their Graveyard.

name: Soul Resurrection
desc: Activate this card by targeting 1 Normal Monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon it in Defense Position. When this card leaves the field, destroy that monster. When that monster is destroyed, destroy this card.

name: Soul Rope
desc: When a monster you control is destroyed by a card effect and sent to the Graveyard (except during the Damage Step): Pay 1000 LP; Special Summon 1 Level 4 monster from your Deck.
rulings: Paying 1000 Life Points is a cost.
You cannot activate this card during the Damage Step.

name: Soul Union
desc: Target 1 face-up monster on the field and 1 "Elemental HERO" monster in your GY; that target on the field gains ATK equal to the other target's ATK (until the end of this turn), then if you have an "Elemental HERO" Normal Monster in your field or GY (except during the Damage Step), you can Fusion Summon 1 "Elemental HERO" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by banishing its materials from your GY. You can only activate 1 "Soul Union" per turn.
rulings: [Regarding the effect "Target 1 face-up monster on the field and 1 "Elemental HERO" monster in your GY; that monster on the field gains ATK equal to the ATK of that other monster in the GY (until the end of this turn), then if an "Elemental HERO" Normal Monster is in your field or GY, you can apply the following effect. ● Fusion Summon 1 "Elemental HERO" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by banishing its materials from your GY."]
It can also be activated during the Damage Step, as long as it is from the start of the Damage Step to before damage calculation.

When resolving this effect, the targeted monster on the field gains ATK equal to the ATK of the targeted monster in the GY. If the monster successfully gains ATK and there is an "Elemental HERO" Normal Monster on your field or in your GY, you can then apply the "●" effect.
The ATK increase and the "●" effect do not occur simultaneously.
Once the targeted monster on the field is no longer face-up in the Monster Zone, its ATK is no longer increased.
If this card is activated during the Damage Step, the "●" effect cannot be applied.
[Regarding the "●" effect.]
When resolving this effect, banish the Fusion Monster's materials from your GY. Then, Fusion Summon the Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck.
Banishing and Special Summoning do not occur simultaneously.

name: Spell Shield Type-8
desc:
Activate 1 of these effects.
● When a Spell Card is activated that targets exactly 1 monster on the field: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.
● When a Spell Card is activated: Send 1 Spell Card from your hand to the Graveyard; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

name: Spirit Barrier
desc: While you control a monster, you take no battle damage.

name: Spirit Shield
desc: Once per battle, when an opponent's monster declares an attack: You can banish 1 Fiend or Zombie monster from your GY; negate that attack. Once per turn, when your opponent activates a card or effect that would destroy a card(s): You can banish 1 Fiend or Zombie monster from your GY; negate that activation. Once per turn, during the End Phase, if you do not control a Fiend or Zombie monster: Send this card to the GY.
rulings: You can activate this card in any of the following ways: Only activating the card itself, activating its first effect as the same Chain Link as the card's activation, or activating its second effect as the same Chain Link as the card's activation.
If you only activate the card itself, there are no additional activation requirements. However, it cannot be activated during the Damage Step.
If the conditions for activating this card's first effect have been met, you can activate its first effect as the same Chain Link as the card's activation.
If the conditions for activating this card's second effect have been met, you can activate its second effect as the same Chain Link as the card's activation.
[Regarding the effect "Once per battle, when an opponent's monster declares an attack: You can banish 1 Fiend or Zombie monster from your GY; negate the attack."
This effect starts a Chain and can be activated in the Spell & Trap Zone.
[Regarding the effect "Once per turn, when your opponent activates a card or effect that would destroy a card(s): You can banish 1 Fiend or Zombie monster from your GY; negate the activation."
This effect starts a Chain and can be activated in the Spell & Trap Zone.
It can be activated by chaining it directly to an opponent's effect that would destroy a card.
It can also be activated during the Damage Step.
[Regarding the effect "Once per turn, during the End Phase, if you do not control a Fiend or Zombie monster: Send this card to the GY."
This effect starts a Chain and can be activated while this card is face-up in the Spell & Trap Zone.
This effect must be activated during your or your opponent's End Phase if there are no face-up Fiend or Zombie monsters in your Monster Zone.

name: Spiritual Water Art - Aoi
desc: Tribute 1 WATER monster; look at your opponent's hand, then send 1 card from their hand to the Graveyard.

name: Statue of the Wicked
desc: When this face-down card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard, Special Summon 1 "Wicked Token" (Fiend-Type/DARK/Level 4/ATK 1000/DEF 1000) on your side of the field.
rulings: This card's effect can activate if it is destroyed during the Damage Step.

The text "cannot activate any Spell or Trap Cards" of "Ancient Gear Golem" means that the opponent cannot activate Quick-Play Spell Cards or Trap Cards from his hand or from face-down on the field. When "Ancient Gear Golem" attacks, your opponent may activate the effect of an "Ultimate Offering" which is already face-up on the field. Also, if "Ancient Gear Golem" attacks and a Set "Statue of the Wicked" is destroyed, then its effect will activate.

name: Staunch Defender
desc: You can only activate this card when your opponent declares an attack. Select 1 face-up monster on your side of the field. During this turn, your opponent can only designate the selected monster as an attack target and your opponent must attack the selected monster with all face-up monsters.
rulings: After "Staunch Defender" is activated, your opponent must attack with all monster that can declare attacks.
The effect of "Staunch Defender" targets one face-up monster you control.
When your opponent attacks a monster you control, you can activate "Staunch Defender" and target a different monster.

name: Stronghold the Moving Fortress
desc: Special Summon this card in Defense Position as an Effect Monster (Machine/EARTH/Level 4/ATK 0/DEF 2000). (This card is also still a Trap.) While you control "Green Gadget", "Red Gadget", and "Yellow Gadget", this card gains 3000 ATK.

name: Super Junior Confrontation
desc: Activate only when an opponent's monster declares an attack. Negate the battle, and 1 monster with the lowest ATK in face-up Attack Position your opponent controls battles against 1 monster with the lowest DEF in face-up Defense Position you control. After that battle, end the Battle Phase.

name: Survival Instinct
desc: Banish any number of Dinosaur-Type monsters from your Graveyard; gain 400 Life Points for each Dinosaur-Type monster banished to activate this card.

name: Synthetic Seraphim
desc: Each time a Counter Trap Card is activated, immediately after it resolves, Special Summon 1 "Synthetic Seraphim Token" (Fairy/LIGHT/Level 1/ATK 300/DEF 300).
rulings: The activation of the card "Synthetic Seraphim" can be performed at any time, except during the Damage Step.
Special Summoning 1 "Synthetic Seraphim Token" does not start a Chain Link.
This effect is applied immediately each time the activation of a Counter Trap Card resolves.
If "Synthetic Seraphim" is already face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone, then 1 "Synthetic Seraphim Token" is Special Summoned even if a Counter Trap Card is activated during the Damage Step.

The effect of "Synthetic Seraphim" is only applied when the activation of a Counter Trap Card resolves. If the effect of "Rebound" is activated from the Graveyard, since a Counter Trap Card was not activated, the effect of "Synthetic Seraphim" is not applied.

name: Taunt
desc: Activate only during your opponent's Main Phase 1; select 1 monster on your side of the field. While the selected card remains on the field, if your opponent attacks with a monster(s) this turn, they must select the selected monster as the attack target.
rulings: The effect of "Taunt" does not force your opponent to conduct their Battle Phase. Also, it does not force your opponent’s monsters to declare an attack. (Your opponent can end their turn without conducting their Battle Phase. Also, even if your opponent conducts their Battle Phase, your opponent can end their Battle Phase without declaring an attack.) If an opponent's monster declares an attack during the turn the effect of "Taunt" was applied, the attack target must be the monster targeted by "Taunt".

While you control both "Chu-Ske the Mouse Fighter" and "Monk Fighter", if "Taunt" is activated during your opponent's Main Phase 1 targeting "Chu-Ske the Mouse Fighter", then a second copy of "Taunt" can be activated during the same Main Phase targeting "Monk Fighter". In this case, the effects of both copies of "Taunt" are applied during this turn. When an opponent's monster declares an attack, the player who activated both copies of "Taunt" chooses whether "Chu-Ske the Mouse Fighter" or "Monk Fighter" become the attack target, and the attack is performed.

While you control both "Elemental HERO Terra Firma" and "Elemental HERO Heat", if "Taunt" is activated during your opponent's Main Phase 1 targeting "Elemental HERO Heat", then "Terra Firma Gravity" can still be activated during your opponent's Battle Phase. In this case, the effects of "Terra Firma Gravity" and "Taunt" are both applied during this turn. When an opponent's Level 4 or lower monster declares an attack, the player who activated "Terra Firma Gravity" and "Taunt" chooses whether "Elemental HERO Terra Firma" or "Elemental HERO Heat" become the attack target, and the attack is performed.

name: The Dragon's Bead
desc: Discard 1 card from your hand. Negate the effect of a Trap Card that targets 1 face-up Dragon-Type monster and destroy the Trap Card.
rulings: "The Dragon's Bead" can be activated at any time, except during the Damage Step.

The effect of "The Dragon's Bead" can be activated in a chain to the activation of a Trap Card that targeted a face-up Dragon-Type monster on the field. (It does not target. It cannot be activated during the Damage Step.)
The effect of "The Dragon's Bead" cannot be activated in a chain to the activation of the effect of a Trap Card.
"The Dragon's Bead" and its effect can be activated in the same Chain Link.
Discarding 1 card is a cost to activate the effect of "The Dragon's Bead".

"Double Snare" can destroy cards like "The Dragon's Bead", "Tyrant Dragon", "Fiend Skull Dragon", "Jinzo", "Royal Decree", and "Sorcerer of Dark Magic". It can target "Ryu Senshi", but "Double Snare" will be negated and destroyed.

name: The First Sarcophagus
desc: During each of your opponent's End Phases, place 1 card face-up on your side of the field from your hand or Deck in this order: "The Second Sarcophagus", "The Third Sarcophagus". If 1 Sarcophagus card is removed from your side of the field, all of them on your side of the field are sent to the Graveyard. When you have all 3 Sarcophagus cards on your side of the field, send all Sarcophagus cards on your side of the field to the Graveyard to Special Summon 1 "Spirit of the Pharaoh" from your hand or Deck.
rulings: The activation of the card "The First Sarcophagus" can be performed at any time, except during the Damage Step.

Its effect activates during each of your opponent End Phases, and each time it resolves, place 1 card in the order of "The Second Sarcophagus" and "The Third Sarcophagus" from your hand or Deck face-up on your field. After placing, if all the cards are placed on your field, send all of them to the Graveyard and Special Summon 1 "Spirit of the Pharaoh" from your hand or Deck.

The effect "If any of these cards, including this card, leaves your field, send all of them you control to the GY, including this card" does not start a Chain Link. (It is applied even during the Damage Step.)

name: The Forces of Darkness
desc: Target 2 "Dark World" monsters in your Graveyard; add those targets to your hand.
rulings: This card targets two "Dark World" monsters in your Graveyard.
If you do not have two legal targets in your Graveyard, you cannot activate this card.

If an effect like "D.D. Crow" or "Disappear" is Chained to "The Forces of Darkness" so that one of the targeted monsters is no longer in the Graveyard at resolution, then the remaining monster is still added to your hand.

name: The Grave of Enkindling
desc: You can only activate this card when a monster on your side of the field is destroyed as a result of battle and sent to the Graveyard. You and your opponent each select 1 monster from your respective Graveyards and Special Summon them in Defense Position. Neither monster Special Summoned by this card's effect can change its battle position while it is face-up on the field, except with a card effect.

name: Threatening Roar
desc: Your opponent cannot declare an attack this turn.

name: Toon Briefcase
desc: When your opponent Summons a monster(s) while you control a Toon monster: Shuffle that monster(s) into the Deck.

name: Toon Mask
desc: If you control "Toon World": Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; Special Summon 1 Toon monster from your hand or Deck, whose Level is less than or equal to the Level/Rank of that monster, ignoring its Summoning conditions.

name: Tour of Doom
desc: During your opponent's Standby Phase, toss a coin. ● Heads: Your opponent cannot Normal Summon or Flip Summon until the End Phase. ● Tails: You cannot Normal Summon or Flip Summon during your next turn.
rulings: The effect to toss a coin is an effect that makes a Chain Link during the Standby Phase.
In "● Heads: Your opponent cannot Normal Summon or Flip Summon until the End Phase", the text "until the End Phase" should read "until the end of the turn". (This is effective from July 10, 2014.)

name: Tragedy
desc: When a face-up Attack Position monster(s) your opponent controls is changed to face-up Defense Position: Destroy all Defense Position monsters your opponent controls.
rulings: Missing the timing: If a monster is changed to Defense Position in the middle of a chain, you cannot activate "Tragedy". To activate "Tragedy", the last thing to happen must be the monster changing to Defense Position.

name: Trap Jammer
desc: When your opponent activates a Trap Card during the Battle Phase: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

name: Treasure Map
desc: You can only activate this card in response to the activation of an effect that would return this card from the field to the hand. Draw 2 cards from your Deck and discard 1 card from your hand.
rulings: The effect does not target.
When a card effect such as "Giant Trunade" is activated that would return this Set card in the Spell & Trap Zone to hand, this card can be activated directly in Chain to that activation.
It cannot be activated during the Damage Step.
Drawing 2 cards and discarding 1 card are not considered to happen at the same time.

name: Triggered Summon
desc: Activate only when a monster is Special Summoned to your opponent's side of the field. Each player can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower monster from their hand.

name: Trojan Blast
desc: Activate only when an opponent's card effect shifts control of a monster from your side of the field to theirs. Destroy that 1 monster and inflict damage to your opponent equal to its ATK.
rulings: The effect of "Trojan Blast" targets 1 monster whose control was changed from you to the opponent.
This card cannot be activated during the Damage Step.
The damage inflicted is equal to the ATK the monster had while on the field.
If control of multiple monsters you controlled is changed to your opponent, this card can only affect 1 of those monsters.

name: Tyrant Wing
desc: Target 1 Dragon monster on the field; equip this card to it. It gains 400 ATK/DEF, also it can make up to 2 attacks on monsters during each Battle Phase. Once per turn, during the End Phase, if the monster equipped with this card by this effect attacked an opponent's monster this turn: Destroy this card.

name: Virus Cannon
desc: Tribute any number of monsters, except Tokens; your opponent sends an equal number of Spells from their Deck to the GY (or all their Spells, if lower than the number of Tributes).
rulings: Tributing monsters you control is a cost to activate this card.
This card does not target.
Your opponent chooses Spell Cards from their Deck and sends them to the Graveyard. The player who activated this card does not choose Spell Cards from the opponent's Deck.
This card cannot be activated during the Damage Step.

name: Volcanic Eruption
desc: During your End Phase, if you control "Jurassic World": Destroy all cards on the field.

name: Wonder Garage
desc: When this face-down card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard, you can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Machine-Type "roid" monster from your hand.

name: Zero Gravity
desc: Change the battle positions of all face-up monsters on the field.

name: Zoma the Spirit
desc: Special Summon this card in Defense Position as an Effect Monster (Zombie/DARK/Level 4/ATK 1800/DEF 500). (This card is also still a Trap.) If this card Summoned this way is destroyed by battle: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to the ATK of the monster that destroyed it.

name: The Winged Dragon of Ra - Immortal Phoenix
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned by its own effect. If "The Winged Dragon of Ra" is sent from the field to your GY while this card is in your GY: Special Summon this card. Cards and effects cannot be activated in response to this effect's activation. This card is unaffected by other cards' effects. You can pay 1000 LP; send 1 monster on the field to the GY. Once per turn, during the End Phase: Send this card to the GY, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "The Winged Dragon of Ra - Sphere Mode" from your hand, Deck, or GY, ignoring its Summoning conditions.
